title: Systemutvecklare Oracle
description:
Vill du ha en nyckelroll som systemutvecklare i driften och moderniseringen av system som säkrar Sveriges elförsörjning? Svenska Kraftnät befinner sig i en expansiv fas där vi bygger framtidens smarta elnät. Som en del av detta pågår just nu ett arbete med att modernisera vårt It-landskap.
   

  

 Svenska kraftnät är en nyckelaktör i energiomställningen och vår IT-division växer för att möjliggöra en fördubblad elproduktion och en fossilfri framtid. Med den senaste tekniken ökar vi både infrastrukturens kapacitet och utvecklingstakten inom digitalisering och processer.
   

  

**Om tjänsten**
 Vi söker dig som vill kombinera applikationsförvaltning med utveckling av plattformen och förflyttning till en modernare teknik.
   

  

 I den här rollen får du ett brett tekniskt helhetsansvar som sträcker sig från applikationskod till den underliggande infrastrukturen. Du kommer att arbeta med Mäster som är byggt på en Oracle-lösning där gränssnitt finns i Forms samt i WebLogic. Du konfigurerar miljöer, vidareutvecklar kritisk affärslogik och säkerställer en stabil drift. Vi håller just nu på att gå över från Solaris till Linux.
   

  

 Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:
   

  

* Förvaltning och utveckling av applikationen
* Aktivt deltagande i projekt för förflyttning av applikationen
* Vid behov konfigurering, drift och optimering av WebLogic i den nya Linuxmiljön
* Databasutveckling och programmering/felsökning i PL/SQL
* Säkerställa hög tillgänglighet, prestanda och säkerhet i gränslandet mellan applikation och operativsystem
* Vid behov använda skript och automatisering för att effektivisera processer och plattformsdrift


 Hos oss får du arbeta med ett samhällskritiskt uppdrag tillsammans med kollegor med hög teknisk kompetens och starkt samhällsengagemang.
   

  

 Vi erbjuder en trygg anställning inom staten med flexibla arbetsformer och goda möjligheter till kompetensutveckling.
   

  

**Om dig**

 Som person gillar du att lösa problem och har ett analytiskt tänk, men också en kreativ ådra som gör att du hittar nya vägar framåt. Du tar ansvar för ditt arbete, driver saker i mål och har ett strukturerat sätt att få saker gjorda.
   

  

 Du är en lagspelare som trivs med att samarbeta och dela kunskap med dina kollegor och har lätt för att kommunicera tydligt och enkelt. Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.
   

  

 Du ska också leva upp till den statliga värdegrunden.
   

  

 Vidare har du en eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT eller motsvarande relevant arbetslivserfarenhet. Du har också:
   

  

* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av databasutveckling i PL/SQL.

* Bakgrund inom branscher som elförsörjning, offentlig sektor, telekom, bank/finans eller läkemedel

title: AI-Utvecklare
description:
Vill du utveckla AI- och ML-tjänster som faktiskt går i produktion och gör verklig skillnad för människor och djur? Hos oss får du kombinera modern fullstackutveckling med avancerad AI, från NLP och chatbotar till bildigenkänning, i en miljö där du är med och formar både arkitektur och lösning.
   

  

 Om rollen
   

  

 Du blir en central del i ett team som bygger intelligenta tjänster ovanpå en modern Azure-plattform. Här jobbar du både med klassisk systemutveckling och hands-on AI-utveckling. Du rör dig obehindrat mellan backend i .NET, frontend i React och AI-komponenter i Python, och du är med hela vägen från idé och prototyp till produktion och vidare optimering.
   

  

 IT och affären jobbar nära tillsammans, vilket betyder att du snabbt ser effekten av det du bygger. Du samarbetar tätt med andra utvecklingsteam för att säkerställa att våra lösningar hänger ihop från frontend till backend – och att AI-funktionaliteten faktiskt används och skapar värde.
   

  

 Du kommer bland annat att:
   

  

* Bygga moderna frontend-lösningar med React, TypeScript och microfrontend-arkitektur
* Jobba testdrivet och bidra till hög kvalitet i koden
* Designa och implementera integrationer med både synkrona och asynkrona mönster
* Vara delaktig i mjukvaruarkitektur och tekniska vägval
* Bygga och optimera CI/CD-pipelines med Azure och Azure DevOps
* Automatisera miljöer och infrastruktur med Bicep
* Utveckla och implementera avancerade AI-lösningar med fokus på NLP, intelligenta system och bildigenkänning
* Bygga, integrera och optimera chatbotar och språkmodeller (inklusive generativ AI)


 För att lyckas i tjänsten tror vi att du har:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av generativ AI och av att ha deployat applikationer i produktion
* God kunskap av fullstack-utveckling med .NET och React
* Vana av testdriven eller testfokuserad utveckling
* Erfarenhet av integration mot synkrona och asynkrona gränssnitt/mönster
* Förståelse för mjukvaruarkitektur och hur man bygger skalbara lösningar
* Erfarenhet av att bygga CI/CD-pipelines med Azure som målplattform
* Kunskaper i Bicep
* Flytande i både svenska och engelska


 Som person är du drivande och resultatfokuserad, med en stark nyfikenhet på ny teknik. Du kan växla mellan att arbeta självständigt och i team, och du har ett gott självledarskap. Du håller ordning och reda, dokumenterar på en lagom nivå och bidrar till en kultur där man delar kunskap, utmanar gamla sanningar och tillsammans bygger smartare lösningar.
   

  

**Kontaktuppgifter:**
 Rekryterande chef: Poja Daroui, poja.daroui@agria.se
   

  

 Facklig representant Forena: Mirek Swartz, mirek.swartz@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

 Facklig representant Akademikerföreningen: Ellinor Jatéus, ellinor.jateus@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

*Låter det spännande? Då vill vi veta mer om dig! Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag. Vi arbetar löpande med denna rekrytering och kan komma att tillsätta tjänsten innan sista ansökningsdag.*
 Agria är ett helägt dotterbolag till Länsförsäkringar och finns idag i Sverige, Norge, Finland, Danmark, Storbritannien, Tyskland, Frankrike och Irland. Vårt svenska kontor ligger på Gärdet i Stockholm, men vårt hjärta och verksamhet sträcker sig långt utanför Sveriges gränser. Med en tydlig tillväxt agenda fortsätter vi att expandera internationellt, driva innovation och utveckla digitala lösningar som gör verklig skillnad för djurägare. Ett exempel är vårt dotterbolag Agria Vet Guide, som erbjuder digital rådgivning och gör det enklare att hjälpa fler djur snabbare.
   

  

 Vi är marknadsledande i Norden inom djur- och husdjursförsäkringar, med en tydlig vision: att bli Europas mest omtyckta och pålitliga partner för djurägare. Vårt ledarskap handlar inte bara om marknadsandelar; det handlar om att skapa trygghet för både djur och människor, och att göra livet med djur enklare och roligare.

title: Insurance Systems Engineer
description:
**Summary** 



  


 We're looking for our first dedicated engineer for the insurance team - someone who wants to own the technical infrastructure behind how we price, analyze, and build insurance products. You'll build a truly great pricing engine, one that puts Lassie at the absolute top of the industry from a pricing perspective, and equip the insurance team with AI-powered analysis tooling and agents so they can move fast on pricing analysis and actuarial work without waiting on tech. Working closely with our tech team, you'll also contribute to projects across our insurance products more broadly - and to building something exceptional.
 


  


**About Lassie** 



  


 Pet parents have been stuck for too long with slow claims, confusing policies, and providers that treat their pet like a policy number instead of a member of the family. Lassie is the opposite: the go-to platform for managing every part of pet parenthood - health, insurance, payments, products, services and community - built around the pet and the people who love them. We've raised $75M in Series C, we're live in Sweden, Germany, France and the UK, and we're just getting started.
 


  


 As a fast-growing scale-up, we hold ourselves to a high bar when it comes to our work: real ownership, fast execution, and decisions made like the business depends on them, because it does. Three values shape how we work:
 


  

  
* Speed Machine - we move fast while others hesitate
  
* Packed with Passion - we care deeply about our work and the pet parents we do it for
  
* Copied Since 2021 - we don't follow trends, we create them.
  



  




  


 We look for people who already work this way: people who care deeply, deliver fast, and want to help set the standard the rest of the industry ends up following.
 


  


**Tasks** 



  

  
* Own the pricing engine end to end: architecture, development, deployment, optimisation and maintenance
  
* Build AI-powered analysis tooling and agents that let the insurance team move faster on pricing analysis and actuarial work, without waiting on tech
  
* Build, improve and maintain high-frequency price updates, along with the monitoring and testing that let pricing changes ship fast with confidence, not risk
  
* Act as the technical counterpart to our tech team from within the insurance team
  
* Be scrappy and hands-on with whatever the work needs
  
* Help set the bar for insurance engineering quality and how insurance engineering works at Lassie
  



  




  


**Requirements** 



  

  
* 5+ years of experience as a developer, with a track record of owning systems end to end
  
* Strong hands-on experience with Python and/or TypeScript, and comfortable working with data stores and warehouses like MongoDB and BigQuery
  
* Fluent in English, both speaking and writing
  
* Self-starter with strong problem-solving skills
  
* Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment
  
* Genuine analytical interest and drive for optimising pricing and winning customers
  
* High ability for shipping and learning extraordinarily quickly
  
* You take ownership without waiting to be told. You see what needs fixing and you fix it
  
* Bonus: Experience with AWS
  



  




  


 Work-model: This role is based in Stockholm, where we work 3 days per week at the office.

title: Software Engineer
description:
*Vill du göra samhällsnytta och bidra till Sveriges oberoende i världen? Vi söker dig som är skarp och tekniskt intresserad, och som vill utvecklas och bli ständigt bättre. Du är alltid hungrig på nya kunskaper och vill använda din dyrbara tid till att göra Sverige tryggare. På FRA arbetar vi med unika uppgifter – för Sveriges säkerhet och integritet.*
 Ditt uppdrag
   

  

 I rollen som Software Engineer utvecklar och underhåller du lösningar som hanterar stora mängder data och utvinner och förädlar de relevanta delarna till efterföljande system för användning i verksamhetens underrättelseproduktion och cybersäkerhetsarbete. Världen förändras och så även de data som behövs i vårt arbete för att skydda vår demokrati. Därför sker kontinuerlig utveckling i takt med att nya krav uppstår.
   

  

 Du kommer att ingå i ett team med helhetsansvar för sina system. Teamet arbetar agilt med utveckling och drift, med stort ansvar och mandat i det dagliga arbetet i samarbete med den strategiska ledningen utifrån verksamhetens behov och prioriteringar. Teamet har ett nära samarbete med andra delar inom produktionen av underrättelseinformation, både med slutanvändare (analytiker) och andra tekniska team.
   

  

 I teamen ansvarar ni för att bygga helt nya produktionsmiljöer och förmågor, men även för att underhålla och automatisera befintliga produkter. Systemen är en blandning av open source, egenutvecklade samt externa produkter. Ni deltar i design, arkitekturval, implementation, testning, driftsättning, underhåll och avveckling/migrering av dessa produkter, det vill säga hela livscykeln.
   

  

 Teamet ingår i en enhet med två team som har fokus huvudsakligen på systemutveckling/förmågeutveckling respektive systemintegration mot plattformar/nät, för system som hanterar stora mängder data till underrättelseproduktionen och cybersäkerhetsarbetet. Rollen som Software Engineer kan placeras i ettdera av de två teamen, beroende på kunskap, erfarenhet och intresse. Även om tyngdpunkten kan variera mellan och inom teamen är arbete med infrastruktur grundläggande i vår verksamhet. Om du inte redan har mycket goda kunskaper och erfarenheter inom detta område behöver du vara intresserad av komma dit.
   

  

 Vi strävar alltid efter att våra medarbetare ska trivas och utvecklas. Vi ser det som en förutsättning för teamets effektivitet. I teamet uppmuntrar vi kreativitet och nytänkande. Vi har kompetensmässigt djup och bredd, och samarbetet i gruppen är starkt. Via utbildningar, konferenser och egen omvärldsbevakning håller vi oss uppdaterade på den senaste tekniken. Tillsammans utvärderar vi och tar del av varandras insikter.
   

  

 Du kan
   

  

**Vi Söker Dig Som Har**
* Civilingenjör/högskoleingenjör inom datateknik eller liknande område, alternativt förvärvat motsvarande kompetens genom arbetslivserfarenhet
* Goda kunskaper i arbete i Linuxmiljö, exempelvis administration, konfiguration, integration, automatisering och systemutveckling
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skift


 För Oss Är Det Viktigt Att Du Är Nyfiken, Ödmjuk Och Har Ett Driv Att Lära Dig Nya Saker. Det Är Även Meriterande För Tjänsten Om Du Har Erfarenhet Från Ett Eller Flera Av Följande Områden Som Du Kan Komma i Kontakt Med i Olika Utsträckning
   

  

* Programmering för systemautomation i Linuxmiljöer (t.ex. Bash/shellscript, Python, Go)
* Hårdvarunära programmering på Linuxservrar (primärt C++, men även Rust)
* DPDK/XDP
* Kubernetes (t.ex. RKE2)
* Containerteknologi (t.ex. Docker, Podman)
* Infrastructure as Code (t.ex. Ansible, Puppet)
* GitOps och att arbeta automatiserat mot repon (t.ex. ArgoCD)
* Nätverk (t.ex. DNS, routning, brandväggar, IP-protokoll, Snort/Suricata)
* Övervakning och metrik (te.x Grafana/Prometheus, Kibana/Elasticsearch, Nagios/Checkmk)
* Fysisk serverhårdvara
* Stora dataflöden (t.ex. olika message buses eller Apache NiFi)


 Du är
   

  

 Vi Kommer Att Lägga Stor Vikt Vid Dina Personliga Egenskaper, Och Söker Dig Som Känner Igen Dig i Följande Egenskaper
   

  

* Samarbetsförmåga – Du arbetar bra med andra människor. Du relaterar till dem på ett lyhört och smidigt sätt och lyssnar, kommunicerar och löser konflikter på ett konstruktivt sätt.
* Självgående – Du tar ansvar för din uppgift, strukturerar själv ditt angreppssätt och driver dina processer vidare.
* Mål- och resultatorienterad – Du arbetar mot mål och fokuserar på resultat. Du styrs av mål- och resultattänkande i prioriteringar, planering och agerande och förändrar din inriktning när målen ändrar sig.
* Problemlösande analysförmåga – Du arbetar bra med komplexa frågor och använder kreativitet för att hitta nya angreppssätt. Analyserar och bryter ner problem i sina beståndsdelar och löser komplicerade problem.


 Mer information
   

  

 Arbetsplatsen är belägen i närheten av Drottningholm, ca 10 min från Brommaplan. Svenskt medborgarskap är ett krav då anställning vid FRA innebär placering i säkerhetsklass. Före en anställning kommer du att säkerhetsprövas i enlighet med säkerhetsskyddslagens bestämmelser. Med anställning följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras. Vi tillämpar sex månaders provanställning. I denna rekryteringsprocess kommer arbetsprov/tester att tillämpas. För mer information är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef på rekrytering@fra.se. Fackliga företrädare nås på
 **010-557 46 00** 
 .
   

  

 Vi tar emot ansökningar via www.fra.se
 **senast 2026-10-18.**
 Referensnummer
 **2026FRA1420-2.**
 Då vi inför denna rekrytering redan tagit ställning till de rekryteringskanaler vi önskar använda undanber vi oss att bli kontaktade för ytterligare erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp.
   

  

 Sökord
 *: Linux, RHEL, infrastruktur, infrastructure, Bash, shellscript, Python, Go, GitOps, Kubernetes, Docker, Podman, nätverk, network, server, serverhårdvara, automation, automatisering, Ansible, C++, Rust, Go, systemutvecklare, systemadministratör, systemintegratör*

title: Cloud Data Engineer – GCP, Data Platforms & Automation | SEB, Solna
description:
Do you enjoy building reliable cloud data solutions and finding smarter ways to work? Join our Data, Analytics and Reporting team to develop our GCP data platform, automate manual processes and turn promising AI use cases into practical solutions.
   

  

 SEB is a technology-driven financial institution where customer needs and business outcomes guide how we work. We offer opportunities to solve meaningful engineering challenges alongside skilled and supportive colleagues.
   

  

 SEB is more than a bank. We are a technology-driven financial institution where everything starts from our customer needs and business outcomes. AI, data and modern engineering are natural parts of how we work, build and deliver value. From core banking platforms to agentic AI , automation, cybersecurity and cloud, we offer a broad tech landscape and many paths to grow. Together, we are shaping secure, responsible and future- proof solutions for our customers and society. Are you ready to take on a new challenge?
   

  

**About The Role**
 We build and operate a GCP data platform supporting reporting and analytics, often driven by legal and regulatory requirements. We also enable other teams to develop and publish business data products within our domain.
   

  

 Our responsibilities cover the full lifecycle of our solutions: application code, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, access configuration, monitoring and production troubleshooting. You will contribute across these areas and take ownership of your deliveries from design through ongoing operation.
   

  

 Alongside our core platform work, we have AI use cases to develop and many opportunities to improve how we build, operate and support our data solutions. We are looking for someone curious and proactive who can recognise these opportunities, challenge inefficient processes and help turn ideas into useful, maintainable solutions. You will have room to explore and contribute in this area as part of a broader cloud and data engineering role.
   

  

 You will work closely with engineers, business stakeholders and our Product Owner to understand requirements, make technical decisions and improve the platform.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

* Design, build and maintain data pipelines covering ingestion, orchestration, transformation and delivery to consumers.
* Provision and maintain cloud infrastructure using Terraform and reusable infrastructure components.
* Develop and improve CI/CD pipelines, automated checks and deployment practices.
* Investigate production issues across pipelines, infrastructure and service dependencies, and implement improvements to prevent recurrence.
* Build monitoring, alerting and data quality controls that make failures and delays visible and actionable.
* Develop reusable Python components and engineering patterns that simplify maintenance and support other teams.
* Apply appropriate access controls and data governance practices.
* Collaborate on solution design, contribute to PI planning and help onboard new teams and consumers.
* Identify opportunities to simplify manual work and improve platform operations and user workflows through automation.
* Help develop and evaluate AI use cases, choosing approaches that fit the problem and integrating useful solutions into our existing workflows.


 Our stack includes Python, SQL, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, Composer/Airflow, Dataform, Terraform and Git-based CI/CD.
   

  

 To thrive in this role, we believe you have
   

  

 You have several years of relevant software, cloud or data engineering experience and can independently take a delivery from requirements to production, while collaborating on wider platform decisions.
   

  

 We would like you to bring:
   

  

* Strong Python and SQL skills, with experience writing maintainable code and appropriate automated tests.
* Practical experience building and operating production data pipelines, including investigating failures and implementing lasting fixes.
* Hands-on cloud infrastructure experience, preferably on GCP, with an understanding of service configuration, dependencies and access controls.
* Infrastructure as Code experience, preferably Terraform, including maintaining and troubleshooting existing infrastructure.
* Experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and working with Git, pull requests and code reviews.
* Experience with orchestration tools, such as Airflow, including scheduling, dependencies, retries and troubleshooting.
* An understanding of data architecture and modelling, including how data is prepared and exposed for reporting and analytics.
* Experience with monitoring, logging and data quality controls for production solutions.
* An improvement mindset: you question repetitive work, look for opportunities to automate and take initiative to turn ideas into practical improvements.
* An interest in applying AI to engineering and business problems, with a willingness to experiment and assess whether a solution delivers useful results.
* A collaborative approach and the ability to explain technical decisions and trade-offs clearly.


 You do not need experience with every tool in our stack. We value sound engineering judgement, practical ownership and the ability to learn and transfer knowledge between technologies.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Databases SRE | Sweden | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

 We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
   

  

 You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
   

  

 This is a remote opportunity and we are looking for candidates from the UK, Sweden, Spain or Germany.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Grafana Cloud runs Mimir, Loki, Tempo and Pyroscope as multi-tenant SaaS databases across AWS, GCP and Azure in regions worldwide. Our highest-SLA customers depend on them to run their businesses. We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer to keep these systems reliable at scale.
   

  

 The role combines building and operating. You’ll write the software, automation and product changes that make our databases more reliable, including changes to the Mimir, Loki and Tempo codebases where reliability calls for it. You’ll also be on call for our highest-SLA customers and handle the operational work that comes with it. You’ll bring a production mindset to product engineering and engineering rigor to reliability, and you’ll set technical direction across squads.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Build reliability into the product. Write production code in our services, tooling and the Mimir, Loki and Tempo codebases that makes our databases more resilient, self-healing and scalable as demand grows quickly.
* Build automation and platform tooling that removes toil and scales our reliability practices across regions and cloud providers.
* Lead technical design. Author design docs, review others’ designs and PRs, and shape feature design so it’s scalable and operable from day one.
* Own the SLO framework. Define and evolve per-tenant SLOs and reliability models. Use SLO burn and incident learnings to find and fix the causes of failure in the systems themselves.
* Improve observability and alerting so we find problems before customers do, and so escalations are actionable rather than noisy.
* Be on call for our highest-SLA customers. Act as a technical escalation point for complex customer environments. Lead customer-impacting incident response, including customer bridge calls when needed, and write blameless post-incident reviews that lead to engineering fixes.
* Handle the operational work that comes from on-call. This includes investigating customer escalations, following up on incident actions, tuning capacity and configuration, and turning recurring issues into permanent fixes or automation.
* Multiply the team. Mentor engineers, teach reliability practices that teams adopt early in development, and work with engineering leadership on roadmaps and product strategy.
* We highly value those who are intellectually curious, who default to transparency, possess a high bias towards action, and who are also kind (this is important!)


**On-Call**
 Weekday on-call is 12-hour shifts, Monday to Friday, split between North America and Europe so you cover your local working hours. Weekends are covered by a separate 24-hour rotation. You’ll take a weekend roughly once every six to eight weeks.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
* 8+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time building and owning distributed systems in production.
* Strong production software skills, ideally in at least one object-oriented language. You write clean, tested code and can make targeted changes in large open-source codebases you didn’t write.
* Deep understanding of distributed systems: performance, scaling and failure modes. You can reason about how a system will break before it does.
* Experience running multi-tenant systems at scale on Kubernetes in AWS, GCP or Azure, with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, Helm or Jsonnet.
* Hands-on experience designing and implementing SLOs.
* Experience being on call for production systems. You troubleshoot calmly and methodically under pressure, and you’ve taken part in blameless incident response and written high-quality post-incident reviews.
* Staff-level technical leadership: driving cross-team projects, setting technical direction and making the engineers around you better.
* Working knowledge of Linux internals, networking and cloud storage.


**Nice To Have**
* Experience with Mimir, Loki, Tempo, Pyroscope, Prometheus or other observability and time-series databases.
* Open-source contributions.
* Customer reliability engineering (CRE) or customer-facing escalation experience.


 In Sweden, the Base compensation range for this role is SEK 878,578 - SEK 1,054,294. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed here.
   

  

* Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.


**Why You’ll Thrive At Grafana Labs**
* 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
* Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
* Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
* Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
* Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
* Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
* Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
* Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
* Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
* In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
* Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. \*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.


**Equal Opportunity Employer:** 
*Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.*
*Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.*
*For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.*

title: Data Engineer - Vitamin Well Group
description:
*Vitamin Well Group utvecklar funktionella premiumprodukter inom dryck, snacks och proteinprodukter, framtagna för en modern vardag och konsumtion på språng. I vår portfölj ingår Barebells, NOCCO, NÅBE, Tyngre och Vitamin Well. Med över 750 medarbetare och en omsättning på mer än 10 miljarder kronor finns vi på över 50 marknader, med huvudkontor i Stockholm samt lokala team och partners runt om i världen. Vår tillväxt drivs av att bygga starka varumärken, skapa produkter med kompromisslös smak och tydlig funktionalitet, samt att konsekvent höja nivån inom våra kategorier.*
 Bakom Vitamin Well Groups starka varumärken finns en internationell verksamhet där kraven på teknik, data och system fortsätter att växa. Det ställer höga krav på lösningarna bakom – och på människorna som utvecklar dem. På Vitamin Well Group är IT mer än en supportfunktion. Vårt globala IT-team spelar en central roll i att utveckla och säkerställa de tekniska lösningar som behövs. Därför söker vi nu en
 **Data Engineer** 
 som vill ta ett tydligt tekniskt ansvar och vara med att säkerställa högpresterande system.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som
 **Data Engineer** 
 arbetar du med att utveckla, förvalta och optimera våra databaslösningar, med höga krav på prestanda, stabilitet och skalbarhet. Här får du möjligheten att både arbeta med tekniken - men också ta ansvar för den. Du kommer ha ägandeskap för delar av vår systemmiljö, där SQL Server är en central del och där vi även arbetar med lösningar som Softadmin, Anaplan och Microsoft Fabric. Du samarbetar med utvecklare och kollegor från olika delar av organisationen för att omsätta affärsbehov till tekniska lösningar, identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och driva utvecklingen framåt.
   

  

**Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:**
* Utveckla, förvalta och optimera databaser för att hantera växande datavolymer och komplexa flöden.
* Arbeta med molnbaserade lösningar och integrationer för att säkerställa skalbara och högpresterande system.
* Omsätta affärsbehov och tekniska krav till lösningar i samarbete med utvecklare och andra delar av verksamheten.
* Identifiera och lösa flaskhalsar, förbättra prestanda och bidra till vidareutvecklingen av vår systemmiljö.


**Vem är du**
 Du har flera års erfarenhet av databasutveckling och vet att en lösning som fungerar inte alltid är en lösning som håller. Du gillar att förstå systemen på djupet, hitta orsaken bakom problemen och göra förbättringar som faktiskt märks. Du är analytisk och strukturerad, tar ansvar för ditt arbete och driver lösningar framåt även när utmaningarna är komplexa. Samtidigt vet du värdet av att samarbeta, dela kunskap och bygga lösningar som fungerar även utanför ditt eget ansvarsområde.
   

  

**Vi ser att du har:**
* Högskoleutbildning inom datateknik, systemvetenskap eller motsvarande.
* Flera års praktisk erfarenhet av T-SQL och Microsoft SQL Server.
* Erfarenhet av att designa och optimera databaser med höga krav på prestanda och skalbarhet.
* God kommunikativ förmåga och flytande kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.


**Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av något av följande:**
* Softadmin
* Anaplan
* Microsoft Fabric
* PySpark


**Ansökan**
*Sista ansökningsdag: 15e november 2026*
 Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdagen. Ett CV ger oss bäst underlag för utvärdering – komplettera gärna med LinkedIn, men låt det inte stå för sig själv.
   

  

**Att jobba hos oss**
 På Vitamin Well Group är vi övertygade om att en riktigt bra arbetsplats bidrar till riktigt bra produkter. Vi är över 750 medarbetare världen över, där alla spelar en viktig roll i hur vi bygger våra varumärken, utvecklar våra produkter och driver verksamheten framåt. Våra värderingar – innovation, courage, drive and responsibility – präglar vårt arbete tillsammans och hur vi gör affärer.
   

  

 Våra funktioner och marknader arbetar aktivt tillsammans med att bygga våra varumärken, utveckla våra produkter och erbjuda dem till konsumenter runt om i världen. Vi har en ”office first”-princip, eftersom vi tror att de bästa idéerna växer fram när människor möts, delar tankar, bygger relationer och tar ansvar.
   

  

 Att främja en aktiv livsstil är en del av vår kultur. Våra medarbetare kan delta i löpklubbar, gruppträningar och sportevenemang för olika intressen och träningsnivåer. I takt med att vi fortsätter växa vill vi bidra positivt genom att minska vårt miljöavtryck, främja aktiva och hälsosamma livsstilar och agera ansvarsfullt genom hela vår värdekedja.
   

  

*Som en del av rekryteringsprocessen kan vi komma att be dig genomföra ett personlighetstest samt ett test som mäter logisk slutledningsförmåga. Syftet med testerna är att på ett så objektivt sätt som möjligt utvärdera kandidater och identifiera bästa möjliga matchning mot rollen. Testerna är baserade på gedigen forskning och tas genom vår partner.*

title: Azure Data Engineer to Handelsbanken

**Your Team**

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
At Viaplay Group, we entertain millions of people every day through our streaming services, radio networks, and TV channels. We believe in the power of content not just as a way of telling stories and touching lives, but also expanding worlds.
   

  

 We’re looking for the best people to join us on our journey. Right now, we’re searching for a
 **Analytics Engineer** 
 in our
 **Stockholm** 
 office – are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change?
   

  

**The Role**
 As an Analytics Engineer at Viaplay Group, you will build and maintain data pipelines and models that support reporting and analytics across the business. You will take ownership of the pipelines feeding our BI system, ThoughtSpot, and create reliable, reusable tables for analysis. Working closely with analysts and business stakeholders, you will translate business needs into well-structured data that helps us understand user engagement, content performance, and our operations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Data Pipelines: Develop, maintain, and improve pipelines that deliver accurate and timely data to ThoughtSpot and analytical tables
* Data Modeling: Use SQL and dbt to transform source data into well-structured, reusable models with consistent business logic
* Development: Use Python to support data processing and automate recurring tasks across analytics workflows
* Data Quality: Build automated tests and validation checks to identify data issues and ensure reliable datasets for reporting and analytics
* Reliability and Performance: Monitor pipeline runs, investigate failures, and resolve data freshness and performance issues. Improve workflows as data volumes and business needs grow
* Collaboration: Work with analysts and business stakeholders to understand their needs, define data requirements, and deliver datasets that answer relevant business questions
* Documentation: Document data models, business definitions, and pipeline dependencies so colleagues can understand, use, and maintain the data.


**What We’re Looking For**
 We are looking for someone who enjoys building reliable data solutions, takes ownership of their work, and collaborates well with others. We understand you may feel confident ticking certain boxes more than others and that’s why we always keep an open mind in our recruitment process. But, in order to thrive in this role, we do believe you’ll have some experience in the following:
   

  

* Practical experience with SQL, including writing and maintaining queries for data transformation and modeling
* Hands-on experience with dbt for building and maintaining data transformation models
* Experience using Python for data processing or automation
* An understanding of data modeling and how to structure tables for BI reporting and data analytics
* A structured approach to data quality, with the ability to investigate issues and develop reliable solutions
* A proactive approach to problem-solving and an interest in making data pipelines easier to maintain and scale
* Strong collaboration and communication skills, including the ability to translate business needs into data requirements and explain technical concepts clearly


**It’s a bonus if you have:** 
  

  

* Experience working with Databricks
* Background in the streaming or media industry


 What we offer you
   

  

* We’ve got you covered! 30 days of paid vacation every year, an attractive pension and insurance scheme, and generous parental leave pay lift.
* Your wellbeing matters. We provide you with various wellbeing initiatives including wellness allowance.
* Flexibility that works. We follow a hybrid model with at least three days a week in the office, giving you the best mix of collaboration and focus time.
* A safe space to grow and up-skill. Our learning culture puts you in the driver’s seat of your own development.
* An innovative environment with Hack Days once a year. This week-long initiative allows you to think outside the box and deliver creative, technical solutions that (more often than not) go on to be implemented, either in our product or our ways of working.
* Entertainment is what we love, and entertainment is what we do. So, unlimited access to Viaplay seems only fair for you to get to know the product – including serier & viewing events, new release movie rentals, linear channels and more.


**Hit play today**
 If this feels like your kind of challenge, make sure you apply by attaching your CV here – you may also want to add your LinkedIn profile. Please don’t send us your application via email because we won’t be able to accept it. We do, however, welcome any questions you may have about this particular position.
   

  

 Want to learn more about who we are and what we do? Check out our careers page or follow us on Instagram! We’re only ever a few clicks away.

title: Data Engineer
description:
*We're Tibber - the energy company that wants you to use less energy.*
*When you join Tibber, you'll be part of building the tech that creates a real shift in how people consume electricity - good for our users, their wallets and the planet. We believe AI is how we accelerate that shift, and it's our people who lead it. The more we lean into AI, the more human judgment, curiosity and creativity matter.*
*We’re looking for a Data Engineer to join us in making the energy transition happen – maybe that’s you?*
**Job Mission 🚀**
 In the Data team at Tibber, you’ll be a vital part of Tibber’s mission to empower the clever, using data and technology to make it easier for our customers to make smarter energy choices.
   

  

 We’re already well ahead with agentic analytics. Our AI agents have answered thousands of questions from colleagues, with grounded answers built on our certified data. We also deliver analytical insights straight to our customers.
   

  

 As a
 **Data Engineer** 
 , you’ll take this further. You’ll shape how Tibber’s analytical data is modelled, governed and delivered so that employees, internal agents and customers can all trust the answers they get.
   

  

**What You'll Do ✅**
* Build agentic framework for data analysis that let colleagues ask questions in plain language and get correct, well-grounded answers.
* Serve analytical data to employees internal agents and external customers through well-defined interfaces (semantic layers, APIs and MCP servers), with the right access controls in place.
* Build and maintain scalable, robust, and efficient data pipelines in a modern cloud environment, ensuring our platform reliably supports growing data demands.
* Design and develop data ingestion and processing frameworks that streamline the flow of information, delivering timely and accurate data to power insights.
* Own and evolve the infrastructure behind our data platform, leveraging emerging technologies to bolster stability, performance, and cost-effectiveness.
* Lean in and take ownership beyond what’s asked. Solve problems at the source and scope your work with stakeholders, rather than waiting for a perfect brief
* Stay curious about the latest industry trends, offering ideas to refine architecture, scalability, and governance across diverse data use cases.
* Iterate and refine workflows based on stakeholder feedback, team insights, and the evolving requirements of a dynamic energy market.


**What We're Looking For⚡**
* Data Pipeline Expertise. A track record of 3+ years building ingestion and transformation frameworks that can handle large, fast-growing datasets with ease.
* APIs for Data Serving. Experience designing, building and running APIs that serve analytical data to applications, with attention to performance, reliability, versioning and authentication.
* DevOps Know-How. Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, and version control to ensure smooth, automated deployments and maintenance.
* Agents & LLMs. Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications or agents on top of data, including tool use, retrieval, evaluation and MCP. You have a sense for what makes an agent’s answer trustworthy.
* Data Modelling. Strong foundations in dimensional modelling, metric definitions and semantic layers. You design data models that are easy for both humans and agents to use correctly.
* Security & Compliance. Solid understanding of data privacy regulations, access control and best practices.
* Passion for Data Products. You love data, engineering and building great things together with others team.


**The Tibber Mindset 💆🏻‍♀️💆🏽‍♂️**
 Tibber exists to drive energy independence - away from fossil dependency. Our tech helps hundreds of thousands of households shift their electricity consumption to more sustainable and affordable hours, strengthening the resilience of the grid. Not in theory. In everyday life.
   

  

 Being on a mission to change an industry means being prepared for the unexpected. We do what others say can't be done - and we do it together. We win, fail and grow together, staying curious and pushing for better - every day. AI is shaping how we work - and we believe it's how we accelerate the energy transition. The more it becomes part of how we operate, the more our Tibberinos matter.
   

  

 Started by two founders in 2016. Now 300+ Tibberinos across Stockholm, Berlin, Amsterdam, Oslo and Førde. Backed by Balderton Capital, Eight Roads Ventures, Founders Fund, Summa and Schibsted. Still just getting started.
   

  

 Diversity of thought fuels better products, so we welcome applicants of every background, identity and lived experience. Ready to be part of powering the energy transition? Apply below!

title: Data Scientist
description:
Nordnet redefined the financial world as the first digital bank in Europe. Now we are about to do it again—this time by putting AI at the heart of our strategy. You'll embark on a challenging journey alongside skillful teams of sharp and committed colleagues.
   

  

 We're searching for a Data Scientist to join Nordnet's AIR (AI & Research) function, working embedded within one of our cross-functional teams. Your mission: Bring the best possible AI capabilities to life as robust solutions, both internally and for our customers.
   

  

**The Setup**
 You'll be working in a full-stack team with different competencies and together tackle the full lifecycle—from exploring possibilities to deploying production features. Our technical foundation is Google Cloud Platform, where we've deployed internal and customer facing GenAI features. Now we're scaling what works and developing new capabilities.
   

  

 This is not a theoretical role; you're a builder and problem-solver who thrives on iteration. You'll report to our Data Science Manager while working daily with developers, analysts and designers.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Build and maintain production AI pipelines from experimentation through deployment and monitoring.
   

  

 Collaborate with engineers throughout the development cycle—you'll work together on architecture and implementation in an iterative fashion.
   

  

 Drive quality through evaluation, metrics, and testing of AI solutions.
   

  

 Champion AI Governance - Ensure compliance with the bank's regulatory framework by clarifying AI concepts and risks
   

  

**This is you**
 You take pride in your work and are driven by curiosity—you want to continuously learn and grow.
   

  

**You Likely Have**
* Experience with LLMs, GenAI and agentic AI
* Python skills for both exploration and production code.
* SQL proficiency for data analysis and pipeline building.
* Knowledge of ML/AI evaluation, metrics, and best practices.
* Experience with ML/AI in cloud environments (GCP experience is a plus).


**We Also Get Excited If You Have**
* Experience working embedded.
* Comfort presenting technical work to diverse audiences.
* Interest in finance, investing, or personal finance.


 We think that you have 3+ years experience working as a Data Scientist, ML Engineer or AI Engineer with a University degree in data science, computer science, mathematics, engineering or similar field.
   

  

**We offer**
* Work in a product-focused environment with direct impact
* Growth opportunities as a data scientist in a fast-moving AI space
* Competitive salary and compensation


 You'll work in a Nordic environment with high ambitions and a strong focus on delivery, product development, and technology.

title: Rule Detection Engineer - SOC
description:
**About Us**
 We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.
   

  

 As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.
   

  

**About The Role**
*Are you ready to dive into the world of cybersecurity with a dynamic and impactful role? Join our Customer Delivery Unit team within Security Operations!*
 DNV Cyber is a leading cybersecurity services provider, formed by merging Nixu, Applied Risk and DNV in 2024. At DNV Cyber we take pride in safeguarding what’s critical to our customers and all of us as individuals – from personal data to industrial safety systems. We use our expertise and scale to tackle the most difficult cyber issues in multiple industries that are critical to society.
   

  

**The role in short**
 As a Detection Engineer, your primary responsibility will be developing and implementing advanced detection capabilities to bolster our clients' security defenses, for example by creating both logic-based and more sophisticated ML-based detection rules for Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) and Extended detection and response (XDR) products. Furthermore, you will participate in developing innovative tools and automated solutions to enhance the effectiveness of our SOC operations.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
 We are seeking a talented individual with previous experience working with security tools such as Microsoft Sentinel and XDR, Splunk, or similar technologies. Your experience is complemented by proficient skills in programming and query languages (e.g. Python and/or KQL).
   

  

 You will be working as part of a team of security professionals with the purpose of delivering high-end services to our clients. This requires customer communication and understanding on how to provide value in cyber security to our clients .
   

  

 Of course, a genuine passion for the cybersecurity field and an eagerness to learn are essential. We recognize your potential in specific areas that align with your expertise and contribute significantly to the team's success.
   

  

 #DNVCyber
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

 At DNV Cyber, we are passionate about cybersecurity and take pride in the way we are impacting the society we live in. We encourage you to excel professionally through knowledge sharing and demanding cases. At DNV Cyber, you'll have 500 colleagues who share an interest in cyber security with you. With us, you will be surrounded by the most talented people in the cybersecurity field
   

  

 Join us on an exciting adventure of growth, meaningful work, and shaping the future through cybersecurity!
   

  

 Visit our website to get to know more about us!
   

  

 DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
   

  

**About You**
**You have the following**
* Customer communication skills with ability to create customer value in the area of cyber security
* Experience with SIEM and XDR technologies such as Microsoft security stack. Experience with other similar SIEM and/or XDR systems is appreciated too
* Exposure to data engineering concepts (e.g. data collection, data lakes, ETLs, ML Ops, etc.) is appreciated
* Experience with at least one scripting and programming language (e.g. Python or Powershell) and/or experience in writing queries with a query language (e.g. KQL)
* Genuine Passion for Cybersecurity: While previous experience in cybersecurity is not mandatory, the candidate must demonstrate a genuine passion for the field and a strong interest in staying up to date with the latest trends and emerging threats
* Innovative Problem-Solving Skills, Adaptability and Collaboration is appreciated
* Fluent skills in English


**Desired But Not Required**
* Experience with Git-based CI/CD pipelines, IaC (Infrastructure as Code), and DaC (Detection as Code)
* Experience in working in or in cooperation with a Security Operation Center (SOC)


*Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country-specific laws and practices.*
