title: Business Analyst-On Premise
description:
Som
 **On Premise Business Analyst** 
 omvandlar du intern och extern data till handlingsbara insikter som förbättrar verksamhetens resultat och stödjer strategiskt beslutsfattande. Du bygger skalbara datamodeller och analyslösningar, minskar behovet av manuell rapportering och gör insikter mer lättillgängliga för verksamheten. Du rapporterar direkt till National On Premise Manager och arbetar nära stakeholders i hela organisationen för att säkerställa att data och insikter skapar verkligt affärsvärde.
   

  

 Tjänsten är placerad på vårt kontor i Stockholm. Vi arbetar med löpande urval, så skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Sista ansökningsdag är den
 **8e november.**
**De ansvarsområden som vi anförtror dig:**
**Dataanalys och modellering**
 Analysera stora mängder strukturerad och ostrukturerad data från både interna och externa källor. Utforma och dokumentera datapipelines, arbetsflöden och transformationer för att säkerställa datakvalitet, konsekvens och användbarhet. Äga och driva projekt inom täckningsplanering för säljkåren genom att kombinera interna och externa datakällor för att identifiera högpotentialskunder och outnyttjade affärsmöjligheter. Identifiera nya möjligheter att öka B2B-räckvidden genom nya grossist- och distributionspartners.
   

  

**Samarbete med stakeholders**
 Samarbeta med verksamheten kring definition, uppföljning och standardisering av KPI:er och rapportering. Omvandla affärsbehov och frågeställningar till datakrav och säkerställa att dataresurser möter verksamhetens behov. Fungera som en brygga mellan affärsverksamheten och tekniska funktioner såsom IT och Data Science.
   

  

**Datahantering**
 Sammanföra interna och externa datakällor till sammanhängande datamodeller anpassade efter verksamhetens behov. Bygga och underhålla semantiska lager som förenklar tillgången till data och möjliggör self-service-analys för verksamheten.
   

  

**Datadriven transformation**
 Stödja och bidra till utvecklingen av vision, roadmap och implementering av AI, Power BI och andra visualiseringsverktyg. Arbeta nära Insights-teamet och centrala stakeholders för att identifiera skalbara användningsområden som ökar effektiviteten, stärker beslutsfattandet och minskar beroendet av Excel-baserad rapportering och manuella analyser.
   

  

**Rapportering och datavisualisering**
 Använda verktyg som Power BI, Tableau och andra BI-plattformar för rapportering och visualisering. Hålla sig uppdaterad kring ny teknik och nya arbetssätt inom AI, dataanalys och FMCG.
   

  

**Dina tidigare erfarenheter Du kan visa prov på:**
* Minst 1-2 års erfarenhet inom programmering och AI-relaterade områden.
* En stark nyfikenhet och ett genuint intresse för att utveckla system, processer och verktyg samt hitta nya insikter genom data.
* Kunskaper inom Python, BI eller SQL, samt vilja och förmåga att utveckla kompetens inom övriga relevanta tekniker. Erfarenhet av Snowflake eller Databricks är meriterande.
* God dataförståelse och förmåga att strukturera och förbereda datamängder på ett sätt som möjliggör relevanta analyser och affärsinsikter.
* Stark kommunikativ förmåga och erfarenhet av stakeholder management på olika nivåer.
* Erfarenhet från FMCG-branschen i en data- eller analysorienterad roll är meriterande.


 Red Bull Sweden AB är en arbetsgivare som arbetar för lika möjligheter oavsett vem du är. Vi tror starkt på att olikheter och månfald är viktigt för vår fortsatta framgång. Besluten vi tar i våra rekryteringsprocesser baserar vi på dina erfarenheter och färdigheter och vi välkomnar alla ansökningar som representerar vårt samhälle, oavsett ålder, kön, funktionshinder, sexuell läggning, etnicitet, religion.

title: Head of Anti-Cheat
description:
As Head of Anti-Cheat at Embark, you will own how we keep THE FINALS, ARC Raiders and our future games fair. You lead a team of highly skilled security engineers, data scientists and ML engineers, and you report to our CTO. You set the direction, decide what we build, buy and partner on, and make sure players can trust both our games and what we tell them about cheating. You don't need to be the deepest technical expert in the room. You partner with strong tech leads, and you lead with product thinking, clear judgement and genuine care for your team.
   

  

**Example Of Responsibilities**
**Leadership & Team**
* Lead, coach and grow a team of senior specialists, and build an environment where they do the best work of their careers.
* Own hiring, team structure and headcount planning.
* Partner with the tech leads in game security, ML and data, who own the technical direction of their tracks.


**Strategy & Product**
* Own anti-cheat strategy and roadmap across all Embark games.
* Make build, buy, partner and stop decisions with technical input from your team.
* Set detection and evidence standards, and turn data into clear recommendations for game teams.
* Balance what players feel about cheating with what the data shows, and make both visible.


**Collaboration & Players**
* Work closely with game teams, who rely on your recommendations on enforcement.
* Own relationships with third-party anti-cheat partners, from integration to contract.
* Shape how we talk to players about cheating, together with our community and player support teams.


**We would love if you have**
* A creative and curious mind.
* Experience leading teams of senior technical specialists, with a record of building trust and stability.
* A hands-on background in security, data science/ML or backend engineering. You won't be coding, but you're at home in a design review.
* Experience in an adversarial domain such as anti-cheat, fraud, trust & safety, risk or abuse.
* Experience owning a product or outcome end to end, including strategy and partner decisions.
* Experience working with vendors and external partners.
* Comfort communicating with players or the public on sensitive topics.
* Bonus: experience from games or live services, ML-based detection, or kernel and client security.
* Professional English communication skills.


 At Embark we offer competitive salaries, passionate colleagues to share knowledge with and much more, but most of all we invite you to take part of a journey into the unknown, to build creative, surprising and beautiful experiences together.
   

  

 Be yourself at Embark and make games while doing so. Please apply with confidence. We can’t wait to hear from you (in English)!

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
description:
Senior Solutions Engineer – Sovos SOVOS
 **Senior Solutions Engineer**
 Sales Engineering
   

  

* Full-Time
* Europe


 Build Your Future With Us
   

  

 The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.
   

  

 We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.
   

  

 AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.
   

  

 Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 At Sovos, we're building a dedicated sales team from the ground up to support our growing portfolio of AI-native offerings, spanning financial orchestration, compliance automation, and intelligent invoicing. You'll be one of the first technical sellers on this team, joining at the foundation as we define the playbook together. This isn't a support role that ends with a good demo. You'll own technical opportunities end-to-end, configuring the platform to a client's real environment and building the technical proof points your Account Executive partner uses to close.
   

  

**More Specifically, You Will**
* Carry a quota tied to technical opportunity progression from discovery through close, owning the technical inputs (POC results, integration effort, system fit) that feed the ROI and TCO business case.
* Lead technical workshops and proofs of concept with clear success criteria, partnering with your AE to navigate objections, build urgency, and drive the opportunity to a decision.
* Configure the platform against a client's real data and workflows ahead of every demo, navigating model routing, APIs, integrations, data governance, and security with Engineering and IT.
* Translate technical solutions into ROI, TCO, and operational impact for Finance and executive stakeholders, moving seamlessly between architecture conversations and business-level discussions.
* Leverage AI tools to improve qualification, demo configuration, and business case development, staying engaged through kickoff and early delivery to maintain technical continuity with the Field Delivery Engineering team.
* Help shape the qualification criteria, demo approach, and business case format this team will use going forwards, bringing customer and market feedback back into how Sovos positions and packages its AI-native offerings.


 What You Bring to Sovos
   

  

* You've successfully led business process transformation or procurement optimization projects, ideally gained through consulting or working buyer-side, ideally with procurement or AP expertise gained from working buyer-side rather than solely in an advisory capacity.
* You have enough systems fluency to know where a client's data lives (SAP vs. Ariba vs. elsewhere) and how workflows cross systems; familiarity with AI gateways, model routing, or data governance is a strong plus.
* You bring direct quota-carrying or deal-closing ownership of the pre-sale cycle, not only demo or support experience, with a demonstrated ability to close complex B2B deals with clear revenue accountability, moving opportunities from technical discovery through contract signature and clear revenue accountability.
* You're comfortable moving between technical and executive conversations in the same day (sometimes the same meeting), building executive-level business cases that include ROI and TCO analyses.
* Comfort with AI-assisted workflows and automation or workflow platforms is important; experience selling AI infrastructure, applications, agents, workflow automation, or finance technology is preferred.
* Experience helping launch a new product or build an early go-to-market motion is preferred, as is experience at a consulting firm with a finance transformation or automation practice.
* Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.


 The Process
   

  

 We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect:
   

  

 1
   

  

 Pre-Employment Assessment
   

  

 Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot.
   

  

 2
   

  

 Video Interview
   

  

 A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume.
   

  

 3
   

  

 Meeting with a Recruiter
   

  

 A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals.
   

  

 4
   

  

 Live Interviews with the Hiring Team
   

  

 Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day-to-day of the role.
   

  

 Life at Sovos
   

  

 The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!
   

  

* Global Mentoring Programs
* AI Tools and Technology from Day 1
* Continuous Learning and Development
* Language Learning Support
* Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs
* Global Parental Leave Policy
* An opportunity to work with a global team
* Bi-Weekly Meeting Free Days!
* Mentoring Programs
* Globally recognised Training and Development programmes
* Competitive benefits package


**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, colour, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.
   

  

**Company Background**
 Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. Sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150+ countries.
   

  

 More than 100,000 customers – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos’ tax and regulatory expertise and unparalleled integration with their business applications. Learn more at sovos.com.
   

  

**Ready to make your move?**
 We'd love to hear from you. Use the Apply button at the top of this page to submit your application
   

  

 SOVOS © Sovos 2026. All rights reserved.

title: Product Verification & Test Rig Engineer - the Workshop Suite
description:
TRATON is a group of strong brands with a shared mission: transforming transportation together to create the future of sustainable transport solutions. Within TRATON, we include MAN, Scania, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International. As part of a global team of industry experts, you get to think bigger, experience more, and reach further. Together, we have the power to transform transportation - Let´s make a difference together. Find out more: www.traton.com
   

  

 Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do.
   

  

**Role Summary**
*This role is a part of TRATON Group R&D, located in Södertälje, Sweden*
 As a Product Verification & Test Rig Engineer, you will combine hands-on ownership of HIL and SIL test rigs with verification of the Workshop Suite (tWS) in physical trucks. You will ensure that the rigs are correctly built, configured, maintained and operational according to the needs of development and test teams. This includes installing and replacing ECUs and other rig-related hardware, performing software updates, configuring rigs and connected systems, and troubleshooting hardware, communication and integration issues. In addition to the rig responsibilities, you will verify tWS as a complete product in physical trucks, with particular focus on end-to-end quality, robustness, reliability and vehicle safety under realistic operating conditions.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Build, configure, commission and maintain HIL and SIL test rigs, including installation and replacement of ECUs and other rig-related hardware.
* Perform software updates and configure test rigs and connected systems with the required software, data and system settings, while maintaining documented software baselines and rig configurations.
* Troubleshoot rig hardware, communication interfaces and system integrations, and verify that HIL and SIL test rigs are operational and meet the agreed needs of development and test teams.
* Coordinate and administer rig-related work, including planning activities, prioritizing requests, following up on actions and aligning rig availability with the needs of development and test teams.
* Plan, design and execute end-to-end verification of tWS as a complete product in physical trucks, assessing its behavior and quality under realistic operating conditions.
* Assess the quality, robustness, stability, reliability and safety-related behavior of tWS; document deviations and support root cause investigations together with development teams.


**Who You Are**
 You are a hands-on and experienced test engineer who enjoys combining practical rig engineering with structured product verification. You have
 **at least 4 years of relevant professional experience** 
 in HIL/SIL test rig engineering, verification of software products in physical trucks, or closely related work.
   

  

  

* You have experience building, configuring, commissioning, maintaining and troubleshooting HIL and SIL test rigs, including ECU installation and replacement, software updates and configuration of connected systems.
* You understand vehicle electronic systems, ECU interactions, and the information exchange between the truck, ECUs, tWS and supporting systems. You can use this understanding to verify tWS as a complete product in a physical truck.
* You work systematically, take ownership and communicate clearly. You are comfortable collaborating across development and test teams, analyzing logs and system behavior, documenting rig configurations and deviations, and supporting technical issues through to resolution.
* You have at least a Class B driving license (preferable Class C)


*Experience supporting shared HIL and SIL test rigs and using test and defect management tools such as JIRA or Zephyr is advantageous.*
*We welcome applicants from all backgrounds – your unique experience and perspectives is valuable to us.*
**This Is Us**
 You will join Content Enablement & Verification, where the Verification area is responsible for end-to-end testing of the Workshop Suite. Our work covers both functional and non-functional testing, quality assurance and verification of tWS as a complete product. We also provide test tools and HIL and SIL test rigs that support efficient development and verification across the organization. We work cross-functionally and support other teams with test capabilities, technical expertise and shared solutions. Our work environment is hands-on and driven by innovation and sustainability.
   

  

*Within TRATON Group R&D, you are an important part of something bigger. Joining us means gaining access to the ins and outs of the entire transportation industry.*
**TRATON Offers**
 We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.
   

  

 With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, TRATON Group R&D supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.
   

  

 Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. We also arrange events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.
   

  

**Application**
 We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.
   

  

 Apply as soon as possible, no later than
 **2026-10-30** 
 . Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.
   

  

**If you have questions or would like more information, please contact:**
 Azam Roomi, Unit manager, azam.roomi@scania.com
   

  

**We look forward to your application!**

**About Us**
 Integrity360 is a leading independent cybersecurity and PCI specialist operating across Europe, Africa, the Caribbean, and North America. The company has office locations in Ireland, the UK, Bulgaria, Italy, Sweden, Spain, Lithuania, Ukraine, Africa, the Caribbean, and Canada, supported by seven Security Operations Centres (SOCs) located in Dublin, Sofia, Madrid, Stockholm, Rome, Johannesburg and Cape Town.
   

  

 With over 780 employees, including more than 585 dedicated cybersecurity professionals, Integrity360 delivers a full suite of professional, support, and managed security services. These span the complete cyber risk lifecycle, from identification and prevention to detection, response, and recovery. Integrity360 supports over 3000 mid-market and enterprise organisations across sectors including financial services, insurance, government, healthcare, retail, telecommunications, and utilities.
   

  

 At Integrity360, people come first. We invest heavily in learning, development and progression, fostering a dynamic culture where innovation, collaboration and continuous growth are at the heart of what we do. If you're ready to take your cyber security career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 Job Role / Responsibilities
   

  

 We Are Building An OT Cybersecurity Capability In Sweden And Need a Versatile Consultant With Both Advisory And Technical Exposure. As Part Of The OT Security Practice And Localized With The Swedish Team In Stockholm
   

  

* Working on industrial environment including ICS, SCADA, and critical infrastructure
* Assisting our clients in securing their information systems (defining target objectives, developing action plans, implementing actions (organizational or technical), coordination, monitoring and managing these plans)
* Assessing our clients' cybersecurity posture against current norms and regulations (ISO 27001, NIS 2, IEC 62443, Cyber Resilience Act...) and through cybersecurity risk analysis (ISO 27005 / EBIOS RM)
* Integrating cybersecurity into our clients' projects
* Supporting our clients' CISOs in their daily activities: defining cybersecurity processes, drafting policies and documentation, conducting awareness sessions, organizing cyber crisis exercises, animating the client's cyber community
* Contributing to design and implementation of OT security architectures
* Leading or deploying cybersecurity solutions specific to industrial environments.
* We work under fixed-price projects and/or in Time and Material mode. The duration of assignments depends on client needs, topics, and consultant aspirations – ranging from a few days to several months.
* Our clients vary widely: large enterprises and SMEs, across private and public sectors – industry, energy, luxury, maritime, transportation, institutions... in France and Worldwide.


**Hard Skills Required**
* You have a solid understanding of security concepts (CIA triad, vulnerability, risk, threat…)
* You have a technical mindset and understand core security components, their principles: systems and networks, security devices (firewalls, AV/EDR, VPN...), , network segmentation
* Good understanding of industrial/OT environments (SCADA, ICS, PLCs, industrial networks…).
* Experience in OT is a strong advantage – it's our specialty
* Exposure to OT security tools is a plus
* You master risk analysis methodologies (ISO 27005, EBIOS RM). Even better if you’re certified!
* You're curious and have already read cybersecurity frameworks and methodologies (ISO27001/2, IEC 62443, ANSSI, NIS, NIST…)


**Soft Skills Required**
* Mindset is key: you’re motivated, dynamic, and autonomous
* You enjoy teamwork and value mutual support and customer service
* You know how to organize your activities, multitask, prioritize, and raise alerts when needed
* You have good writing skills, good spelling, and you're comfortable with Microsoft Office
* Fluent Swedish is mandatory
* You speak and write fluent English (you can understand conversations, lead meetings, and write reports…)


**Other Requirements**
* Master’s degree or equivalent
* Certifications such as IEC 62443, ISO27001/2/5, EBIOS EM, ISC2 are a plus!
* Driver's license (B), useful for some travel


**What We Offer**
 To support you, Integrity360 will assign a close reference manager who will follow your progress and skills development through coaching, internal training, and an annual external training that may be certifying!
   

  

 Life at Integrity360 is vibrant! You'll contribute to company life by joining a dynamic, motivated, and growing team. Activities include knowledge base enrichment, tool/method development, sharing experience feedback – and fun activities.

 Working At Voi Is More Than Just a Job; Our People Promise Includes a Personal Voyage Where You Will Grow As a Professional And Be a Part Of a Team And Culture That Builds Something Meaningful For Society. In Addition To This, You’ll Have The Opportunity To

* Join Europe’s #1 micromobility operator and one of the fastest-growing scale-ups.
* Help build agentic, knowledge and open-model infrastructure from the ground up.
* Work in a small, senior team with high trust, fast decisions and a clear mandate.
* Get “skin in the game” through our employee options programme.
* Enjoy unlimited free Voi rides and a dog-friendly office.
* Work together with inspiring, motivated and fun colleagues towards a common goal.
* Join the micromobility revolution and be a part of creating sustainable cities made for living, free from noise and pollution.


 Since 2018,
 **Voi** 
 has been on a mission to create safe, sustainable and reliable micromobility for everyone. Today we are the leading shared micromobility operator in Europe, with HQ in Stockholm (Sweden), operating 200,000+ vehicles in 130+ towns and cities across 13 countries, serving 8+ million riders with over 500+ MILLION rides to date, and we have no intention of stopping here! We believe that micromobility will play a central role in changing how people move in our towns and cities in the future and want to ensure that the micromobility transformation happens the right way - through real innovative technology, partnership and transparent dialogue with towns, cities and governments, and by adapting our products to the local needs. In addition to improving quality of life in cities around the world, we are contributing to the solution for climate change by making sustainable transportation options more widely available and promoting renewable energy use and circularity along our supply chain.
   

  

**Diversity Matters**
 As a Voiager, we offer you a friendly, collaborative and fast-paced workplace where you can bring your whole self to work, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability or sexual orientation - and welcome applications from whoever you are, including veterans, those actively serving as a Reservist and their partners. What is most important to us is how you treat others and what skills and value you bring to our team. We believe that having a wide diversity of people with different backgrounds and perspectives within Voi is essential to our success in delivering the best user experience to our equally diverse user base. With employees from over 50 nationalities working within Voi, we believe we have made good progress but know we can still do more - therefore we discourage any photos, personal letters, or disclosure of any information that concerns other information than your professional experience.

title: Senior React Native Developer
description:
**Who we are?**
 We Dibbers are passionate travel enthusiasts who want to make travel planning as easy as possible - a few clicks and you are ready to go! We have built a Swedish cutting-edge online platform to streamline and digitalize the travel experience for companies, individual travelers and wanderlust groups. We are an innovative team who moves the limits and who loves to celebrate success!
   

  

 We are thrilled to announce an exciting opportunity for a talented Senior React Native Developer to join our team in Stockholm! Our passion for travel is what drives us, and we are looking for someone who shares that same enthusiasm. If you're ready to join us on our quest to create a state-of-the-art platform and help people explore the world, let's connect and discuss how you can make a difference.
   

  

**Your role:**
 As a Senior React Native Developer, you will be responsible for building our React Native app from the ground up, with automated testing and CI/CD integrated from day one. This includes setting up automated builds and deployment pipelines for both the Apple App Store and Google Play. You will also plan and lead the migration from Flutter to React Native, take ownership of mobile releases, and work closely with frontend and backend engineers, as well as the Product team.
   

  

**What are we looking for?**
* 5+ years of professional software development experience, including at least 3 years working with React Native in production.
* Experience building a React Native app from scratch.
* Strong knowledge of TypeScript, React, and Expo/EAS or a similar build setup.
* Experience shipping and maintaining apps on both the Apple App Store and Google Play.
* Hands-on experience with automated testing and CI/CD pipelines for mobile applications.
* Fluency in English.


**Nice to have:**
* Experience with Flutter and Dart to help us transition from our current setup.
* Native iOS or Android development experience.
* Knowledge of Swedish.


**What’s awesome about working at DIB?**
* Be part of a rapidly growing company with the opportunity to influence the development of our platform.
* Hybrid working policy.
* A nice and social office in a great central location.
* We prioritize your growth and development, offering training and education opportunities.
* It is not our goal to box you in, on the contrary, it is to allow you to grow and self-improve through our performance management process. We have a well-organized career path, according to your professional ambition within our company.

title: SAP ABAP IS-U Developer
description:

 Customer Metering & Settlement Solutions, which is part of Customer IT that develops and operates specialized IT solutions based on SAP IS-U and SAP CRM supporting all Nordic business units in Vattenfall that have a customer relation.

 As an SAP ABAP Developer you are responsible to provide expertise to ensure that stable and reliable solutions are designed, developed, implemented and maintained and you will contribute to quality assurance activities to meet business needs.

 We believe that you have strong communicative skills and a creative and analytical mindset. You master English in both spoken and written format.  Additional Information

 Good remuneration, a challenging and international work environment, and the possibility to work with some of the best in the field.  At Vattenfall, we value being active, positive, open, and safety-conscious. We are looking for employees who share our vision and can contribute to strengthening our corporate culture.  Vattenfall is one of Europe’s largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Our main markets are Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK. title: Backend Engineer
description:
We're at a pivotal moment for both Tibber and the planet. When joining Tibber, you won’t just help scale a forward-thinking tech company – you’ll contribute to a real shift in how people consume electricity. With millions of smart devices connected to the Tibber platform (like electric vehicles and smart thermostats), we have one of the most unique portfolios trading energy on the market.
 



  





*We’re looking for a We're looking for a Backend Engineer o join us - maybe that's you?* 




  





**Job Mission 🚀** 




 As a Backend Engineer, you'll play a key role in turning our trading models into robust, production-ready systems - helping Tibber trade smarter so we can pass better prices and a more reliable energy experience on to our customers. You'll work closely with our forecasting team, right where trading decisions meet real customer impact.
 



  





**What You'll Do ✅** 



* Build forecasts that support Tibber's trading operations
* Bridge model development and production-ready backend systems, working closely with the team building our ML models
* Support both our retail trading and flex trading domains
* Work hands-on with time series data
* Collaborate closely with traders who act on your systems' outputs daily



  





**What We're Looking For⚡** 




 You are driven by impact and know how to turn strategy into execution. You're used to fast-paced environments and thrive when given clear goals and high accountability. We believe you'll thrive here if you:
 


* Have strong Python skills and experience building backend systems in ML-heavy environments (production ML, not just notebooks)
* Have hands-on experience with time series data and forecasting
* Know how to move ML models from development into reliable, production-ready systems
* Are proactive and entrepreneurial, comfortable owning your work end-to-end in a small, high-impact team
* Communicate well with both technical peers and business stakeholders
* Have a background in energy, utilities, or financial markets, or experience with .NET — a plus, but not required
* Tibber becomes more AI-enabled and we embrace new tools and ways of working. You don't need to be an expert, but we believe you are motivated by that and excited to grow with it too



  





**The Tibber Mindset 💆🏻 ♀️💆🏽 ♂️** 




 Tibber exists to drive energy independence - away from fossil dependency. Our tech helps hundreds of thousands of households shift their electricity consumption to more sustainable and affordable hours - from electric vehicles to smart thermostats, all connected to the Tibber platform. We strengthen the resilience of the grid. Not in theory. In everyday life.
 



  





 We win, fail, and grow together, staying curious and pushing for better every day. AI is shaping how we work - and we're on a journey to make it central to everything we do. The further we go, the more our Tibberinos matter - and yes, that's what we call ourselves!
 



  





 Started by two founders in 2016. Now 300+ Tibberinos across Stockholm, Oslo, Berlin, Amsterdam, and Førde. And we're still just getting started.
 



  





 You're welcome at Tibber for who you are. We hire for what you can do and how you think - not your background or where you've been. Diverse teams build better products, and we mean that.

title: Salesforce Developer

title: Inhämtare/utvecklare vid Must till enheten för Teknisk Inhämtning
description:
**Vill du ha ett meningsfullt arbete och bidra till ett säkrare Sverige i en osäker värld?**
 Militära underrättelse- och säkerhetstjänsten (Must) söker nu en inhämtare/utvecklare till säkerhetsunderrättelseavdelningen. Du kommer arbeta inom området offensiv cyber och ha arbetsuppgifter med att utveckla egen mjukvara för insamling av information i vårt underrättelse- och utredningsverksamhet.
   

  

 Ett viktigt inslag i arbetsuppgifterna är omvärldsbevakning och kompetensutveckling inom eget verksamhetsområde och du kommer att ha stora möjligheter att påverka enhetens metodutveckling och du har själv möjlighet att styra över din tekniska arbetsmiljö.
   

  

 Du ska ha intresse för att utveckla egna tekniska lösningar för att upprätta god opsec och anonymitet för inhämtning inom cyberområdet.
   

  

**Om enheten**
 Säkerhetsunderrättelseavdelningen arbetar med att indikera, klarlägga och motverka säkerhetshotande verksamhet samt bedriva försvarsunderrättelseverksamhet kopplat till säkerhetshotande aktörer. Sektionen för teknisk inhämtning ansvarar för teknisk områdesexpertis vid säkerhetsunderrättelseoperationer- och utredningar.
   

  

**Personliga egenskaper**
 Vi sätter stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper och du som person ska vara företagsam och innovativ. Du arbetar självgående och driver ditt arbete framåt samt arbetar väl tillsammans i grupp mot gemensamma mål. Du är strukturerad, analytisk och resultatinriktad. Du drivs av att förstå hur saker hänger ihop och att lösa komplexa problem. Du har en hög personlig mognad, pålitlighet och integritet med hänsyn till arbetets natur.
   

  

 Tjänsten är placerad i säkerhetsklass och mycket stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet.
   

  

**Kvalifikationer**
* Erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling
* Erfarenhet av offensiv cyberverksamhet
* Erfarenhet av teknisk säkerhetsgranskning och sårbarhetsanalys
* Förståelse för säkerhetsmekanismer i moderna operativsystem och tekniker för att komma runt dessa
* B-körkort


 Anställningen kräver svenskt medborgarskap.
   

  

**Meriterande**
* Erfarenhet för hur man kan använda skyddande åtgärder som t.ex. anonymiseringstjänster m.fl. för att öka det operativa skyddet i egen verksamhet
* Tidigare erfarenhet av Försvarsmaktens verksamhet


 Ovan ställda kvalifikationer ska på begäran kunna verifieras genom intyg, referenser samt arbets- eller urvalstester.
   

  

*För att myndighetens uppdrag ska vara framgångsrikt förutsätts att alla medarbetare uppträder enligt den värdegrund som finns. Försvarsmaktens värdegrund slår vakt om alla människors lika värde, rättvisa och jämlikhet och främjar demokrati och mänskliga rättigheter (läs mer på www.forsvarsmakten.se).*
**Övrigt**
 Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning som inleds med provanställning om sex månader
   

  

 Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse
   

  

 Befattning: Civil
   

  

 Arbetsort: Stockholm. Annan tjänstgöringsort i Mälardalen förekommer. Resor nationellt och internationellt förekommer.
   

  

**För upplysningar om befattningen eller rekryteringsprocessen kontakta:**
 hkv-rekrytering-must@mil.se, vänligen skriv ”Inhämtare/utvecklare SL” i ämnesraden.
   

  

**Fackliga företrädare**
 Fackliga representanter nås via hkv-rekrytering-must@mil.se
   

  

 Varmt välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-12-04. Vi tillämpar löpande urval. I ditt CV och personliga brev vill vi att du beskriver på vilket sätt du uppfyller våra efterfrågade krav och meriter. Du ansöker via jobb.forsvarsmakten.se.
   

  

 ,
 **Ansökningar till denna befattning kommer endast tas emot via Försvarsmaktens webbplats.** 
 -------------------------------------------------------- Militära underrättelse- och säkerhetstjänsten (Must) är en del av Försvarsmaktens högkvarter i Stockholm. Vi ger regeringen och Försvarsmakten kvalificerade beslutsunderlag om omvärldsutvecklingen och hot mot Sveriges och Försvarsmaktens säkerhet. Vår vision är ”Ett säkrare Sverige i en osäker värld”. Must är en kunskapsorganisation och erbjuder både spännande och för Sverige angelägna arbetsuppgifter. Här arbetar både officerare och civila experter inom olika områden, t ex statsvetenskap, IT, ekonomi, teknik, matematik och HR. En stor del av Must verksamhet omfattas av sekretess och vi ber dig därför att inte berätta att du sökt jobb hos Must för andra personer än dina närmaste. Läs gärna mer om Must och vår verksamhet här Varje dag och varje timme gör våra medarbetare insatser som påverkar andra människors liv, både i stort och smått, och både på hemmaplan och runt om i världen. Försvarsmakten ger dig möjlighet att utvecklas som människa och växa i din professionella roll. Vi är en ansvarstagande arbetsgivare och har en öppen organisation där vi ställer upp för varandra. I Försvarsmakten finns en stark värdegrund som bygger på öppenhet, resultat och ansvar. Professionell utveckling och personlig hälsa värdesätts och uppmuntras. Det finns goda förutsättningar för intern karriärrörlighet, friskvård och bra balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Försvarsmakten tillvaratar de kvaliteter som mångfald och jämn könsfördelning tillför verksamheten. Vi välkomnar därför sökanden med olika bakgrund och erfarenheter i våra rekryteringar. En anställning hos oss innebär placering i säkerhetsklass. Vanligtvis krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer att genomföras före anställning enligt 3 kap i säkerhetsskyddslagen. Med anställning följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras. I anställningen ingår även en skyldighet att tjänstgöra utomlands. Innebörden av detta varierar beroende på typ av befattning. Till ansökan om anställning ska CV och personligt brev bifogas. Om du går vidare i anställningsprocessen ska alltid vidimerade kopior av betyg och intyg uppvisas. Samtal från externa rekryteringsföretag och säljare undanbedes.

title: Entry level: System Developer
description:
**Join our Team**
**About this opportunity:**
 At 5G/6G Baseband System Management, we define how advanced radio network functions should behave in the 5G/6G RAN. Our work spans radio communication, signal processing, system studies, software simulation, 3GPP standardization, baseband architecture, and real customer networks.
   

  

 We are looking for the Entry Level: System Developer to join our team and work on the technologies behind the next generation of mobile communication. You will combine technical analysis and software simulation with system-level thinking, standards work, and collaboration across development teams. You will also have the opportunity to contribute to AI/ML-related developments and AI-assisted engineering, as these technologies become increasingly relevant to future radio systems and development workflows.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Perform system studies in the Radio Physical Layer for radio functions such as Beamforming, Massive MIMO, and emerging 6G technologies
* Specify new 5G/6G system features and functions, including requirements, test cases, algorithms, use cases, parameter settings, and interactions with existing functionality
* Develop and use software simulations, primarily link-level, to analyse and optimise the performance of 5G/6G features and signal-processing algorithms
* Contribute to the evolution of 5G/6G standards, including analysing relevant specifications and maintaining our Statement of Compliance
* Contribute to innovation and Ericsson IPR, including invention disclosures and patents
* Support the deployment of new 5G/6G products and features into customer networks through network analysis, troubleshooting, and investigation of customer configurations and issues
* Work closely with cross-functional development teams, locally and globally, on new features, simulations, and improvements.
* Explore opportunities to apply AI/ML in radio systems, as well as AI-assisted tools for simulation, development, analysis, and engineering workflows.


**The skills you bring:**
* MSc or PhD in a relevant field such as Wireless Communications, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Signal Processing, Mathematics, or a related area
* Strong background in communication theory, digital signal processing, and mathematics
* Strong knowledge of LTE, NR/5G, and 3GPP specifications, particularly in the Physical Layer
* Experience with software development for link-level simulations, using languages such as Python, C, and C++
* Experience developing and analyzing software simulations; knowledge of simulation environments and tools such as MATLAB is an advantage
* An analytical and result-oriented mindset, with the ability to investigate complex problems and deliver under pressure
* Ability to manage multiple activities and meet deadlines while working across different projects
* Strong English communication skills, both verbal and written, and the ability to explain technical topics and build effective relationships with colleagues and external stakeholders
* A motivated, proactive, and collaborative approach, with the ability to work independently when needed and contribute effectively as part of a team
* Interest in AI/ML and AI-assisted engineering is a plus, but strong wireless communication and signal-processing fundamentals are the foundation for the role


**Why join Ericsson?** 
 At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.
   

  

**What happens once you apply?** 
 Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

 Sweden (SE) || Stockholm

title: Databasutvecklare
description:
Vi söker en databasutvecklare till ett uppdrag hos en myndighet i Stockholm. Uppdraget är inriktat på systemmigrering från Oracle till PostgreSQL i en transaktionsintensiv miljö med stora datamängder.
   

  

 Arbetet omfattar konvertering och anpassning av databaslogik från Oracle PL/SQL till PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL. I rollen ingår även att analysera befintlig kod, hantera skillnader mellan plattformarna samt säkerställa att den migrerade lösningen fungerar korrekt och effektivt i den nya databasmiljön.
   

  

 Du blir en del av ett team med hjälpsamma och kunniga kollegor som stöttar dig i att komma in i uppdraget och den tekniska miljön. Samtidigt söker vi dig som är motiverad och engagerad, snabbt sätter dig in i nya tekniska sammanhang och självständigt driver ditt arbete framåt.
   

  

**Vi söker dig som har:**
* Minst fyra års erfarenhet av databasutveckling.
* Minst ett års erfarenhet av databasutveckling i både Oracle PL/SQL och PostgreSQL PL/pgSQL.
* Erfarenhet av att migrera eller porta kod från Oracle och PL/SQL till PostgreSQL och PL/pgSQL.
* Erfarenhet av transaktionsintensiva system som hanterar stora datamängder.
* Erfarenhet av versions- och förändringshantering med exempelvis Git eller Liquibase.
* Flytande kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift.

*Tech Consulting Stockholm hjälper kunder i både privat och offentlig sektor med kompetens inom IT och digitalisering. Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta i utvecklande uppdrag, vara nära både kund och team samt bidra till att bygga en växande konsultenhet i Stockholm.*

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer
description:
Senior Fullstack Engineer – Internationalisation Platform
   

  

 The Platform team creates the technology that enables Spotify to learn quickly and scale easily, enabling rapid growth in our users and our business around the globe. Spanning many disciplines, we work to make the business work; creating the infrastructure, tooling, frameworks, and capabilities needed to welcome a billion customers.
   

  

 Within Platform, the Internationalisation team makes Spotify feel local everywhere. We build the systems, tools, and frameworks that power language support, localization workflows, cultural adaptation, and global feature rollouts across more than 180 markets. Our work ensures that when Spotify launches something new, it resonates just as well in São Paulo as it does in Stockholm.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Senior Fullstack Engineer who cares deeply about building scalable systems and seamless user experiences — and who understands that great internationalisation is both a technical and cultural challenge.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Design, build, and evolve the platforms and services that power localization, translation workflows, and global content delivery across Spotify
* Develop high-quality frontend and backend solutions that enable product teams to ship globally from day one
* Partner closely with product managers, designers, and engineers across missions to ensure internationalisation is embedded early in the development lifecycle
* Improve developer experience by creating intuitive tooling, documentation, and self-serve frameworks
* Drive technical direction for complex cross-platform initiatives that impact millions of users worldwide
* Identify performance, scalability, and reliability improvements in systems supporting global expansion
* Contribute to a culture of technical excellence, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning


 Who You Are
   

  

* You have 5+ years of experience building and shipping production-grade software as a fullstack engineer
* You are experienced with modern frontend frameworks (such as React) and backend development (such as Java, Kotlin, TypeScript, or similar technologies)
* You have a deep understanding of distributed systems, APIs, and scalable service architecture
* You know how to design systems with global scale, localization, and performance in mind
* You care about developer experience and building tools that empower other engineers
* You have worked in cross-functional environments and communicate complex ideas clearly
* You demonstrate strong technical judgment and take ownership of outcomes
* You care about building inclusive products that serve users across languages, regions, and cultures


 Where You'll Be
   

  

* This role is based in London or Stockholm
* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.


 Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
   

  

 At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice
   

  

 Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Meet the Team**
 Join Cisco's Webex Media engineering site in Stockholm, where we craft the meeting experience that connects people and businesses around the world. We are a highly motivated, startup‑like team within a global organization, combining the impact and resources of Cisco with the agility and camaraderie of a smaller group. Our work powers the shift to a hybrid workforce and aims to make people feel truly connected. You’ll find a friendly, supportive environment that celebrates creativity, growth, and a shared passion for building world‑class real‑time audio algorithm experiences.
   

  

**Your Impact**
* Design, implement, and optimize VoIP audio algorithms—including adaptive jitter buffers, packet loss concealment, and codec pipelines—based on product requirements.
* Perform peer code reviews and automate development workflows and quality gates.
* Participate in agile ceremonies including daily stand‑ups, planning, releases, and retrospectives.
* Collaborate across teams to broaden technical and soft skills through training and mentoring.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* 7+ years of professional software development experience and a MSc (or equivalent) in Software Engineering or a related field.
* Hands-on experience developing VoIP or real‑time audio algorithms (e.g., adaptive jitter buffer, packet loss concealment, codec integration) in production systems.
* Proficiency in C/C++ with strong knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and design patterns.
* Experience with media streaming and relevant protocols for real‑time applications.
* Professional verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Uses AI responsibly to accelerate development.
* Critically reviews AI-generated code before using it.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience applying AI/ML to audio algorithm development or optimization in production voice systems.
* Experience evaluating and tuning audio algorithms using objective metrics (e.g., POLQA, PESQ) and subjective listening tests.
* Experience with close‑to‑real‑time systems and performance‑sensitive code paths.
* Comfort with incremental development, testing, and A/B testing in production.
* Collaborative, friendly, and self‑directed; eager to learn and share knowledge.
* Steers AI effectively via context and prompt design.


 Collab Hiring
   

  

 Why Cisco?
   

  

 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
   

  

 We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

title: Oracle Databasutvecklare
description:
*Vill du arbeta nära några av ATG:s mest affärskritiska tjänster och samtidigt vara med på en spännande teknisk förändringsresa? Här får du en central roll med stort mandat inom databasutveckling, där du både arbetar hands-on med dagens Oraclelösningar och är med och formar vägen mot PostgreSQL och en modernare arkitektur.* 




  





**I rollen får du:** 



* Ta ett stort tekniskt ansvar för databasutvecklingen inom Tillsammans och Butiksandelar
* Arbeta med utveckling, optimering och problemlösning i affärskritiska system med stora transaktionsflöden
* Vara med och påverka arkitektur och tekniska vägval framåt
* Samarbeta nära backendutvecklare, arkitekter, test och verksamheten
* Bidra med din databasexpertis i resan från Oracle mot PostgreSQL och nya backendtjänster



  





 Tillsammans och Butiksandelar är två viktiga tjänster inom ATG:s erbjudande för andelsspel. Som vår databasexpert arbetar du nära båda teamen och får en bred vardag med utveckling, förvaltning och felsökning. Samtidigt är vi inne i en större teknisk utvecklingsresa där våra lösningar successivt moderniseras. Här får du möjlighet att använda din djupa databaskompetens och samtidigt påverkar hur framtidens lösningar ska utformas.
 



  





**Är det här du?** 




 Vi tror att du gillar kombinationen av tekniskt djup, problemlösning och samarbete. Du är trygg inom databasutveckling och trivs med att ta ansvar för ditt område, samtidigt som du gärna diskuterar lösningar och delar kunskap med andra. Du är prestigelös, nyfiken och tycker om att förstå hur tekniken hänger ihop med verksamheten.
 



  





 Vi ser att du har:
 


* Flera års erfarenhet av Oracle och databasutveckling
* Goda kunskaper i PL/SQL
* Erfarenhet av felsökning, optimering och prestandatuning
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med verksamhets- eller affärskritiska system
* God förmåga att samarbeta och kommunicera med olika kompetenser



  





 Meriterande:
 


* Erfarenhet av PostgreSQL och/eller databasmigrering
* Erfarenhet av backendutveckling i Java eller Kotlin
* Erfarenhet av modernisering eller transformation av större tekniska lösningar



  





**We are the game** 




 I mer än 50 år har vi på ATG levererat spänning och underhållning till svenska folket. Vi drivs av att trygga den svenska hästnäringen och att fortsatt vara ett ansvarsfullt spelbolag i framkant. Vår vision är att leverera världens bästa spelupplevelse. Vi gillar att samarbeta och uppmuntrar varandra att tänka och testa nytt. Självledarskap och kompetensutveckling är viktiga delar för oss. Vi bryr oss om varandra och våra kunder och vi vill så klart också att alla tävlingshästar ska må bra. Hela vårt överskott går till hästnäringen – något som både känns och gör gott.
 



  





**Join the game!** 




 Varmt välkommen med din ansökan via vår rekryteringsportal antingen med ditt cv eller din LinkedIn-profil – det som är enklast och smidigast för dig. Läs gärna mer om oss på vår karriärsida och tveka inte att höra av dig om du har frågor om tjänsten.
 



  





 Vi tillämpar 6 månaders provanställning och kommer att göra en bakgrundskontroll för denna roll. Tjänsten är på heltid och utgår från vårt kontor vid Solvalla, alldeles intill travbanan. Vi har ett flexibelt arbetssätt vilket innebär att du har möjlighet att kombinera distansarbete med arbete från kontoret. Var med och bygg världens bästa spelupplevelse tillsammans med oss!

title: Gen AI Developer
description:

 • Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)
 



 • Python and AI/ML application development
 



 • Agentic AI and multi-agent architectures
 



 • Model Context Protocol (MCP) – servers, tools, resources, and integrations
 



 • LLM orchestration frameworks and agent workflows
 



 • Prompt engineering and context management
 



 • Tool/function calling and API integrations
 



 • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
 



 • REST APIs, databases, SaaS platforms, and enterprise systems

**Responsibilities:**

 • Build and maintain Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, tools, resources, and integrations to enable AI agents to interact with enterprise systems.
 



 • Develop orchestration frameworks and multi-agent workflows for coordinating AI agents, tools, APIs, and business processes.
