title: Consultant / Senior Consultant, Financial Services Transformation
description:
Deloitte is a leading global provider of audit and assurance, consulting, financial advisory, risk advisory, tax, and related services. During its 175-year history, our organization has grown tremendously in both scale and capabilities. Deloitte currently has approximately 457,000 people in more than 150 countries and territories and serves four out of five Fortune Global 500® companies. Yet, our shared culture and mission—to make an impact that matters—remains unchanged.
   

  

  




**Job Description**

**Make an impact in financial services transformation**




 Are you ready to take the next step in your career and join our successful teams in Sweden? Deloitte is a market leader in Sweden, working with decision-makers across global and local organisations. As a Consultant or Senior Consultant in the Operations Transformation or Engineering team, you will help leading financial institutions translate complex business and technology challenges into practical transformation initiatives.
   

  

  





 You will help financial services clients innovate and transform their organisations, core systems and operating models. This includes driving business transformation, consolidating and implementing systems and processes, embedding regulatory change and operational efficiency, designing new operating models, and leading large-scale transformations.
   

  

  





**Requirements to succeed in this role**




 We will assess your level based on the depth of your experience and the scope of responsibility you have held. You are expected to have 1-4 years of professional experience in management consulting, financial services, or a business or technology transformation role.
   

  

  




* As a Consultant, you will typically contribute to analysis and project delivery, while coordinating stakeholders within a workstream.


* As a Senior Consultant, you will typically lead workstreams, shape solutions, manage senior stakeholders, review deliverables, and guide junior colleagues.


**What you will do**
* Analyse complex business, operating model, regulatory, data, and technology challenges.


* Design practical solutions in collaboration with client stakeholders and Deloitte specialists.


* Support or lead workstreams from strategy and requirements through implementation and adoption.


* Translate business needs into clear requirements for technology and delivery teams.


* Develop evidence-based recommendations and present them clearly to senior stakeholders.


* Contribute to proposals, client relationships, and the continued development of our Financial Services capabilities.


**About the team**

 You will join the Operations Transformation or Engineering team within Technology & Transformation. We combine deep industry knowledge with expertise in strategy, operations, technology, data, and change to help financial institutions deliver sustainable transformation.
   

  

  





 Our team brings together colleagues with expertise across:
   

  

  




* Banking: payments, lending, savings, cards, financial crime, risk, compliance, and regulatory reporting.


* Capital markets: front-to-back trading, post-trade, treasury, finance transformation, and regulatory change.


* Asset and wealth management: operating model, product, platform, data, and regulatory transformation.


* Insurance: underwriting, claims, policy administration, personal and commercial products, and core-system implementation.


**Qualifications**

 What we are looking for:
   

  

  




* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field, such as business, engineering, economics, or information systems.


* Experience contributing to projects or workstreams that have delivered measurable business or operational change.


* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex information into practical recommendations.


* Confidence working with stakeholders across both business and technology functions.


* Professional fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.


* Willingness to travel as required for client assignments.


**Experience that would be an advantage:**
* Experience in one or more of the Financial Services areas described above.


* Demonstrated interest or experience in business and IT transformations - project, programme, product, or requirements management.


* Business development.


* Regulatory, operating model, or process transformation.


* Change management and implementation of new ways of working.


* Business and technology transformation, including system implementation, cloud or system migration, vendor selection, data migration, testing, or agile delivery.


**How you work and as a person:**
* You build strong working relationships across diverse teams and client organisations.


* You take ownership of your work, manage priorities effectively, and deliver on commitments.


* You communicate complex ideas clearly, in a structured way and tailored to your audience.


* You are curious, actively seek feedback, and use it to continuously improve.


* You enjoy collaborating with others and are equally comfortable working independently when required.


* You are outgoing, collaborative and enjoy working as part of a team.


**Additional Information**

**What we offer**



* Varied assignments spanning design, implementation, and adoption.


* Structured development supported by a dedicated coach, formal learning, and regular on-the-job feedback.


* Access to Financial Services specialists and international teams across Deloitte’s global network.


* A collaborative and inclusive environment that values knowledge sharing and diverse perspectives.


* Opportunities to deepen your expertise, contribute to client development, and take on greater responsibility.


* Competitive compensation and benefits.


 At Deloitte, we are committed to helping our employees grow and develop throughout their career. We offer a range of on-the-job learning experiences, formal development programs at Deloitte University, and access to a personal coach to support you in identifying and utilizing your strengths. We also provide the necessary training and resources for you to obtain various certifications to further advance in your career.
   

  

  


 Our culture is built on collaboration and innovation. We value diverse perspectives and encourage our employees to think creatively to find the best solutions for our clients. We work hand-in-hand with our clients to understand their unique needs and to develop tailored solutions that drive growth and innovation. At Deloitte, you´ll have the chance to grow and succeed alongside like-minded professionals who share your passion.
   

  

  





**How to apply**




  

  

  





 Please apply online. As part of your application, please submit:
   

  

  




* CV


* A short statement explaining your interest in the role and relevant industry experience (if any)


* University grades


*As a qualitative part of Deloitte's recruitment process, our final candidates undergo a background check, to increase awareness of our future employees, secure the working environment for our employees and meet regulatory requirements. The background check process is carried out in collaboration with To Find Out.* 
*https://tofindout.se/en/background-check/*

**Please submit your application as soon as possible, as we work with ongoing selection.**




 At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team’s success.
   

  

  





**Questions?**




 If you have any questions regarding the role or the application process, please contact Anna Taube, Manager Talent Acquisition, at ataube@deloitte.se.
   

  

  





**We are looking forward to your application!**




**What impact will you make?**




 Every day, your work will make an impact that matters, while you thrive in a dynamic culture of inclusion, collaboration and high performance. We do not just aspire to make solutions. We wish to create an impact that makes a positive and crucial difference for the people around us, our clients and our society. Deloitte is where you’ll find unlimited opportunities to succeed and realize your full potential.
   

  

  





 For further information on Deloitte, please visit www.deloitte.se
   

  

  





**What impact will you make?**




 På Deloitte gör ditt arbete en meningsfull skillnad, varje dag, medan du växer i en inkluderande företagskultur av samarbete och hög prestation. Utöver att skapa lösningar strävar vi efter att göra en positiv och avgörande skillnad för andra i vår omgivning, våra klienter och samhället. På Deloitte hittar du tidigare dolda möjligheter att lyckas och inser din fulla potential.

title: Products & Industrial Engineer
description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.
   

  

 Har du ett intresse för produktionsteknik, industrialisering och att förbättra hur produkter och processer utvecklas och tillverkas? Då kan detta vara rollen för dig!
   

  

 Vi söker nu produktionstekniska och industriella ingenjörer till Stockholm som vill vara med och utveckla framtidens produktion och leverans i teknikintensiva miljöer.
   

  

**Din roll**
 Som produktionsteknisk eller industriell ingenjör kommer du att arbeta nära verksamheten och bidra till att utveckla, effektivisera och optimera produktionsflöden och tillverkningsprocesser. Du kommer att kombinera analytiskt arbete med operativ problemlösning och samarbeta med tvärfunktionella team för att säkerställa effektiva och hållbara lösningar.
   

  

 Rollen passar dig som trivs med att driva förbättringsarbete, analysera verksamhetsdata och omsätta insikter till konkreta åtgärder som skapar värde för verksamheten.
   

  

*I den här rollen kommer du ha en nyckelroll i att:*
* Utveckla och optimera tillverkningsflöden och produktionsprocesser
* Ta fram beredningar, routings, instruktioner och layoutunderlag
* Analysera kapacitet, ledtider, resurser och verksamhetskritiska nyckeltal
* Driva förbättringsinitiativ inom exempelvis Lean, värdeflödesanalyser och industrialisering
* Bidra till operativ leverans och samarbeta med tvärfunktionella team för att säkerställa kvalitet och effektivitet


**Din profil**
* Högskole- eller civilingenjörsexamen, alternativt motsvarande erfarenhet inom produktion, manufacturing, logistik eller Industrial Engineering
* Erfarenhet av produktionsteknik, industrialisering eller produktionsutveckling
* Stark analytisk förmåga och erfarenhet av att omsätta analyser till praktiska förbättringar
* God samarbetsförmåga och ett strukturerat arbetssätt
* Flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift


**Meriterande erfarenheter**
* Erfarenhet av IFS eller andra ERP- och PLM-system
* Kunskap inom Creo, AutoCAD eller andra CAD-verktyg
* Erfarenhet av Lean, 5S, VSM, FMEA, layoutplanering eller simulering
* Erfarenhet av digitalisering, automation eller Smart Factory-lösningar


**Vad vi tror kommer få dig att trivas hos oss:**
* Möjligheten att arbeta i teknikintensiva och utvecklande industrimiljöer
* Varierande uppdrag inom produktion, industrialisering och förbättringsarbete
* En kultur där vi investerar i din kompetensutveckling och karriär
* Ett globalt företag med både lokala och internationella projekt och kunder
* Kollegor som delar ditt intresse för teknik, innovation och ständiga förbättringar


**Ansökan**
 Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kommer identitetskontroll att genomföras genom granskning av ditt ID-kort, och bakgrundskontroller kan utföras vid behov.
   

  

 Uppdrag inom försvarsindustrin kan kräva godkänd säkerhetsprövning och kan i vissa fall medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.
   

  

**About Capgemini**
 Capgemini is the business transformation partner for enterprises in the age of AI. We help organizations imagine and build an intelligent, sustainable future, combining AI, technology and human ingenuity to transform how they operate, innovate, and grow. With unique end-to-end capabilities spanning strategy, technology, engineering and intelligent operations, we bring together deep industry expertise and market-leading capabilities in AI, cloud and data to turn ambition into measurable business outcomes at scale. Supported by a robust ecosystem of partners and nearly 60 years of expertise, Capgemini is a responsible and diverse global organization of over 410,000 team members in more than 50 countries. The Group reported 2025 revenues of €22.5 billion.
   

  

 Make it real | www.capgemini.com

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
description:
SOVOS
   

  

 Senior Solutions Engineer
   

  

 Sales Engineering·Full-Time·Europe
   

  

 Build Your Future With Us
   

  

 The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.
   

  

 We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.
   

  

 AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.
   

  

 Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 At Sovos, we're building a dedicated sales team from the ground up to support our growing portfolio of AI-native offerings, spanning financial orchestration, compliance automation, and intelligent invoicing. You'll be one of the first technical sellers on this team, joining at the foundation as we define the playbook together. This isn't a support role that ends with a good demo. You'll own technical opportunities end-to-end, configuring the platform to a client's real environment and building the technical proof points your Account Executive partner uses to close.
   

  

**More Specifically, You Will**
* Carry a quota tied to technical opportunity progression from discovery through close, owning the technical inputs (POC results, integration effort, system fit) that feed the ROI and TCO business case.
* Lead technical workshops and proofs of concept with clear success criteria, partnering with your AE to navigate objections, build urgency, and drive the opportunity to a decision.
* Configure the platform against a client's real data and workflows ahead of every demo, navigating model routing, APIs, integrations, data governance, and security with Engineering and IT.
* Translate technical solutions into ROI, TCO, and operational impact for Finance and executive stakeholders, moving seamlessly between architecture conversations and business-level discussions.
* Leverage AI tools to improve qualification, demo configuration, and business case development, staying engaged through kickoff and early delivery to maintain technical continuity with the Field Delivery Engineering team.
* Help shape the qualification criteria, demo approach, and business case format this team will use going forwards, bringing customer and market feedback back into how Sovos positions and packages its AI-native offerings.


 What You Bring to Sovos
   

  

* You've successfully led business process transformation or procurement optimization projects, ideally gained through consulting or working buyer-side, ideally with procurement or AP expertise gained from working buyer-side rather than solely in an advisory capacity.
* You have enough systems fluency to know where a client's data lives (SAP vs. Ariba vs. elsewhere) and how workflows cross systems; familiarity with AI gateways, model routing, or data governance is a strong plus.
* You bring direct quota-carrying or deal-closing ownership of the pre-sale cycle, not only demo or support experience, with a demonstrated ability to close complex B2B deals with clear revenue accountability, moving opportunities from technical discovery through contract signature and clear revenue accountability.
* You're comfortable moving between technical and executive conversations in the same day (sometimes the same meeting), building executive-level business cases that include ROI and TCO analyses.
* Comfort with AI-assisted workflows and automation or workflow platforms is important; experience selling AI infrastructure, applications, agents, workflow automation, or finance technology is preferred.
* Experience helping launch a new product or build an early go-to-market motion is preferred, as is experience at a consulting firm with a finance transformation or automation practice.
* Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.


 The Process
   

  

 We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect:
   

  

 1
   

  

 Pre-Employment Assessment
   

  

 Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot.
   

  

 2
   

  

 Video Interview
   

  

 A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume.
   

  

 3
   

  

 Meeting with a Recruiter
   

  

 A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals.
   

  

 4
   

  

 Live Interviews with the Hiring Team
   

  

 Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day-to-day of the role.
   

  

 Life at Sovos
   

  

 The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!
   

  

* Global Mentoring Programs
* AI Tools and Technology from Day 1
* Continuous Learning and Development
* Language Learning Support
* Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs
* Global Parental Leave Policy
* An opportunity to work with a global team
* Bi-Weekly Meeting Free Days!
* Mentoring Programs
* Globally recognised Training and Development programmes
* Competitive benefits package


**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, colour, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.
   

  

 Company Background
   

  

 Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. Sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150+ countries.
   

  

 More than 100,000 customers – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos’ tax and regulatory expertise and unparalleled integration with their business applications. Learn more at sovos.com.
   

  

 Ready to make your move?
   

  

 We'd love to hear from you. Use the Apply button at the top of this page to submit your application
   

  

 SOVOS © Sovos 2026. All rights reserved.

title: Project Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 Job Location: Tumba
   

  

 Working Model: Hybrid
   

  

 Project Manager
   

  

 Do you want to work in a global company where you can contribute to a more sustainable food production? DeLaval is a leading developer, manufacturer and supplier of solutions for dairy farmers around the world. As a company built on innovation, we constantly work to find ways of helping our customers do more with less.
   

  

 We are now looking for a Project Manager to the DeLaval Project Management Office.
   

  

 You will lead cross-functional product development projects involving both hardware and embedded software, working closely with engineering, product management, supply chain, quality, and other key stakeholders.
   

  

**Working in our PMO and at DeLaval**
 In our PMO, we are in total about 30 skilled and experienced project managers with 20 of us located in Tumba. We collaborate closely together and continuously evolve our project and portfolio management practices. As a project manager, you will not only lead projects but also contribute to developing our common ways of working and strengthening One PMO.
   

  

**Role And Responsibilities**
 Your role will be to ensure the successful and cross-functional management of DeLaval projects and assignments on new product development, product maintenance, and quality.
   

  

* Project and Program execution Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of projects, while proactively managing dependencies and risks.
* Team Leadership and Collaboration Build efficient program and project teams, provide direction, and foster open communication to achieve project objectives.
* Stakeholder management Manage relationships and communications with stakeholders, including upper management, product management, IT, engineering, supply chain, and market, ensuring transparency and involvement.


**Qualifications**
 To be successful in this role we believe that you have:
   

  

* Solid experience in managing development projects within a product development environment.
* Experience managing complex system development projects involving embedded software and cross-functional hardware/software integration.
* Experience working with agile methodologies, combined with the ability to adapt to hybrid approaches incorporating a more traditional waterfall model.
* Master’s degree in Engineering or equivalent degree.


 As a person, you combine structure and drive with a collaborative leadership style. You build trust across functions, communicate effectively with stakeholders at different levels, and are comfortable leading complex initiatives in an international environment.
   

  

**Working at DeLaval**
 Our core values Passion, People, Professionals and Partnerships connect individuals across entities and geographies. Success is far more than knowledge – it is strongly related to behaviour. At DeLaval we are all guided by our three behaviours: Set Direction, Make Things Happen and One DeLaval.
   

  

 We Offer You a Workplace Like No Other, Where State-of-the-art Technology Goes Hand In Hand With Animal Welfare. DeLaval Is a Part Of The Tetra Laval Group Together With Tetra Pak And Sidel. In Addition, We Offer
   

  

* Secure employment and benefits from the collective agreement (occupational pension, work-related accident insurance).
* Parental leave compensation (approx. 10 percent of the employee's monthly salary).
* Wellness allowance of SEK 4 000/year.
* Private healthcare insurance.
* Flexible working hours and reduced working hours.
* 30 days paid annual leave.


**Additional Information**
 The position will be part of the Division Product Development and will report to the Swedish PMO manager of Product Development. This is a full-time position located in Tumba, south of Stockholm, Sweden. We offer a hybrid workplace model, combining on-site work with flexibility to work remotely. Travel will be part of this position.
   

  

 We review applications ongoing. We do not accept applications via email, however if you have any questions regarding the role or the recruitment process don’t hesitate to contact us.
   

  

**Contact**
 Hiring manager: Marie Engstrand, marie.engstrand@delaval.com
   

  

 Recruiter: Mathias Gunnstedt, mathias.gunnstedt@delaval.com
   

  

**About DeLaval**
 Our vision is to make sustainable food production possible. As a company built on innovation, we constantly work to find ways of helping our customers, dairy farmers, do more with less by providing world-leading milking equipment and solutions.
   

  

 Today, DeLaval has approximately 4,900 passionate professionals operating in more than 90 markets around the world. DeLaval is part of the Tetra Laval Group.
   

  

 See more at corporate.delaval.com
   

  

 Project Management

title: Digital Communications Editor
description:
Are you an experienced digital communicator who understands how to turn science into stories that capture attention, spark curiosity, and inspire action? SEI is looking for a Digital Communications Editor to manage our global social media channels and help communicate our research and insights to diverse audiences.
   

  

 Become part of our international non-profit research organization and help translate evidence into policy and practice on global environmental and development challenges. At Stockholm Environment Institute (SEI), you will be joining a world-leading research institute. Our dynamic and expanding workplace employs around at a centrally located, activity-based HQ office in Stockholm, with an additional 200 employees in seven centres globally.
   

  

**The role**
 The Digital Communications Editor is part of the Communications and Impact Division based at SEI Headquarters. This is a central role where you will support the global organization with curation, editing and writing for the website, social media channels and our monthly newsletter.
   

  

 Your responsibilities will include managing SEI’s global social media platforms (LinkedIn, Bluesky, Facebook and ) with a focus on user engagement, brand consistency and innovative content creation. You will act as an internal advisor, collaborating with different team members to ensure high-quality content that aligns with our mission and values. This role involves both and curation, alongside implementing effective social media strategies to enhance our SEI’s digital visibility and reputation. You will use analytics and analysis to follow up and report on engagement and impact.
   

  

 The role may also include supporting colleagues with web publishing on sei.org. You will lead on creating and sending SEI’s monthly newsletter.
   

  

* Manage SEI’s global social media accounts, creating, editing and curating engaging content that draws on SEI research, organizational priorities and relevant external developments to reach and engage target audiences. This includes editing and scheduling colleagues’ posts in Buffer, creating posts for institutional news and daily community management.
* Manage and develop SEI’s monthly newsletter, including editorial planning, content selection, writing and editing, distribution, and ongoing optimization.
* Support website publishing ensuring content is accurate, accessible, well-structured according to house style and optimized for online audiences
* Coordinate global digital content workflows by working proactively and responsively with our global community of communications experts, managing requests via shared inboxes and Asana, to ensure digital content meets our quality and brand standards on our global digital channels.
* Ensure digital content meets SEI’s visual identity, accessibility, and editorial standards, applying relevant guidelines and identifying opportunities to improve the quality and accessibility of content.
* Collaborate with communications colleagues across SEI to develop content promotion plans, share good practices and strengthen coordination and learning across the global organization.
* Monitor, analyse, and report on digital performance, using analytics and audience insights to evaluate engagement and assess impact. Provide recommendations for improving content and channel performance.


**Who You Are**
 You will have a strong interest in sustainability and climate science and be passionate about the importance of communication to drive change. You should enjoy being part of a team, finding innovative solutions while working individually in a structured manner. You must have an eye for detail, be adept at working across digital communications platformsand be happy to juggle different priorities. You will enjoy working in an international setting with people from varied backgrounds and disciplines.
   

  

* At least three years professional experience in digital communications, including social media, editing, and web publishing.
* Track record of creating, editing and publishing quality digital content in English.
* P roven experience with web content management systems (ideally WordPress) , scheduling tools such as Buffer , email marketing tools such as Mailchimp and project management tools such as Asana .
* Experience coordinating content with multiple contributors and managing projects.
* Skilled in analytics, monitoring, analysis and reporting, ideally in social media and for websites.
* Experience with content in climate, environment and/or development topics is a plus.
* Written and spoken fluency in English
* Experience explaining complex or technical subjects in accessible formats for different audiences.


**Required Personal Skills**
* Effective communication and strong networking skills.
* Good organizational and time management abilities.
* Diplomatic approach and inclusive mindset.
* Have a service-minded attitude and the ability to balance conflicting priorities.
* Flexible, positive attitude and enjoy working with a collaborative team.


**Our offer**
 At SEI HQ, we offer a stimulating position in an international environment. You will be part of a leading multinational, multidisciplinary and multilingual team of experts in an organization where the well-being and development of our employees is a high priority. We value diversity and creativity at the core of what we do. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds to apply. Our ambition is to provide a safe, professional and creative workspace for all.
   

  

* Collective agreement, including occupational pension and many other collectively agreed benefits.
* Annual healthcare contribution and additional benefits connected to promoting employee well-being such as yearly health check-ups.
* Flexible working hours, 37.5-hour work week and a generous number of vacation days.
* Being part of a world-leading organizational that works to bridge science to policy and practice in the fields of the environmental and development.


**Additional Information**
 This is an eight-month temporary position at SEI HQ in Stockholm, Sweden. The start date is in December to allow a period of handover.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis. Please submit your application as soon as possible, and no later than 26 October 2026, 23:59 Stockholm local time.
   

  

 Applications must be written in English and submitted through our recruitment system using the button below. Please include:
   

  

* Cover letter highlighting relevant qualifications and experience (one page)


 Use the button below to submit your application. Applications sent via email will not be accepted.
   

  

**About SEI**
 Stockholm Environment Institute is an international non-profit research institute that tackles environment and sustainable development challenges.
   

  

 We empower partners to meet these challenges through cutting-edge research, knowledge, tools and capacity building. Scientific quality and integrity are foundations of our work. Partnership is at the heart of our approach, leading to change that lasts.
   

  

 Our work connects science to policy and practice, aiming to drive tangible impacts. It spans climate change, natural resources, water, air, and health, and addresses questions of governance, innovation, finance, poverty, gender equality and social equity.
   

  

 We are committed to transparency and full disclosure of our funding. The Government of Sweden is our largest funder, and we also receive funds from a range of public research funders, philanthropic foundations, bilateral and multilateral development agencies, governments, NGOs and other partners.
   

  

 Through SEI’s HQ and seven centres around the world, we engage with policy, practice and development action for a sustainable, prosperous future for all.

title: AI Engineer
description:
AI Engineer - Build Production AI at Scale
 



  





**Stockholm | Permanent** 




  





 Build AI that actually gets used.
 



  





 We're looking for a hands-on
 **AI Engineer** 
 to join a small central AI team at a major Nordic consumer business.
 



  





 This isn't a role where you'll spend your time writing requirements for someone else to build.
 



 You'll work directly with product teams and business stakeholders, help decide
 **what is actually worth building** 
 , challenge ideas when needed, prototype quickly and then write the code to turn those ideas into production systems.
 



  





 If you enjoy the space between
 **software engineering, AI and real business problems** 
 , this could be a very interesting role.
 



  





 What are you actually going to build?
 



  





 The team already has a growing pipeline of AI projects across the business.
 



  





**Current and upcoming work includes:** 




  




* **Customer-facing conversational AI** 
 with the potential to reach millions of users.
* **Semantic search and retrieval** 
 using modern embedding and vector technologies.
* **Internal AI assistants** 
 helping thousands of employees access knowledge.
* **AI-powered content production** 
 at significant scale.
* **Image generation and processing** 
 for campaigns and digital content.
* Internal platforms that make it easier for teams to build and deploy AI-powered applications.



  





 The technology isn't fixed.
 



  





 The team takes a pragmatic approach to AI - using whatever works best for the problem rather than forcing everything through one framework or vendor.
 



  





 You'll have the freedom to experiment, prototype, rip things apart and rebuild them when necessary.
 



  





 This is the important bit.
 



 We're
 **not looking for a traditional Data Scientist** 
 .
 



 We're looking for someone who can combine:
 



**Strong software engineering + modern AI + product judgement.** 




  





 You should be comfortable going from:
 



**“The business wants this…”** 




 to:
 



**“Here's what I think we should actually build…”** 




 to:
 



**“I've built it — let's get it into production.”** 




 You'll work closely with product owners, stakeholders and other engineers throughout that process.
 



  





**What you'll bring** 




 We're looking for someone who has:
 


* Experience delivering
 **real AI solutions** 
 , not just prototypes or experiments.
* Strong Python/software engineering skills.
* Experience building backend services and APIs.
* Good understanding of modern LLM and Generative AI technologies.
* Experience working with real-world data using SQL, Pandas or similar tools.
* The confidence to communicate directly with stakeholders.
* The technical judgement to push back when there is a better solution.
* A genuine hands-on attitude — you like building things yourself.



  





 Your previous job title isn't particularly important.
 



  





 You might currently be an:
 



  




* AI Engineer
* Applied AI Engineer
* AI Software Engineer
* Software Engineer
* Backend Engineer
* Product Engineer
* Machine Learning Engineer
* Generative AI Engineer



  





 What matters is what you've
 **actually built and owned** 
 .
 



 You don't need to know every tool.
 



  





 Experience with things like these would be valuable:
 



  




* LLM applications
* RAG
* Semantic search
* Embeddings
* Vector databases
* AI agents
* Tool calling
* Recommendation systems
* AI evaluation
* Production AI monitoring
* Image generation
* Ecommerce/search/personalisation



  





 Specific framework experience isn't a deal-breaker.
 



  





 If you've used Pinecone rather than Qdrant, LangGraph rather than another agent framework, or AWS rather than another cloud platform, that's fine.
 



  





 Strong engineering fundamentals transfer.
 



  





**Why this role is different** 




  





 You'll be joining a
 **small AI team with a big surface area** 
 .
 



 Rather than owning one small component of a huge platform, you'll have visibility across a substantial part of the business.
 



  





 You'll work directly with the people asking:
 



 “Could AI solve this?”
 



 and have the opportunity to answer:
 



 “Yes — and here's how I'd build it.”
 



  





 That means exposure to:
 



  




* Product.
* Engineering.
* AI strategy.
* Architecture.
* Business stakeholders.
* Real customers.
* Real production systems.



  





 And you'll remain
 **hands-on technically** 
 .
 



  





 No need to become a people manager to increase your influence.
 



  





**The setup** 




  





 📍
 **Central Stockholm** 
 — close to Stockholm Central Station.
 



 🏖️
 **30 days holiday** 




 💻 Flexible choice of laptop/equipment.
 



 🏠 Hybrid working with plenty of flexibility within the team.
 



 ✈️ Occasional Copenhagen travel, typically a day trip.
 



  





 Candidates must already have
 **full working rights in Sweden** 
 .
 



  





 Swedish is preferred, although strong English-speaking candidates can be considered.

title: Principal Engineer - High growth scale up- Stockholm
description:
🚀 Principal Engineer role - High Growth scale-up - Stockholm 🚀
   

 The title can be interchangeable, but what is a given is that this role is the opportunity to be at the tip-of-the spear within one of Stockholm's most exciting and high-impact startups right now!
   

 This role is for someone who wants to be at the forefront of technical discovery, AI application, solving complex, unexplored problems, exploring and spearheading new product & engineering initiatives which translate into real-world commercial impact!
   

 You won’t be joining to own a particular engineering team or simply deliver against an existing roadmap. You’ll operate across the organisation, working closely with the CTO, head of product, business leadership and an exceptional product-minded engineering org, to identify opportunities, challenge assumptions and figure out what should be built next!
   

 What Makes This Role Different ✅
   

 A newly created, foundational position with significant freedom to shape the role and having a transformative impact on a company already leading the pack in its fieldOperating across the organisation rather than within a single engineering teamClose partnership with senior technology and product leadershipExposure to complex technical, product and commercial challengesSignificant autonomy to explore, experiment and influence directionThe opportunity to work on problems where there is no obvious playbookA position at the intersection of technology, product, AI and business strategy
   

 Your Mission ✅
   

 Your role will be to find and solve the problems that sit beyond the boundaries of individual teams.You’ll have the agency to:
   

 Explore complex business and technical challengesIdentify opportunities where technology can create meaningful new valueLead early-stage discovery, experimentation and validationTurn promising ideas into prototypes, products or new capabilitiesChallenge existing thinking and introduce new approachesInfluence technical and product strategyConnect engineering capability with wider business opportunitiesHelp identify potential new products, markets and revenue streams
   

 The emphasis is on discovery and problem solving rather than execution against a predefined backlog.
   

 AI & Emerging Technology ✅
   

 AI will be an important part of the role and our strategy going forward, but this is not simply an AI engineering position. You’ll be expected to understand where AI and emerging technologies can genuinely change how the organisation operates, what it builds and how it creates value. AND, be able to decide when AI isn't the solution!
   

 This could include: ✅
   

 Identifying unconventional opportunities for AI across the businessExploring emerging technologies and their practical applicationsRapidly prototyping new conceptsEvaluating whether an idea has genuine customer or commercial potentialTaking successful experiments through to productionHelping shape the broader technology and AI strategyFocusing on measurable outcomes rather than experimentation for its own sake
   

 How You'll Work✅You’ll operate with a high degree of autonomy and work horizontally across engineering, product and business functions.
   

 You should be comfortable moving between high-level business problems and deep technical detail, and knowing when to stay strategic versus when to get hands-on.
   

 You won't be expected to manage a large team. Instead, your impact will come through the problems you solve, the direction you influence and the leverage you create for others.
   

 The Ideal Profile ✅
   

 You may currently be a Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, Distinguished Engineer, VP of Technology or another senior technical leadership position, a founder trapped within a slow moving enterprise org, or maybe you've been a founding engineer or CTO within a high growth startup!
   

 More important than your current title is that you: ✅
   

 Have significant experience building software and designing complex systemsHave operated successfully in high-growth or high-change environmentsEnjoy ambiguity rather than needing a clearly defined scopeHave experience taking ideas from 0→1A track record / examples of taking product/engineering initiatives from idea to launch, getting stakeholder buy in and taking it to production. Combine strong technical depth with product and commercial thinkingCan understand a business problem before jumping to a technical solutionHave strong architectural judgement and systems thinkingAre comfortable influencing without formal authorityKnow when to experiment, when to move quickly and when something needs to be built properlyAre naturally curious about emerging technology and what it could enable
   

 Technology ✅
   

 The existing environment includes:Node.js / TypeScriptAWSMongoDBCloud-native architectureModern engineering practices and tooling
   

 The technology stack is not restrictive. You’ll have the freedom to introduce new technologies where they make sense for the problem being solved.
   

 What Success Looks Like ✅
   

 Success won't be measured simply by the number of tickets delivered or systems owned.It will look more like:
   

 Complex problems being turned into clear opportunitiesNew ideas moving from discovery → prototype → productionTechnology creating measurable new business or product valueAI being applied in places where it genuinely changes outcomesNew product or revenue opportunities being identified and validatedSenior leadership having a trusted technical partner for difficult, ambiguous problemsThe organisation becoming faster and more capable at exploring what comes next
   

 This is a role for someone who wants to be at the frontier of what the organisation could become, rather than simply maintaining what already exists. Like we mentioned, high ownership, high agency and autonomy, startup ambiguity with an established engineering team and successful product, with a tonne of room to impact!
   

 This is a hybrid role, 3 days/week in Stockholm office generally. Unable to assist in Visa sponsorship or extensions at the moment.
   

 Compensated with an attractive salary & compensation offering!

title: Data Engineer - Scaling Avanza into Denmark & Beyond
description:
**Do you want to build the data-driven engine taking Avanza into Denmark?**
 At Avanza, we are driven by making savings cheaper, better, and simpler. To succeed, we need data that is not only accessible, but accurate, smart, and actionable.
   

  

 We are currently operating as an internal startup at Avanza, building a brand-new platform to expand our business into Denmark. We combine startup speed with corporate strength, taking an AI-first approach to everything we do. We are now looking for a Data Engineer who is ready to step outside their comfort zone, interface seamlessly with software engineering teams, and help build the foundation for our next big journey.
   

  

**Working at Avanza**
 As a Data Engineer in our expansion team, you will help transform raw data into business value through robust pipelines and sustainable data models. We work according to data mesh principles, meaning you will both provide and consume data in a decentralised landscape. Our tech stack rests on BigQuery, Kafka for real-time streaming, and dbt for transformation logic.
   

  

 You will become part of an autonomous team with a strong mandate to shape both architecture and ways of working. We value the craft of data engineering and apply core software development principles such as traceability and scalability—often through pair programming and close cross-functional collaboration.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 You are a curious and proactive team player who loves solving complex problems together with others. You turn ideas into action and see learning from mistakes as a natural part of growth. You actively contribute to maintaining a safe, inclusive, and supportive environment within the team, where asking for help is just as natural as offering it.
   

  

**We Believe You Have**
 (Note: You don't need to check every single box to apply!)
   

  

* Solid experience with SQL, data modeling, and modern data tools such as BigQuery and dbt.
* Experience with streaming data and message queues (e.g., Kafka).
* Strong background in software engineering (e.g., Java) and API design in distributed environments—you have your primary focus in data, but can code application logic when needed.
* An interest in systems monitoring, observability, and analytics support.
* A humble, solution-oriented mindset where you prioritise team success and knowledge sharing.
* Professional working proficiency in English, Swedish is a bonus but not a must.


**Bonus Points If You Have**
* Previous experience working with both user behavior data (e.g., clickstream, event tracking, product analytics) and core platform/financial data, with a track record of combining them to build holistic insights.
* Experience working with Python for advanced data automation or AI/ML integrations.
* A curiosity and passion for taking an AI-first approach to problem-solving and software/data development.
* Prior experience working in a regulated environment such as banking or fintech.


**What Success Looks Like at Avanza & in this Role**
 We have many customers and they love the product!
   

  

 Success means building reliable, high-impact data pipelines that power our Danish expansion, collaborating seamlessly across tech domains, and fostering an environment where innovation and knowledge-sharing thrive.
   

  

**Ready to Build the Future of Banking with Us?**
 We apply a hybrid workplace model and love seeing each other at our renovated office at Regeringsgatan 103 about 2–3 days a week.
   

  

 If you're excited to help bring Avanza to Denmark with an AI-first mindset, we’d love to hear from you! We review applications continuously, so feel free to apply today.
   

  

 Ready to get started?
 **Click the “Apply” button below**

title: Utredare inom strålskydd för radioaktiva ämnen - Allmänhet och miljö
description:
**Vill du vara med och forma framtidens strålskydd i Sverige? Hos Strålsäkerhetsmyndigheten arbetar du med några av samhällets mest komplexa miljö- och strålskyddsfrågor. Du bidrar till utvecklingen av regelverk, riskbedömningar och miljöövervakning som får betydelse både nationellt och internationellt.**
 Vi söker en utredare till vår enhet Strålskydd. Du blir organisatoriskt placerad på enheten för Strålskydd som ansvarar för att utveckla kunskap i syfte att upprätthålla och stärka strålskyddet för patienter, arbetstagare, allmänhet och miljö. I enhetens uppdrag ingår att ta fram underlag för lagstiftning, policyer, strategier och andra styrmedel. Placeringsort är Göteborg, Katrineholm eller Solna.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som utredare bidrar du till myndighetens utvecklingsarbete inom strålskydd för allmänhet och miljö med fokus på radioaktiva ämnen. Arbetet kombinerar kunskapsuppbyggnad, egna utredningar och stöd till övrig verksamhet, exempelvis vid tillståndsprövning och tillsyn. Du kan exempelvis komma att utreda hur utsläpp från nya kärntekniska anläggningar ska bedömas, utveckla nationell miljöövervakning eller representera Sverige i internationella expertgrupper.
   

  

 Arbetet omfattar även att ge råd och sprida information om strålning, dess egenskaper och användningsområden samt hur ett effektivt strålskydd kan upprätthållas.
   

  

 I dina arbetsuppgifter ingår att:
   

  

* medverka i tillståndsprövning och utveckla granskningsförmåga kopplat till kärntekniska verksamheter med fokus på utsläpp, dosberäkningar och tillämpning av BAT
* delta i och vidareutveckla arbetet med systematisk riskvärdering inom strålskydd
* genomföra utredningar om exponering och risker samt ta fram beslutsunderlag
* arbeta med miljöövervakning av radioaktiva ämnen, inklusive analys och presentation av data
* vara expertstöd inom exempelvis föreskriftsutveckling, forskning, tillsyn och prövning
* bidra till internationell rapportering och samverkan.


 Du blir en del av en grupp med experter inom radioekologi, dosimetri, miljöövervakning, kärnteknik och riskanalys där kunskapsutbyte är en naturlig del av vardagen.
   

  

**Om dig**
 Vi söker dig som har:
   

  

* en universitets- eller högskoleutbildning på minst kandidatnivå inom t ex fysik, biologi eller annat relevant naturvetenskapligt eller tekniskt område
* minst fem års aktuell arbetslivserfarenhet av kvalificerat analys- eller utredningsarbete inom t ex strålskydd, kärnteknik, miljöriskbedömning, miljöövervakning eller annan närliggande verksamhet
* god kunskap om strålskyddsprinciper och riskbedömning kopplat till joniserande strålning
* förståelse för kärntekniska verksamheter och deras påverkan på människa och miljö
* mycket god förmåga att uttrycka sig i tal och skrift på svenska och god förmåga på engelska.


 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av exempelvis arbete inom en myndighet, forskningsorganisation eller annan kunskapsintensiv verksamhet. Kunskap om BAT-principer och miljörättsliga frågeställningar är också meriterande liksom erfarenhet av miljöövervakning eller arbete med utsläpps- och dosfrågor.
   

  

 För att lyckas i rollen är du initiativtagande och självgående. Du tar ansvar för dina uppgifter, driver arbetet framåt och ser möjligheter att hitta nya angreppssätt.
   

  

 Du är noggrann, kvalitetsmedveten och analytisk och strävar efter att leverera välgrundade analyser och beslutsunderlag med hög kvalitet. Du är också strukturerad och uthållig, med förmåga att planera, prioritera och arbeta metodiskt – även i komplexa frågor och längre processer.
   

  

 Som medarbetare på Strålsäkerhetsmyndigheten förväntas du leva upp till vår värdegrund . Att arbeta i staten innebär att du följer den statliga värdegrunden . Det ställs särskilda krav på omdöme, säkerhetstänkande och att du följer gällande lagar.
   

  

**En arbetsplats med mening**
 Som medarbetare på Strålsäkerhetsmyndigheten är du en del av ett viktigt samhällsuppdrag. Hos oss arbetar många olika kompetenser tillsammans i frågor som rör teknik, naturvetenskap, samhälle, juridik och kommunikation. Du får ett arbete där du kan utvecklas i din yrkesroll samtidigt som du bidrar till något som är viktigt på riktigt – för säkerhetens skull.
   

  

**Om anställningen**
 Anställningen är tillsvidare med start enligt överenskommelse. Anställningen kan komma att inledas med provanställning i sex månader. Eftersom vi tror starkt på samarbete mellan kollegor vill vi att du jobbar från kontoret majoriteten av din arbetstid men du har också möjlighet att jobba hemifrån del av tiden. Resor i tjänsten förekommer.
   

  

 En anställning hos oss kan innebära placering i säkerhetsklass. En säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) kan därför komma att genomföras före beslut om anställning. För en del av våra arbetsuppgifter i säkerhetsklass krävs svenskt medborgarskap.
   

  

**Vill du veta mer?**
 Om du vill ha mer information om arbetsuppgifterna innan du ansöker kan du kontakta enhetschef Carl Bladh, 08-799 44 84. Vill du veta mer om rekryteringsprocessen kan du kontakta Annika Kjerrman, hr, 08-799 43 75.
   

  

 Vill du prata med en facklig företrädare? kontakta Johan Persson, Saco-S, 08-799 44 85, Michael Wallin, ST, 08-799 42 87, eller SEKO, 077-045 79 00.
   

  

 Du ansöker enkelt genom att bifoga ditt CV samt genom att svara på några urvalsfrågor. Läs mer om Vår rekryteringsprocess - Strålsäkerhetsmyndigheten.
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 16 oktober 2026.**
 Vi arbetar för att Sverige ska vara strålsäkert – från strålskydd och kärnsäkerhet till arbetet mot nukleär icke-spridning. Genom nationella och internationella samarbeten bidrar vi till ett tryggt samhälle.
   

  

 Våra kontor finns i Solna, Katrineholm och Göteborg. Läs mer om oss och följ oss på LinkedIn.

I nästa steg laddar du upp dina universitetsbetyg och svarar på frågor kopplade till rollen, inklusive en motivering till varför du söker vårt Consulting Internship. title: Master Thesis - Datadriven identifiering av energieffektiviseringspotential i industriella process
description:
Bakgrund
   

  

 I takt med att fokus på hållbar produktion ökar är en viktig del av Scanias energiarbete att eliminera energislöserier och energieffektivisera processer. En stor del av den tillförda energin används i våra tillverkningsprocesser för att driva maskiner och utrustningar. Samtidigt uppskattas cirka 15–40 % av den tillförda energin utgöras av slöseri, det vill säga energi som inte skapar något värde till produkt och kund. Scania har ett etablerat arbete med att minska energianvändning per producerat fordon och eliminera energislöserier, men inneboende potentialer under pågående processdrifter är mer komplext. Energiprestanda under drift påverkas av bland annat produktionsvolym, produktmix, cykeltid, stopptid, omarbete, kassation, temperatur, fuktighet, börvärden och utrustningars tillstånd.
   

  

 Scania har nu identifierat ett behov av att öka kunskapen om hur energi-KPIer (Key Performance Indicators) kan användas tillsammans med fler relevanta parametrar för att detektera avvikelser och analysera tekniska processers energiprestanda.
   

  

 Uppdragsbeskrivning
   

  

 Det tidigare examensarbetet vid Scania utvecklade ett ramverk för processnära energi-KPI:er och visade särskilt behovet av fler förklarande parametrar. I caset gav enkel regression mellan daglig energianvändning och produktionsvolym hög förklaringsgrad när dagar utan produktion ingick, men mycket låg förklaringsgrad när endast produktionsdagar analyserades. Resultatet pekar på att det behövs mer kunskap om hur förklarande nyckeltal, processdata och andra processvariabler kan användas för att hitta avvikelser och bedöma energiprestanda under tiden tillverkningsprocessen är i drift.
   

  

 Syftet med arbetet är att utveckla ny kunskap hur tillverkande verksamheter kan använda multivariant-analys av energi-, produktions-, kvalitets- och processdata för att identifiera, värdera och prioritera energieffektiviseringsåtgärder. Arbetssättet ska stödja Scania Production System (SPS) där både eliminering av energislöseri och förbättringar där energiprestanda optimeras tillsammans med övriga parametrar, såsom kvalitet och produktivitet.
   

  

 Målet med arbetet är att utveckla och testa arbetsprocess, metod och verktyg för datadriven identifiering av energieffektiviseringspotential i industriella processer. För att verka för generella resultat kommer testobjekt vara två skilda energiintensiva processavsnitt med olika tillverkningstekniker på Scania.
   

  

 Förslag forskningsfrågor
   

  

  

* Vilka energi-, produktions-, kvalitets- och processparametrar är mest relevanta för att förklara variationer i energianvändning och energiprestanda i de två valda pilotområdena?
* Vilken analysmetod är mest lämplig för att skapa ett tillförlitligt och begripligt beslutsunderlag, exempelvis enkel eller multipel regressionsanalys?
* Hur kan avvikelser från en normaliserad energibaslinje användas för att skilja naturlig variation från slöseri, kvalitetsförlust, produktionsvolym eller förbättringspotential?


 Genomförande
   

  

 Arbetet utförs med handledning från institution samt utsedd handledare på avdelningen QFX i Södertälje. Studenten ska vid behov vara närvarande på Scanias produktionsanläggning i Södertälje i den omfattning som behövs för att uppfylla målet. QFX tillhandahåller kontorsplats med bärbar dator och erforderligt stöd. I uppdraget ingår att inhämta data från maskiner & utrustningar, utföra intervjuer och uppföljningar med berörda roller.
   

  

 Mål
   

  

 Arbetet ska resultera i en analysmodell som kan användas för att:
   

  

  

* förstå vilka typer av parametrar som är viktiga att integrera i analysmodell för att uppfylla syftet
* förklara förändringar i energiprestanda under produktionstid
* föreslå ett mått (låg→hög) på volymrörlighet där energianvändning per tillverkad produkt är indikatorer


 Resultatet har en direkt påverkan i Scanias organisation eftersom analysmodellen kommer, efter internremiss, implementeras i verksamheten och vara ett stöd i Scanias fortsatta energiarbete och bidra till att energi-KPI går från att enbart beskriva energianvändningen till att även användas för att förstå och påverka den.
   

  

 Förutsättningar
   

  

 Kompetens och mätutrustning finns att tillgå inom Scania Industrial Maintenance AB, främst på avdelningen QFX, Energi- och Media.
   

  

 Arbetets omfattning
   

  

 Examensarbete, master thesis, à 30 HP (20 veckor).
   

  

 Startdatum januari/februari 2027.
   

  

 Ersättning
   

  

 Ersättning utgår för godkänt arbete enligt företagets riktlinjer.
   

  

 Kontaktpersoner
   

  

 Uppdragsgivare: Roland Dahlström, QFX, roland.dahlstrom@scania.com, tel: 070 553 49 95
   

  

 Handledare: Abdullah Asaid, QFX, abdullah.x.asaid@scania.com
   

  

 Ansökan
   

  

 Din ansökan skall innehålla CV, personligt brev och betygskopior. Vi kommer under denna rekryteringsprocess hantera ansökningarna löpande. Uppdragen kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. En bakgrundskontroll kan göras för denna position.
   

  

 Ansökningsperiod:
   

  

 2026-10-16 – 2026-11-22

title: Utredare inom strålskydd – kärnteknisk verksamhet
description:
**Vill du vara med och forma framtidens strålskydd och bidra till en säker utveckling av svensk kärnteknisk verksamhet? Sverige står inför nya möjligheter och utmaningar på det kärntekniska området, vilket ställer höga krav på kunskap och analys. Som utredare på Strålsäkerhetsmyndigheten får du använda din kompetens för att utreda komplexa frågor och bidra till underlag och bedömningar av stor betydelse för samhällets säkerhet. Vi söker dig med relevant naturvetenskaplig eller teknisk bakgrund som vill göra skillnad i ett område under utveckling.**
 Vi söker en utredare till vår enhet Strålskydd. Du blir organisatoriskt placerad på enheten för Strålskydd som ansvarar för att upprätthålla och stärka strålskyddet för patienter, arbetstagare, allmänhet och miljö. I enhetens uppdrag ingår att utveckla kunskap samt ta fram underlag för lagstiftning, policyer, strategier och andra styrmedel. Placeringsort är Göteborg, Katrineholm eller Solna.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Du arbetar med att utveckla och tillämpa kunskap inom strålskydd och bidrar med analyser, utredningar och expertstöd i myndighetens arbete, exempelvis vid tillståndsprövning och normering. Arbetet spänner från långsiktiga och strategiska strålskyddsfrågor till konkreta utredningar, riskbedömningar och kunskapsunderlag för myndighetens ställningstaganden. Du har en nyckelroll i ett kunskapsdrivet arbete där analys, strategi och samhällsnytta möts.
   

  

 I dina arbetsuppgifter ingår att:
   

  

* medverka i och utveckla myndighetens granskningsförmåga inför tillståndsprövning kopplat till etablering och drift av kärntekniska verksamheter, med särskilt fokus på strålskydd för arbetstagare och allmänhet
* delta i och vidareutveckla arbetet med systematisk riskvärdering inom strålskydd för arbetstagare och allmänhet
* initiera och genomföra utredningar inom aktuella strålskyddsfrågor
* ta fram kunskapsunderlag för policy, rekommendationer och beslut
* ge råd och sprida information om strålning och strålskydd
* samverka i nationella och internationella sammanhang.


 Hos oss får du möjlighet att fördjupa din expertis inom strålskydd och kärnteknik samtidigt som du utvecklar din förmåga att arbeta strategiskt med policy, regelutveckling och tillståndsfrågor. Du blir en del av en grupp med bred kompetens inom strålskydd, där du arbetar tillsammans med kollegor med olika specialistområden och erfarenheter. Kunskapsutbyte och samarbete mellan olika kompetensområden är en naturlig del av arbetet.
   

  

**Om dig**
 Vi söker dig som har:
   

  

* en universitets- eller högskoleutbildning på minst kandidatnivå inom t ex strålningsfysik, strålskydd eller annat relevant naturvetenskapligt eller tekniskt område
* minst fem års aktuell relevant arbetslivserfarenhet av kvalificerat analys- eller utredningsarbete inom strålskydd vid kärnteknisk verksamhet eller närliggande område
* god kunskap om strålskyddssystem och riskbedömning kopplat till joniserande strålning
* förståelse för strålskyddsaspekter vid kärntekniska verksamheter
* god analytisk förmåga
* mycket god förmåga att uttrycka sig i tal och skrift på svenska och god förmåga på engelska.


 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av arbete inom en myndighet, forskningsorganisation eller annan kunskapsintensiv verksamhet. Erfarenhet av utredningar och kunskapssammanställningar inom strålskydd som underlag för riskvärderingar, policyutveckling, råd och rekommendationer är också meriterande.
   

  

 För att lyckas i rollen är du driven, resultatinriktad och strukturerad. Du tar initiativ, driver arbetet framåt och ser till att uppgifter blir genomförda med hög kvalitet och inom uppsatta tidsramar. Du har ett strategiskt och långsiktigt perspektiv, samtidigt som du kan växla mellan helhet och detaljer och göra väl avvägda prioriteringar.
   

  

 Rollen innebär många kontaktytor och därför är det viktigt att du är lyhörd och samarbetsinriktad. Du kommunicerar tydligt, bygger goda relationer och bidrar aktivt till ett konstruktivt samarbete. Du trivs med att ta ansvar och tillsammans med andra skapa resultat i ett komplext och samhällsviktigt område.
   

  

 Som medarbetare på Strålsäkerhetsmyndigheten förväntas du leva upp till vår värdegrund . Att arbeta i staten innebär att du följer den statliga värdegrunden . Det ställs särskilda krav på omdöme, säkerhetstänkande och att du följer gällande lagar.
   

  

**En arbetsplats med mening**
 Som medarbetare på Strålsäkerhetsmyndigheten är du en del av ett viktigt samhällsuppdrag. Hos oss arbetar många olika kompetenser tillsammans i frågor som rör teknik, naturvetenskap, samhälle, juridik och kommunikation. Du får ett arbete där du kan utvecklas i din yrkesroll samtidigt som du bidrar till något som är viktigt på riktigt – för säkerhetens skull.
   

  

**Om anställningen**
 Anställningen är tillsvidare med start enligt överenskommelse. Anställningen kan komma att inledas med provanställning i sex månader. Eftersom vi tror starkt på samarbete mellan kollegor vill vi att du jobbar från kontoret majoriteten av din arbetstid men du har också möjlighet att jobba hemifrån del av tiden. Resor i tjänsten förekommer.
   

  

 En anställning hos oss kan innebära placering i säkerhetsklass. En säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) kan därför komma att genomföras före beslut om anställning. För en del av våra arbetsuppgifter i säkerhetsklass krävs svenskt medborgarskap.
   

  

**Vill du veta mer?**

 Vill du prata med en facklig företrädare? kontakta Johan Persson, Saco-S, 08-799 44 85, Michael Wallin, ST, 08-799 42 87, eller SEKO, 077-045 79 00.
   

  

 Du ansöker enkelt genom att bifoga ditt CV samt genom att svara på några urvalsfrågor. Läs mer om Vår rekryteringsprocess - Strålsäkerhetsmyndigheten.
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan senast den 25 oktober 2026.**
 Vi arbetar för att Sverige ska vara strålsäkert – från strålskydd och kärnsäkerhet till arbetet mot nukleär icke-spridning. Genom nationella och internationella samarbeten bidrar vi till ett tryggt samhälle.

title: Master Thesis Student
description:
**Title: Master Thesis Student (more than one position, 30 ECTS or 45 ECTS theses) AI-based fault detection**
 The research and development divisions of Scania, Man and International have merged into a common research and development organisation under the name Traton.
   

  

 Traton's engine development is an important part of meeting our ambitious environmental goals with an ecosystem of sustainable transport. Among other things, controlling finding faults and unwanted behaviour, such as wear or malfunction of component, significantly affect the uptime, total cost of ownership and environmental impact of the vehicles Traton develop.
   

  

 Our sections are responsible for drive train control system pre-development and drive train software. Parts of the vehicle design with a major impact on the environmental impact and greenhouse gas footprint.
   

  

 We are a strong multi-cultural team with different backgrounds and experience, where a devotion for technical development and requirements balancing are the common denominator. Together we normally supervise 10-20 theses students a year and we regularly get the feedback that our way of working is characterized by an inclusive, positive and helpful attitude.
   

  

 With us, you will have the opportunity to do your thesis on a major company leading the development towards a sustainable future. You will have the opportunity to develop your engineering skills, to learn if the Scania work culture suits your future career goals and to show your abilities and talents over 20 weeks of thesis work.
   

  

**Thesis assignment:**
 As for all theses the work will be divided in four phases. Starting with the tentative research question an iterative information survey will take place during the first four weeks ending with a more or less finalized introduction, motivation, research question, literature survey and method choice as well as a time plan. The following twelve weeks consists of the main thesis work, divided in two parts and split by a mid-term seminar feedback option. Finally it’s time to write up the thesis and present it orally both at Scania and the grading university.
   

  

 The research of these theses will be focused on the design and verification of a new AI-based model for parameter quantification and fault detection on an Internal combustion engine. The study will mostly be theoretical utilizing data from previous experiments, but for the interested student an experimental verification can be added to the thesis.
   

  

**Student profile:**
 We are looking for someone who is an imaginative, communicative, initiative-taking and structured problem solver who sees opportunities. You have a positive attitude, find it easy to make new contacts and appreciate working both in a team and on your own.
   

  

 The would preferably be:
   

  

  

* Educated in computer science and programming.
* With experience on using AI as problem solving tool in modelling projects.
* Having worked with Matlab evaluating and presenting results.
* A Master of Science student in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics, computer science or similar.


 As documentation is available in multiple languages proficient in Swedish and English in speech and writing is required.
   

  

 If you have questions on the thesis or on the recruitment process please contact Dr. Ola Stenlåås, ola.stenlaas@scania.com.

title: Master Thesis Student

**Title: Master Thesis Student AI based process, method and tool for automatic software documentation and signal requirement specification**
 The research and development divisions of Scania, Man and International have merged into a common research and development organisation under the name Traton.
   

  

 Traton's control system development is an important part of meeting our ambitious sustainability goals with an ecosystem of sustainable transport. Among other things, a uniform diagnostics and component design for the desired vehicle life length is important and a part of Traton being a world leader.
   

  

 Our sections are responsible for drive train control system pre-development and drive train software. Parts of the vehicle design with a major impact on the environmental impact and greenhouse gas footprint.
   

  

 We are a strong multi-cultural team with different backgrounds and experience, where a devotion for technical development and requirements balancing are the common denominator. Together we normally supervise 10-30 theses students a year and we regularly get the feedback that our way of working is characterized by an inclusive, positive and helpful attitude.
   

  

 With us, you will have the opportunity to do your thesis on a major company leading the development towards a sustainable future. You will have the opportunity to develop your engineering skills, to learn if the Scania work culture suits your future career goals and to show your abilities and talents over 20 weeks of thesis work.
   

  

**Thesis assignment:**
 As for all theses the work will be divided in four phases. Starting with the tentative research question an iterative information survey will take place during the first four weeks ending with a more or less finalized introduction, motivation, research question, literature survey and method choice as well as a time plan. The following twelve weeks consists of the main thesis work, divided in two parts and split by a mid-term seminar feedback option. Finally it’s time to write up the thesis and present it orally both at Scania and the grading university.

 We are looking for someone who is an imaginative, communicative, initiative-taking and structured problem solver who sees opportunities. You have a positive attitude, find it easy to make new contacts and appreciate working both in a team and on your own.
   

  

 We want you to be:
