 Erfarenheten ska ha införskaffats de senaste 8 åren.
   

  

**Meriterande kompetens (Börkrav):**
* Erfarenhet av att ha arbetat inom säkerhetsklassad verksamhet.
* Erfarenhet av att ha arbetat i Azure Devops
* Erfarenhet av Powershell
* Erfarenhet/kunskap om Linux

title: IT Manager
description:
**Meet Yubico**
 Yubico is a global leader in identity security and creator of the YubiKey, the original hardware-backed passkey. We are publicly traded on Nasdaq Stockholm; our global footprint includes headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, Silicon Valley, California; and Singapore.
   

  

**Why Join Our Mission?**
 At Yubico, We Are Guided By a Shared Belief That Your Work Matters. We Operate Under a Cultural Philosophy Of Speed With Integrity, Pushing The Boundaries Of Technology To Secure The AI Frontier—protecting Both Human And Agentic AI Interactions—and Leading The Transition To Post-quantum Cryptography. In Everything We Do, We Live By Our Core Values
   

  

* Battle Friction: We constantly look for new ways to simplify our products, our work, and the user experience.
* Inspire Higher: We think big, champion the open internet, and strive to do the right thing even when it is difficult.
* One Team: We are open, responsive, and collaborative, overcoming challenges and celebrating our successes together.


 Aligned with our commitment to open standards, we foster a thriving builder ecosystem through the Yubico Developer Program, offering free open-source repositories, libraries, and SDKs to help developers rapidly integrate strong hardware authentication into any application. Through close collaborations with technical partners like Google, Microsoft, and Amazon, as well as newer frontiers like OpenAI, we continue to shape a safer digital world while donating security keys to protect vulnerable communities, journalists, and humanitarian groups worldwide through our
 *Secure it Forward* 
 program.
   

  

**The Role**
 We are looking for a talented IT Manager to lead our global IT Support and Services team. In this role, you will play a critical part in maximizing the team's full potential, ensuring the efficient operation of our Information Technology department, and driving key business objectives.
   

  

 As a hands-on IT Manager, you will focus on executing, optimizing, and maintaining operational workflows. Your responsibilities will include overseeing core technologies, scaling IT support operations on a global level, and managing the IT work queue to ensure service delivery to our workforce worldwide. Based at our Stockholm headquarters, the role requires regular on-site presence with some remote flexibility.
   

  

**About You**
* You are an approachable, people-first leader who thrives in a collaborative, close-knit team environment.
* You are highly process-oriented and passionate about creating order out of chaos through automation and clear workflows.
* You are a systematic troubleshooter who looks beyond immediate fixes to solve the root causes of systemic IT challenges.


**Roles And Responsibilities**
* Team Leadership & Mentorship: Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing, globally distributed IT Support and Services team, fostering a culture of continuous learning and collaboration.
* Queue & Service Management: Own the global IT service desk queue and escalations, ensuring effective service delivery and high user satisfaction.
* Process Optimization: Design, document, and continuously improve IT processes and automated workflows, utilizing an automate-first mindset to scale with Yubico's growth.
* IT Operations: Drive reliable service delivery and optimal performance of core IT services, alongside providing dedicated support for our Supply Chain teams.
* Vendor Management: Manage vendor relations and the augmented workforce, including contractor management and tracking renewals and spend for hardware and software suppliers.
* IT Asset Management: Manage IT asset inventory and lifecycle to optimize spend, support sustainability, and ensure optimal hardware refresh cycles globally.
* Security & Compliance Alignment: Partner with Security to ensure IT processes, access controls, and device baselines adhere to strict internal security policies and external global compliance standards.
* AI Administration and Support: Drive adoption and enhance operational efficiency across Yubico by supporting AI enablement initiatives.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Proven IT Leadership: Demonstrated experience managing IT support teams in a fast-paced, scaling environment. 5+ years of professional IT experience, including 2+ years in an IT management role.
* Strong Systems Knowledge: Deep familiarity with modern productivity suites (e.g., Google Workspace, Microsoft 365), enterprise SaaS solutions, and device management for both macOS and Windows environments.
* Service & Workflow Tooling: Practical experience utilizing modern IT project management, ticketing, and workflow tools (e.g. Jira Service Management).
* Security Fundamentals: An understanding of modern IT security principles, identity management, and endpoint security.
* Communication: Strong leadership, interpersonal, and communication skills to effectively collaborate with cross-functional global stakeholders.


**Bonus Qualifications**
* Relevant industry certifications (e.g., ITIL).
* Experience with Asset Management systems (e.g., SnipeIT) and the broader Atlassian Suite.


 We are an equal opportunity employer, we value diversity and uphold an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. We'd love to learn about what you can add to our diverse team. We are an E-Verify Participating Employer.
   

  

 Yubico does not accept agency resumes or referrals so please do not send them to our careers staff or employees. Yubico is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes or referrals.
   

  

 Personal data submitted through this form is used for managing Yubico’s recruitment activities, which include facilitating any application you make, setting up and conducting interviews and tests for applicants, evaluating and assessing results and selecting candidates, and as otherwise needed in our recruitment and onboarding processes. The use of your personal data may also be necessary prior to entering into a contract with you (that is prior to offering you a job with Yubico). Your personal data will only be used for the purposes for which it was collected and in accordance with the Yubico Privacy Notice. We only keep your personal data for as long as necessary and in compliance with Yubico’s record retention policies. If you have asked us to, we will keep you informed of other opportunities at Yubico. We do this in various ways, including email and by phone. If at any time you do not want us to contact you or use your information as described herein please contact us at jobs@yubico.com to let us know and we will delete all such information. Providing your personal data is voluntary, but necessary to join our talent community, and if you do not agree to provide your data, we will not be able to consider you as part of our talent community.
   

  

 As part of providing the requested service, we will transfer your data to be processed by Greenhouse Software Inc., a service provider contracted by Yubico AB and/or its subsidiaries that meets legally mandated privacy requirements. The Yubico Privacy Notice offers more information about Yubico privacy practices, including the lawful basis for processing of personal data, how to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority, and how to contact Yubico to exercise your data subject rights. In this notice, when we refer to "Yubico", "us", "we" or "our", we mean the Yubico group company or companies that you apply to, or correspond with, and which are responsible for any personal data collected about you.

title: IT-specialist med säkerhetsprofil – bygg och säkra Musts kritiska IT-miljöer
description:
**Vill du ha ett meningsfullt arbete och bidra till ett säkrare Sverige i en osäker värld?**
 Militära underrättelse- och säkerhetstjänsten (Must) söker nu en IT-specialist med säkerhetsprofil till Systemavdelningen. Systemavdelningen etablerar, driftsätter, förvaltar och utvecklar IT-system med höga krav på säkerhet och separation. Rollen kombinerar systemadministration, automation, virtualisering, nätverk och IT-säkerhet, och du bidrar till Musts operativa verksamhet med teknik i framkant.
   

  

 Du arbetar i team med korsvisa beroenden men är också bekväm med att lösa utmaningar på egen hand. Arbetsmetoden (agilt, vattenfall eller annan projektform) anpassas efter uppdragets karaktär och mål.
   

  

 Vi erbjuder ett meningsfullt arbete med tydligt samhällssyfte och direkt koppling till Sveriges säkerhet. Tekniska utmaningar i separerade miljöer med höga säkerhetskrav – sådana du sällan möter någon annanstans. Goda möjligheter till fördjupad kompetensutveckling.
   

  

**Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:**
* Bygga, konfigurera och förvalta IT-system och tjänster i Linux- och containermiljöer med höga krav på säkerhet och separation
* Utveckla och automatisera infrastruktur och driftuppgifter med scripting, konfigurationshantering och infrastruktur som kod
* Arbeta med virtualiseringsplattformar
* Stödja IT-säkerhetsarbetet genom teknisk härdning, underlag till ackreditering och framtagning av IT-säkerhetsspecifikationer
* Dokumentera system, konfigurationer och förändringar på ett strukturerat och spårbart sätt
* Bidra till avdelningens samlade tekniska förmåga och kompetensutveckling


**Personliga egenskaper**
 Du har ett genuint teknikintresse och vill förstå hur saker fungerar, inte bara att de fungerar. Säkerhet är för dig ett förhållningssätt, inte ett verktyg du plockar fram vid behov.
   

  

 Du är lösningsorienterad och kreativ. När något krånglar ser du möjligheter snarare än hinder och hittar nya vägar framåt utan att göra avkall på säkerheten. Samtidigt är du metodisk, noggrann, och dokumentation samt uppföljning är en naturlig del av ditt arbetssätt.
   

  

 Du är resultatorienterad och driver ditt arbete hela vägen i mål. Du är samarbetsorienterad, delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och bidrar till att teamet lyckas, men trivs också med att ta egna initiativ och arbeta självständigt.
   

  

 Du har hög personlig integritet och förstår att diskretion kring arbetsuppgifterna är en grundförutsättning i rollen.
   

  

 Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet.
   

  

**Kvalifikationer**
* Relevant utbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet införskaffad på annat sätt som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig
* Minst tre års yrkeserfarenhet som IT-specialist eller i liknande roll
* Erfarenhet av virtualisering (t.ex. VMware, KVM eller Citrix)
* Aktuell erfarenhet av containerteknologi och infrastruktur som kod
* Aktuell erfarenhet av Linux-servermiljö
* Goda kunskaper i scriptspråk och automation
* God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift


**Meriterande**
* Erfarenhet av IT-säkerhetsarbete, t.ex. härdning eller ackrediteringsprocesser (KSF, ITSS)
* Erfarenhet av nätverk och IT-infrastruktur
* Erfarenhet av liknande arbete inom Försvarsmakten eller annan myndighet med höga säkerhetskrav


 Ovan ställda kvalifikationer ska på begäran kunna verifieras genom intyg, referenser samt arbets- eller urvalstester.
   

  

*För att myndighetens uppdrag ska vara framgångsrikt förutsätts att alla medarbetare uppträder enligt den värdegrund som finns. Försvarsmaktens värdegrund slår vakt om alla människors lika värde, rättvisa och jämlikhet och främjar demokrati och mänskliga rättigheter (läs mer på www.forsvarsmakten.se).*
**Övrigt**
 Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning som inleds med provanställning om sex månader
   

  

 Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse
   

  

 Arbetsort: Stockholm
   

  

**För upplysningar om befattningen eller rekryteringsprocessen kontakta:**
 hkv-rekrytering-must@mil.se, vänligen skriv ”IT-specialist med säkerhetsprofil SL” i ämnesraden.
   

  

**Fackliga företrädare**
 Fackliga representanter nås via hkv-rekrytering-must@mil.se
   

  

*Varmt välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-11-13. I ditt CV och personliga brev vill vi att du*
*beskriver på vilket sätt du uppfyller våra efterfrågade krav och meriter. Du ansöker via*
*jobb.forsvarsmakten.se.*
 ,
 **Ansökningar till denna befattning kommer endast tas emot via Försvarsmaktens webbplats.** 
 -------------------------------------------------------- Militära underrättelse- och säkerhetstjänsten (Must) är en del av Försvarsmaktens högkvarter i Stockholm. Vi ger regeringen och Försvarsmakten kvalificerade beslutsunderlag om omvärldsutvecklingen och hot mot Sveriges och Försvarsmaktens säkerhet. Vår vision är ”Ett säkrare Sverige i en osäker värld”. Must är en kunskapsorganisation och erbjuder både spännande och för Sverige angelägna arbetsuppgifter. Här arbetar både officerare och civila experter inom olika områden, t ex statsvetenskap, IT, ekonomi, teknik, matematik och HR. En stor del av Must verksamhet omfattas av sekretess och vi ber dig därför att inte berätta att du sökt jobb hos Must för andra personer än dina närmaste. Läs gärna mer om Must och vår verksamhet här Varje dag och varje timme gör våra medarbetare insatser som påverkar andra människors liv, både i stort och smått, och både på hemmaplan och runt om i världen. Försvarsmakten ger dig möjlighet att utvecklas som människa och växa i din professionella roll. Vi är en ansvarstagande arbetsgivare och har en öppen organisation där vi ställer upp för varandra. I Försvarsmakten finns en stark värdegrund som bygger på öppenhet, resultat och ansvar. Professionell utveckling och personlig hälsa värdesätts och uppmuntras. Det finns goda förutsättningar för intern karriärrörlighet, friskvård och bra balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Försvarsmakten tillvaratar de kvaliteter som mångfald och jämn könsfördelning tillför verksamheten. Vi välkomnar därför sökanden med olika bakgrund och erfarenheter i våra rekryteringar. En anställning hos oss innebär placering i säkerhetsklass. Vanligtvis krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer att genomföras före anställning enligt 3 kap i säkerhetsskyddslagen. Med anställning följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras. I anställningen ingår även en skyldighet att tjänstgöra utomlands. Innebörden av detta varierar beroende på typ av befattning. Till ansökan om anställning ska CV och personligt brev bifogas. Om du går vidare i anställningsprocessen ska alltid vidimerade kopior av betyg och intyg uppvisas. Samtal från externa rekryteringsföretag och säljare undanbedes.

title: IT Service Delivery Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 The IT Service Delivery Manager is accountable for the end-to-end ownership, governance, and continuous improvement of assigned IT services, systems, and applications throughout their lifecycle. 
   

 The role ensures that services remain aligned with business needs, agreed service expectations, security and policy requirements, user communication standards, financial structures, and vendor obligations. 
   

 Key areas of ownership include service lifecycle management, business impact analysis coordination, usage monitoring, service performance follow-up, compliance and audit activities, license management, vendor and contract coordination, and decommissioning initiation when systems or applications no longer meet requirements or have limited usage. 
   

 The role is also accountable for enabling effective communication between users, business stakeholders, vendors, and IT, including communication related to service requests, bug reports, release notes, outages, planned changes, risks, and service improvements. 
   

 Through structured governance, stakeholder collaboration, and clear accountability, the IT Service Delivery Manager supports reliable, compliant, cost-aware, and business-aligned IT service delivery. 
   

  

**Job Requirements**
* Ability to take end-to-end ownership of assigned IT services, systems, and applications, including lifecycle management, usage monitoring, service relevance, and decommissioning coordination.
* Ability to understand business needs, translate them into service expectations, and manage communication with users, business stakeholders, IT teams, vendors, and governance functions.
* Strong capability in service management practices, including service performance follow-up, risk coordination, incident/request/change-related communication, and continuous improvement of service delivery.


* Ability to coordinate service-related compliance, audit evidence, documentation, policy alignment, security requirements, and governance activities within the assigned service scope.
* Ability to support controlled service management through vendor coordination, license oversight, cost awareness, contract follow-up, and financial governance related to assigned services.
* Ability to communicate clearly and proactively about service requests, outages, changes, releases, risks, improvements, and user-impacting issues across technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to assess service usage, performance, risks, trends, feedback, and improvement opportunities to support reliable, transparent, and business-aligned service delivery.
* Ability to work effectively across IT Infrastructure, Software Engineering, Network, Security, Governance, business stakeholders, and external suppliers to ensure coordinated service outcomes.


**Job Responsibilities**
* Own the end-to-end lifecycle of assigned IT services, systems, and applications, ensuring clear accountability from introduction through ongoing operation and decommissioning.
* Govern assigned services to ensure alignment with business needs, agreed service expectations, security requirements, policies, and operational standards.
* Coordinate business impact analysis activities and maintain understanding of service criticality, usage, dependencies, and business relevance.
* Monitor service usage, performance, risks, and improvement needs, and initiate appropriate actions to maintain reliable and business-aligned service delivery.
* Ensure service-related compliance, audit, documentation, and evidence activities are coordinated and maintained in line with applicable requirements.
* Manage license, cost, vendor, and contract-related coordination within the scope of assigned services, supporting cost-aware and controlled service management.
* Facilitate effective communication between users, business stakeholders, vendors, and IT regarding service requests, changes, releases, outages, risks, and improvements.
* Support continuous improvement of assigned services by identifying opportunities to improve service quality, transparency, user experience, and operational effectiveness.
* Initiate and coordinate decommissioning activities when systems or applications no longer meet business, operational, compliance, or usage requirements.


**Job Benefits**
 This role offers the opportunity to grow professionally, build valuable skills, and contribute to meaningful outcomes. It also provides a supportive environment where individuals can develop their strengths and make a real impact.

title: Delivery Lead e-handel till Axfood IT, Stockholm
description:
Välkommen till Axfood IT, en av matbranschens största IT-avdelningar med nästan 400 medarbetare. Det är vi som ser till att Axfood, och alla våra kedjor, kan ligga i framkant vad gäller digital utveckling. Vi jobbar med att utveckla och förbättra allt ifrån e-handel till logistiklösningar och AI.
   

  

 Hos Axfood IT blir du del av ett sammanhang som utmanar och levererar lösningar som gör skillnad, både för våra kollegor och våra kunder. Här finns det alltid möjlighet att lära sig om ny teknik och växa, både som individ och tillsammans med kollegorna.
   

  

**Ditt nya team**
 Som Delivery Lead blir du en del av vår e-handelsorganisation och arbetar för att våra kunder ska få den bästa möjliga upplevelsen när de handlar online. Avdelningen består av flera team som tillsammans hanterar utveckling och vidareutveckling av våra e-handelslösningar i app och webb för Willys och Hemköp. Rollen har en central funktion i området och arbetar därför också nära andra delar av verksamheten för att få människor, prioriteringar och leveranser att hänga ihop.
   

  

 Här får du möjlighet att arbeta i en organisation där e-handel är ett affärskritiskt område och där tillgänglighet, stabilitet och smidiga leveranser är viktiga delar av vardagen. Du bidrar till att våra kunder ska ha den bästa möjligheten när de handlar mat i butik, på bussen eller hemma i soffan.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som Delivery Lead har du ett helhetsansvar för leveransförmåga, planering och koordinering inom området. Du är ett operativt nav som skapar förutsättningar för teamen att lyckas, ser till att prioriteringar blir genomförbara planer och håller ihop beroenden mellan olika team och intressenter.
   

  

 Du arbetar nära flera produktägare, Scrum Masters, arkitekter och Tech Leads på avdelningen, liksom leverantörer och representanter från verksamheten, och kombinerar leveransstyrning med ett coachande ledarskap. I rollen jobbar du också nära vår avdelningschef Jennie Kronander och fattar strategiska beslut för e-handelns framtid.
   

  

 En viktig del av uppdraget är att skapa tydlighet, få samarbetet att fungera och hela tiden utveckla arbetssätt och leveransförmåga.
   

  

**Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat att innebära att:**
* planera och koordinera leveranser, resurser och beroenden över flera team
* omsätta prioriteringar till genomförbara planer och följa upp leverans mot tidplan och budget
* samordna releaser och andra viktiga leveranstillfällen med berörda parter
* följa upp leveranser, incidenter och problem samt driva kontinuerliga förbättringar
* skapa ett nära samarbete mellan utvecklingsteam, verksamhet, leverantörer och andra intressenter
* coacha teammedlemmar och bidra till gemensamma, effektiva arbetssätt


**Din nya chef har ordet**
*Det här är en roll för dig som vill jobba med verkligt kundnära lösningar, i en bransch där du själv är kund. Du får driva och utmana, men framför allt får du människor och team att lyckas tillsammans. -* 
 Jennie Kronander, avdelningschef e-handel
   

  

**Stämmer detta in på dig?**
 För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du har erfarenhet av att leda IT-leveranser i en komplex miljö med många intressenter. Du är van att arbeta nära utvecklingsteam och har förståelse för hela utvecklingskedjan, från planering och utveckling till release och förvaltning.
   

  

**Vi tror att det är viktigt att du har:**
* erfarenhet av att leda team och IT-leveranser i en agil utvecklingsmiljö
* erfarenhet av planering, resursstyrning och koordinering mellan flera team
* god förståelse för systemutveckling och vad som krävs för stabila leveranser med hög kvalitet
* erfarenhet av budget, prognos och ekonomisk uppföljning
* erfarenhet av att samarbeta med och hantera externa leverantörer
* förmåga att kombinera ledarskap, teknisk förståelse, affärsförståelse och tydlig kommunikation.


 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av e-handel eller andra affärskritiska digitala tjänster, liksom erfarenhet av IT Service Management, integrationsplattformar eller betalningslösningar.
   

  

 Som person tror vi att du skapar förtroende genom tydlighet och kommunikation. Du gillar att få många olika perspektiv och beroenden att mötas i en gemensam riktning och är både strukturerad och handlingskraftig. Samtidigt har du ett coachande förhållningssätt och tycker om att skapa förutsättningar för andra att lyckas. Det stämmer väl med rollkatalogens betoning på coachande ledarskap, samarbete och kommunikation.
   

  

**Ansökningsprocessen**
 Vi vill att det ska vara enkelt att söka jobb hos oss. Om du inte har ett CV redo räcker det med att du länkar en väl ifylld LinkedIn-profil. I din ansökan får du svara på de frågor vi behöver svar på i den här delen av processen, och personligt brev är därför inte obligatoriskt.
   

  

 Ansökningar behandlas efter sista ansökningsdatum (8e november). Vår rekryteringsprocess innehåller tester, intervjuer, bakgrundskontroll och ID-kontroll. Observera att vi inte under denna rekryteringsprocess kommer be dig logga in med ditt Bank-id eller scanna någon QR-kod, men vi kommer be dig styrka din identitet i processens slutskede.
   

  

 Vid frågor om rekrytering på Axfood, kontakta Medarbetarsupporten eller läs mer: Så går det till när du söker jobb inom Axfood. Om du har frågor om tjänsten, kontakta jennie.kronander@axfood.se. Av GDPR-skäl behandlar vi inga ansökningar eller annan personlig information via mail.
   

  

 Läs mer och se filmer om Axfood som arbetsgivare här: Din karriärväg hos Axfood | Utveckling och möjligheter | Axfood

title: Software Engineer - Salesforce Marketing Cloud till Axfood IT, Stockholm

 Hos Axfood IT blir du del av ett sammanhang som utmanar och levererar lösningar som gör skillnad, både för våra kollegor och våra kunder. Här finns det alltid möjlighet att lära sig om ny teknik och växa, både som individ och tillsammans med kollegorna.

 Arbetet är teambaserat och du samarbetar tätt med både kollegor inom IT och verksamheten, vilket gör att du får en tydlig koppling mellan det du bygger och den faktiska kundupplevelsen.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som Software Engineer inom Salesforce Marketing Cloud är du med och utvecklar hur vi skapar relevanta och effektiva kundresor i våra digitala kanaler. Rollen är både teknisk och verksamhetsnära, där du arbetar med att bygga, anpassa och optimera kommunikation utifrån data och kundinsikt.
   

  

 Du är med i hela kedjan, från att sätta upp och utveckla lösningar till att följa upp, felsöka och förbättra. Rollen är viktig i vår fortsatta satsning på mer personaliserad och datadriven marknadsföring.
   

  

**Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer att inkludera:**
* Utveckling, konfigurering och förvaltning av lösningar i Salesforce Marketing Cloud
* Skapa och optimera kundresor i kanaler som e-post, SMS och push
* Utveckla och anpassa e-postmallar
* Arbeta med data och segmentering för att förbättra träffsäkerhet i kommunikationen
* Felsöka, testa och optimera befintliga flöden och kampanjer
* Arbeta med data extensions och använda API:er för integrationer


**Stämmer detta in på dig?**
 För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du tycker om att kombinera teknik och kundupplevelse, och att du drivs av att förbättra och optimera lösningar över tid. Du gillar att samarbeta och dela kunskap med andra. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på både svenska och engelska och har ett intresse för datadriven marknadsföring och kundanalys.
   

  

 Du behöver ha en bra grundläggande teknisk förståelse, men i den här rollen finns också möjligheter att lära sig på plats. Vi välkomnar därför även sökanden som är tidigt i karriären.
   

  

**Vi ser det som meriterande om du har:**
* Erfarenhet av Salesforce Marketing Cloud och AMPscript
* Kunskaper i HTML, CSS, SQL och JavaScript
* Vana av att arbeta med API:er och data

**Ansökningsprocessen**

 . Vår rekryteringsprocess innehåller tester, intervjuer, bakgrundskontroll och ID-kontroll. Observera att vi inte under denna rekryteringsprocess kommer be dig logga in med ditt Bank-id eller scanna någon QR-kod, men vi kommer be dig styrka din identitet i processens slutskede.

title: Senior Solutions Engineer Nordics
description:
Acronis is a global leader in cyber protection, delivering AI-powered protection for productive MSPs in a single, natively integrated platform that unifies operations management, cybersecurity, and data protection. Driven by our mission to protect, manage and automate every workload, we’ve built the industry’s only all-in-one solution.
   

  

 The Solution Engineer will be an integral part of the entire sales cycle helping to achieve technical wins and to drive the adoption of our solutions and products. You will get a chance to be a key member of the Sales organization, responsible for the design and architecture of Acronis platform solutions. This is a very dynamic role, and you will have the option to evolve and take your career to the next level.
   

  

 The ideal candidate for this position will not only possess the skills and experience required but will also a positive attitude and ability to solve complex problems and work in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment, have worked with cloud & security technologies or vendors, consulted, or conducted solution sales, and be passionate about understanding new technologies in the cloud computing and security space.
   

  

* Please send your CV's in english. Thank you!


**What You'll Do**
* Collaborate with sales teams and business partners to articulate solutions for service providers, partners, and end customers.
* Participate as an Acronis technology expert in meetings, conduct demos, and pitch products throughout the sales cycle.
* Engage with customers, partners, and internal teams to coordinate activities for selling Acronis solutions.
* Analyze business requirements, market strategies, and policies relating to data protection.
* Manage strategic accounts collaborating with Acronis Account Managers to influence and develop sales strategies.
* Facilitate customer evaluations and proof of concept activities for Acronis solutions.
* Perform technical troubleshooting and secure technical wins during the pre-sales process.
* Position solutions that address customer business problems and act as a technical advisor.
* Conduct hands-on demonstrations and knowledge transfer of Acronis solutions to customers and partners.
* Gather technical requirements, develop cost-effective solutions, and present them to prospects.
* Develop responses to RFIs & RFPs.
* Assist in integrating MSPs RMM platforms with the Acronis Platform and work closely with cross-functional teams.
* Understand complex customer needs and develop innovative solutions.
* Provide customer and market feedback to Product Management, Engineering, and other Acronis teams.


**What You Bring**
* Cloud-based applications such as Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace
* Backup, Disaster Recovery, and Storage solution design experiences
* Security experience in one or more of the following areas:
* Antivirus / Ransomware Protection
* EDR/MDR/XDR
* Email Security
* Network Security
* Knowledge of Microsoft Operating Systems (Linux or other operating systems beneficial)
* The ability to articulate technical and business value propositions
* Experience in customer and sales opportunity management practices
* Must be a good listener, creative, intuitive, a team player, and have the ability to resolve problems
* A high level of discipline, attention to detail, and ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment while still maintaining a high level of accuracy
* Should be an articulate, persuasive, and polished oral and written communicator, able to discuss and negotiate around technical issues effectively
* Fluent in English
* Ability to travel - 25%


**Who We Are**
 A Swiss company founded in Singapore in 2003, Acronis offers over twenty years of innovation with 15 offices worldwide and employees in 50+ countries. Acronis Cyber Protect is available in 26 languages in 150 countries and is used by over 21,000 service providers to protect more than 750,000 businesses.
   

  

 Our corporate culture centers on innovation, accountability, and impact. We encourage our people to think boldly, challenge conventional approaches, and take ownership of outcomes. As a member of our global “A-Team,” you’ll operate in a high-growth, fast-paced environment where resilience, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous improvement drive success.
   

  

**OUR INTERVIEW PRACTICES**
 To ensure a fair and genuine hiring process, candidates are expected to participate in interviews without the use of AI tools, automated prompts, or third-party assistance. Interviews are designed to assess individual skills, experience, and communication style, and we value authentic, real-time interaction.
   

  

 Use of AI or external assistance during live interviews may result in disqualification. For roles where AI skills are being evaluated, permitted use of AI tools will be clearly communicated in advance. Candidates may be asked to disable virtual backgrounds or participate in in-person interviews. All employment offers are contingent upon successful completion of applicable criminal, education and identity background checks
   

  

*Acronis is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, medical condition, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.*

title: Staff Software Engineer – Customer Management
description:
More customers, less manual work. That's the goal for Customer Management. We expect AI and automation to cut the work of managing customers, users, and access even as we grow. We're looking for a full-time Staff Software Engineer to own this domain. It's a two-hat role, and a great opportunity if you want wider impact while still building as an engineer. The mandate for the domain is yours, and so is the accountability for where it goes and what it delivers. You'll also be an engineer on the team, building it together with your teammates. How you split your week will shift with the work, and we'll tweak it together.
 



  





**The domain you'll own** 




 Customer Management covers the control panels where colleagues and customer administrators manage users, automatic rostering and provisioning, authentication, and how customer support resolves access and account issues. A dedicated engineering team builds it, and demand comes from many directions. The requests are input, not the job. We need someone who digs into the challenges and opportunities behind them, finds the ones nobody has raised, and sometimes fixes things without writing more software. The result should be less company time spent on administration, fewer routine issues needing support, and reliable machinery as customer numbers grow. With AI and automation doing the work where possible.
 



  





**Our challenge for you** 



* Make our users more productive, colleagues and customer administrators alike. AI is central to that.
* Own the roadmap and lead its delivery with the team. Understand what colleagues across the company need, decide what takes priority, and explain the trade-offs. Set the goals and measures, and change course when the results say so.
* Build hands-on on our serverless platform, built on Node.js (TypeScript) running on AWS. Together with the team, you run what you build, including reliability and security.
* Lead the engineers and others building the domain, and make it theirs as much as yours. That's how people grow here.



  





**What you'll bring to the team** 




 You're an excellent software engineer who can take responsibility for a domain, make decisions, and get people working together to make them happen.
 


* Experience with, and a strong pull towards, the product side: talking to stakeholders and users, reframing problems, and saying no when needed.
* You’ve designed, built, and run systems other teams depend on, and can explain the trade-offs you made.
* You build at the front edge of what AI makes possible, can show where it made you better and where challenges remain, and bring others with you.
* You've led work without being the boss, including initiatives across teams, people you didn't manage, and made decisions you were accountable for.
* A plus: you know identity, access, and authentication concepts.



  





**What's in it for you** 




 We offer you the opportunity to join an exciting, committed EdTech company in a strong growth phase. You'll work in an international environment with motivated, skilled colleagues while contributing to a good cause. We have an entrepreneurial mindset and a flat organization with an open-minded atmosphere. Our values are optimism, drive, cooperation, and quick action. And, not least, to make an impact!
 



  





**Diversity and inclusion at ILT Education** 




 At ILT, we believe that diverse perspectives make us better, both as a company and in the impact we create through education. As an international EdTech organization, we actively foster an inclusive environment where people from different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives feel valued, respected, and empowered to contribute. We are committed to building teams that reflect the diversity of the learners we serve, and we welcome applicants regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or background. What matters most to us is your potential, your mindset, and your ability to contribute to our shared mission.

title: Objektledare – i gränslandet mellan verksamhet och IT
description:
**Digitaliseringsavdelningen, Sektionen för systemförvaltningsledning**
 Regeringskansliet är mitt i en omfattande digital utveckling. Vi bygger moderna digitala tjänster, stärker informationshanteringen och utvecklar en säker och hållbar digital miljö för hela organisationen. För att lyckas behöver vi bli fler.
   

  

 Nu söker vi en eller flera objektledare som vill vara med och utveckla och förvalta verksamhetskritiska system och digitala lösningar. Hos oss får du arbeta i en unik verksamhet där teknik, verksamhetsutveckling och samhällsnytta möts.
   

  

****Din arbetsdag. Sveriges morgondag.****
 Digitaliseringsavdelningen leder stora delar av Regeringskansliets digitala förflyttning. Vårt uppdrag är unikt. Våra lösningar används i hela Regeringskansliet och på över 100 utlandsmyndigheter världen över. Det du är med och utvecklar får direkt betydelse för hur Sveriges regering bedriver sitt arbete, både nationellt och globalt.
   

  

 Som objektledare blir du en del av sektionen Systemförvaltningsledning där vi ansvarar för att säkerställa att våra system förvaltas, utvecklas och möter verksamhetens behov över tid. Vi arbetar nära verksamheten och har en central roll i att omsätta behov och förändringsinitiativ till hållbara lösningar.
   

  

****Om rollen****
 Som objektledare ansvarar du för ett eller flera objekt där du tillsammans med verksamheten driver förvaltning och utveckling av applikationer och tillhörande komponenter. Du säkerställer att IT-lösningar möter verksamhetens behov och driver IT-relaterade frågor i nära samarbete med verksamhetsföreträdare, utvecklare, arkitekter, tekniker och leverantörer.
   

  

 Rollen innebär att du samordnar aktiviteter, leder möten och driver arbetet framåt i frågor som rör teknik, säkerhet, arbetssätt, budget, licenser, avtal och upphandling. Du bidrar till att utveckla befintliga lösningar och identifiera nya möjligheter som stödjer Regeringskansliets digitala utveckling.
   

  

**Hos oss får du**
* Arbeta med verksamhetskritiska system som används i hela Regeringskansliet och vid Sveriges utlandsmyndigheter.
* Ha en central roll i utveckling och förvaltning av digitala tjänster och applikationer.
* Samarbeta med verksamhetsföreträdare, utvecklare, arkitekter och andra specialister.
* Vara delaktig i frågor som rör digitalisering, teknik, informationssäkerhet och verksamhetsutveckling.
* Arbeta i en miljö där utveckling, samarbete och kunskapsdelning uppmuntras.
* Bidra till att skapa effektiva och hållbara lösningar för en av Sveriges viktigaste verksamheter.


****Din bakgrund****
 Vi söker dig som har:
   

  

**Formella krav**
* Högskole- eller universitetsutbildning inom ett för rollen relevant område, eller annan utbildning i kombination med arbetslivserfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer som likvärdig.
* Erfarenhet av arbete som Objektledare, Förvaltningsledare eller i en liknande roll.
* Erfarenhet av kontakter och samverkan med IT-utvecklare och externa leverantörer.
* Erfarenhet av projektledning.
* Kunskap om förvaltningsmodeller och agila arbetssätt.
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.


**Meriterande**
* Utbildning inom data- eller systemvetenskap.
* Certifiering som Objektledare eller Förvaltningsledare.
* Erfarenhet av arbete som Scrum Master eller liknande agil roll.
* Kunskaper inom ITIL.
* Erfarenhet av eller kunskap om plattformar såsom Pega eller SharePoint.


****Dina egenskaper****
 Du har god samarbetsförmåga och trivs i en roll med många kontaktytor. Du är ansvarstagande, initiativrik och driver arbetet framåt på ett strukturerat sätt.
   

  

 Vidare är du problemlösande och flexibel, med förmåga att hantera olika frågeställningar och förändrade förutsättningar. Du bidrar till en positiv arbetsmiljö, delar gärna med dig av kunskap och har ett genuint intresse för IT och digital utveckling.
   

  

 Regeringskansliets medarbetarkriterier är helhet, utveckling och resultat. Alla som arbetar i Regeringskansliet behöver ha helhetssyn och samarbeta för verksamhetens bästa. Du förväntas bidra med ditt perspektiv och din kompetens samt vara öppen för andras. Du kommer med idéer och nya angreppssätt för att förbättra och utveckla verksamheten och din egen kompetens. Du är inriktad på resultat i ditt agerande och anpassar dig när behov och inriktning ändras.
   

  

****Övrigt****
 Rollen är en tillsvidareanställning som inleds med sex månaders provanställning. Befattningen är placerad i säkerhetsklass och en säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer att genomföras innan beslut om anställning fattas.
   

  

 Placering är i Stockholm och rollen innebär inget personalansvar.
   

  

****Är du intresserad?****
 Vill du veta mer om jobbet och vad vi erbjuder, vänligen kontakta sektionschefchef David Åström. Du är även välkommen att kontakta rekryteringsspecialist Filip Ristov. Fackliga kontakter är Johan Strokirk för Saco och Jan Wahlström för ST. Du når dem via Regeringskansliets växel, 08-405 10 00.
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan senast 3 november 2026.**
 Vi tar gärna emot samtal från dig som är intresserad av jobbet men vi tackar nej till dig som säljer annonser och rekryteringstjänster.
   

  

 Regeringskansliets uppdrag är att stödja regeringen i dess arbete med att styra Sverige och förverkliga sin politik. Här arbetar 4 800 personer, varav 600 utomlands. Regeringskansliet välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund och erfarenheter. Vi ser jämställdhet och mångfald som en styrka och tillgång och vi arbetar aktivt för att vara en arbetsplats fri från diskriminering. Förvaltningsavdelningen ansvarar för myndighetsövergripande frågor som förändrings- och förnyelsearbete, ekonomi, arbetsgivarfrågor, kompetensförsörjning, kommunikation, säkerhet, it, bibliotek, arkiv och registratur samt för den gemensamma servicen i Regeringskansliet.

title: Senior Security Operations Specialist
description:
*Are you security-focused and ready to help build a brand-new security operations team and services from the ground up? Do you want to dedicate yourself to protecting cloud-first environments while delivering consultancy services-security assessments, solution deployments, onboarding and ongoing operations-for our customers? Join GlobalConnect and play a pivotal role in launching and growing our new Security Operations practice.*
**About The Role And The Team**
 As a Senior Security Operations Specialist, you will join our newly formed security operations team, working closely with leadership to define and deliver consultancy services for customer environments.
   

  

 You will work delivering our managed security and services and security consulting engagements. Depending on your experience and skills, you will also have the opportunity to support the design and development of the service features, technology and processes.
   

  

 The cyber security team will be part of the security services unit responsible for security products and services in GlobalConnects B2B business unit. Our unit has the sole focus of enabling our customers to secure their infrastructure.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Perform daily security operations: review solution configurations, monitor alerts, investigate issues, and deliver insight reports.
* Deliver security assessments and advisory engagements: evaluate customer controls, recommend improvements, and document findings.
* Deploy and configure security technologies in hybrid and cloud-first environments (Azure, M365).
* Support security engineering to improve security controls, processes and automation related to our services.
* Stay current on cyber threats, TTPs and defensive techniques to protect and advise customers.
* Partner with sales to support scoping, proposals and customer workshops.


**Why you should join GlobalConnect?**
 Joining GlobalConnect means becoming part of a company that’s actively leading change. You’ll be embedded in a diverse, inclusive Nordic team launching a brand-new security practice. We offer a hybrid working model for flexibility and strong collaboration. This is your chance to shape services from day one, gain broad consultancy experience, and make a real impact on customer security across industries.
   

  

**To Succeed In This Role, We Believe You Have**
 5+ years of relevant technical cyber security experience, practical knowledge covering several of the following areas:
   

  

* Security monitoring and/or security incident investigations and response.
* Delivering security assessments, specifically around hybrid Microsoft environments
* Designing layered protection, detection and response with relevant security technologies
* Security consulting engagements for different types of customers across various industries, including scoping the engagement and supporting sales
* System administration, cloud automation and scripting experience is considered beneficial
* Proficient in English and fluent in one Nordic or German language (Swedish, Norwegian or Danish) - able to communicate clearly with customers and colleagues in both written and spoken form.


 At GlobalConnect, you’ll have the chance to make a significant impact from day one. If you're ready to take on a role where your contributions will be valued and your success will be celebrated, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 If you’re excited about this opportunity but don’t meet every single requirement, don’t worry! We’d still love to hear from you.
   

  

 No need for a personal letter – just send us your CV or LinkedIn profile.

title: Chief Technology Officer - Kaisa
description:
**Chief Technology Officer - build the platform behind Europe's car and property deals**
 When someone finds their next car on mobile.de, AutoScout24, leboncoin or Blocket, the first five minutes decide whether the deal happens. Kaisa is the engagement layer that makes those minutes count - capturing, qualifying and routing every lead between Europe's leading marketplaces and 100,000+ dealers, in real time. We are the category leader in our market, profitable, and we already run AI products that generate real revenue. Now we're looking for the CTO who will lead our next chapter.
   

  

**The mandate**
 In January 2026, Monterro - the Nordic B2B software growth investor - became Kaisa's majority owner. The plan is ambitious: strengthen the core marketplace platform, make AI the default in both product and engineering, and build the technical foundation for our direct-to-dealer expansion - a market opportunity of €2.4bn, where the acquisition of Danish Carbuddii this spring was the first step. Technology leadership sits at the center of that plan. This is a scaling mandate, not a turnaround.
   

  

 You will join the management team, report to CEO Daniel Petrell, and own technology end to end: strategy, architecture, engineering and technical operations. The engineering organization is ~20 people across Uppsala/Stockholm, Poland, North Macedonia and Denmark - senior, capable, and ready for a leader they want to follow.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Set and own the technology strategy - concrete enough to drive architecture decisions, priorities and hiring.
* Lead and mentor the engineering organization: build trust, shape the team structure, and recruit the people the AI transformation requires.
* Be the counterpart our CPO needs: balance product roadmap against platform investment with well-grounded arguments.
* Make AI-assisted development the default way of working, and own the architecture behind AI products built on our proprietary interaction data - together with our Chief AI Architect.
* Evolve an AWS-native platform (ISO 27001:2022, ~19 production deployments/month, 99.8% availability target) - including completing the transition off our legacy stack at full delivery speed.


**What You Bring**
* 10+ years in software, including senior engineering leadership in B2B SaaS.
* Leadership that creates trust and stability - a mentor who forms a team into a unit.
* Hands-on architectural depth: you can credibly challenge technology choices, and you care about the platforms behind the product - with a bias for modular design that adapts as technology shifts.
* Demonstrated AI conviction: you have driven AI-assisted development and know how to build AI products without painting them into a corner.
* An engineering degree or the equivalent depth from a self-taught path. Fluent English; Swedish is not required - experience of Nordic working culture is.
* You can be at our Uppsala office 2-3 days per week (many colleagues commute from Stockholm).


**What's In It For You**
* A rare AI mandate: production AI products, real revenue, proprietary data - and the freedom to set the technical direction.
* A category leader with happy customers and a profitable, cash-generative business as your foundation.
* The start of the Monterro journey: hands-on support in Tech & AI, Product and Talent, and participation in the management equity program.
* A warm, low-ego, fast-moving company that still feels young - and a management team that has been strengthened for exactly this phase.


**Apply**
 The recruitment is led by Monterro Talent, all conversations will be confidential. Johan Redtzer, Talent Lead at Monterro - leads the recruitment. Interviews start after the summer - we review applications continuously.
   

  

 Are you ready to take Kaisa to the next level? Apply now!
   

  

**About Monterro**
 Monterro is a hands-on growth investor. We turn Nordic B2B software companies into market leaders by contributing our time, experience, know-how, and networks. And yes, we provide capital too. In fact, we invest our own capital, so we are personally committed to our mutual success. Monterro is headquartered in Stockholm with offices in Oslo, Copenhagen, Helsinki, and our software development centre in Hanoi. Learn more at monterro.com.

title: Chief Technology Officer - Grieg Connect
description:
**Chief Technology Officer**
**Ports run on Grieg Connect. Come and lead the technology, and the teams, that keep them running, and take our platform into the AI era.**
****About Grieg Connect****
 Grieg Connect is the Nordic leader in port software. Our platform is the operational and financial system that runs the daily work of the port, from vessel and berth planning to security, resource management, work orders and invoicing. Around 125 ports and operators rely on us every day, and we hold a leading position across the Nordics. We are backed by Monterro, the leading B2B software investor in the Nordics, and we are scaling across Europe with the ambition to become the category leader in our space.
   

  

 We are now hiring our first Chief Technology Officer to lead all of engineering and set the technical direction for our next chapter.
   

  

****What You Will Do****
* Lead and unify all of our engineering teams across our Nordic sites, with clear ownership and accountability.
* Own the technology strategy and target architecture across all products, aligned with our growth and international expansion.
* Drive AI to the top of everything we build, and embed it into both the product and our internal ways of working.
* Carry a strong influence over the overall product strategy and roadmap, working closely with the current product organisation.
* Strengthen infrastructure, reliability and security, and make our service commitments measurable.
* Take a firm hand on two modernisation projects, challenging scope and keeping the platform future-ready.
* Build engineering leadership beneath you and reduce key-person risk as we grow.
* Integrate add-on acquisitions cleanly as we expand across Europe.
* Sit on the management team and report to the CEO.


****Who You Are****
* A senior engineering leader with 10+ years in SaaS, ideally B2B, who has scaled and unified more than one team.
* An engineer at heart with the authority to set technical direction and earn the respect of strong engineers, without needing to be the sharpest coder in the room.
* A change leader who brings people with you and finishes what you start.
* Genuinely curious about AI and how to make it deliver, whether or not you have run a full AI transformation.
* Comfortable shaping product strategy alongside a product team.
* Strong on cloud architecture, platform modernisation, security and pragmatic technology choices.
* Experience integrating teams through M&A is a plus. Maritime knowledge is welcome, but not a requirement.


****What We Offer****
* The defining technology hire of our next chapter, with a real mandate.
* A strong platform to build on, with clear gaps to close and an AI story to write.
* A grounded, low-ego team and a hands-on CEO.
* The chance to help take a Nordic leader across Europe, organically and through M&A.
* Competitive compensation and the opportunity to invest alongside the owners.
* The Monterro network, including technology and product peers across the portfolio.


**Location**
 We are flexible on where you are based within the greater Oslo, greater Gothenburg or greater Karlstad areas are preferens. The role involves regular travel between our Nordic sites, so we are looking for someone who is mobile.
   

  

****About Monterro****
 Monterro is a hands-on software growth investor and the leading B2B software investor in the Nordics, with a portfolio of 30 Nordic champions. We invest only in B2B software, we have operated and scaled these companies ourselves, and the Monterro team is the largest investor in its own funds.
   

  

**Apply**
 The recruitment is led by Monterro Talent, all conversations will be confidential. Johan Redtzer, Talent Lead at Monterro - leads the recruitment. Interviews start after the summer - we review applications continuously.
   

  

 Are you ready to take Grieg Connect to the next level? Apply now!
   

  

****About Monterro****
 Monterro is a hands-on growth investor. We turn Nordic B2B software companies into market leaders by contributing our time, experience, know-how, and networks. And yes, we provide capital too. In fact, we invest our own capital, so we are personally committed to our mutual success. Monterro is headquartered in Stockholm with offices in Oslo, Copenhagen, Helsinki, and our software development centre in Hanoi. Learn more at monterro.com.

title: Product Owner

Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions.
   

  

 Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 As Product Owner for the IT Service Desk, you will define the vision, roadmap, and priorities for a product that supports employees across a global organization. You will transform user needs, operational insights, and business objectives into measurable improvements and clear development priorities. Working closely with stakeholders across Digital Workplace, IT service management, and support delivery, you will drive a support experience that is scalable, efficient, and user-focused.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Define and drive the product vision, roadmap, and prioritized backlog for the IT Service Desk.
* Use user feedback, operational data, and service performance measures to identify opportunities and deliver continuous improvements.
* Enhance the end-to-end support experience, including intake, triage, escalation, and collaboration with resolving teams.
* Balance user experience, service reliability, efficiency, cost, and risk when making product decisions and prioritization trade-offs.

* You understand first-line IT support processes, incident management, escalation practices, and service-level-driven delivery in a global environment.

title: IT Procurement Manager
description:
**The Role And Key Responsibilities**
 This role puts you at the heart of IT and procurement, where your technology understanding and commercial insight will shape better sourcing outcomes. Working closely with stakeholders, you will influence sourcing strategies and explore supplier, delivery and commercial models that improve efficiency, reduce risk exposure and optimize total cost of ownership. You will contribute to supplier and sourcing strategies, commercial governance, sourcing initiatives and stakeholder advisory across a broad IT landscape.
   

  

**Your main responsibilities include:**
* Lead and support sourcing initiatives across software, cloud, infrastructure, End User Services, IT Support and network services, with ownership of relevant IT sourcing portfolios.
* Act as a commercial advisor and sparring partner to IT stakeholders.
* Challenge and improve sourcing approaches, supplier operating models and commercial strategies.
* Evaluate alternative delivery models, including managed services, outsourcing, reseller models and multi-supplier environments.
* Lead commercial negotiations and manage IT agreements throughout their lifecycle.
* Translate technical, security and operational requirements into commercial and contractual solutions.
* Develop and drive sourcing and supplier governance, performance management and renewal planning across major technology suppliers.
* Support category planning, supplier roadmaps, risk management and optimization initiatives.
* Collaborate with Service Owners, Architects, Information Security, Legal and business stakeholders to ensure aligned sourcing decisions.


**About Purchasing At NCC**
* NCC Purchasing is a network of professionals across the Nordics. We handle everything from project purchasing and supplier base development to strategic sourcing and category management. Collaboration between our teams is key to delivering successful customer projects.


 You will join a highly engaged IT Procurement team working closely with IT leadership, strategic suppliers and stakeholders across the Nordic organization. The position offers exposure to a broad technology landscape and the opportunity to develop through increasingly complex sourcing initiatives, supplier relationships and category responsibilities.
   

  

 You will have room to contribute with your ideas, challenge existing approaches and help improve how IT Procurement operates.
   

  

**Your Experience And Background**
 You are commercially minded, curious about technology and motivated to continue developing your expertise. You have the confidence to contribute with your own perspective, while remaining open to challenge, feedback and new ways of working. You enjoy understanding how IT services are delivered and how commercial models, supplier ecosystems and technology decisions connect. You can work independently within your area of responsibility, but you also value collaboration and know when to involve specialists from IT, security, architecture, legal or the business. You do not need to have mastered every part of the IT landscape. More important is your ability to learn quickly, structure complex questions and progressively take on broader sourcing, category and supplier responsibilities.
   

  

**Requirements specification:**
 You may bring around 5–7 years of relevant experience in IT Procurement, IT Sourcing, IT Vendor Management or Supplier Management. If you have a strong commercial mindset, an interest in technology and the ambition to learn and grow, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

* Strong commercial and contracting capability, with experience negotiating and managing IT agreements independently.
* Good understanding of enterprise IT environments.
* Relevant experience in one or more of the role’s main areas—such as infrastructure, end user services, IT Support or network —would be an advantage. You do not need to be an expert across the full scope.
* Ability to engage credibly with IT stakeholders and challenge conventional sourcing approaches.
* Experience translating technical requirements into commercial and contractual frameworks.
* Experience from working with strategic suppliers and governance structures in complex IT environments.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* English and at least one Nordic language.


 If you meet these criteria and are ready to contribute to our Purchasing Transformation journey, we invite you to apply. Your passion, drive, and commitment will help us achieve new heights through digitalization and innovation in the construction industry.
   

  

**NCC Offers**
 NCC strives to be an appealing employer, providing a work environment where employees can grow and experience well-being. We offer a wide range of employee benefits. NCC has collective agreements for all employees, providing a solid foundation of security and clear guidelines so that you know what applies to your employment. We also offer excellent opportunities for continued development and a broad range of further education options, allowing for a long career within the company.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 This position is based in our Stockholm or Gothenburg office; however, we encourage flexible working and digital collaboration whenever possible.
   

  

 As part of NCC's safety culture, background checks will be conducted for final candidates.
   

  

**Contact and information**
 For more information, please contact recruiting manager Iina Haatainen, Manager of IT Procurement team, +358504697556 or Gunilla Glännå, Recruitment Consultant, gunilla.glanna@ncc.se, 0790788170.
   

  

 Register your application and CV below. Applications are reviewed continuously, so apply as soon as possible, and no later than
 **6th of November 2026.**
**Build with us - together with the best colleagues in the industry!**
 At NCC, we are driven to continue developing, whether it's our construction projects or our personal expertise. With us, you are a significant employee who contributes to the landmarks that define our cities and communities. **NCC - one of the leading companies in the Nordics.**
