title: SEO Manager at Pierce Group, Stockholm
description:
***Are you an experienced technical SEO specialist ready to take full ownership of organic growth for a multi-brand, international e-commerce leader?***




  





*Pierce is currently rolling out a modern e-commerce platform across our three core brands:* 
***24MX, XLMOTO, and Sledstore***
*, while expanding into new European markets. We are looking for an SEO Manager to own organic search end-to-end, safeguard our search visibility during this transformation, and drive our long-term organic growth strategy.* 




  





**About Pierce Group** 




 Pierce is a leading European e-commerce group offering gear, parts, and accessories for motocross, motorcycle, and snowmobile enthusiasts across approximately 30 European countries, as well as globally. Founded in a garage in 2009 by two motocross riders, we are now listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. However, our core philosophy,
 *“by riders, for riders”* 
 , still defines how we operate.
 



  





 We operate in a fast-paced, ambitious environment with a strong entrepreneurial spirit. Our head office is located in central Stockholm, and our core IT operations are based in Szczecin, Poland.
 



  





**Current key initiatives at Pierce:** 



* Rolling out C
 **ommercetools** 
 across all brand storefronts.
* Centralising global data architecture in
 **Snowflake** 
 .
* Integrating
 **AI solutions** 
 for automation, reporting, and operational efficiency.



  





**About the SEO Manager role** 




 As SEO Manager, you will hold global responsibility for organic search across 24MX, XLMOTO, and Sledstore in all active markets. You will join our Performance Team and report directly to the Head of Performance & Partnerships.
 



  





 Your initial priority will be overseeing the ongoing platform migration. You will ensure seamless transition management to protect existing rankings and establish an optimised technical foundation for future growth. In practice, this means translating SEO strategy into precise technical requirements for our IT team in Poland, evaluating proposed solutions, and ensuring flawless execution.
 



  





 Following the migration, your focus will pivot to scaling: market expansion, international localisation, and optimising our content workflows (including evaluating how external agency partnerships and AI tools can be best leveraged).
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Technical Ownership:** 
 Own end-to-end technical SEO across 24MX, XLMOTO, and Sledstore in ~30 markets.
* **Migration Strategy:** 
 Safeguard organic performance and maximise SEO opportunities during the Commercetools rollout.
* **Developer Collaboration:** 
 Define, write, and prioritise technical requirements for IT regarding site architecture, page speed, URL structures, internal linking, and redirection strategies.
* **Content & Localisation:** 
 Direct international keyword strategy and brief our external multilingual content agencies.
* **Data & Analytics:** 
 Monitor and analyse organic search performance using Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs, Power BI, and Snowflake to identify growth opportunities and prioritise backlog items.
* **Innovation:** 
 Drive strategy and tactical execution for AI search visibility (AEO).



  





**About you** 




 You are an analytical, data-driven professional who proactively monitors performance trends and takes immediate action when deviations occur. You thrive when solving complex technical SEO challenges, but your solutions are always grounded in commercial impact and business growth. Furthermore, you continuously look for ways to automate processes and increase operational efficiency.
 



  





**Key requirements:** 



* Minimum 3 years of hands-on SEO experience, with a heavy emphasis on technical SEO.
* Proven track record in site architecture, URL design, redirect mapping, page speed optimisation, and international web setups.
* Demonstrated experience partnering with engineering teams: writing functional requirements, defining technical acceptance criteria, and advocating for SEO prioritisation.
* Strong proficiency in analysing data within Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar enterprise data warehouse environments.
* Professional fluency in English. Swedish language skills are a plus.



  





**Bonus Qualifications:** 



* Experience working both agency-side and in-house.
* Prior experience leading SEO through large-scale enterprise platform migrations.



  





**What Pierce offers** 



* **Pension:** 
 Standard ITP1 occupational pension plan.
* **Work-Life Balance:** 
 30 days of annual leave
* **Wellness Allowance:** 
 SEK 3,000 annual wellness grant (
 *friskvårdsbidrag* 
 ).
* **Motorcycle License Support:** 
 Up to SEK 25,000 reimbursement upon completing your motorcycle driver’s license.
* **Employee Discount:** 
 Generous staff discounts across 24MX, XLMOTO, and Sledstore.



  





**Practical details** 




 Location: Stockholm (Fleminggatan). Hybrid setup: 4 days in office, 1 day remote.
 



 Employment type: Full time, permanent
 



 Start date: By agreement
 



 Salary: Market-aligned, by agreement

title: IT-Jurist
description:
Länsstyrelsernas IT-avdelning växer för att möta Sveriges 21 länsstyrelsers breda och skiftande behov inom IT. Vi utvecklar och förvaltar verksamhetsspecifika appar, daglig IT för medarbetare, e-tjänster för invånare och företag – vi bidrar vi till ett demokratiskt, hållbart och säkert samhälle.
 



  





 Här kan du till exempel jobba med IT-säkerhet, systemutveckling, verksamhetssystem, support, automation och integration. Vi har också en central roll i länsstyrelsernas position som högsta regionalt ansvariga myndighet för det civila försvaret. Var med och utveckla IT-tjänster som får samhällen, människor, djur, natur och kulturvärden att fungera - både idag och i framtiden!
 



  





**Om jobbet** 




**Vill du arbeta med kvalificerade juridiska frågor i en stimulerande miljö tillsammans med kompetenta och utvecklingsinriktade kollegor? Ser du dig som en lösningsorienterad kommunikativ jurist som har lätt för att sätta juridiken i stora sammanhang och se helhetslösningar? Då tror vi att du kan vara den vi söker.** 




  





 Du kommer att tillhöra IT-avdelningens Säkerhetsenhet som ansvarar för att perspektiven IT-säkerhet, säkerhetsskydd, säkerhetsjuridik, kontinuitet och totalförsvar omhändertas. Säkerhetsenheten agerar primärt styrande, rådgivande och samordnande och alltid med utgångspunkt från ett helhetsperspektiv för IT-verksamheten. Du arbetar på en enhet och i en organisation där det ställs höga krav på säkerhet och riskmedvetenhet.
 



  





 Hos oss får du vara med om att utveckla en säkerhetsorganisation med helhetsperspektiv och som ofta agerar inom samhällskritiska delar av verksamheten. Som IT-säkerhetsjurist på länsstyrelsernas gemensamma IT-avdelning blir du en central aktör i samverkan mellan teknik och juridik på länsstyrelserna.
 



  





**Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter kommer att vara:** 



* Bedöma juridiska förutsättningar vid implementering och utveckling av digitala system och tjänster.
* Skriva yttranden, genomföra rättsutredningar och ge juridisk rådgivning till IT-verksamheten i centrala frågor samt hålla interna utbildningar.
* Hantera leverantörsavtal och villkor utifrån bland annat ett säkerhets- och säkerhetsskyddsperspektiv.
* Bidra till IT-avdelningens samlade rättsliga arbete genom att identifiera områden i behov av rättslig styrning eller regelutveckling.
* Upprätta myndighetsöverenskommelser, både mellan de 21 länsstyrelserna och andra myndigheter.
* Bidra med juridisk expertkompetens i olika projekt och uppdrag samt vid riskbedömningar.
* Delta i samverkan inom länsstyrelserna och vid behov företräda länsstyrelserna i samverkan med andra myndigheter.



  





 Du kommer arbeta tillsammans med Säkerhetsenhetens befintliga IT-säkerhetsjurister. Inom Länsstyrelsen i Västra Götaland finns också en stor rättslig verksamhet och du kommer ha ett nära samarbete med jurister både i Västra Götaland och på andra länsstyrelser.
 



  





 Vi utvecklar alltid vår verksamhet och du behöver därför vara öppen för att dina arbetsuppgifter även kan komma att förändras över tid.
 



  





 Länsstyrelsernas IT-avdelning finns över hela landet. Placeringsort är Göteborg, Vänersborg, Stockholm eller enligt överenskommelse.
 
 Vi erbjuder ett flexibelt arbete med goda möjligheter till distansarbete del av arbetstiden.
 



 Resor inom landet förekommer.
 



  





**Om dig** 




 Vi söker dig som är drivande, lösningsorienterad och har god initiativförmåga. Du är van att leda dig själv och prestera och leverera mot uppsatta mål. Du är strukturerad och har god förmåga att hitta rätt nivå i ditt arbete. Du har förmåga att arbeta självständigt och kan fatta beslut inom ramen för ditt uppdrag.
 



  





 Du har god förmåga att samarbeta med andra och skapa goda relationer med fokus på samverkan både inom och utanför din egen organisation. Den här tjänsten kräver att du som person har god förståelse för helhetsresonemang, kan resonera och göra sammanvägda bedömningar tillsammans med andra kompetenser.
 



  





 Vi ser att du har god kommunikativ förmåga där du genom ditt pedagogiska förhållningssätt når ut till olika målgrupper och ökar förståelsen och medvetenheten kring de möjligheter och skyldigheter juridiken ger. Du har förmåga att uttrycka dig mycket väl i skrift och tal. Du har erfarenhet av, och är trygg med, att hålla utbildningar.
 



  





 För oss är personliga egenskaper viktiga och vi ser det som självklart att du agerar utifrån
 

 Den statliga värdegrunden - Statskontoret
 
 och bidrar till ett gott arbetsklimat.
 



  





**Du har:** 



* En juristexamen (jur.kand.) eller magisterexamen i juridik.
* Aktuell erfarenhet av kvalificerat juridiskt arbete på minst fem år inom digitaliseringsjuridik, såsom sekretess, dataskydd, AI, cybersäkerhet, upphovsrätt, avtal och upphandling.
* Erfarenhet av arbete i en verksamhet med höga säkerhetskrav.



  





**Vi ser gärna att du har:** 



* Erfarenhet av kvalificerat juridiskt arbete inriktat på offentlig sektors särskilda frågor, såsom handlingsoffentlighet, upphandling, arkiv och informationssäkerhet.
* Särskild erfarenhet av rättsligt stöd till en IT-organisation och de särskilda frågor som uppstår vid utkontraktering av IT-tjänster och tecknande av leverantörsavtal.
* Erfarenhet från säkerhetsskyddad verksamhet och arbetssätt kopplat till detta.
* Erfarenhet av arbete med EU-regelverk inom IT-juridikområdet.



  





 Vi tror på allas lika möjligheter och ett av våra huvuduppdrag är att verka för mångfald och en personalsammansättning som speglar länens befolkning.
 



 Välkommen med din ansökan!
 



  





**Bra att veta** 




 Läs mer om oss på vår webb
 
 Jobba på IT-avdelningen
 
 . Här finns information om
 
 våra förmåner
 
 . Vi finns också på
 
 Linkedin
 
 .
 



  





 I den här rekryteringen vill vi inte att du bifogar något personligt brev. För att berätta om dina erfarenheter och förmågor får du i din ansökan svara på ett antal frågor. Detta är för att vi ska kunna ta ställning till i vilken omfattning din kompetens och dina förutsättningar matchar vårt behov. Ansökan ska vara på svenska då det är vårt arbetsspråk.
 



  





 Vi ställer höga krav på våra medarbetares säkerhetsmedvetenhet. Säkerhetsprövning enligt Säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) kommer att genomföras innan vi fattar beslut om anställning. För en del anställningar kan därför svenskt medborgarskap komma att krävas. Läs mer om säkerhetsprövning
 
 Personalsäkerhet - Säkerhetspolisen (sakerhetspolisen.se)
 
 .
 



  





 Länsstyrelsen är en beredskapsmyndighet och har ett särskilt utpekat ansvar under kris och krig/höjd beredskap.
 



  





 I den här rekryteringen arbetar vi med löpande urval. Det innebär att vi kan komma att kalla till intervju även innan sista dag för ansökning har passerat.
 



  





 Anställningen kan komma att inledas med provanställning 6 månader.
 



  





 Vi har valt rekryteringskanaler och vill inte bli kontaktade av rekryteringsföretag.
 



  





 Din ansökan blir en allmän handling när du söker tjänster hos oss. Därför är det viktigt att du med skyddade personuppgifter inte registrerar dig via vårt rekryteringssystem. Posta din ansökan till HR-enheten, Länsstyrelsen Västra Götaland, 403 40 Göteborg. Delge inte några känsliga uppgifter i din ansökan men ange någon form av kontaktuppgift så att vi kan kontakta dig om du är aktuell för tjänsten. Vid frågor, ta kontakt med rekryterande chef som står med i annonsen.

title: Competence Center Manager - SAP
description:
Do you want to build high-performing teams and shape the future of ERP capabilities at Sandvik Coromant? As Competence Center Manager – SAP, you connect people, skills and strategy to strengthen delivery and create long-term business value.
   

  

 Join an empowered environment where cross-functional collaboration, knowledge sharing and continuous development support an ongoing transformation.
   

  

 Your mission
   

  

 As SAP Competence Center Manager for Product Area ERP, you’re part of the management team driving strategy, cross-functional collaboration and operational excellence. Your focus is to ensure that the ERP product teams have the skills, capacity and conditions they need to deliver business value, particularly within SAP. You report to the Product Area Manager for ERP and collaborate with peers across divisions.
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

* Drive skills development and competence planning across ERP teams.
* Lead recruitment and strategic sourcing together with HR and purchasing.
* Support employees throughout the lifecycle, from onboarding to offboarding.
* Coach individuals and teams to encourage development and effective delivery.
* Facilitate cross-functional collaboration and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
* Contribute to change management, union collaboration and EHS compliance.


 Location and flexibility
   

  

 The position is based in Sandviken or Stockhom. A hybrid setup allows you to combine office and remote work.
   

  

 Your profile
   

  

 You combine a strong understanding of SAP and its business context with experience in people and change management. With a structured yet flexible approach, you navigate complex stakeholder environments and connect sourcing decisions with business needs.
   

  

 Your background includes
   

  

* A relevant university degree or equivalent qualification.
* Solid knowledge of agile ways of working.
* Strong understanding of SAP and the business it supports.
* Experience in people management and change management.
* Fluency in spoken and written English.


 Curious and collaborative, you build trust through transparency and lead with empathy. You listen actively, communicate clearly and create space for others to grow. When conditions change or challenges become complex, you maintain momentum, focus on solutions and confidently question established ways of working.
   

  

 The team
   

  

 You join the Product Area ERP management team and work closely with HR, purchasing, product teams and colleagues across divisions. Collaboration, knowledge sharing and an inclusive, empowering way of working are central to how the team operates.
   

  

 Our culture
   

  

 Innovation is in our DNA and we’re proud to shape the future of manufacturing in close collaboration with our customers and partners. We believe in an inclusive, equal and open-minded culture, and we nurture our diversities to form a solid foundation for achieving great results. Add fair and rewarding benefits, as well as many different career opportunities in an inspiring global environment. Meet some of your future colleagues at our career page or visit our website, LinkedIn or Facebook page to get to know us further.
   

  

 Contact information
   

  

 Are you curious to know more about this position? Please contact Fredrik Mäkinen, hiring manager, fredrik.makinen@sandvik.com
   

  

 Union contacts (Sweden):
   

  

* Thomas Lilja, Unionen, +46 (0)70-261 04 82
* Tord Engström, Akademikerföreningen, +46 (0)76 106 62 87
* Peter Olsson-Andrée, Ledarna, +46 (0)70-222 48 55


 Recruitment Specialist: Anton Karlsson
   

  

 How to apply
   

  

 Send your application no later than November 1st, 2026. Click apply and include your resume and cover letter in English. Please note that we don’t accept applications by e-mail. Job ID: R0098255.
   

  

 We aim for an open and fair recruitment process and use different tools to ensure objective assessment. Later in the process, you may be invited to complete a personality and logic test.

title: Senior Data Analyst - Enterprise GTM
description:
**Join our global force of 400+ innovators, blending the latest in tech with the greatest in soundtracking — from our Stockholm HQ to offices in London, New York, Los Angeles, Berlin, Paris, Oslo, and Seoul. We're an industry leader with a startup mentality. We take what we do seriously, but we don't take ourselves too seriously. Come create with us, and let the world feel your work.**
 As a
 **Senior Data Analyst** 
 , you'll join an embedded, AI-native analytics team that sits inside the commercial and product domains driving our growth. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with the VP of Revenue Operations and Global Sales Leadership as we scale our enterprise business — defining what success looks like across the full bow-tie funnel, from pipeline generation to expansion revenue, and proving it with data. You'll have a dedicated mandate within the Enterprise GTM org while drawing on the shared infrastructure, engineering support, and peers of our central Data & Analytics team.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

* Partner with RevOps and Sales leadership to define success metrics, surface growth opportunities across the enterprise bow-tie funnel, and shape GTM strategy with evidence — proactively raising the questions stakeholders haven't thought to ask.
* Build and refine the models that steer the business — customer segmentation for territory and capacity planning, lead and account scoring for pipeline quality, and forecasting for pipeline and revenue.
* Make our data trustworthy for agentic analytics — enrich context and metadata, and use AI coding tools to ship instrumentation and data-quality fixes directly so both people and AI tools can rely on it.
* Own the analytical backbone of how the enterprise business is steered — KPI and metric definitions aligned across Sales, Marketing, and Finance, and the monthly, quarterly, and annual performance forums, owning the narrative, not just the slides.
* Close data gaps and build scalable, self-serve measurement infrastructure so GTM teams can monitor long-term performance without you in the loop.
* Uphold rigor as self-serve expands — push back on false precision in pipeline and forecast numbers, set the bar for what good analysis looks like, and resist sophistication, statistical or AI, where a simpler approach serves the decision better.


 What you'll bring
   

  

* Senior-level influence. You've driven real business impact by shaping decisions at the leadership level and moving revenue outcomes.
* High agency. Habit of driving decisions through tailored communication and data storytelling.
* Sharp analytical instincts. You scope vague questions with vetted frameworks, state hypotheses up front, and reason to a defensible answer even with imperfect data.
* Sound judgement about data. A solid grasp of statistics and the discernment to know when past data predicts the future and when to override it for where the business is heading.
* Technical versatility. Proficiency across SQL and Python (notebooks in Hex), dbt (on BigQuery), plus experience with AI coding tools and techniques including context engineering and evals.
* PLG/SaaS fluency. Hands-on experience in product-led and SaaS businesses, with a solid grasp of subscription economics and the metrics that drive them.


 Music to our ears
   

  

* Experience across the B2B GTM funnel — Sales, Marketing, and RevOps — with funnel, segmentation, and forecasting analytics.
* Data modelling know-how and experience with semantic layers.
* A track record of defining metrics and steering frameworks for enterprise or 0→1 commercial motions.


 What we'll offer
   

  

* A fast-paced environment with real room for personal growth and tangible impact on the business.
* The chance to help write the new playbook for running Analytics in the AI era, combining timeless principles with fresh learnings from emerging tooling.
* A diverse, collaborative team of Analysts and Engineers building together.


 Equal opportunity employer
   

  

 We believe that bringing people together from different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives makes for a healthy workplace, a more successful business and a better world. We value diversity and encourage everyone to come and soundtrack the world with us.
   

  

 Application
   

  

 Ready to make the world feel your work? Please apply, in English.

title: Director, Forma Design Industry Strategy
description:
**Job Requisition ID #**
 26WD99348
   

  

**Position Overview**
 Autodesk is building the Forma Industry Cloud, a next-generation solution that is redefining how the built environment is designed, delivered, and operated. Forma represents a fundamental shift: from files to granular data, from silos to hyper collaboration, and from traditional BIM to outcome-driven workflows powered by AI. It brings together people, processes, and intelligence across the architecture, engineering, construction, and operations (AECO) ecosystem to help the industry work smarter, faster, and more sustainably.
   

  

 We are seeking a Director, Forma Design Industry Strategy to define the strategy and go-to-market direction for Autodesk’s Forma design applications. Today, this portfolio includes Forma Site Design and Forma Building Design, with a long-term vision to expand across additional industries, workflows, and phases of the built environment lifecycle.
   

  

 This role calls for a strong strategic thinker who can also roll up their sleeves. You will draw on both qualitative and quantitative data to capture insights and translate them into a clear point of view on where the Forma design applications should go and why. You will lead a talented strategy team that is still early in its journey, and act as a trusted partner to product, sales, marketing, customer success, and industry leadership.
   

  

 A core part of this role is being a strong evangelist for the Forma Industry Cloud and the Forma design applications, both inside Autodesk and externally with customers, partners, and the wider industry. You will work closely with the Forma Design product organization to ensure the strategy is grounded in customer outcomes, market opportunities and product direction. You will also bring a broad skill set and proven experience managing senior stakeholders across many teams. Because the work spans regions, this role must be able to support both European and US time zones.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Strategy & Analysis**
* Define the strategy and go-to-market direction for Autodesk's Forma design applications portfolio, identifying where we invest, differentiate, and grow.
* Leverage qualitative and quantitative data, along with AI and the tools available, to turn customer, market, competitive, and product signals into a clear point of view.
* Guide decisions on pricing, packaging, portfolio clarity, and adoption, so customers understand how Forma design delivers value across planning, design, and delivery.
* Build the frameworks, briefs, and recommendations that help leadership make confident decisions


**Evangelism & Advocacy**
* Serve as a strategic evangelist for the Forma Industry Cloud and Forma design applications, building awareness, alignment, and momentum across Autodesk.
* Represent Forma externally with customers, partners, and at industry events, building confidence in its direction.
* Capture and share customer stories and outcomes to demonstrate the platform's value and inspire adoption.
* Engage directly with customers and partners to test our approach and bring their feedback back into the organization.


**Cross-Functional Collaboration**
* Partner closely with the Forma design product team to shape the product roadmap, bringing market, competitive, and customer insight into the discussion.
* Work with Autodesk's global strategy team to connect Forma design's strategy to the company's broader Industry Cloud vision and portfolio.
* Align senior stakeholders across product, sales, marketing, customer success, and industry leadership on Forma's positioning, priorities, and execution.
* Establish a clear operating rhythm so strategy, messaging, and field execution stay connected.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* 10+ years across strategy, go-to-market, product, or management consulting, including significant time in or close to the AEC industry.
* Proven track record of leading teams and shaping strategy that delivers measurable business results.
* Deep understanding of AEC workflows and the opportunities for digital transformation across the built environment.
* Demonstrated experience representing a product or company externally with customers, analysts, and at industry events.
* Strong command of data and AI-enabled tools to generate insights and inform decisions, including cloud platforms and data-driven workflows.
* Bachelor's degree in business, strategy, architecture, engineering, construction management, or a related field (or equivalent experience).


****Learn More****
**About Autodesk**
 Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.
   

  

 We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.
   

  

 When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!
   

  

**Salary transparency**
 Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location. title: PMO Manager
description:
atNorth is a leading Nordic data center company providing cost-effective, scalable high-density colocation and built-to-suit services to industry-leading organizations across Iceland, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark.
   

  

 With sustainability at our core, our data centers run on renewable energy and are designed according to circular economy principles. Through innovative design, power efficiency, and intelligent operations, we deliver reliable, secure, and high-performance infrastructure.
   

  

 Headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland, atNorth operates eight data centers across the Nordics, with additional sites under development in Finland, Denmark, and Sweden.
   

  

 We combine world-class technology with a people-first culture built on collaboration, ownership, and trust, empowering our teams to grow, take responsibility, and make a real impact.
   

  

 By joining our international team, you will help shape the future of sustainable digital infrastructure.
   

  

**PMO Manager at atNorth**
 As a PMO Manager at atNorth, you will play a key role in supporting the successful delivery of large-scale development projects across our growing data center portfolio. Acting as a bridge between project teams and senior management, you will translate complex project information into clear business insights and help ensure informed decision-making across the organization.
   

  

 This is a hands-on role for an experienced project professional who enjoys working closely with project teams, solving delivery challenges, and driving execution. While the role includes exposure to senior stakeholders and opportunities to influence project outcomes, success comes from actively engaging with project teams and supporting delivery on the ground rather than operating purely from a governance perspective.
   

  

 We are looking for someone who can quickly understand complex project environments, build credibility with stakeholders at all levels, and provide practical guidance and challenge to project teams. You will partner closely with Project Delivery Directors and project teams on a day-to-day basis, helping to improve delivery performance and outcomes.
   

  

 This is a unique opportunity to be part of the delivery of some of the most significant data center development projects in the Nordics. You will have visibility across a portfolio of complex, high-value projects while playing an active role in helping teams navigate challenges and achieve successful results.
   

  

**Key responsibilities:**
* Act as a trusted partner to Project Delivery Directors and project teams, providing practical guidance, challenge, and support throughout the project lifecycle.
* Work closely with project teams to identify risks, dependencies, delivery challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
* Translate technical project information into clear, business-focused insights and recommendations for senior leadership.
* Support the development of project reviews, business cases, governance materials, and executive-level reporting.
* Facilitate effective communication between project teams, commercial stakeholders, and leadership forums.
* Drive consistency in project controls, reporting, planning, and governance across the project portfolio.
* Develop practical tools, templates, and training materials that support high-quality project delivery.
* Support and challenge project planning and schedules, helping teams identify critical milestones, dependencies, risks, and potential delivery impacts.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of PMO processes, methodologies, and ways of working.
* Provide constructive challenge to strengthen project planning, execution, decision-making, and delivery outcomes.


**Your profile:**
* Several years of experience in project management, project controls, PMO, project services, or project delivery roles within large-scale construction, infrastructure, industrial, data center, energy, pharmaceutical, or similar capital project environments.
* Strong understanding of how large capital projects are planned, governed, scheduled, and delivered, including familiarity with construction scheduling principles such as critical path, milestones, dependencies, and schedule risk.
* Experience working closely with both project delivery teams and senior business stakeholders.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical project topics into clear business language.
* Proven ability to influence stakeholders, build credibility, and drive alignment across different functions.
* Experience developing presentations, governance materials, business cases, reports, and executive-level communications.
* Ability to quickly understand complex project situations and identify key risks, opportunities, and priorities.
* Demonstrated ability and willingness to work hands-on with project teams and engage in the day-to-day realities of project delivery.
* Hands-on, proactive, and solution-oriented approach with a strong sense of ownership.
* Comfortable operating in evolving international environments and driving continuous improvement.
* Fluency in English.


**About The AtNorth Culture**
 We believe that sustainable success starts with the wellbeing of our people. For us, an open, transparent, and inclusive culture is more than a priority, it is the core of how we lead and innovate.
   

  

 We don’t just talk about culture; we nurture it. Through regular one-to-one engagements and monthly wellbeing surveys, we listen carefully to our teams, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity for improvement is embraced.
   

  

 We recognize that innovation and collaboration thrive where people feel truly connected, which is why we come together each week to share ideas, strengthen relationships, and nurture a sense of belonging, sometimes over a simple breakfast and good conversation.
   

  

 At atNorth, we are building a community where you can do your best work and shape a sustainable future together.

title: Programmatic Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
*Publicis Groupe is one of the largest communications groups in the world. We are building the agency model of the future and take a holistic approach to our clients’ challenges. By fusing together our media, creative, data and technology expertise, we are able to provide clients with integrated solutions, transformative ideas and compelling consumer experiences. We call it the Power of One.
   

  

 We are proud winner of many awards and nominations, both in Sweden and internationally. But nothing makes us prouder than to work with clients and brands such as P&G, Disney, H&M, Mondelez, Volvo, VISA, Lantmännen, LEGO, Spotify, Perrigo, TUI and many more.
   

  

 At Publicis, we put our people first. We are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work® for five consecutive years (2022–2026) and have won the Diversity Charter Sweden Awards in the category Mental Health (2025). We have also been recognized with a Magnet Award for our engaging culture (2023). Our goal is to become the leading workplace in our industry. We are based in two fantastic offices in Vasastan (Odengatan and Upplandsgatan) and offer a flexible work policy.*
**Overview**
**Are you data-driven, tech-savvy, and ready to take the next step in your digital media career?**
 At Publicis Groupe, we believe in creativity, collaboration, and courage. We are looking for a driven and curious
 **Programmatic Specialist** 
 who wants to be a key player in our talented programmatic team.
   

  

 In this role, you will have ownership of the strategy, tactics, hands-on setup, optimization, and analysis of programmatic campaigns across channels like Video, Audio, Display, OOH and other media channels. You will ensure effective and efficient execution, contributing directly to the success of our clients campaigns, striving to showcase the benefits of programmatic and Connected Media frameworks.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy & Tactical Planning**
* Channel Strategy: Develop and implement programmatic tactical plans and audience strategies that meet client objectives and align seamlessly with cross-channel plans.
* AI & Automation Drive: Embrace and test AI and automation tools to optimize bidding, audience segmentation, and creative personalization.


**Campaign Management & Platform Execution**
* End-to-End Execution: Execute day-to-day tactics, including advanced campaign setup, targeting, pacing, and budgeting across DSPs (DV360, Amazon, etc.).
* Operational Excellence: Ensure accurate, timely setup and data utilization (first-, second-, and third-party data) within privacy-first frameworks, adhering strictly to industry best practices.
* Continuous Optimization: Continuously monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize live campaigns to improve performance and achieve client KPIs.


**Insights & Cross-Functional Collaboration**
* Data Analysis: Conduct detailed analysis of campaign data, generate actionable insights, and prepare performance reports for internal reviews and client presentations.
* Cross-Functional Teamwork: Work closely with other media specialists (e.g., Video, Audio, OOH) and Client Managers to ensure cohesive and integrated campaign execution.
* Client Advisory: Actively participate in client meetings to provide channel-specific programmatic insights, translating technical metrics into clear business outcomes.


**Qualifications**
**Profile & Mindset**
 You are genuinely curious about digital media and passionate about exploring identity solutions, tech platforms, and data-driven approaches. You combine this curiosity with a strong analytical mindset, enabling you to turn platform data into sharp performance improvements.
   

  

* The Tech-Savvy Innovator: You thrive in a rapidly changing environment. You aren't afraid to experiment with AI-driven media tools, automation algorithms, and machine learning to find a competitive edge.
* The Collaborator: You enjoy working close to your peers. You naturally share knowledge, love troubleshooting complex tech setups, and collaborate across teams to elevate our collective output.
* The Tactician: You enjoy working both conceptually with tactical plans and hands-on with platform execution, balancing big-picture vision with meticulous, flawless operational execution.


**What You Bring**
* Experience: 1–3 years of hands-on work experience in programmatic buying, digital media optimization, or ad tech.
* Platform Expertise: Practical knowledge of major DSPs (DV360, Amazon DSP, or similar automated buying platforms).
* Tech & AI Savvy: Familiarity with or a strong interest in learning AI-driven media tools, predictive modeling, and next-generation programmatic solutions.
* Analytical Power: Excellent data literacy with strong analytical skills and the ability to turn numbers into compelling narratives (well-versed in the Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel).
* Execution Skills: Meticulous attention to detail to ensure 100% accuracy in campaign set-up and reporting, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously within deadlines.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or other relevant post-secondary education.
* Language: Verbal and written proficiency in English and Swedish.


**Additional Information**
 In addition to a welcoming culture and inclusive environment with passionate colleagues we offer you:
   

  

**Career Opportunities**
 Local and Global opportunities through the Power Of One.
   

  

**Personal and Professional Learning**
 Global AI learning platform where you can participate in +30 000 classes and connect with colleagues from all over the world.
   

  

**Flexible Ways of Working**
 We want to be an employer where work life balance is cherished. We love to spend time with our colleagues at the office but also believe in the output of your work not where the work is being done.
   

  

**Work Your World**
 For six weeks a year, the world is yours. Every employee can work anywhere on the planet where there's a Publicis office. A new city, a favorite locale, or even a different country - Go. Grow. Explore.
   

  

**Mental Health**
 The happiness and health of our people is paramount to us. We work continuously on maintaining a healthy and safe working environment through initiatives that facilitate the well-being of our employees.
   

  

**Benefits**
 Generous benefit package.
   

  

 We look forward to your application!

title: Business Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
*Vi på Billerud tror att när vi har morgondagen i åtanke gör vi vårt bästa idag. Tack vare våra medarbetare är vi ett världsledande företag inom vår bransch av förnybara papper- och förpackningsmaterial. Vill du uppnå din fulla potential och bidra till en hållbar morgondag? Bli en del av oss!*
 Vi söker en analytisk och lösningsorienterad
 **Business Analyst** 
 till vårt Wood Sourcing-team.
   

  

 I denna roll får du en bred introduktion till affären inom Wood Sourcing och möjlighet att arbeta nära flera delar av verksamheten. Du kommer att stötta affären och vara delaktig i att utveckla och förbättra våra arbetssätt. Rollen kombinerar analys och affärsförståelse med system och digitalisering. Rollen erbjuder goda möjligheter att successivt ta ett större ansvar inom affärs- och verksamhetsutveckling.
   

  

**Dina Huvudsakliga Arbetsuppgifter Kommer Att Vara**
* Genomföra analyser och ta fram nyckeltal, prognoser, dashboards och rapporter samt följa upp affärer, avtal och verksamhet.
* Stödja affärsansvariga med affärs- och marknadsanalyser, beslutsunderlag samt operativt och administrativt stöd.
* Vara superuser för relevanta system och bidra till god datakvalitet, processförbättringar, testning, implementering och användarstöd.
* Arbeta med frågor kopplade till Biometria, mätdata, virkesredovisning samt branschstandarder och VIOL.
* Delta i och driva utvecklingsinitiativ som bidrar till effektivisering, digitalisering och förbättrade arbetssätt.


 Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning. Du blir en del av Wood Sourcing-teamet, som består av sex medarbetare, där merparten är placerade i Gävle. Tjänsten kan vara placerad vid antingen Gävle bruk eller på vårt huvudkontor i Solna.
   

  

 Vi sätter Safety First! Hos oss på Billerud ansvarar vi alla för att bidra till en säker arbetsmiljö. Läs mer om vårt Safety First initiativ här.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**För att lyckas i rollen som Business Analyst tror vi att du har:**
* Eftergymnasial utbildning inom ekonomi, industriell ekonomi, statistik, IT/systemvetenskap, eller annat relevant område.
* Några års erfarenhet av arbete inom analys, rapportering, affärsstöd, verksamhetsutveckling eller liknande område.
* Goda kunskaper i Excel och god förmåga att analysera data.
* God systemvana och förmåga att arbeta i affärssystem.
* God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.


 Meriterande
   

  

* Skoglig utbildning eller erfarenhet från skogsbranschen.
* Kunskaper i Power BI eller liknande verktyg.
* Kunskap om Biometria/VIOL.
* Erfarenhet av förbättrings- eller projektarbete.


**Personal qualities**
 Vi lägger stor vikt vid din personlighet. För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du är analytisk och har lätt för att strukturera information, se samband och omsätta data till tydliga slutsatser och beslutsunderlag. Du har god systemförståelse, sätter dig snabbt in i nya system och förstår hur information, processer och arbetssätt hänger ihop.
   

  

 Du har ett intresse för digitala verktyg och ser möjligheter att använda dem för att förenkla och förbättra arbetet. Samtidigt är du strukturerad och noggrann med ett tydligt fokus på kvalitet, särskilt när det gäller data och rapportering.
   

  

 Vidare samarbetar du väl med olika funktioner och anpassar ditt stöd efter verksamhetens behov. Du har ett intresse för affären och verksamhetsutveckling och motiveras av att förstå verksamheten och bidra till att utveckla processer och arbetssätt.
   

  

 Våra värderingar är viktiga för oss och vi tror att du som söker känner igen dig i våra värdeord:
 *Värna om varandra* 
 och
 *vi håller det vi lovar* 
 .
   

  

**Contact**
 Vill du veta mer om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef. Karin Fogelberg, Senior Manager Wood Sourcing, på mail Karin.Fogelberg@billerud.com.
   

  

 Om du vill veta mer om rekryteringsprocessen är du välkommen att kontakta Josefin Seger, HR Generalist via mail josefin.seger@billerud.com.
   

  

**Application information**
 Välkommen med din ansökan senast 8 november 2026.
   

  

 Billerud är en jämställd arbetsgivare. Vi omfamnar mångfald och är engagerade i att skapa en inkluderande miljö för alla anställda och kandidater.
   

  

**Vår rekryteringsprocess innehåller** 
 : rekryteringstester, intervjuer, referenstagning, alkohol- och drogtest.
   

  

**Do you want to help create a sustainable future through your work?**
 At Billerud, we are fully committed to reduce our and our customers carbon footprint by offering high-performance paper and packaging materials. We are convinced that the right solutions can be important tools to help fight climate change. That's why we see it as our responsibility to enable the best packaging choices, for a better tomorrow.
   

  

 Our proud history in the forestry and paper industry goes back more than 150 years. Since then, we’ve grown to what we are today: a world leading company in high-performing paper and packaging materials - passionately committed to sustainability, quality, and customer value. Our materials are the basis of packaging and paper products used by millions of people around the world, 24 hours a day, all year round.
   

  

 We serve customers in more than 100 countries through our three business areas Liquid Packaging Board, Paper and Paper Board. Our nine production units are located in Sweden, USA, and Finland and we have around 5,200 employees in 16 countries. Our annual turnover is approximately SEK 40.5 billion and the share is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. At Billerud we always put safety first, care for each other, and do what we say.
   

  

 Join us in redefining sustainable packaging and drive meaningful change for a better tomorrow.

title: Specialist, Catalog Operations EMEA
description:

In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
   

  

 Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
   

  

****About Wolt****
 At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
   

  

 Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
   

  

****What You’ll Be Doing****
 We are seeking a
 **Catalog Specialist** 
 to drive Catalog adoption and ensure a consistently high standard of product data quality within their country. This role is critical to establishing the Catalog as the single source of truth for packaged goods, enabling scalable operations, faster onboarding, and an improved customer experience.
   

  

 You will work closely with local Operations teams to embed the Catalog into day-to-day workflows, while collaborating cross-functionally with external vendors and global teams to steer catalog-related initiatives forward. Acting as the local subject-matter expert on catalog structure, data quality, and compliance, you will guide stakeholders, validate automated and vendor-provided data, and influence decision-making to ensure successful adoption and long-term quality outcomes.
   

  

**Day-to-day in this role you’ll:**
* Catalog Data Ownership (:60%)
* Review and validate product data from automation, merchants, and vendors before publication.
* Maintain high-quality standards for product data grounded in established compliance frameworks and supported by an ongoing commitment to staying informed and updated on local product data regulations
* Resolve duplicate GTINs and support clean deduplication/migration into the Unified Catalog
* Help create and enrich entries for unlisted products based on local needs, using merchant input, vendor data, or AI-generated suggestions.
* Ensure adherence to global attribute frameworks; escalate mismatches to Global Catalog & Data Quality
* AI/Automation QA (:10%)
* Curate golden datasets for AI model training and evaluation (e.g., for LLMs).
* Audit and approve automation outputs during pilot phases
* Identify local linguistic or structural nuances that impact automation accuracy
* Collaborate with Product & Applied Science to refine automation models and improve QA logic
* Stakeholder Support & Feedback Loops (:30%)
* Serve as the go-to expert for catalog data structure, taxonomy, and enrichment logic in your country
* Support local Sales and Merchant Ops in catalog updates and onboarding efficiency
* Provide structured feedback to global teams on catalog tooling, automation, and schema
* Participate in global process pilots, tool launches, and content governance reviews.


**Our humble expectations**
* Fluent in Swedish and English is a must;
* 3+ years of experience in catalog/content management, product data QA, or similar fields.
* High proficiency in structured data management, with a quality-first mindset.
* Experience working with AI/ML models, QA workflows, or automation processes is a plus.
* Strong communication and stakeholder collaboration skills.
* Experience working with large datasets in spreadsheet tools such as Excel or Google Sheets is required
* First project management experience is a plus;


****What We Offer****
* A fast-growing tech company with lots of career opportunities, both locally and internationally;
* Health Insurance;
* Employee Assistance Programme - therapy and wellbeing;
* Employee discount on all Wolt orders;


**Next steps**
 If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership, and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then click below to apply, make sure to add your CV and get the conversation going!
   

  

 We will be reviewing applications on an on-going basis. If this sounds like an opportunity you want to pursue, apply today!
   

  

 Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
   

  

 We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.
   

  

*Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .*

title: Inbound Sales Representative
description:
**Inbound Sales Representative at atNorth**
 atNorth is a leading Nordic data center company providing cost-effective, scalable high-density colocation and built-to-suit services to industry-leading organizations across Iceland, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark.
   

  

 With sustainability at our core, our data centers run on renewable energy and are designed according to circular economy principles. Through innovative design, power efficiency, and intelligent operations, we deliver reliable, secure, and high-performance infrastructure.
   

  

 Headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland, atNorth operates eight data centers across the Nordics, with additional sites under development in Finland, Denmark, and Sweden.
   

  

 We combine world-class technology with a people-first culture built on collaboration, ownership, and trust, empowering our teams to grow, take responsibility, and make a real impact.
   

  

 By joining our international team, you will help shape the future of sustainable digital infrastructure.
   

  

**Inbound Sales Representative at atNorth**
 This role is positioned at the center of our inbound commercial flow, acting as the first point of contact for new opportunities and playing a key role in ensuring a structured, efficient, and scalable sales process. You will enable the broader Sales organization to focus on larger and more complex deals, while independently managing smaller, standardized opportunities.
   

  

 You will be responsible for qualifying inbound leads and leading sales opportunities up to a defined size, using standardized solutions, pricing, and agreements. The role requires a combination of commercial understanding, structured execution, and strong communication skills.
   

  

**Key responsibilities:**
 A key focus of the role is to ensure a fast, consistent, and high-quality handling of inbound opportunities. You will assess and qualify leads, manage standardized proposal processes, and ensure efficient handover across the organization.
   

  

 You will be responsible for initial qualification of all inbound opportunities in accordance with atNorth’s qualification framework and dispatch relevant opportunities to the appropriate Sales representatives based on customer segment and scope.
   

  

 You will own the full proposal process for smaller colocation opportunities, utilizing predefined templates, solutions, and pricing models to ensure efficiency and quick turnaround times. This includes managing client communication throughout the bid process, clarifying requirements, presenting solutions, and addressing any questions.
   

  

 From a commercial and contractual perspective, you will adapt standard colocation agreements within predefined thresholds, ensuring alignment with atNorth’s pricing policies and deal structures.
   

  

 Beyond execution, you will ensure proper documentation of all proposals and customer interactions, manage contract closure, and drive the formal handover to Operations and Finance.
   

  

 You will also contribute to continuous improvement of the standardized bid process and support outbound initiatives, including targeted outreach and preparation of sales materials in collaboration with the high-density colocation team.
   

  

**What We Are Looking For**
 We are looking for someone who thrives in a structured sales environment and enjoys working with standardized solutions while maintaining a strong customer focus.
   

  

**Your profile**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or similar
* Minimum 2 years of experience working with customer contracts within IT, infrastructure, or real estate
* Experience with digital sales, inbound handling, or standardized solution selling is an advantage
* Strong digital understanding, including experience with IT systems, platforms, and AI tools
* Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken


 You are detail-oriented and committed to delivering high-quality outputs. You are a quick learner with a strong ability to work with new systems and tools, and you bring a service-minded and responsive approach to your work. You are able to work under pressure, manage multiple tasks, and meet tight deadlines while maintaining a strong commercial mindset.
   

  

**Decision-making & impact**
 You will have responsibility for managing and closing standardized proposal processes within defined commercial frameworks and authority limits. You will operate in accordance with atNorth’s Bid Process, Sales Strategy, and Delegation of Authority, while actively contributing to improving how we manage and scale smaller colocation opportunities.
   

  

**About The AtNorth Culture**
 We believe that sustainable success starts with the wellbeing of our people. For us, an open, transparent, and inclusive culture is more than a priority, it is the core of how we lead and innovate.

title: Account Executive (Enterprise)
description:
**About Proxify** 




  





 Proxify gives companies vetted senior developers within 48 hours, so they can ship without months of hiring. Since 2018 we've worked with 2,500+ companies. Enterprise customers include Securitas, Electrolux and Lufthansa. The Financial Times ranked us Sweden's 3rd fastest-growing company in 2025, and we were in Deloitte's Fast 50 Sweden in 2024.
 



  





**Why enterprise, and why now?** 
 AI is changing how software gets built, but it hasn't closed the talent gap. It has moved it. Large companies are rebuilding their engineering organisations around AI, cloud and data, and they need engineers who can build and run these systems now. Proxify helps place those engineers.
 



  





**The role** 




  





 As an
 **Enterprise Account Executive** 
 , you'll win new enterprise logos and grow them across business units and subsidiaries. You own each deal from first outreach to signature, so this is an outbound role.
 



  





 Enterprise buyers don't buy developer capacity the way startups do. A typical deal involves:
 



  




1. **Getting in** 
 : Reaching CTOs or VPs of Engineering through research-led outbound and warm paths into existing customer groups.
2. **Proving value** 
 : A pilot placement of 1–3 engineers, scoped with Client Engineering, that shows speed and quality.
3. **Getting through procurement** 
 : Vendor onboarding, security and legal review, and negotiating a place on a preferred-supplier list, often against large consultancies already in the account.
4. **Scaling** 
 : Turning the framework agreement into multi-team demand.



  





**What you'll do** 




  




* Build and work a named account,
 **generating your own pipeline** 
 through multi-channel outbound;
* **Run multi-threaded deals** 
 across engineering, business, procurement and legal stakeholders;
* Build
 **business cases** 
 leaders can take to their CFO: cost, time-to-hire and delivery risk;
* **Negotiate** 
 commercial terms, MSAs and supplier-framework entries;
* **Find expansion routes** 
 into subsidiaries and new business units of existing customer groups;
* **Hand won accounts** 
 to Account Management with a clear expansion plan;
* **Keep** 
 your pipeline, forecast and
 **CRM accurate** 
 , and help write the enterprise playbook as it grows.



  





**What we're looking for** 




  




* At least 4 years of new-business B2B sales in SaaS, tech services, IT consulting, staffing or outsourcing;
* Experience running the full cycle yourself, from cold outbound to signed contract, including procurement and legal;
* Confidence with C-level and technical buyers: you can talk about engineering teams, AI and cloud without a script;
* Comfort building structure where it doesn't exist yet;
* Fluent English (written and spoken).



  





**Nice to have** 




  




* Experience selling developer staffing, IT consulting or engineering services to large enterprises;
* A network among enterprise engineering leaders;
* Swedish, German or another language;
* Experience with a structured method such as MEDDPICC or command of the message;
* Experience helping set up a new sales function.



  





**Why it may not be your match** 




  





 ❌ You prefer structured environments with established processes rather than help build them.
 



 ❌ You enjoy account management more than hunting for and closing new business.
 



 ❌ You lack curiosity about technology or feel uncomfortable discussing technical challenges.
 



 ❌ You are not based in Stockholm for on-site collaboration.
 



 ❌ You solely worked as an Account Manager and don't have outbound experience.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**About Gallagher**
 At Gallagher, our purpose is simple: Protect what matters most. We live this every day through smart, future-focused security solutions that help organisations protect people, places, and critical assets.
   

  

 Gallagher Security is a global technology business with operations across the UK, Europe, New Zealand, Australia, Asia, Africa, the USA, and Canada, and exports to more than 140 countries.
   

  

 The Nordics is an important and growing market for Gallagher. Our presence in the region continues to develop as more organisations look for modern, integrated security solutions and long-term technology partners.
   

  

 With growing customer engagement and increasing demand across the region, we are expanding our Nordic team to support the next phase of that growth.
   

  

 Our culture is entrepreneurial, collaborative, and ambitious. We’re painting the future of what’s possible. Come join us.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We're looking for a Business Development Manager to drive growth across the Nordics market. This is a commercially focused role centred on identifying, developing, and converting new business opportunities while building strong relationships with enterprise end users and key supply chains across industry influencers across key vertical markets.
   

  

 You’ll be joining a growing Nordic operation with the opportunity to make a real impact. Rather than simply managing an established territory, you’ll help develop the market, create new opportunities, and strengthen Gallagher’s position across the region.
   

  

 This is a true business development role. You'll be responsible for creating demand, building pipeline, and delivering profitable growth by developing strategic customer relationships and uncovering new opportunities. Working closely with Sales Managers, Solution Managers, and technical specialists, you'll take opportunities from initial engagement through to successful close.
   

  

**Your Role At a Glance**
* Develop and execute business growth strategies that support regional sales objectives.
* Analyse industry trends, customer needs, and competitor activity to inform business growth strategies.
* Identify, qualify, nurture, and close profitable opportunities across targeted vertical markets.
* Build relationships with enterprise end users, consultants, and key industry influencers.
* Drive new business development while expanding existing strategic customer relationships.
* Lead customer presentations and solution discussions with support from technical specialists.
* Support RFIs, RFQs, tenders, and customer solution requirements.
* Analyse market and competitor activity to identify growth opportunities and market trends.
* Maintain strong CRM discipline, forecasting, reporting, and account planning.


**The Fit**
 We’re looking for a sales professional who thrives on winning new business and building trusted customer relationships. You'll be commercially focused, motivated by results, and comfortable working in a technical B2B environment where insight, credibility, and persistence drive success.
   

  

**What You’ll Bring**
* At least 5 years’ proven B2B sales experience, ideally within technology, security, or a related solutions-led environment
* Strong business development experience with a track record of prospecting, generating leads, and closing opportunities.
* Experience engaging with enterprise customers and multiple stakeholder groups.
* Solution-selling capability and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly.
* Commercial confidence, including negotiation, forecasting, pipeline management, and account planning.
* Strong analytical and relationship management skills.
* A collaborative, results-driven approach with high integrity and accountability.


**Why Gallagher?**
 This is an exciting time to join Gallagher in the Nordics. We are building on strong momentum in the region and investing in our team to support increasing market demand and future growth.
   

  

 You’ll have the opportunity to help shape that journey, develop strategic customer relationships, open new markets, and contribute directly to Gallagher’s continued expansion across the Nordics.
   

  

 At the same time, you’ll be backed by a global security technology business with established expertise, strong technical capability, and an international network of colleagues and specialists.
   

  

 This is a field-based role based in Stockholm, with travel across the Nordics to meet customers, consultants, partners, and key stakeholders.
   

  

**We Offer**
* Competitive salary, with bonus opportunities.
* A high-trust, collaborative team environment with strong regional and global support.
* The opportunity to influence growth and build strategic customer relationships.
* The chance to join a growing Nordic business at a point where you can genuinely help shape its future.


 If you’re commercially driven, customer-focused, and passionate about winning new business, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 Applications will be reviewed as they are received, and we may close the advert early if we appoint before the official closing date. Apply now!

title: Engineering Manager to our Customer Scalability area
description:

We are now looking for an Engineering Manager to join our Customer Scalability area within Tech, who together with other managers and product roles wants to help drive Avanza forward!*

**About The Role**
 The entire Product & Tech organization consists of around 35 development teams that collectively build our platform, services, and offerings. In your role as Engineering Manager, you will work closely with 1-2 cross-functional teams and have direct line management responsibility for the software developers.
   

  

 This role is connected to the teams responsible for building and advancing Avanza's customer and account lifecycle. Our objective is to ensure that the entire organization has seamless access to high-quality, reliable, and up-to-date customer and account data whenever needed. You will balance business acumen with technical direction to deliver concrete value for both our customers and the company.
   

  

**You Will Also Be Responsible For/work With**
* Leading, coaching, and empowering developers in your team while taking full responsibility for line management and the work environment.
* Creating optimal conditions for a high-performing, healthy team and guiding them toward high-quality, efficient technical deliveries.
* Ensuring that technical initiatives align with product strategies and supporting teams in building robust, sustainable solutions.
* Driving our cloud evolution toward GCP and exploring AI-driven ways of working within team processes.

 Your profile
   

  

 To thrive as our Engineering Manager, you are a supportive, present leader with a genuine interest in people. You are motivated by seeing your team members grow, creating psychological safety, and building trusted relationships in a dynamic environment. You possess strong collaborative skills, a delivery-oriented mindset, and confidence in technical decision-making, enabling you to translate business goals into sustainable architecture and concrete execution.
   

  

**We Would Love To See That You Have**

* A background in modern software engineering, ideally with experience in data-intensive systems.
* A solid understanding of data quality, system architecture, and well-designed APIs.

 To succeed in this role, you bring strong self-leadership, a collaborative approach, and the ability to bridge strategic direction with technical reality. You excel at prioritizing quality, building trust across teams, and empowering your team members to reach their full potential.
   

  

 What We Offer

title: Delansvarig IT Förvaltningsmodell (PM3)
description:
Techster Solutions söker nu för kunds räkning en erfaren
 **Verksamhetsutvecklare inom IT** 
 med stark kompetens inom
 **PM3** 
 och förvaltningsstyrning. Kunden är en samhällsviktig statlig myndighet med ansvar för Sveriges elöverföringssystem och energinät.
   

  

**Om uppdraget**
 Som Delansvarig IT Förvaltningsmodell kommer du att ingå i enheten för IT Leveransstyrning. Enhetens uppdrag är att förvalta och vidareutveckla IT-divisionens operativa modell baserad på PM3, i syfte att skapa mervärde som utgår från verksamhetens strategier och mål.
   

  

 I rollen samverkar du med kollegor på enheten för att säkerställa att förvaltningsstyrningsmodellen är ändamålsenlig och att förvaltningsorganisationen får rätt stöd. Eftersom förvaltningsstyrningen har starka beroenden till portfölj-, projekt- och produktionsmodeller arbetar du i nära dialog med hela organisationen.
   

  

**Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:**
* Driva och facilitera forum inom IT-styrning (t.ex. operativ IT-ledningsgrupp och förvaltningsledarforum).
* Bereda placeringsbeslut tillsammans med projekt och förvaltning, hålla förvaltningsobjektarkitekturen (FOA) aktuell samt ta fram beslutsunderlag vid förändringar.
* Introducera, utbilda och stötta objektägare och förvaltningsledare inom både IT och verksamheten.
* Driva kontinuerligt förbättringsarbete och effektivisering av förvaltningsstyrningsmodellen.
* Stötta IT-ledningen i diverse förvaltningsstyrningsfrågor, däribland ekonomisk uppföljning.


**Kvalifikationskrav (Obligatoriska)**
 För att vara aktuell för uppdraget behöver du uppfylla följande krav (Kompetensnivå 3, 5–9 års erfarenhet):
   

  

* Utbildning: Högskole- eller universitetsutbildning (minst 120/180 hp).
* PM3: Minst 3 års arbetslivserfarenhet inom PM3 förvaltningsstyrning.
* Införande & Styrformer: Minst 3 års erfarenhet av att driva införande av IT-processer och styrformer för förvaltning (t.ex. PM3 eller ITSM).
* Beslutsunderlag: Påvisad erfarenhet av att ta fram dokumentation och beslutsunderlag kopplat till förvaltningsstyrning.
* Facilitering: Erfarenhet av att facilitera och leda forum inom IT-styrning (t.ex. operativa ledningsgrupper eller förvaltningsledarforum).
* Språk: Flytande svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift.


**Meriterande erfarenheter (Mervärdeskrav)**
 Vi ser det som starkt meriterande om du har:
   

  

* Erfarenhet från arbete i både offentlig och privat verksamhet.
* Erfarenhet av arbete i stora organisationer (minst 500 anställda).
* Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att hålla i utbildningar (lärarledda kurser eller interna utbildningsinsatser).
* Minst 2 års erfarenhet i leveransroller såsom Service Manager, Application Manager, Utvecklingsledare eller motsvarande.
* Praktisk erfarenhet av förbättringsarbete kopplat till styrmodeller inom IT.


**Personliga egenskaper**
 Vi söker dig som är utåtriktad, tydlig i din kommunikation och har lätt för att skapa förtroende i organisationen. Du har stark initiativförmåga, arbetar målinriktat och trivs lika bra med självständigt arbete som i grupp. Rollen ställer även krav på god struktur och fallenhet för administrativa uppgifter.
   

  

**Säkerhetsprövning**
 Då kunden bedriver säkerhetskänslig verksamhet krävs godkänd säkerhetsprövning och registerkontroll innan uppdragsstart. Processen beräknas ta cirka 8–10 veckor.
   

  

**Ansökan & Kontakt**
 Låter uppdraget intressant? Skicka in ditt CV och en kort beskrivning av hur du matchar kraven till oss på Techster Solutions så snart som möjligt.
   

  

*Vid ansökan är det viktigt att dina erfarenheter kopplade till de obligatoriska kraven tydligt framgår i ditt CV.*

title: CTO - Qondor
description:
**Lead an AI-first Builder organisation**
 Qondor is the Nordic leader in meetings and events management software, replacing a patchwork of tools with one connected workflow from first request to final invoice. Around 44,000 events ran through the platform in 2025 across more than 15 countries, and over half our ARR comes from outside Norway. Backed by Monterro, we are investing hard in product, engineering, and AI.
   

  

**How We Work**
 We are building Qondor's next platform with AI in the loop at every step. Product managers write and ship code. Developers sit inside product decisions rather than receiving them as tickets. Specs, prototypes, tests, and migrations are drafted by agents and reviewed by people accountable for what goes out.
   

  

 As a result, the key objectives of the role are setting an architecture and holding the guardrails that enable a fast AI-assisted team to deliver efficiently and reliably. You own product strategy and technical direction, lead the Builder organisation, and report to the CEO.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Define Qondor’s long term product and technology strategy, with AI at its heart
* Lead and develop the Builder organisation, with team members stemming from product and engineering
* Establish a clear and scalable architectural direction that supports international growth
* Own the guardrails - test strategy, review standards, pipelines, observability, security, and clear rules for agents’ actions
* Address structural bottlenecks and scalability risks proactively
* Foster a culture of rapid iteration, learning, and outcome focused delivery
* Take a technology agnostic approach, choosing solutions based on product value and long term sustainability
* Build further on a small, high-output team
* Drive disciplined prioritisation and transparent trade off decisions
* Act as a bridge between market and product, ensuring that customer insights, commercial priorities, and competitive dynamics shape the roadmap and technology investments


**Who You Are**
 We’re looking for someone who has:
   

  

* built something. Founder, co-founder, or early technical leader in a scaling company is highly relevant
* plenty of experience of being hands-on and already work this way. Coding agents daily on production work, with informed opinions about where they fail.
* shipped AI capability that customers actually use, and can say what it did to retention or cost
* a strong strategic and architectural judgement, also connecting technical decisions to commercial outcomes
* leadership experience – regardless of title, you enjoy motivating colleagues and seeing them succeed


**What’s In It For You**
* A rare chance to build an AI-first R&D organisation, in a promising company with a solid customer base - rather than from zero
* Full ownership of technical direction, architecture, and how the team works - no imposed frameworks or committee approvals
* A collaborative leadership team with high ambitions and a strong, motivated Builder organisation
* Meaningful equity with real upside tied to Qondor's growth
* Access to knowledge sharing through Monterro and a network of peers across +30 Nordic software companies
* Competitive terms and pension scheme
* Flexible working arrangements
* Modern office in the centre of Oslo


**About Monterro**
 Monterro is a hands-on growth investor. We turn Nordic B2B software companies into market leaders by contributing our time, experience, know-how, and networks. And yes, we provide capital too. In fact, we invest our own capital, so we are personally committed to our mutual success. Monterro is headquartered in Stockholm with offices in Oslo, Copenhagen, Helsinki, and our software development centre in Hanoi. Learn more at monterro.com.
