* Testa och kvalitetssäkra kampanjer före utskick
* Samarbeta med CRM, analys, affär och IT för att säkerställa relevanta och träffsäkra kundupplevelser


 Vi söker inte bara någon som förvaltar befintliga arbetssätt utan någon som vill vara med och utveckla dem. AI och nya tekniska möjligheter förändrar snabbt hur vi arbetar med Marketing Automation och vi tror att du drivs av att utforska hur ny teknik kan skapa ännu bättre kundupplevelser och affärsresultat.
   

  

 Du arbetar nära kollegor inom CRM, analys och affären samtidigt som du har stort eget ansvar för dina leveranser. Här får du möjlighet att fördjupa dig inom Marketing Automation i ett område som Tre fortsätter att investera i och utveckla.
   

  

 Det här är en tillsvidareanställning med start så snart som möjligt kopplad till vår fortsatta satsning inom CRM och kundkommunikation.
   

  

**Annika Beskriver Sitt Ledarskap**
 "Jag leder med tillit, nyfikenhet och tydlighet. Jag tror på att uppmuntra idéer snarare än att sätta upp hinder, på ett ”ja, vi kör”-mindset där människor får växa, ta ansvar och lyckas tillsammans. För mig är engagemang, glädje och många skratt på vägen en viktig del av att skapa riktigt starka resultat."
   

  

**Du Kan Se Fram Emot Att**
* Arbeta hands-on med Salesforce Marketing Cloud, kundresor och automatiserade kampanjer
* Vara en del av Tres fortsatta satsning på CRM, kundlojalitet och riktad kundkommunikation
* Arbeta datadrivet nära både affär, analys och marknadsföring
* Ha stort eget ansvar i en specialistroll där kvalitet och noggrannhet står i fokus
* Tillhöra ett team som präglas av samarbete, nyfikenhet och en prestigelös kultur
* Vara med och utforska hur AI och nya arbetssätt kan utveckla vårt arbete inom Marketing Automation
* Vara en del av en av Sveriges bästa arbetsplatser enligt Great Place to Work samt en stolt samarbetspartner till Women in Tech och Tjejer Kodar


 ,
   

  

**Mer om dig**
 Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av Marketing Automation och som trivs i en operativ specialistroll nära tekniken. Du gillar att bygga, testa och optimera lösningar och är nyfiken på hur data, automatisering och AI kan användas för att skapa bättre kundupplevelser och affärsresultat.
   

  

 Du har gärna erfarenhet av Salesforce Marketing Cloud och känner dig trygg i att arbeta med kundresor, segmentering och kampanjer. Du har goda kunskaper inom SQL och erfarenhet av AMPscript och HTML, vilket gör att du kan bygga, utveckla och optimera lösningar i plattformen. Du tycker om att förstå hur saker fungerar bakom kulisserna och använder tekniken för att skapa smarta kundupplevelser.
   

  

**Vi Tror Att Du Har**
* Erfarenhet av kampanjhantering, kundresor eller automatiserad kundkommunikation
* Arbetat i Salesforce Marketing Cloud eller en liknande Marketing Automation-plattform
* God förståelse för segmentering, målgruppsurval och datadriven kommunikation
* Självledarskap och förmåga att ta ansvar för dina leveranser från start till mål
* Ett strukturerat arbetssätt och ett stort fokus på kvalitet
* För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du:
* Har goda kunskaper i SQL
* Har erfarenhet av AMPscript och HTML
* Är nyfiken på hur AI och ny teknik kan användas för att utveckla arbetssätt och kundupplevelser
* Gillar att omsätta idéer till konkreta lösningar


**Det Är Meriterande Om Du Har Erfarenhet Av**
* Journey Builder
* Cloud Pages
* Telekom, abonnemangsaffärer eller andra datadrivna kundverksamheter


 Som person är du självgående, noggrann och samarbetsinriktad. Du är nyfiken, gillar att testa nya idéer och delar gärna med dig av kunskap och perspektiv till teamet. Vi tror att du trivs i en miljö där man hjälps åt, utmanar varandra och tillsammans hittar smartare sätt att arbeta.
   

  

 Du tar ansvar för ditt arbete, driver dina uppgifter framåt och levererar med hög kvalitet även när förutsättningarna förändras. Vi tror att du får energi av att skapa välfungerande kundkommunikation, gillar att arbeta datadrivet och vill vara med och utveckla vårt CRM-arbete framåt.
   

  

**Välkommen med din ansökan!**
 Vi tar emot ansökningar via denna annons och intervjuar löpande. Personligt brev behövs inte, men vi vill gärna att du bifogar ditt CV och svarar på några korta frågor i samband med din ansökan.
   

  

 Vi använder tester som en del av vår urvalsprocess för att säkerställa objektiva bedömningar. Tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Bakgrundskontroll genomförs på slutkandidat.

title: OT Solution Sales Specialist
description:
We are looking for a
 **OT Solution Sales Specialist** 
 to join us at Telia Cygate.
   

  

 My name is Michael Mothander, Head of Cyber Security, and I’m looking for someone who wants to grow together with us. We are a supportive and forward‑looking team focused on helping customers secure and modernize critical infrastructure through advanced networking, cybersecurity, and OT solutions.
   

  

**What you’ll do:**
 As an OT Solution Sales Specialist, you will play a key role in developing business opportunities within Operational Technology (OT), IoT, networking, and cybersecurity. You will work closely with customers, account teams, solution architects, and technical specialists to understand business challenges, shape solutions, and drive commercially successful outcomes.
   

  

 This is a highly collaborative role where you'll combine commercial insight with technical understanding to help customers navigate an increasingly complex security and digitalization landscape.
   

  

* Develop new business opportunities within OT security, industrial networking, IoT, and cybersecurity services
* Lead consultative customer dialogues, workshops, and solution discovery sessions
* Collaborate with technical experts and solution architects to design customer-centric solutions
* Own and drive the commercial process from opportunity identification through proposal and contract
* Contribute to bids, tenders, and complex solution proposals
* Build trusted relationships with both operational stakeholders and executive decision-makers
* Stay up to date on industry trends, regulations, and frameworks such as NIS2, IEC 62443, ISO 27001, and Zero Trust


**What will help you thrive in this role:**
 You are curious, commercially sharp, and comfortable operating in complex customer environments. You enjoy translating technical possibilities into business value and can build credibility with both specialists and decision-makers. You thrive in long sales cycles and are motivated by creating sustainable customer outcomes.
   

  

* Several years of experience in solution sales, business development, presales, or customer advisory within technology-related fields
* Experience from one or more of the following areas: OT/ICS cybersecurity, enterprise networking, cybersecurity services, industrial digitalization, critical infrastructure, or managed/professional services
* Strong understanding of networking and cybersecurity concepts
* Experience leading complex customer dialogues and solution-oriented sales processes
* Ability to communicate technical topics in a clear and business-focused way
* Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills
* Excellent communication skills, with fluency in Swedish (native or near-native) and good English


 The following are considered a plus:
   

  

* Experience working with industrial environments and OT/ICS technologies
* Knowledge of frameworks such as IEC 62443, NIS2, ISO 27001, or NIST
* Familiarity with technologies and vendors such as Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, Microsoft Security, Claroty, Armis or Nozomi Networks
* Experience selling solutions to customers within industry, energy, utilities, healthcare, real estate, or other critical infrastructure sectors


**Additional Requirements**
 Telia is part of critical infrastructure and parts of our operations are subject to security protection. Depending on the role, vetting activities may be required prior to employment. In some cases, additional eligibility requirements, including specific citizenship requirements, may apply.
   

  

 We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every qualification. If the role interests you and you believe you can make a valuable contribution, we would be pleased to hear from you
   

  

**Why Telia Cygate?**
 At Telia Cygate, we’re not only experts in networks, security, and various types of cloud solutions – we’re also a team that believes work should be fun! As part of Telia Company, we have the strength to create real impact on a large scale, contribute to societal value, and help our customers navigate the world of digitalization. And we always do it with warmth, care, and a smile. Here, it’s our ideas and diverse perspectives that make us strong, and together we ensure that the world of technology becomes a place where everyone feels good – and where you belong.
   

  

 Your development matters to us. We encourage continuous learning and make sure that you and your interests are in focus. We know that people are the heart of our company, which is why we value joy, creativity, and different perspectives in everything we do.
   

  

 Welcome to grow together with us – where we make technology human and create real impact!
   

  

**Telia Cygate is proud to be certificated as Great Place to Work!**
 With us, people are at the center – here you get the chance to grow, be challenged, and thrive together with dedicated colleagues. We are building a culture where security, togetherness, and opportunities go hand in hand. Do you want to be part of the journey? Welcome to a workplace that truly lives up to its name.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 When you join us, you'll receive a comprehensive benefits package tailored to your local market, opportunities for remote work, and more. You'll also have the chance to earn a bonus based on your performance and Telia's results.
   

  

**Interested? Apply!**
 We look forward to receiving your application by
 **2026-11-01.** 
 Please note that we might close the position earlier if we find the right candidate, so don’t wait too long to apply!
   

  

 Location:
 **Solna** 
 (preferred), but other locations in Sweden can also be considered.
   

  

 If you’re selected for the next stage, you’ll be contacted by our
 **Talent Acquisition Partner.**
 Background and reference checks will be part of the process.
   

  

 Want to know more about this role? Please reach out to Michael Mothander at michael.mothander@cygate.se.
   

  

 We kindly ask recruitment agencies and external vendors not to contact us regarding this position.
   

  

**Equal opportunities**
 At Telia, we recognize talent by professional skills and growth potential. We champion diversity, ensuring every individual’s needs are met, regardless of disability, gender, age, nationality, sexual orientation, or social status. Together, we’re dedicated to fostering an inclusive work environment where your uniqueness is our strength.
   

  

**Welcome to Telia Cygate – Home of Experts**

title: Global Process Manager Commercial People Analytics and Data Management
description:
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions. Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 As a Global Process Manager Commercial People Analytics and Data Management, you will play a key role in enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization. You will help ensure the consistent adoption of global People & Culture processes, data standards, and analytics practices while empowering business stakeholders to confidently use trusted people data, reports, dashboards, and insights.
   

  

 Acting as the bridge between business stakeholders and data, analytics, and process teams, you will support data quality improvements, promote self-service analytics, and translate business needs into actionable data and reporting requirements. This is an opportunity to shape how people data is managed and leveraged globally, driving better workforce decisions and business outcomes.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Support the adoption of global People & Culture processes, data standards, and common definitions across assigned divisions and domains.
* Train and support business users, People Business Partners, P&C Directors, and local teams in the effective use of People processes, data, analytics tools, and self-service reporting.
* Monitor data quality, identify issues impacting reporting and analytics, and drive corrective actions in collaboration with business stakeholders and Data Management teams.
* Enable business self-service through trusted People data, reports, dashboards, and insight products, while gathering and translating business needs into analytics and reporting requirements.
* Identify opportunities where analytics can improve business decision-making and support the generation of actionable People & Culture insights.
* Collaborate with Global Process Owners, Product Owners, HR Controlling, Data Management, and analytics teams to ensure business needs are addressed and governance standards are followed.
* Support resolution of process, data, and reporting deviations and escalate unresolved issues through established governance channels.


**Who You Are**
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Management, Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Proven experience working with HR data, people analytics, data governance, reporting, business intelligence, or HR process management.
* Strong understanding of data management principles, including data governance, stewardship, quality, ownership, and accessibility.
* Experience supporting business stakeholders in the adoption of data-driven ways of working and strong stakeholder management skills.
* Skilled at translating complex data, analytics, and process topics into practical and business-friendly guidance.
* Experience gathering and translating business requirements into analytics and reporting solutions.
* Familiarity with HR technologies such as SAP SuccessFactors (MySuccess) or similar platforms is an advantage.
* Fluent in English, both written and spoken.


**This Is Us**
 At Scania, we are transforming the way we work with People & Culture data and analytics to create a more insight-driven organization. Our ambition is to make trusted people data accessible, understandable, and actionable for leaders and employees across the business.
   

  

 You will join an international and collaborative environment where business, data, process, and technology experts work together to improve the employee experience and support strategic decision-making. We value curiosity, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and the courage to challenge existing ways of working.
   

  

 Here, your expertise will help shape global People & Culture processes, improve data quality, strengthen analytics capabilities, and enable better workforce decisions that support Scania's journey toward a more sustainable future.
   

  

**Application**
 Your application should include a CV and any relevant certificates. We welcome all applicants and strive for diversity in our recruitment processes.
   

  

 Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-10-26. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.
   

  

 If you have questions or would like more information, please contact:
   

  

 Anna Choynowska, TA Specialist, anna.choynowska@scania.com
   

  

 We look forward to your application!

title: Data Analyst/Scientist to Quality Information
description:
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions.
   

  

 Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.
   

  

**Role Summary**
**Join us in our mission to provide exceptional statistical support and drive the future of Scania's quality solutions.**
 Welcome to the Quality Information team within the SCANIA Brand Identity Development Field Quality organization!
   

  

 We're on a mission to provide top-notch statistical support for decision making process and analysis that describe the quality situation in the field. We gather data from various sources, including vehicle production, warranty information, fault codes, workshop work orders, and operational data. We visualize this information using Power BI and SAS VIYA. With one of our analysts moving to a new position within Scania, we're on the lookout for a new team member to join our dynamic and innovative group.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Build and modify Power BI reports, perform advanced analysis, and create data models related to our customer vehicles. This includes operational data, fault codes, failures, repair history, and software updates.
* Dive into the exciting world of machine learning to uncover new insights and benefits in our data.
* Work closely with a team of analysts and data engineers in Södertälje and Brazil, all striving towards the same goal – helping our customers make data-driven decisions.
* Actively participate in management team meetings and be responsible for yearly planning, coordination, and follow-ups.


**Who You Are**
 We're looking for someone who thrives in a transforming organization.
   

  

 You have a degree in engineering, computer science, or a similar field, and you possess excellent analytical skills. You enjoy helping others and have a knack for SQL coding and building reports in Power BI or SAS Viya. Experience in these platforms is a plus. As an analyst/data scientist in our team, you need to be cooperative with a strong customer focus, as you'll regularly interact with both the business side and Scania IT. You're curious about new technologies,have innovative mindset, and thrive in both team and individual settings.
   

  

 You are good at solving complex problems and curios about the automotive industry.
   

  

**Skills We Value** 
 :
   

  

  

* Statistical Analysis
* DAX Programming
* SQL Server & SSAS
* Building Reports in Power BI
* Python or R Programming


**This Is Us**
 Quality Information is a team within the SCANIA Brand Identity Development Field Quality organization that provides statistical support for decisions and analysis needed to describe the quality situation in the field. Our team is currently moving all our data to the cloud as part of Scania's "cloud first" strategy, using Azure and Snowflake. We collect data from various sources, including information about our produced vehicles, warranty information, fault codes, workshop work orders, and operational data. We visualize this information in Power BI or SAS VIYA.
   

  

 Our team consists of three analysts and three data engineers in Södertälje and two analysts in Brazil. Since one of our analysts has moved to another position within Scania, we are looking for their replacement. Join us and be part of a team that values creativity, collaboration, and a customer-centric approach. Together, we help our customers make data-driven decisions with a smile and big hearts!
   

  

**Scania Offers**
 We offer a dynamic, flexible workplace with hybrid work options, including Scania Sergel and Midway hubs. With a structured development plan and courses, Scania supports your career growth both locally and internationally.
   

  

 Benefits include training at our health center Gröndal or wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible hours, and company car leasing. Scania also hosts events for employees and their families, and Stockholm residents enjoy direct access to Södertälje via Scania Job express buses for an easy commute to Södertälje.
   

  

**Application**
 We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.
   

  

 Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-11-01. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.
   

  

 If you have questions or would like more information, please contact:
   

  

 Ivana Jankovic, Head of Quality Information, +46 855354165, ivana.jankovic@scania.com, or Jan Lindeborg, Senior Analyst, jan.lindeborg@scania.com or Malina Grunt, Talent Acquistion Specialist, malina.grunt@scania.com.
   

  

**We look forward to your application!**

title: Distribution Partner Account Manager – Nordics, Baltics & Eastern Europe
description:
Extreme Networks represents a tremendous career challenge and personal growth opportunity. We’re a company of strong market standing, with proven technological capability, differentiators and the growth mindset to overachieve goals.
   

  

 We also adamantly promote an internal culture that truly embraces diversity, inclusion and equality in the workplace. We’re proud to foster an environment where every Extreme employee can thrive because of their differences, not despite them.
   

  

 Extreme’s EMEA distribution team stands out as one that fosters success in all aspects, from over-achieving sales targets to providing a first-class team culture.
   

  

 We are recruiting for the role of Distribution Partner Account Manager (DPAM) responsible for our key Nordics, Baltics & Eastern Europe region. The DPAM is the ‘quarterback’ for the distributor (disti) relationship. Working closely with regional leaders plus other stakeholders, the DPAM ensures distributor activity aligns with the business priorities of the EMEA and global distribution team and to our Regional Directors’ (RD) objectives.
   

  

**The DPAM is fundamentally an experienced leader and influencer who…**
* Reports to the Senior Director, EMEA Distribution as part of a global distribution organization;
* Drives corporate sales revenue with deep focus on disti-led high potential resellers to ensure a pipeline of new and emerging VARs and MSPs;
* Maintains continuous sell-in focus to ensure disti inventory holding metrics are met;
* Aligns with stakeholders / business partners including iDPAM, regional RD, Channel Leaders, PAMs, Field Sales, Services/Support Team, SE teams, Disti Ops, Order Management Team, Finance, RevRec, Supply Chain and Legal team.


**The DPAM owns the C-Level relationship (and below) with all distributors in region and manages these core responsibilities:**
* Builds and executes a plan to maximize and measure disti performance, reflecting local plans where relevant
* Aligns to RD and Channel Leader to realize the reseller development potential of the region
* Manages a consistent set of KPIs
* Enables cloud capability into and through disti
* Leads contractual and other operational negotiations
* Leads inventory and stocking discussions to satisfy contractual / program minimums and other corporate objectives
* Manages the weekly bookings and POS forecast as well as stock rotation expectations
* Partners with distributor and Extreme channel marketing team to execute strategic marketing programs and activities
* Leads Quarterly Business Planning (QBP) with distributors and stakeholders
* Evaluates and enables disti partner program compliance, including competence
* Participates in setting quarterly Value Incentive Rebate (VIR) targets and attainment tracking
* Proactively manages MDF approvals and spend in alignment with the business and marketing plan
* Shares best practices and initiatives, covers colleague absences when appropriate and maintains continuity of business plan for own accounts with colleagues
* Leads a virtual team of iDPAM and other colleagues


**Necessary Skills Will Include**
* Degree level education and/or significant distribution management experience
* Relevant local language fluency as well as fluent English
* An optimistic, confident and enthusiastic attitude with a progressive and pragmatic approach to achieving goals
* Self-starter and team player
* An experienced background or strong solution selling skillset in transmitting advanced technology differentiators into the channel
* Able and willing to travel regularly across the region (some global travel) including some out-of-hours working
* Strong relationship-building, presentation, AI and problem-solving skills
* An influencer and leader


 OTE is on a 60/40 split and is based on qualifications and experience between 1.2 and 1.4 million SEK.
   

  

 Extreme Networks Benefits
   

  

 Fundamentally, the successful candidate will be someone who brings us something new, who embraces change, who is a great cultural fit, who leads virtual teams with passion and respect and who makes Extreme more relevant to our distributors whilst making our distributors more relevant to Extreme.
   

  

**Extreme Networks, Inc. (** 
**EXTR** 
**) creates effortless networking experiences that enable all of us to advance. We push the boundaries of technology leveraging the powers of machine learning, artificial intelligence, analytics, and automation. Over 50,000 customers globally trust our end-to-end, cloud-driven networking solutions and rely on our top-rated services and support to accelerate their digital transformation efforts and deliver progress like never before. For more information, visit Extreme's** 
**website** 
**or follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, and Facebook.**
 We encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. Come Advance with us! In keeping with our values, no employee or applicant will face discrimination/harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination/harassment based on “protected categories,” Extreme Networks also strives to prevent other, subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (e.g., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our organization. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at Extreme Networks.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Manager Systems Engineering, PU EW
description:

 Your role

title: Interim tech rekryterare
description:
**Om företaget** 




 Human Capital är ett rekryterings- och konsultbolag som hjälper organisationer att hitta rätt kompetens för såväl interimslösningar som långsiktiga rekryteringar. Genom ett kvalitativt och personligt arbetssätt matchar vi erfarna specialister och ledare med uppdrag där de kan skapa värde från första dagen.
 



  





 Vi söker nu en
 **Technical Recruiter / Talent Acquisition Consultant** 
 för ett internationellt och snabbväxande techbolags räkning.
 



  





 Bolaget verkar på en global marknad och präglas av höga ambitioner, korta beslutsvägar och en stark teknisk kultur. Organisationen består av medarbetare och ledare från flera länder, vilket skapar en dynamisk arbetsmiljö med många olika perspektiv. Nu söker man förstärkning till Talent Acquisition-teamet för att stötta verksamheten i ett flertal pågående rekryteringar av tekniska specialistroller.
 



  





**Rollen** 




 Som Technical Recruiter kommer du att spela en nyckelroll i bolagets fortsatta kompetensförsörjning. Fokus ligger på att driva rekryteringsprocesser för tekniska roller inom bland annat mjukvaruutveckling och engineering. Du kommer att arbeta nära rekryterande chefer och kandidater genom hela processen, från sourcing och urval till intervjuer och slutkandidat.
 



  





 Rollen kräver en person som trivs i ett högt tempo och som är van att självständigt driva flera parallella processer. Du kommer att vara en viktig partner till verksamheten och bidra med expertis inom search, kandidatbedömning och rekryteringsstrategi.
 



  





**Ansvarsområden** 



* Driva rekryteringsprocesser från behovsanalys till sista intervjusteg
* Arbeta proaktivt med search och sourcing av tekniska specialister i Sverige och övriga Europa
* Identifiera, attrahera och bedöma kandidater inom bland annat Android, iOS och backendutveckling
* Säkerställa en hög kvalitet i kandidat- och rekryteringsupplevelsen
* Samarbeta nära rekryterande chefer och andra nyckelintressenter
* Genomföra kvalificerade kandidatintervjuer och bedömningar
* Hantera och administrera rekryteringsprocesser i Greenhouse
* Bidra till effektiva arbetssätt inom Talent Acquisition-funktionen

title: Requirements Management Engineer
description:
Req ID:530317
   

  

 At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.
   

  

**Could you be the Requirements Management Engineer (RME) in Stockholm or Västerås we’re looking for?**
**Your future role**
 Take on a new challenge and apply your
 **Requirement Management** 
 expertise in a new cutting-edge field.
   

  

 The Nordic Technology Center of Alstom is an internal development and supplier organization for train onboard signaling; train control and communication system. The organization is global with sites in Sweden, Germany, Switzerland, France, and India. The team in Stockholm and Västerås is responsible for computers legacy control and communication products as well as new, input and output products, and human machine interface products. We are now investing in new products with increased performance, cyber security protection and increased functionality.
   

  

 As Requirements Management Engineer (RME) you shall be a key user for requirement tools , manage requirement structure and support multiple programs by providing guidelines, coaching and training team members for the management and writing requirements. You will collaborate daily with the Program Development Managers, System Architects and engineering teams.
   

  

**We will look to you for:**
* Implement Requirement Management processes for product development
* Administrate and be key user for Requirement Management tool
* Drive the engineers in their requirements development activities
* Verify the data quality & consistency in the Requirement Management database
* Manage the requirements changes & configuration
* Be the first line contact for Requirement Management queries


**All About You**
 We value passion and attitude over experience. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
   

  

* Master’s degree in engineering like System Engineering, Electronic Engineering or similar.
* Previous working experience (3-5 years) as requirement manager, requirement engineer (Doors and Doors NG).
* Previous working experience with DevOps (CI/CD)
* Previous working experience in international teams
* Previous working experience in configuration and change management.
* Experience in the development of embedded software and hardware.
* It would be highly appreciated if you have knowledge and or experience of industrial or railway safety standards (IEC61508/EN50128/EN60567/EN50129).
* Fluent in English. Swedish is an advantage.


**Things you’ll enjoy**
 Join us on a life-long transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:
   

  

* Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from boring daily routines.
* Work with newest train control systems
* Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
* Contribute to innovative projects
* Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
* Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning
* Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential


 You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!
   

  

**Important to note**
 As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

title: Office Manager & Corporate Services Coordinator
description:
**About The Opportunity**
 Job Type: Fixed Term Contractor
   

  

 Contract duration : 8 months.
   

  

 Application Deadline: 31 October 2026
   

  

**Title** 
 Office Manager & Corporate Services Coordinator
   

  

**Department** 
 Nordic Distribution Team
   

  

**Location** 
 Stockholm

 Head of Nordics & Benelux

 Assistant Manager
   

  

**Please note that this role is offered on a fixed-term contract until early August 2027 to cover a maternity leave.**
 We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our
 **Nordic Distribution** 
 team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
   

  

**About your team :**
 The Fidelity Nordic Distribution Team consists of seven professionals operating across the Nordic markets. The primary hub is located in Stockholm, where the Head of Nordics & Benelux is based alongside a Sales Manager, Sales Support Specialist, Marketing Manager, and Office Manager. A second hub in Copenhagen is home to two additional Sales Managers.
   

  

 The team is highly experienced, collaborative, and technically skilled, providing expert support and tailored investment solutions to some of the most sophisticated institutional and wholesale investors in the region. Their deep market knowledge and strong client focus enable them to effectively address the complex needs of the Nordic investment landscape.
   

  

**About your role :**
 The Office Manager & Corporate Services Coordinator is responsible for ensuring the efficient day-to-day operation of the Stockholm office while providing administrative, financial, facilities, and business support across the Nordic region. The role serves as a key liaison between employees, vendors, Corporate Services, IT, Finance, and external service providers, ensuring a safe, well-functioning, and professional office environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities :
   

  

 The role combines office management, financial administration, facilities coordination, IT liaison responsibilities, business support, and business continuity management.  Office Administration & Reception :

 Finance & Invoice Management :

 Expense Management :
   

  

* Administer employee expenses and reimbursements through Concur.
* Review, collect, and upload receipt documentation.
* Support expense reporting processes across the Nordic region.
* Ensure compliance with company expense policies.


 Corporate Services & Facilities Management :
   

  

* Serve as the local Corporate Services contact for Sweden and provide support across Denmark and Finland.
* Coordinate building maintenance, inspections, security measures, and office improvements.
* Manage relationships with landlords, contractors, and facility service providers.
* Coordinate technician visits and ensure permits and preparations are in place.
* Monitor workplace safety and ensure fire safety requirements are maintained.
* Receive and coordinate internal deliveries and office logistics.


 IT Coordination :
   

  

* Act as the primary liaison between the office and IT departments.
* Support office technology upgrades and infrastructure changes.
* Coordinate and assist with technical installations and troubleshooting.
* Provide local support during office technology projects, including activities outside normal business hours when required.


 Sales & Marketing Support :
   

  

* Assist with meeting planning, agendas, transportation bookings, and visitor arrangements.
* Coordinate catering and hospitality services for client meetings and office events.
* Support internal and external marketing events.
* Assist with administrative and financial activities related to marketing initiatives


 Business Continuity & Compliance :
   

  

* Maintain and update the Business Continuity Plan (BCP).
* Support annual reporting requirements and internal sustainability or consumption reporting.
* Ensure office operations comply with company policies and regulatory requirements.
* Support health, safety, and operational risk management activities


**About you :**
* Strong organizational and administrative skills.
* Experience with invoice processing, purchase orders, and expense management.
* Excellent stakeholder management and vendor coordination abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently.
* Strong communication skills and service-oriented mindset.
* Fluent in both Swedish and English
* Experience working with Finance, Facilities, IT, and Corporate Services functions.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and financial systems such as Concur and Anaplan


**Feel rewarded :**
 For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com.

title: Account Executive
description:
Volumental is the foot scanning and fit technology company trusted by leading footwear retailers worldwide. We combine 3D scanning hardware with AI-powered sizing recommendations, in physical retail, on Shopify storefronts, and across enterprise e-commerce platforms, improving customer experience, shopper confidence and boosting sales. Our mission: make standard sizes obsolete.
   

  

 We are growing our commercial team and looking for a driven, curious Account Executive to own new business across
 **both in-store and e-commerce channels.**
**Where you'll fit in**
 You will own the full sales cycle, from outbound prospecting to close, across two complementary product lines: our physical foot scanner for retail environments and our e-commerce sizing widget for Shopify and enterprise online storefronts.
   

  

 You will report to and work closely with the CCO, proactively bring deal questions, set your own cadence, and be expected to self-correct. There is no dedicated sales manager in the team. If you thrive with autonomy and accountability, this is your environment.
   

  

**We're Excited About You Because...**
* You are curious to dive deep on the product you are selling.
* You are hands-on and collaborative with low prestige, willing to jump in where needed.
* You have sold across both physical retail and digital/e-commerce channels and are comfortable with the context-switching that requires.
* You have experience working with B2B sales and/or project management and are ready to take on $500K+ deal sizes for globally scalable products.
* You are willing to travel. We work with customers around the world and this role will require regular travel to attend customer meetings, fairs and conferences.
* You proactively follow industry developments and think about how they affect your accounts.


**What You'll Do**
* Build and own your outbound pipeline targeting footwear and sports apparel brands across physical retail and e-commerce.
* Run discovery-led sales conversations that adapt in real time, where you listen more than you pitch.
* Build business cases using scan data, conversion metrics, and account-specific insights to prove value.
* Conduct store visits, run scanner demos, and get hands-on with the product as a core part of your sales process.
* Track your pipeline with discipline in HubSpot and bring structured deal updates to the CCO.
* Stay close to the product roadmap and translate new features into commercial opportunities.
* Collaborate with Customer Success on handovers and expansion signals.


**We Are Looking For Someone Who**
* Has 3-6 years in a closing role, with demonstrated success in outbound/new logo hunting of enterprise customers.
* Has experience selling into retail, footwear, or e-commerce. You understand the buyer's world, pain points and needs.
* Has Shopify or SaaS e-commerce sales experience.
* Has strong discovery skills: you ask good questions, read the room, and adjust when a conversation shifts.
* Is comfortable building business cases with data, even when the data is incomplete.
* Is self-directed: you know when to push ahead, when to ask for input, and how to proactively manage your own energy and pipeline.
* Is comfortable using AI tools as a natural part of work - for research, prep, account planning, or whatever makes you sharper.


**Bonus - Not Required, But Nice To Have**
* Experience selling to footwear retailers or brands.
* Experience selling hardware bundled with software.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive base + commission structure
* Direct access to leadership and real input into commercial strategy
* A product with genuine proof points and a growing enterprise customer base
* Flexible, hybrid work (at least 3 days from the office)
* An AI-forward team that gives you the tools to work smarter
* Personal learning budget and access to coaching
* Opportunity to work with a great team of 20+ nationalities in our English-speaking office
* Occupational pension at ITP1 level
* Flexible Public Holidays Policy
* Options Program
* Parental pay top-up
* Wellness allowance


 This is a
 **full-time position** 
 based at our
 **Stockholm headquarters** 
 , reporting to our
 **Chief Commercial Officer** 
 . We welcome applicants from all backgrounds! If this role excites you but you don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply—we’d love to hear from you.

title: Real Assets Product Manager – Property Intel
description:
Your Team Responsibilities
   

  

 The Property Intel (PI) Product Manager will sit within MSCI's Real Assets Private Assets business, driving product and commercial innovation for the Property Intel platform across the EMEA region. PI delivers property-level market intelligence, valuation benchmarks, and collateral risk data to banks, insurers, public sector bodies, and real estate advisory firms, drawing on a combination of proprietary research, transaction data, and third-party and regulatory/public data sources. The role holder will be responsible for product strategy and development for PI, working closely with clients across the region to ensure the platform continues to meet the evolving needs of financial institutions managing real estate-secured lending and investment portfolios.
   

  

 Product Managers at MSCI are responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle of new products and enhancements to existing products. This includes market research and client interviews to ideate and prototype new initiatives, fleshing out detailed requirements and working with other teams on solutioning and estimation, participating in governance forums to determine prioritization and timing, monitoring the build process, quarterbacking go-to-market planning, and tracking product success with clients.
   

  

 Given the maturity of PI's core bank and public-sector client base, this role also carries particular emphasis on deepening and protecting incumbent relationships, and on adapting PI's commercial model as the underlying data and regulatory landscape in EMEA markets evolves. The role holder will additionally contribute to strategic business development projects and partnership evaluation for the business.
   

  

 Your Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Market analysis of EMEA property markets, financial institution client needs, and the competitive and regulatory landscape — including how shifts in public/regulatory data availability affect PI's differentiation and pricing.
* Product Lifecycle Management: identify new opportunities, service improvements, and cost reductions; contribute to pricing and profitability decisions, including approval of special pricing where necessary.
* Client engagement across EMEA — presenting new ideas to banks, public sector, and advisory clients in collaboration with the sales team, and refining the product based on client feedback.
* Account retention and growth — working proactively with the region's incumbent bank and institutional relationships to defend and grow revenue, identifying cross-sell and upsell opportunities within the existing client base.
* Develop new Property Intel capabilities in collaboration with research, including working with external providers and public/regulatory data sources to onboard new data and evolve existing datasets and indices.
* Build a business plan with a strategic marketing mindset — product, pricing, packaging, and competitive analysis — to defend PI's core franchise and capture attractive adjacent revenue across EMEA.
* Mapping out a plan for development of Property Intel products for different EMEA client segments (banks, insurers, public sector, advisory), working closely with Program Management, Engineering, Data Operations, and Research.
* Develop go-to-market plans for new products or features and prioritize their development.
* Product release & launch support, including coordinating changes to applications, standard data feeds, and Salesforce; testing new features; preparing pitchbooks and factsheets; drafting FAQs and supporting documentation for client-facing teams; and coordinating client communications.
* Working with EMEA sales to understand how the product is being received in the market and identify ways to improve commercial packaging, targeting, positioning, and product-market fit.


**Desired Experience**
 Your skills and experience that will help you excel
   

  

* Deep, commercial understanding of European (ideally Nordic or broader EMEA) commercial real estate markets, property valuation practices, and how real estate data is used in bank collateral and mortgage risk processes.
* Experience working with financial institution clients (banks, insurers, public sector bodies) — understanding of credit risk, loan book management, and the regulatory capital considerations tied to real estate collateral.
* Working knowledge of the EMEA real estate data ecosystem, including public and regulatory data sources (e.g., national land registries/cadastral bodies), and how shifts in data availability or licensing can reshape a data product's competitive moat.
* Deep institutional commercial and strategic business experience in the investment industry, with significant experience managing regional and cross-functional teams across EMEA.
* Proven track record of P&L management in Fintech, particularly in Investment & Capital Markets Technology, Financial Data, or real estate/mortgage technology.
* Exceptional track record of managing, building, developing, and growing sales, research, and product management into high-performing teams.
* Excellent balance of strategy and process/execution.
* Proven track record of sustained revenue and profitability growth — including in structurally maturing markets — as a dynamic and successful product management business leader.
* Experience delivering projects to clients from pitch to execution.
* Experience delivering against target sales and retention goals.
* Fluency in English required; proficiency in Swedish or another Nordic/European language is a strong plus given PI's core EMEA client base.


**Desired Qualifications**
* Balanced mindset between commercial revenue creation and technical skills, with an ambition to create revenue and profits.
* Creative and innovative in problem solving, the formulation of solutions, and overcoming obstacles.
* Great initiative and motivation, and a drive to learn new interpersonal and analytical skills.
* Strong understanding of the investment and lending processes of our clients, strong client relationships, and strategic mindset.
* Proven record of collaboration, building highly effective business and commercial teams, achieving high revenue growth and profitability.
* Strong communication and collaboration across different groups not reporting into the same function, and the ability to motivate people within a matrixed organization.
* Strong intellectual, commercial, persuasive, regional market vision and entrepreneurial ability.
* Ability to convey expertise across the organization and to clients.
* 15+ years of experience in strategic marketing, product, pricing, packaging, and competitive analysis in the relevant space.
* Excellent presentation and communication
* Strong analytical and quantitative
* Team player who enjoys hands-on contribution.


**About MSCI**
**What we offer you**
* Salary range: SEK 987,000–1,086,000.
* Transparent compensation schemes and comprehensive employee benefits, tailored to your location, ensuring your financial security, health, and overall wellbeing.
* Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.
* A culture of high performance and innovation where we experiment with new ideas and take responsibility for achieving results.
* A global network of talented colleagues, who inspire, support, and share their expertise to innovate and deliver for our clients.
* Global Orientation program to kickstart your journey, followed by access to our Learning@MSCI platform, AI Learning Center , LinkedIn Learning Pro and tailored learning opportunities for ongoing skills development.
* Multi-directional career paths that offer professional growth and development through new challenges, internal mobility and expanded roles.
* We actively nurture an environment that builds a sense of inclusion belonging and connection, including eight Employee Resource Groups. All Abilities, Asian Support Network, Black Leadership Network, Climate Action Network, Hola! MSCI, Pride & Allies, Women in Tech, and Women’s Leadership Forum.


 At MSCI we are passionate about what we do, and we are inspired by our vision – to power better decisions. You’ll be part of an industry-leading network of creative, curious, and entrepreneurial pioneers. This is a space where you can challenge yourself, set new standards and perform beyond expectations for yourself, our clients, and our industry.
   

  

 MSCI strengthens global markets by connecting participants across the financial ecosystem with a common language. Our research-based data, analytics and indexes, supported by advanced technology, set standards for global investors and help our clients understand risks and opportunities so they can make better decisions and unlock innovation. We serve asset managers and owners, private-market sponsors and investors, hedge funds, wealth managers, banks, insurers and corporates.
   

  

 MSCI Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. It is the policy of the firm to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, age, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability, marital and civil partnership/union status, pregnancy (including unlawful discrimination on the basis of a legally protected parental leave), veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. MSCI is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please email Disability.Assistance@msci.com and indicate the specifics of the assistance needed. Please note, this e-mail is intended only for individuals who are requesting a reasonable workplace accommodation; it is not intended for other inquiries.

 MSCI does not accept unsolicited CVs/Resumes. Please do not forward CVs/Resumes to any MSCI employee, location, or website. MSCI is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited CVs/Resumes.

title: Digital Marketing Specialist - 12 month contract
description:
**We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us!**
*As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. Our people and our values. We Arrive Curious, Focused and Together. Just as our entire brand is inspired by the North Star, the shining light leading travelers to their destinations since time began, our values guide us. They help us be at our best. For our customers. For the cities and communities we serve. For ourselves. As a global team, we are transforming urban mobility. Let’s grow better, together.*
**About The Role**
 We are looking for a hands-on
 **Digital Marketing Specialist** 
 to join our team for
 **a 12-month contract.** 
 In this role, you will bring deep, specialised expertise in mobile app acquisition to drive app downloads and in-app conversions across multiple international markets.
   

  

 You will own the end-to-end performance of our mobile acquisition campaigns, primarily across Google UAC and Apple Search Ads (ASA). You will also manage brand awareness initiatives on LinkedIn to engage specialised B2B audiences, run cross-channel structured tests, and leverage data and AI tools to optimise budgets and campaign impact.
   

  

 If you thrive in a fast-paced environment managing high-impact mobile campaigns and know how to turn complex data into actionable performance strategies, we want to hear from you.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Paid App Campaigns: Plan, run, and optimise multi-market paid acquisition campaigns focusing on app installs and in-app events across Google UAC and Apple Search Ads (accounting for core app volume), as well as Meta, TikTok, and direct/influencer deals..
* Brand Awareness: Execute targeted brand awareness campaigns on LinkedIn to reach specific B2P/B2G and stakeholder audiences..
* Day-to-Day Optimisation: Own campaign management across 5–10 active campaigns simultaneously, optimising bids, budgets, creative assets, and performance messaging..
* Prioritisation & Stakeholder Requests: Manage and prioritise incoming cross-functional campaign requests efficiently through structured workflows .
* Tracking & Attribution: Collaborate with analytics and technical teams on tracking accuracy, AppsFlyer setup, data attribution, standard naming conventions, and UTM parameters..
* Reporting & AI Insights: Deliver clear performance reporting and investment scenarios. Leverage analytical capabilities and modern AI reporting tools (e.g., Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT) to synthesise campaign data for leadership..
* Investment & Forecasting: Build investment and performance scenarios to support market expansion and budget allocation decisions..
* Creative Collaboration: Brief, review, and test creative copy and assets in partnership with internal design teams and external agencies..
* Market Intelligence: Monitor competitor activities and market shifts to inform testing frameworks and strategic budget adjustments..


**Requirements**
* Mobile App Expertise: Minimum of 3+ years of hands-on experience managing paid app acquisition campaigns specifically (Google UAC & Apple Search Ads). Note: General e-commerce or non-app consumer marketing experience alone will not be considered..
* Attribution & Analytics: Direct experience with Mobile Measurement Partners (MMP), preferably AppsFlyer, including attribution setup, event tracking, and data troubleshooting..
* Channel Mastery: Proven track record running B2B/brand awareness campaigns on LinkedIn alongside performance mobile channels..
* AI & Reporting Tools: Comfort utilising AI-assisted reporting tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) alongside traditional dashboards to analyse performance metrics..
* Multi-Market Management: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple regional markets and prioritise competing demands in a high-velocity environment..
* Language & Communication: Native-level fluency in English (C1/C2 spoken and written) .


**About Arrive**
 Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. Present in over 90 countries and 20,000 cities, the company helps people and decision-makers make smarter decisions about urban mobility and ease the experience of travel worldwide. Arrive delivers a unique combination of the core ingredients to make cities more livable: from smart payments and optimized car parks to data-driven traffic reduction and support for reinvestment in public transport and green space. It’s about more than function, it’s about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone. Travel is more than a journey, it’s how you Arrive.

So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Sana (now a part of Workday) is an AI lab building superintelligence for work. Our mission is to empower organizations to accomplish their goals faster by helping teams effortlessly access knowledge, automate repetitive work, and learn anything with the help of agentic AI. Trusted by pioneering global companies and serving over 1 million users worldwide, we are looking for pragmatic dreamers to join us in reshaping how humans harness knowledge.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Go-To-Market team brings our cutting-edge AI products to the global market. As a GTM Associate, you will serve as the crucial first touchpoint for stakeholders at leading global organizations. This is a highly strategic, individual contributor role focused on sourcing high-value deals and building a robust sales pipeline. You will work closely with our leadership team to navigate an unprecedented market, shape our go-to-market motion, identify emerging trends, and set the blueprint for scalable growth.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Drive Pipeline Generation: Act as the initial point of contact for prospective enterprise clients, executing lead generation, qualification, and high-value deal sourcing.
* Execute Market Strategy: Assess markets to identify emerging trends, strategic organizational needs, and opportunities where Sana’s AI solutions can add immediate value.
* Shape the GTM Motion: Collaborate with sales leadership to refine outreach blueprints, tools, and methodologies that enable global scaling.
* Build Relationships: Transform strategic insights into tangible results through relentless tactical execution and relationship-building with executive-level stakeholders.


**What We Offer**

* Accelerated Growth: Swift professional development supported by continuous feedback and direct mentorship from senior leaders.
* Global Collaboration: Work alongside exceptional teammates across 5+ countries from our highly collaborative and inspiring office spaces.

* 2+ years of professional experience in a commercial, sales, go-to-market, or business development role; or 2+ years of experience in management consulting.
* Demonstrated experience in pipeline generation, client outreach, or lead qualification.
* Professional proficiency in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills.


**Other Qualifications**
* Prior experience working in a high-growth B2B SaaS startup environment or at a top-tier management consulting firm (e.g., McKinsey, BCG, Bain).
* A Bachelor's degree or higher from a highly competitive or top-tier university.
* Proven ability to assess complex markets, identify key opportunities, and execute relentlessly to convert insights into revenue.
* A "first-principles" thinker with a strong bias for action, comfortable navigating ambiguous and fast-paced environments.
