* Pragmatic: you enjoy new technology but choose what best solves the current problem while limiting technical debt.
* Humble and grounded: you listen, collaborate, and keep the team's health in mind.
* Independent yet collaborative: you take initiative but thrive in teamwork.
* User-focused: the end user's experience is always your guiding star.


**Qualifications**
* Extensive experience in Java backend development (main requirement).
* Experience with Spring Boot and modern development practices.
* Solid understanding of Microservices and integrations.
* Professional proficiency in English.


**What We Offer**
* Impactful work: Your code directly powers secure identity services used by real customers worldwide.
* A pragmatic environment: We value smart choices over shiny tools. You'll use the most adapted technologies to solve problems, reduce complexity, and limit future technical debt.
* A healthy team culture: We believe in humility, collaboration, and keeping team well-being in balance with delivery goals.
* End-to-end responsibility: You'll see the whole lifecycle, from development through deployment to customer use.
* Growth into leadership: Over time, you'll have the opportunity to take on a bigger role in driving initiatives and supporting others in the team.

title: Information Technology Infrastructure Engineer
description:
* Vill du kombinera IT-infrastruktur med industri, teknik och verklig verksamhetsnytta?
* Vill du ha en central roll i att säkerställa och utveckla stabil, säker och modern IT/OT-infrastruktur för våra produktionsanläggningar i Norden?



  





 Saint-Gobain Digital & IT Nordic & Baltic söker en driven Industrial IT Infrastructure Specialist till vårt Onsite Industrial IT-team.
 



  





 Din primära fysiska arbetsplats är på Saint-Gobain Weber i Häggvik, och du ansvarar även för siterna Weber Riksten, Vingåker & Sala, Gyproc Bålsta samt Scanspac Glanshammar & Örebro med fokus på stabil, säker och verksamhetskritisk produktionssupport.
 



 Detta innebär inte daglig närvaro på samtliga platser, utan insatser vid behov och när uppgifter eller incidenter uppstår. Det kan även bli någon enstaka resa inom Norden.
 



  





**Din roll** 




 Du blir vår övergripande ansvarige för Industrial IT i en hands-on roll med drift, problemlösning och nyutveckling i en varierande och spännande teknisk miljö:
 



  




* LAN & Fabriksnätverk, servrar och virtualisering
* VMware och HP Aruba switchar
* Industriella arbetsstationer, IT/OT-utrustning och produktionskritiska applikationer som t.ex SCADA, MES, Metriks och etikettering
* Windows Server 2000 - 2022, AD, WSUS, klientmiljöer, Patchning och dokumentation
* Backup, t.ex CommVault/Cohesity
* Infrastruktur- och digitaliseringsprojekt, Industry 4.0 & 5.0
* 3rd line support och teknisk eskalering
* Leverantörssamarbete
* Vara länken mellan IT och automation/OT i samarbete med ITS Nordic
* SLA, KPI, Servicekoordinering av IT-Leveranser av interna och externa leverantörer
* Koordinera Cybersäkerhet och riskansvar i IT/OT miljön
* Incident & Problem-management och eskalering
* Mandat att fatta beslut vid verksamhetskritiska krissituationer



  





**Vem söker vi?** 



* Vi söker dig som har
 **erfarenhet av Industrial IT** 
 och en bred teknisk förståelse, där du är:
* Proaktiv, driven, hands-on och lösningsorienterad
* Bra på att bygga relationer samt vänlig
* Självgående och ansvarstagande teamplayer
* Teknisk nyfiken, lösnings- och utvecklingsorienterad
* Bra på att samarbeta med både IT, produktion och leverantörer
* Bra på teknisk
 **engelska & svenska** 
 i tal och skrift
* Körkort och egen bil
* Normalgod fysik då man kan behöva bära IT utrustning emellanåt



 Vi ser gärna att du har
 **3–5 års erfarenhet** 
 inom IT-drift/infrastruktur. Teknisk utbildning är meriterande, men rätt erfarenhet kan väga tyngre.
 



  





**Vad vi erbjuder** 




 Du kommer att bli en del av Saint-Gobain – en av världens ledande globala industrikoncerner med möjlighet att arbeta med kritisk IT-infrastruktur i verklig produktion, med fokus på digitalisering, innovation och hållbarhet.
 


* Möjlighet att arbeta med hållbarhet, digitalisering och framtidens industri.
* En internationell miljö med stora möjligheter till utveckling.
* God kompetens- och karriärutveckling inom en global organisation.
* Konkurrenskraftiga villkor, pension och försäkringar.
* En varierad roll med engagerade och kompetenta kollegor.



  





**Ansökan & Info** 




 Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så vänta vänligen inte med din ansökan som med fördel är på engelska.
 



 Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!
 



  





**Om Saint Gobain** 




 Vi är en global ledare inom hållbara byggmaterial och innovativa lösningar som bidrar till bättre livsmiljöer och en enklare vardag.
 



 Med över 360 års erfarenhet utvecklar, tillverkar och distribuerar vi högpresterande material som skapar ökad komfort, effektivitet och hållbarhet i byggnader och industrier världen över.
 



 Med fokus på innovation och hållbarhet arbetar våra över 168 000 medarbetare globalt för att forma framtidens byggande.
 



  





 Vår vision? Att göra världen till en bättre plats att leva på.

title: IT service Magaer M365
description:
Our client within the construction industry is looking for an experienced
 **IT Service Manager – Microsoft 365** 
 to join their Digital Workplace team. This assignment is a backfill for a key employee and offers the opportunity to take overall responsibility for the end-user-facing delivery, governance, and continuous development of Microsoft 365 application services.
   

  

 In this role, you will drive the strategic and operational management of M365 services, ensuring a secure, modern, and efficient digital workplace that supports business collaboration, communication, information management, and workflow automation.
   

  

**Start date:** 
 2026-11-06
   

  

**End date:** 
 2027-03-31 (extension possible)
   

  

**Location** 
 : Stockholm, 2-3 days/week at the office
   

  

**About the assignment:**
* Own and manage the end-user-facing delivery of Microsoft 365 application services.
* Govern, design, and continuously improve M365 services across the organization.
* Ensure governance frameworks, security controls, and service configurations are properly designed, implemented, and maintained.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into effective service solutions.
* Manage relationships with vendors, suppliers, support partners, and internal stakeholders to ensure high-quality service delivery.
* Develop and maintain service documentation, user guides, and operational procedures.
* Drive service improvements to achieve agreed SLA, KPI, and customer satisfaction targets.
* Support budgeting, service maintenance, and compliance with IT security and governance standards.
* Perform lifecycle management activities and continuously optimize the M365 environment.
* Maintain and develop an Evergreen Microsoft 365 environment, ensuring optimal adoption of new features and capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to increase business value through automation, digitization, and improved use of Microsoft technologies.
* Collaborate closely with IT teams, Service Desk, and business units within established governance frameworks.
* Lead and support change, incident, request, and problem management processes.


**Your Profile**
 Must-Have Skills
   

  

* Proven experience managing and developing Microsoft 365 services in complex enterprise environments.
* Strong understanding of Microsoft 365 architecture and its integration with IT infrastructure, identity management, and security.
* Experience with service lifecycle management, governance, and continuous service improvement.
* Solid experience working with ITSM processes, including Change, Incident, Request, and Problem Management.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to bridge business, IT, and external vendors.
* Experience translating business requirements into effective service solutions.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Fluent in both Swedish and English, written and spoken.
* Structured and organized approach with experience working in agile environments.
* Ability to plan, coordinate, communicate, and execute initiatives from concept through delivery.


 Personal Qualities
   

  

* Results-driven and proactive mindset.
* Passion for creating business value through technology.
* Strong team player with excellent self-leadership and collaboration skills.
* High level of personal effectiveness and accountability.
* Genuine interest in maximizing the potential of the Microsoft 365 ecosystem and how its services work together.


 Nice-to-Have Skills
   

  

* Knowledge of Microsoft Graph API
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID
* Experience driving automation and digital transformation initiatives within large organizations.

title: Cyber Security Officer
description:
**Vill du vara med och skydda kritisk infrastruktur i ett av världens ledande teknikföretag?**
*Cybersäkerhet har aldrig varit viktigare. Digitalisering, ökad uppkoppling och en alltmer komplex hotbild gör att säkerhet är en förutsättning för att lyckas, både som verksamhet och som samhälle. Nu söker vi en Cyber Security Officer som kommer att spela en central roll i att vidareutveckla och stärka cybersäkerheten inom Siemens AB.*
**Om rollen**
 I den här rollen får du möjlighet att göra verklig skillnad genom att:
   

  

* Vara företagets främsta rådgivare inom cybersäkerhet och en viktig sparringpartner för ledningen, våra affärsområden och specialistfunktioner.
* Omsätta globala och nordiska säkerhetskrav, planer och åtgärder till praktiskt genomförande i Sverige.
* Identifiera och hantera risker, koordinera säkerhetsincidenter, följa upp sårbarheter och bidra till kontinuerlig förbättring av säkerhetsarbetet.
* Bygga en stark säkerhetskultur samt stötta chefer och medarbetare genom rådgivning, utbildning och kompetensutveckling.
* Definiera och vidareutveckla lokala processer så att de möter verksamhetens behov och säkerställa att organisationen har rätt verktyg och arbetssätt.
* Säkerställa att Siemens Sverige efterlever relevanta lagar, kundkrav och interna krav inom cybersäkerhet, inklusive arbete kopplat till ISO 27001.
* Bidra till att säkerhet blir en naturlig del av de produkter, lösningar och tjänster som vi levererar till våra kunder.
* Samarbeta nära med kollegor i Sverige, Norden och internationellt samt dela kunskap och välfungerande arbetssätt över landsgränserna.


**Vi tror att du**
* Har gedigen erfarenhet inom cybersäkerhet, gärna i en roll som CISO, CSO eller motsvarande.
* Har arbetat nära både ledning och verksamhet och har erfarenhet av att etablera och vidareutveckla säkerhetsstrategier, styrningsprocesser och riskhantering i komplexa organisationer.
* Har förmåga att omsätta strategier och rekommendationer inom cybersäkerhet till konkreta och praktiska åtgärder.
* Trivs med att ta egna initiativ, skapa framdrift och involvera rätt intressenter.
* Är relationsskapande och kommunikativ samt vill vara synlig i organisationen och bidra till att utveckla människor, processer och säkerhetskultur.
* Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska.
* Har erfarenhet av OT-säkerhet, kritisk infrastruktur, industriell säkerhet eller försvarsrelaterade miljöer. Detta är meriterande, men inget krav.


**Därför ska du välja oss**
 Hos oss får du:
   

  

* Flexibla arbetsformer med möjlighet till hybridarbete.
* Konkurrenskraftiga villkor och förmåner.
* Stora möjligheter till kompetensutveckling och karriärvägar i en internationell organisation.
* En inkluderande arbetsmiljö där olika perspektiv värdesätts.
* Chansen att arbeta med teknik och lösningar som gör skillnad inom bland annat industri, energi, byggnader och kritisk infrastruktur.
* Pension och trygghetspaket för framtiden.
* Försäkringar som kompletterar din anställning.
* Friskvårdsbidrag och stöd för hälsa och välmående.


**Ansök idag**
 Låter det som nästa steg i din karriär? Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig.
 **Skicka vänligen in din ansökan på engelska** 
 . Tjänsten kan komma att stängas tidigare om vi hittar rätt kandidat.
   

  

 Vid frågor om tjänsten kan du kontakta Kristian Herland: kristian.herland@siemens.com
   

  

 Vid frågor om rekryteringsprocessen kan du kontakta Ellen Ahlberg: ellen.ahlberg@siemens.com
   

  

 Facklig kontakt: Facket.se@siemens.com
   

  

**Placeringsort:** 
 Stockholm (Solna)
   

  

**Var med och forma framtiden tillsammans med oss**
 Vi välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund, erfarenheter och perspektiv. Vi är övertygade om att mångfald stärker vår verksamhet och bidrar till bättre lösningar. Hos oss ska alla känna sig inkluderade, respekterade och ha möjlighet att utvecklas.
   

  

 Vi arbetar aktivt för en säker, hållbar och hälsosam arbetsmiljö där människor, samhälle och miljö står i fokus.
   

  

**Bakgrundskontroller**
*Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomför vi bakgrundskontroller som kan inkludera referenstagning, kontroll via Damex, kreditupplysning samt i vissa fall utdrag ur belastningsregistret. Dessa kontroller görs i enlighet med gällande lagstiftning och är anpassade efter tjänstens krav. Syftet är att säkerställa en trygg och pålitlig arbetsmiljö samt att rekryteringen sker med hänsyn till tjänstens säkerhets- och ansvarsområden.*

title: Traineeprogram 2027 - Starta din karriär på Implema
description:
*Vill du kombinera teknik, människor och problemlösning i en roll där du får utvecklas snabbt?*
 På Implemas traineeprogram får du utbildning, certifiering, mentorskap och erfarenhet från verkliga kundprojekt samtidigt som du bygger grunden för en karriär som affärssystemskonsult. Sedan 2004 har traineeprogrammet varit en viktig del av vår kompetensutveckling, och många av våra konsulter och ledare började sin resa som trainees hos oss. Nu söker vi nästa generations konsulter till vårt traineeprogram med start i augusti 2027.
   

  

 På Implema hjälper vi företag att skapa effektiva processer och få ut mer värde av sina digitala lösningar. Genom rådgivning, affärssystem och integrationer stöttar vi några av Nordens mest välkända företag i deras förändrings- och digitaliseringsresor.
   

  

**Därför ska du välja Implemas traineeprogram**
 Hos oss får du mer än ett jobb. Du får en tydlig utvecklingsresa.
   

  

 Från första dagen blir du en del av ett team och ett affärsområde där du arbetar nära både kollegor och kunder. Under programmet får du stöd av en mentor som hjälper dig att utvecklas både professionellt och personligt.
   

  

 Genom en kombination av utbildning, certifieringar, mentorskap och praktiskt arbete i kundprojekt får du de bästa förutsättningarna att växa in i konsultrollen.
   

  

*"Traineeprogrammet blev den perfekta bryggan mellan studierna och arbetslivet. Jag fick lära mig av erfarna kollegor, utvecklas i min egen takt och bygga min kompetens steg för steg tillsammans med andra trainees."*
**– Alice, trainee 2026**
*"Det som överraskat mig mest är hur snabbt man får förtroende och ansvar. Samtidigt finns det alltid kollegor som stöttar och hjälper till när det behövs. Det märks verkligen att traineeprogrammet är en viktig satsning för Implema."*
**– Jakob, trainee 2026**
**Inriktningar hos oss**
 I traineeprogrammet 2027 erbjuder vi traineeplatser inom tre specialistområden:
   

  

**SAP-konsult**
 Som SAP-konsult hjälper du företag att utveckla och effektivisera sina affärsprocesser med hjälp av världens ledande affärssystem, SAP. Du utbildas inom SAP och får möjlighet att fördjupa dig inom området Supply Chain vilket innefattar inköp, lager, försäljning, produktion. Tillsammans med erfarna kollegor arbetar du i kundprojekt där du hjälper kunder att skapa effektiva processer och smarta lösningar.
   

  

 Passar dig som är intresserad av verksamhet, processer och digital utveckling.
   

  

**Business Transformation konsult**
 Som konsult inom Business Transformation hjälper du företag att utvecklas och navigera i förändring. Du arbetar med verksamhetsutveckling, förändringsledning, processutveckling och digital transformation. Tillsammans med erfarna kollegor får du stötta kunder i att omsätta strategier till konkreta resultat.
   

  

 Passar dig som är analytisk, kommunikativ och nyfiken på hur verksamheter fungerar och vill arbeta som projektledare, testledare eller förändringsledare.
   

  

**Integrationskonsult**
 Som integrationskonsult hjälper du företag att få sina system att fungera sömlöst tillsammans. Du arbetar bland annat med hur information och data flödar mellan olika system och applikationer. Du arbetar med moderna integrationslösningar och smarta informationsflöden som skapar värde för verksamheten. Rollen kombinerar teknik, problemlösning och samarbete med både kunder och kollegor.
   

  

 Passar dig som är nyfiken på verksamheter, teknik och att hitta smarta lösningar på komplexa utmaningar.
   

  

**Vi söker dig som**
* Tar examen från universitet eller högskola senast i juni 2027
* Studerar exempelvis civilingenjörsprogram, industriell ekonomi, systemvetenskap, datavetenskap, ekonomi eller motsvarande
* Är nyfiken på affärssystem, digitalisering och hur teknik kan stödja verksamheter
* Talar och skriver svenska och engelska obehindrat


 Tidigare erfarenhet av affärssystem är meriterande men inget krav. Det viktigaste för oss är din personlighet, ditt driv och din vilja att utvecklas.
   

  

**För att trivas hos oss tror vi att du**
* Gillar att samarbeta och skapa resultat tillsammans med andra
* Är kommunikativ och nyfiken på hur digitala lösningar kan skapa värde för verksamheter
* Lockas av konsultrollen och möjligheten att arbeta nära kunder
* Tar initiativ och är prestigelös


**En kultur där du får växa**
 På Implema tror vi på "laget före jaget." Vi hjälper varandra att lyckas, delar med oss av vår kunskap och har en kultur där det är lika självklart att stötta en kollega som att ta ansvar för sina egna uppgifter. Vi vill att du ska våga testa nytt, utvecklas och hitta din egen väg framåt. Vi värnar om gemenskapen och har roligt tillsammans genom allt från traineeaktiviteter, kickoffer, AW:s och kundevents.
   

  

**Våra Värderingar Genomsyrar Allt Vi Gör**
**Tillsammans. Förtroende. Mod. Glädje.**
**Praktisk information**
 Start: Augusti 2027
   

  

 Placering: Stockholm, Linköping, Malmö och Sundsvall
   

  

 Sista ansökningsdag: 6 december 2026
   

  

 Hybrid arbetsplats: Hos oss arbetar du både hemifrån, från något av våra kontor och ute hos kund. Vi tror på flexibilitet och värdesätter samtidigt vikten av att ses och lära av varandra.
   

  

*Implema är en av Sveriges ledande specialister på SAP och Microsoft Dynamics. Med över 20 års erfarenhet och 300 medarbetare på 8 orter runtom i Sverige hjälper vi företag att digitalisera och optimera sina affärsprocesser.*

title: Technical Account Manager - Stockholm
description:
**About Us**
 Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
   

  

 Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
   

  

 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 **$200M+ in ARR** 
 , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.
   

  

 We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
   

  

 Joining Legora means three things.
   

  

* We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


 Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
   

  

 If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
   

  

 This is the most senior seat on the advisory ladder and the person our largest clients trust when it matters most. In legal AI, that trust is hard-won: matters run to fixed dates, data is privileged, and clients hold Legora to the same standard of care they apply to their own work. Part technical advisor, part incident lead, part operating model owner, you hold the technical health of Legora's most complex client relationships and define the playbook the whole function runs on.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* Own the relationship: Hold the technical health and escalation outcomes for our Strategic Accounts, serving as their primary point of escalation and continuity, and read usage and adoption signals to get ahead of risk.
* Lead in a crisis: Act as incident lead on Sev1 and Sev2 events, owning coordination, customer communication, and the path to resolution. Drive post-incident reviews as trust-building artifacts and product feedback loops, not just process checkboxes.
* Set the standard: Define and own the escalation criteria, account-health model, and cross-team interfaces the function runs on. Build mechanisms that make the team consistent and not dependent on individual heroics.
* Own the Technical Blueprint: Maintain the single source of truth for each account, including data setup, integrations, security and legal considerations, and workflow context. Carry technical context from implementation into the live relationship so nothing is lost in the handoff and the whole account team can rely on it.
* Drive adoption and enablement: Run technical reviews and enablement sessions that deepen product usage, unlock new value, and keep customers current on the platform.
* Partner proactively: Work with Engagement Managers (CSM function) on Quarterly Business Reviews that tie technical health to business outcomes.
* Coordinate escalations: Align the Platform Consultants and the Technical Platform Expert around a single resolution path, holding customer-facing ownership while technical root cause is driven in parallel.
* Stay close to the signal: Own the highest-stakes cases in the L2 queue for your assigned Strategic Accounts, and serve as the escalation point for Platform Consultants before an issue reaches the Technical Platform Expert, so you stay close to the ground truth of each account's technical health.


 What you bring
   

  

* You have owned strategic, high-value B2B accounts and kept clients confident when things went wrong.
* You have led incident response or major escalations under pressure, start to finish.
* You communicate with executives as clearly as with engineers: confirmed facts, explicit trade-offs, named owners, and no speculation presented as certainty.
* You build frameworks, not workarounds, and you raise the bar for everyone around you.
* A background in legal AI, legal tech, or a regulated professional-services domain is a strong plus.


 What’s in it for you
   

  

* Global collaboration: Partner with teams and clients across regions, on work that crosses every major legal market.
* Meaningful work: Your work shapes how the world’s leading legal teams adopt AI day to day.
* Competitive package: Comprehensive salary, benefits, and the tools to do your best work.
* In-person environment: A workspace built for ambitious builders.


**Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
 At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Head of Service & Journey
description:
**Looking for a workplace for the future?**
 At Telenor, you own your career. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to make the most of your dreams and expertise while contributing to technological innovations that are barely even imagined today. Innovations that we know will change the map for how we communicate and live our connected lives in the future.
   

  

 Are you ready to lead and shape the future of IT in a fast-evolving telecom landscape? We are looking for a
 **Head of Service & Journey** 
 to lead the development of capabilities supporting B2C customer management, customer communications, service orchestration and customer service capabilities across Telenor's customer lifecycle.
   

  

 You will guide highly skilled engineering teams operating in a complex integration landscape, balancing business needs, technical evolution and long-term modernization.
   

  

**How You’ll Make a Difference With Us**
 As Head of Service & Journey, you will lead two highly specialized engineering teams working at the heart of Telenor’s customer journey and service landscape. Your teams own capabilities such as customer management, customer communications, service orchestration and customer journey management — all central to how we interact with and serve our customers across channels and journeys.
   

  

 You will play a key role in ensuring that these capabilities and integrations are scalable, resilient and continuously evolving. Together with engineers, architects and business stakeholders, you will drive modernization, strengthen engineering excellence and turn technological opportunities into tangible value for customers and the business.
   

  

 With a team of approximately 25 colleagues and consultants, you will also ensure the right capability mix and an effective organization that can support both current priorities and future business needs.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
* Strategic Leadership: Align and execute the roadmap for the Service & Journey domain, balancing business priorities with long-term technology modernization and capability development.
* Team Management & Growth: Lead, develop and inspire highly skilled engineering teams, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, innovation and continuous learning.
* Operational Excellence: Ensure stable, resilient and secure platforms while continuously improving operational performance, engineering efficiency and customer outcomes.
* Engineering Excellence & Innovation: Strengthen engineering excellence through modern development practices, automation, AI-assisted ways of working, continuous improvement and technical modernization.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner closely with business stakeholders, architects, and technology teams to align business priorities, architectural direction and technical execution.


**Are you the one we’re looking for?**
 You are a curious and confident leader who creates direction, engagement and ownership. You thrive in a rapidly changing environment and have a genuine desire to keep learning and developing, both personally and together with your teams. You lead through trust and clarity, build strong relationships across teams and stakeholders, and make complex topics understandable and actionable.
   

  

 You combine strategic thinking with pragmatic execution and have the courage to challenge established ways of working when it creates value. With a genuine curiosity for technology, you are comfortable engaging in discussions on areas such as architecture, engineering excellence and AI. You ask the right questions and help your teams navigate complex technical choices with clarity and confidence.
   

  

 We believe you bring
   

  

* Experience in IT delivery in complex technology environments, with the ability and motivation to lead and develop highly skilled engineering teams.
* Strong technical foundation, ideally gained through experience in architecture, software engineering or other senior technical roles, with the ability to engage confidently in discussions on modern software development, architecture, integration landscapes and engineering excellence — without needing to be the architect yourself.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to bridge business, architecture and engineering perspectives.
* Experience driving modernization, change or continuous improvement, balancing long-term capability building with immediate business needs.
* A practical understanding of how AI, automation and emerging technologies can create value for teams, customers and the business.

title: Data Centre Installer - Gavle
description:
**ATC** is a global logistics, white-glove, and technical services specialist for data centers. For over 45 years, we've helped deliver Europe's data centers safely, securely, and right the first time. Our work includes specialist IT transport and relocations, as well as full data center commissioning and decommissioning.  

  

As part of the **Arvato Group**, we benefit from the strength, scale, and global expertise of one of the world's leading supply chain and technology partners. What truly sets us apart, however, is our people. We invest in training, development, and continuous improvement, and we take pride in building long-term relationships with our clients and teams across Europe.


Role**Job Title: Data Centre Installer**


ATC’s **Data Centre Installers (DCIs)** provide an essential service to our clients across Europe. They work inside our clients’ data centres delivering, positioning, and installing server racks to build their cloud infrastructure. This role is suitable for someone with prior experience in a data centre, warehouse, logistics or construction environment. Safety, security and customer service are the priorities for all ATC employees.


The DCI role provides candidates with opportunities to learn and develop. There are pathways to delivery supervisor, cabling technician, or team leader, and training and mentorship are provided. Candidates can also travel with work as part of ATC’s Mobilisation Team.

**Open positions: 2**

**Responsibilities:**

* Attend clients’ sites on time, with all required equipment, uniform, procedures and documentation, and PPE.
* Unloading, unpacking with power tools and positioning customers’ IT hardware (server racks).
* Lifting up to 30-40 kg is required, with occasional exertion up to 50 kg (using safe lifting methods).
* Cabling server racks by patching and dressing fibre and copper cables (in certain regions, and training will be provided).
* Providing industry-leading customer service levels by acting professionally with clients and colleagues at all times.
* Following clients’ procedures and requirements, including health and safety, and security.
* Communicating with colleagues, including managers, planners, team leaders and supervisors, in a consistent, timely, and efficient manner. Reports include arrival times, delays, safety concerns, and completion times.
* Completing daily checklists and providing reports on daily activities or tasks, including other general administration tasks.
* Any other duties that may be assigned from time to time in line with your skills and competencies.

  

**Requirements**  

* Strong organisational and problem-solving skills, with high levels of attention to detail.
* Strong physical stamina and the ability to perform tasks, involving lifting, carrying, and moving objects.
* **Valid class B driving licence** with a good driving record.
* Basic experience with hand and power tools.
* Experience with Microsoft Word, Excel, Teams and Email.
* Language proficiency: at least C1 level in English and B2 level in the country of employment.


The following qualifications, skills and experience would be an advantage:

* Prior experience in a data centre, logistics or construction environment.
* Ability to be flexible and travel for work.
* Ability to complete checklists in Excel (or Teams) based on daily activities.
* Prior experience with the installation of structured cabling, including fibre and copper.

**Note:** **Candidates are required to have the right to work in the EU/EEA. ATC is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role. Please submit your updated resume/CV in English.**

 **Benefits**  

* Performance-based bonus
* AIG Virtual care programme
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Company pension plan (depending on location)
* Opportunities for continuing professional development

title: Thesis - A Time Decaying Confidence Score for Micro-Testing
description:
**Job Title**
-------------

Thesis - A Time Decaying Confidence Score for Micro-Testing
**Job Description**
-------------------


**Category**

Computer Science; Software Testing and Quality Assurance, Software Engineering, Test Automation

  

  

**Scope**

Bachelor Thesis 22,5 hp or Master Thesis 30 hp


2 students completing 22,5 credits each or 2 master student completing 30 credits each.

  

  

**Background**

Modern cloud-based software systems are composed of multiple services, APIs, and supporting infrastructure. In such systems, a change to one service can unintentionally affect user-facing functionality implemented across several components. Automated unit and integration tests can detect many defects, but they do not always provide a clear, feature-level view of whether a complete user workflow remains reliable.

  

  

This project investigates an approach for improving regression detection in a multi-service software system. The approach decomposes selected user-facing workflows into smaller actions, such as creating, updating, importing, or removing records. Each action is tested independently, and the results are combined into confidence scores for sub-features and then complete features.

  

  

The investigation is motivated by the potential to reduce reliance on repetitive manual acceptance testing while preserving confidence that important workflows continue to function correctly. However, the approach also introduces challenges related to test fragmentation, test-maintenance effort, score calibration, and the risk that an aggregated score may give a misleading impression of system health.

  

  

**Goal**

The goal is to design and implement a proof-of-concept for continuous confidence scoring of selected userfacing software features.

  

  

The prototype will:


* Identify representative workflows supported by the system.
* Divide each workflow into independently testable user actions.
* Execute automated tests through appropriate application or service interfaces.
* Record test outcomes, execution history, and detected failures.
* Calculate confidence scores for individual actions.
* Aggregate action scores into sub-feature and feature-level scores.
* Reduce scores over a defined period when tests are not executed.
* Report the results through logs, summaries, or a simple dashboard.
* Provide sufficient history to evaluate score changes over time.
  

  

The prototype will be evaluated according to:


1) Defect detection capability: whether the tests identify introduced regressions.


2) Confidence-score reliability: whether the scores correspond meaningfully to the actual health of the tested workflows.


3) Testing efficiency: whether the approach can reduce the time required for manual acceptance testing.


4) Maintenance effort: whether the number and granularity of tests remain manageable as the system evolves.

  

  

**Who are you?**

For this thesis proposal, we target students with a strong interest in software engineering, automated testing, and software quality assurance. You are most likely studying a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

  

  

**OK, I am interested! What do I do now?**  

You are valuable to us – how nice that you are interested in one of our proposals! There are a few things for you to keep in mind when applying.


* Applications are accepted in both Swedish and English, and you apply via the proposal advert.
* The announced thesis is open only to students affiliated with a Swedish University/College either directly or via an exchange program.
* When the thesis proposal states that it includes two students working together, we would like you to apply in pairs. In these cases, send one application each but make sure to clearly state in your application who your co-applicant is. If you have any questions regarding this, please do not hesitate to contact us.
* Please attach your CV and University/College grade summary.

description:
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions.
  

  

Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.


**Role Summary**
----------------

  

**Join us in our mission to provide exceptional statistical support and drive the future of Scania's quality solutions.**


Welcome to the Quality Information team within the SCANIA Brand Identity Development Field Quality organization!
  

We're on a mission to provide top-notch statistical support for decision making process and analysis that describe the quality situation in the field. We gather data from various sources, including vehicle production, warranty information, fault codes, workshop work orders, and operational data. We visualize this information using Power BI and SAS VIYA. With one of our analysts moving to a new position within Scania, we're on the lookout for a new team member to join our dynamic and innovative group.


**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------


* Build and modify Power BI reports, perform advanced analysis, and create data models related to our customer vehicles. This includes operational data, fault codes, failures, repair history, and software updates.
* Dive into the exciting world of machine learning to uncover new insights and benefits in our data.
* Work closely with a team of analysts and data engineers in Södertälje and Brazil, all striving towards the same goal – helping our customers make data-driven decisions.
* Actively participate in management team meetings and be responsible for yearly planning, coordination, and follow-ups.
**Who You Are**
---------------

  

We're looking for someone who thrives in a transforming organization.

  

  

You have a degree in engineering, computer science, or a similar field, and you possess excellent analytical skills. You enjoy helping others and have a knack for SQL coding and building reports in Power BI or SAS Viya. Experience in these platforms is a plus. As an analyst/data scientist in our team, you need to be cooperative with a strong customer focus, as you'll regularly interact with both the business side and Scania IT. You're curious about new technologies,have innovative mindset, and thrive in both team and individual settings.

  

  

You are good at solving complex problems and curios about the automotive industry.

  

**Skills We Value**:


* Statistical Analysis
* DAX Programming
* SQL Server & SSAS
* Building Reports in Power BI
* Python or R Programming
**This Is Us**
--------------


Quality Information is a team within the SCANIA Brand Identity Development Field Quality organization that provides statistical support for decisions and analysis needed to describe the quality situation in the field. Our team is currently moving all our data to the cloud as part of Scania's "cloud first" strategy, using Azure and Snowflake. We collect data from various sources, including information about our produced vehicles, warranty information, fault codes, workshop work orders, and operational data. We visualize this information in Power BI or SAS VIYA.

  

Our team consists of three analysts and three data engineers in Södertälje and two analysts in Brazil. Since one of our analysts has moved to another position within Scania, we are looking for their replacement. Join us and be part of a team that values creativity, collaboration, and a customer-centric approach. Together, we help our customers make data-driven decisions with a smile and big hearts!


**Scania Offers**
-----------------

We offer a dynamic, flexible workplace with hybrid work options, including Scania Sergel and Midway hubs. With a structured development plan and courses, Scania supports your career growth both locally and internationally.
  

  

Benefits include training at our health center Gröndal or wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible hours, and company car leasing. Scania also hosts events for employees and their families, and Stockholm residents enjoy direct access to Södertälje via Scania Job express buses for an easy commute to Södertälje.

title: Databasutvecklare till bolag i försvarsindustrin
description:
Vill du arbeta med databaser i ett uppdrag där din problemlösningsförmåga gör verklig skillnad? Vi söker nu en databasutvecklare till vår kund i Lund, där du får kliva in i ett omfattande och tekniskt komplext migreringsprojekt inom försvarsindustrin. Rollen passar dig som gillar att ta ägarskap, ställa frågor och hitta lösningar även när alla svar inte finns dokumenterade från början. Välkommen med din ansökan!
  
  

**OM TJÄNSTEN:** I rollen driver du den logiska datamigreringen för teknisk information kopplad till ett större fartygsprojekt, som ritningar, PDF och teknisk dokumentation och annan teknisk dokumentation som ska föras över från ett äldre Oracle-baserat PLM-system till Windchill.. Det handlar inte enbart om att flytta data, en stor del av arbetet består av att undersöka hur informationen är uppbyggd, förstå datarelationer och säkerställa att rätt information migreras på rätt sätt. Dokumentationen i det befintliga systemet är begränsad, vilket gör att rollen passar dig som trivs med detektivarbete och gillar att lösa komplexa problem på ett smidigt och strukturerat sätt. Du driver arbetet självständigt, men har stöd av en befintlig utvecklare och användare i verksamheten.
  
  

För att lyckas behöver du ta egna initiativ, aktivt söka upp information och ställa rätt frågor för att förstå både systemen och hur informationen används. Du blir en del av ett team i Lund med cirka 25 personer och bred kompetens inom utveckling, systemadministration, databaser och metodutveckling. I en Microsoftmiljö arbetar teamet både med att anpassa befintliga system efter verksamhetens behov och att utveckla nya verktyg från grunden. Framåt finns också fokus på modernisering, cloud, AI och datadrivna arbetssätt, vilket ger dig möjlighet att arbeta i en verksamhet under utveckling.
  
  

Uppdraget är initialt kopplat till ett projekt som planeras pågå i minst ett år. Vår kund befinner sig i en stark tillväxtfas, och därmed finns goda möjligheter till förlängning och en långsiktig fortsättning för dig som gör ett bra arbete. Du kommer bland annat att: Analysera databaser, datastrukturer och relationer i ett äldre Oracle-baserat PLM-system Undersöka hur teknisk information är uppbyggd och används i verksamheten Ta fram och implementera logik för migrering till Windchill Säkerställa att ritningar, PDF och annan dokumentation överförs korrekt Felsöka och lösa problem som uppstår under migreringen Samarbeta nära användare och verksamhet för att inhämta kunskap och verifiera information Driva arbetet självständigt, med stöd från en befintlig utvecklare i teamet VI SÖKER DIG SOM: Har god och praktisk förståelse för databaser, datastrukturer och dataanalys Har erfarenhet av system- eller datamigrering, alternativt av att tolka, strukturera och flytta komplex data mellan system Har god förmåga att kommunicera med både tekniska och verksamhetsnära personer Har mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift Erfarenhet av Oracle, Java, .NET eller Det är även meriterande om du har: Erfarenhet av PLM-system Erfarenhet av Windchill Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper. För att trivas i rollen är du nyfiken och har ett genuint intresse för att förstå hur både system och verksamhet fungerar.
  
  

Du är självgående, tar ansvar för att driva arbetet framåt och trivs med att själv söka information när alla svar inte finns dokumenterade. Du är analytisk och gillar att lösa komplexa problem. Samtidigt är du kommunikativ och har lätt för att samarbeta med både tekniska kollegor och verksamhetsnära användare. Du vågar ställa frågor, utmana invanda arbetssätt och är trygg i att ta dig an uppgifter där du behöver undersöka, reda ut och hitta rätt väg framåt.
  
  

**OM ANSTÄLLNINGEN:** Tjänsten är en konsultuppdrag där du kommer att vara anställd av Friday. Denna befattning kräver att du genomgår och blir godkänd enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där vår kund har krav på säkerhetsklassplacering kan det, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap. ÖVRIG INFO: Omfattning: Heltid, långsiktigt Start: Enligt överenskommelse Placering: Karlskrona Rekryteringsansvarig: Ellen Brobeck, Ellen.Brobeck@friday.se Lön: Marknadsmässig Ansök genom att klicka på länken nedan.
  
  

Kom ihåg att vara snabb med din ansökan då vi gör löpande urval av kandidater och att annonsen kan stängas ner innan tjänsten är tillsatt om vi har gått vidare till urvals- och intervjufasen. OM FRIDAY: På Friday brinner vi för att hjälpa dig att ta nästa steg i din karriär inom IT och teknik, oavsett om du söker ditt första jobb eller redan har några års erfarenhet. Genom att lyssna på vad just du vill och drivs av matchar vi dig med företag och möjligheter som får dig att se fram emot att gå till jobbet. Vi värderar ambition och potential högt och arbetar aktivt för en fördomsfri rekrytering, där alla ges samma chans att lyckas.
  
  

Vi finns i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Linköping och Örebro. Varje år genomför vi över 5 000 karriärmöten och matchar kandidater med allt från globala företag till innovativa startups.

title: Security Architect
description:
Enterprise clients in Sweden face a new set of security challenges as AI-enabled solutions and cloud platforms become central to their operations. The pressure to secure these environments is rising, especially as generative AI and advanced data integrations introduce new risks. In this Security Architect role in Göteborg, you work at the intersection of technology and governance, helping clients navigate the complexity of responsible AI adoption. You shape the security posture for platforms that must stand up to evolving threats and regulatory demands. The work matters because trusted, resilient platforms are the foundation for business growth and compliance.

**Responsibilities**

* Design and implement security controls for AI/ML and generative AI solutions, and assess risks across LLMs, AI APIs, model integrations and AI data pipelines
* Mitigate AI-specific threats such as prompt injection, data leakage, model poisoning, insecure output handling and unauthorised model access
* Shape target-state architectures for AI platforms, assistants, RAG systems, agents and AI gateways, and define governance frameworks for responsible AI, security and identity
* Run architecture reviews and sign-offs for AI solutions, and steer technical direction on emerging AI platforms
* Embed security into the secure development lifecycle and DevSecOps pipelines, and support compliance and cyber-risk management
* Establish and document security reference architectures, technology standards and best practices across the technology landscape
* Lead and coordinate architecture work across teams, represent security in projects, and support adherence to security policies and standards
* Advise senior management on security strategy, risks and benefits, and run training sessions and workshops for development teams
* Contribute to KPI, KRI and SLA reporting for the security programme

**Requirements**

* 7+ years in security architecture across enterprise applications, cloud platforms and AI-enabled solutions
* Background in AI/ML and generative AI security, including LLMs, AI APIs and AI data pipelines
* Securing applications on AWS and Microsoft Azure; experience integrating AI with Azure OpenAI and enterprise APIs is a good fit
* Proven skill in creating enterprise security reference architectures, frameworks and blueprints
* Knowledge of TOGAF and SABSA; degree in computer science, information security or a related field
* Delivery of enterprise-scale AI platforms in regulated environments, with experience of AI guardrails and responsible AI controls
* Track record of taking AI initiatives from proof of concept to enterprise-grade production

**Nice to have**

* Certifications such as CISSP or SABSA, or CCSP and cloud architect certifications (AWS/Azure/GCP)
* Experience in the tech, security or automotive industry
* Threat modelling and security risk management knowledge
* Familiarity with other AI ecosystems (AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Databricks, OpenAI API, Hugging Face)
* Secure engineering practices around GitHub Advanced Security and pull-request workflows

**We offer**

* EPAM Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
* Company’s pension plan
* Private healthcare insurance
* Safety & life insurance
* Gym discounts
* Wellness Grant (SEK 2000)
* Corporate Programs including Employee Referral Program with rewards
* Learning and development opportunities including in-house training and coaching, professional certifications, and courses

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
description:
**SOVOS**


**Senior Solutions Engineer**
=============================


Sales Engineering·Full-Time·Europe


**Build Your Future With Us**


The digitization of tax compliance is fundamentally changing global commerce and how businesses need to operate and grow. Governments now have real-time visibility into business data, creating new challenges and new opportunities for organizations around the world. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions.


We're solving more than today's tax compliance challenges. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to navigate increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive.


AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change.


Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here.
**THE ROLE**


At Sovos, we're building a dedicated sales team from the ground up to support our growing portfolio of AI-native offerings, spanning financial orchestration, compliance automation, and intelligent invoicing. You'll be one of the first technical sellers on this team, joining at the foundation as we define the playbook together. This isn't a support role that ends with a good demo. You'll own technical opportunities end-to-end, configuring the platform to a client's real environment and building the technical proof points your Account Executive partner uses to close.


*More specifically, you will:*


* Carry a quota tied to technical opportunity progression from discovery through close, owning the technical inputs (POC results, integration effort, system fit) that feed the ROI and TCO business case.
* Lead technical workshops and proofs of concept with clear success criteria, partnering with your AE to navigate objections, build urgency, and drive the opportunity to a decision.
* Configure the platform against a client's real data and workflows ahead of every demo, navigating model routing, APIs, integrations, data governance, and security with Engineering and IT.
* Translate technical solutions into ROI, TCO, and operational impact for Finance and executive stakeholders, moving seamlessly between architecture conversations and business-level discussions.
* Leverage AI tools to improve qualification, demo configuration, and business case development, staying engaged through kickoff and early delivery to maintain technical continuity with the Field Delivery Engineering team.
* Help shape the qualification criteria, demo approach, and business case format this team will use going forwards, bringing customer and market feedback back into how Sovos positions and packages its AI-native offerings.
**WHAT YOU BRING TO SOVOS**


* You've successfully led business process transformation or procurement optimization projects, ideally gained through consulting or working buyer-side, ideally with procurement or AP expertise gained from working buyer-side rather than solely in an advisory capacity.
* You have enough systems fluency to know where a client's data lives (SAP vs. Ariba vs. elsewhere) and how workflows cross systems; familiarity with AI gateways, model routing, or data governance is a strong plus.
* You bring direct quota-carrying or deal-closing ownership of the pre-sale cycle, not only demo or support experience, with a demonstrated ability to close complex B2B deals with clear revenue accountability, moving opportunities from technical discovery through contract signature and clear revenue accountability.
* You're comfortable moving between technical and executive conversations in the same day (sometimes the same meeting), building executive-level business cases that include ROI and TCO analyses.
* Comfort with AI-assisted workflows and automation or workflow platforms is important; experience selling AI infrastructure, applications, agents, workflow automation, or finance technology is preferred.
* Experience helping launch a new product or build an early go-to-market motion is preferred, as is experience at a consulting firm with a finance transformation or automation practice.
* Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire.
**THE PROCESS**


We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect:


**1**
**Pre-Employment Assessment**


Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot.


**2**
**Video Interview**


A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume.


**3**
**Meeting with a Recruiter**


A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals.


**4**
**Live Interviews with the Hiring Team**


Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day-to-day of the role.


**LIFE AT SOVOS**


The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!


* Global Mentoring Programs
* AI Tools and Technology from Day 1
* Continuous Learning and Development
* Language Learning Support
* Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs
* Global Parental Leave Policy
* An opportunity to work with a global team
* Bi-Weekly Meeting Free Days!
* Mentoring Programs
* Globally recognised Training and Development programmes
* Competitive benefits package
**Equal Opportunity Employer**  

Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, colour, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.


**Company Background**
----------------------


Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. Sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150+ countries.
More than 100,000 customers – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos’ tax and regulatory expertise and unparalleled integration with their business applications. Learn more at sovos.com.

title: Tactical Portfolio Manager
description:
**Help Shape the Future of Hybrid & Cloud Services at Telia Cygate**
--------------------------------------------------------------------

At Telia Cygate, we believe the best solutions are created when people with different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives come together. We are now looking for a **Tactical Portfolio Manager** to join our growing Hybrid & Cloud team and help shape the future offerings we bring to our customers.

  

  

My name is **Staffan Sundqvist** , and I lead the Hybrid & Cloud business area within Managed Services at Telia Cygate. Together with an experienced team of specialists, we develop services that help organizations navigate an increasingly complex IT landscape. If you are passionate about hybrid cloud, service innovation, and creating tangible business value, this could be your next career move.

  

  

  

**What you will do**
--------------------

As a Tactical Portfolio Manager, you will play a central role in developing and managing our Hybrid & Cloud portfolio. Working closely with Service Owners and other Portfolio Managers, you will ensure that our existing services continue to deliver value while identifying opportunities for further development and innovation.

  

  

This role combines strategic thinking, commercial insight, and cross-functional collaboration. You will have the opportunity to influence business direction and create real impact within one of today’s most important technology areas.

  

  

### **Your responsibilities will include:**

* Driving the continuous development and optimization of the Hybrid & Cloud portfolio.
* Maximizing the return on portfolio investments and, together with Service Owners, ensuring long-term profitability.
* Supporting sales teams and solution specialists by communicating portfolio strategy, customer value, and service differentiation.
* Participating in selected customer engagements and supporting strategic business opportunities.
* Building strong partnerships across sales, delivery, marketing, and product organizations.
* Monitoring and reporting on portfolio performance, trends, and outcomes.
* Collaborating with vendors and technology partners on market analysis, customer events, and go-to-market initiatives.
* Leading and qualifying new service development initiatives, including building business cases and securing stakeholder alignment.
* Partnering with procurement teams to evaluate and select new technologies.
* Contributing to the overall success and growth of the Hybrid & Cloud portfolio.

Strong technical understanding of the Android platform and debugging using Android Debug Bridge (ADB). Solid knowledge of test automation architecture and verification strategies. Understanding of Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), Software-in-the-Loop (SIL), and cloud-based testing frameworks. Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills. ⭐ Preferred Skills Experience with automotive software quality standards, including ISO 26262 and Automotive SPICE (ASPICE). Familiarity with Jenkins, Bitbucket, Gerrit, and Git. Experience with test management and requirements tools such as JIRA, SystemWeaver, SE Tool, and Confluence. Who Should Apply? We are looking for a technically hands-on product leader who can translate product objectives into an effective test automation strategy, guide engineering teams, and continuously improve software quality across complex automotive systems.

description:
Nordnet redefined the financial world as the first digital bank in Europe. Now we are about to do it again—this time by putting AI at the heart of our strategy. You'll embark on a challenging journey alongside skillful teams of sharp and committed colleagues.


We're searching for a Data Scientist to join Nordnet's AIR (AI & Research) function, working embedded within one of our cross-functional teams. Your mission: Bring the best possible AI capabilities to life as robust solutions, both internally and for our customers.

**The Setup**


You'll be working in a full-stack team with different competencies and together tackle the full lifecycle—from exploring possibilities to deploying production features. Our technical foundation is Google Cloud Platform, where we've deployed internal and customer facing GenAI features. Now we're scaling what works and developing new capabilities.


This is not a theoretical role; you're a builder and problem-solver who thrives on iteration. You'll report to our Data Science Manager while working daily with developers, analysts and designers.

**What You'll Do**


Build and maintain production AI pipelines from experimentation through deployment and monitoring.


Collaborate with engineers throughout the development cycle—you'll work together on architecture and implementation in an iterative fashion.


Drive quality through evaluation, metrics, and testing of AI solutions.


Champion AI Governance - Ensure compliance with the bank's regulatory framework by clarifying AI concepts and risks

**This is you**  

  

You take pride in your work and are driven by curiosity—you want to continuously learn and grow.

**You likely have:**

* Experience with LLMs, GenAI and agentic AI
* Python skills for both exploration and production code.
* SQL proficiency for data analysis and pipeline building.
* Knowledge of ML/AI evaluation, metrics, and best practices.
* Experience with ML/AI in cloud environments (GCP experience is a plus).

**We also get excited if you have:**

* Experience working embedded.
* Comfort presenting technical work to diverse audiences.
* Interest in finance, investing, or personal finance.


We think that you have 3+ years experience working as a Data Scientist, ML Engineer or AI Engineer with a University degree in data science, computer science, mathematics, engineering or similar field.

**We offer**

* Work in a product-focused environment with direct impact
* Growth opportunities as a data scientist in a fast-moving AI space
* Competitive salary and compensation


You'll work in a Nordic environment with high ambitions and a strong focus on delivery, product development, and technology.


Culture is built and cared for, each day by everyone. We're proud of ours. Having a flat organization where anyone can talk to anyone creates a warm and friendly atmosphere worth protecting. We believe in a culture where every effort counts and where everyone is recognized—a culture embracing our core values of passion, simplicity, and transparency on all levels, no matter who you are or what you do.


We are over 900 employees in Stockholm, Oslo, Helsinki, Copenhagen and Frankfurt.


Visit us on www.nordnetab.com, www.nordnet.se, www.nordnet.no, www.nordnet.dk and www.nordnet.fi.

title: OT Solution Sales Specialist
description:
We are looking for a **OT Solution Sales Specialist** to join us at Telia Cygate.

  

  

My name is Michael Mothander, Head of Cyber Security, and I’m looking for someone who wants to grow together with us. We are a supportive and forward‑looking team focused on helping customers secure and modernize critical infrastructure through advanced networking, cybersecurity, and OT solutions.

  

  

**What you’ll do:**

  

As an OT Solution Sales Specialist, you will play a key role in developing business opportunities within Operational Technology (OT), IoT, networking, and cybersecurity. You will work closely with customers, account teams, solution architects, and technical specialists to understand business challenges, shape solutions, and drive commercially successful outcomes.

  

  

This is a highly collaborative role where you'll combine commercial insight with technical understanding to help customers navigate an increasingly complex security and digitalization landscape.

  

  

* Develop new business opportunities within OT security, industrial networking, IoT, and cybersecurity services
* Lead consultative customer dialogues, workshops, and solution discovery sessions
* Collaborate with technical experts and solution architects to design customer-centric solutions
* Own and drive the commercial process from opportunity identification through proposal and contract
* Contribute to bids, tenders, and complex solution proposals
* Build trusted relationships with both operational stakeholders and executive decision-makers

Stay up to date on industry trends, regulations, and frameworks such as NIS2, IEC 62443, ISO 27001, and Zero Trust  
* 

**What will help you thrive in this role:**

  

You are curious, commercially sharp, and comfortable operating in complex customer environments. You enjoy translating technical possibilities into business value and can build credibility with both specialists and decision-makers. You thrive in long sales cycles and are motivated by creating sustainable customer outcomes.

  

  

* Several years of experience in solution sales, business development, presales, or customer advisory within technology-related fields
* Experience from one or more of the following areas: OT/ICS cybersecurity, enterprise networking, cybersecurity services, industrial digitalization, critical infrastructure, or managed/professional services
* Strong understanding of networking and cybersecurity concepts
* Experience leading complex customer dialogues and solution-oriented sales processes
* Ability to communicate technical topics in a clear and business-focused way
* Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills
* Excellent communication skills, with fluency in **Swedish (native or near-native)** and **good English**

  

The following are considered a plus:

  

  

* Experience working with industrial environments and OT/ICS technologies
* Knowledge of frameworks such as IEC 62443, NIS2, ISO 27001, or NIST
* Familiarity with technologies and vendors such as Cisco, Fortinet, Palo Alto Networks, Microsoft Security, Claroty, Armis or Nozomi Networks
* Experience selling solutions to customers within industry, energy, utilities, healthcare, real estate, or other critical infrastructure sectors
  

  

**Additional requirements**

  

Telia is part of critical infrastructure and parts of our operations are subject to security protection. Depending on the role, vetting activities may be required prior to employment. In some cases, additional eligibility requirements, including specific citizenship requirements, may apply.

  

  

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every qualification. If the role interests you and you believe you can make a valuable contribution, we would be pleased to hear from you

  

  

**Why Telia Cygate?**  



  

At Telia Cygate, we’re not only experts in networks, security, and various types of cloud solutions – we’re also a team that believes work should be fun! As part of Telia Company, we have the strength to create real impact on a large scale, contribute to societal value, and help our customers navigate the world of digitalization. And we always do it with warmth, care, and a smile. Here, it’s our ideas and diverse perspectives that make us strong, and together we ensure that the world of technology becomes a place where everyone feels good – and where you belong.

  

  

Your development matters to us. We encourage continuous learning and make sure that you and your interests are in focus. We know that people are the heart of our company, which is why we value joy, creativity, and different perspectives in everything we do.

  

  

Welcome to grow together with us – where we make technology human and create real impact!

  

  

**Telia Cygate is proud to be certificated as Great Place to Work!**  



  

With us, people are at the center – here you get the chance to grow, be challenged, and thrive together with dedicated colleagues. We are building a culture where security, togetherness, and opportunities go hand in hand. Do you want to be part of the journey? Welcome to a workplace that truly lives up to its name.

  

  

**What we offer**  



  

When you join us, you'll receive a comprehensive benefits package tailored to your local market, opportunities for remote work, and more. You'll also have the chance to earn a bonus based on your performance and Telia's results.

  

  

**Interested? Apply!**

  

We look forward to receiving your application by **2026-11-01.** Please note that we might close the position earlier if we find the right candidate, so don’t wait too long to apply!

  

  

Location: **Solna** (preferred), but other locations in Sweden can also be considered.

  

  

If you’re selected for the next stage, you’ll be contacted by our **Talent Acquisition Partner.**  

Background and reference checks will be part of the process.

  

  

Want to know more about this role? Please reach out to Michael Mothander at michael.mothander@cygate.se.

  

  

We kindly ask recruitment agencies and external vendors not to contact us regarding this position.

  

  

**Equal opportunities**

  

At Telia, we recognize talent by professional skills and growth potential. We champion diversity, ensuring every individual’s needs are met, regardless of disability, gender, age, nationality, sexual orientation, or social status. Together, we’re dedicated to fostering an inclusive work environment where your uniqueness is our strength.

  

  

**Welcome to Telia Cygate – Home of Experts**

description:
**Do you want to lead products that make everyday life safer, smarter, and more connected for millions of households worldwide?** Join ASSA ABLOY Opening Solutions in Malmö, Sweden, and become part of a forward-thinking organization where innovation, customer focus, and collaboration drive success.  

As a Product Manager within Yale's Smart Residential team, you will take ownership of a portfolio of connected smart home products, software, and services that make everyday life safer, smarter, and more integrated. You will play a key role in shaping and managing Yale's Residential Access portfolio across EMEIA. Working closely with Market Regions, customers, R&D, Operations, Quality, Regulatory, and Manufacturing teams, you will translate customer and market needs into successful products and services. You will manage products throughout their lifecycle, from opportunity identification and development through launch, continuous improvement, and phase-out, ensuring they deliver customer value, achieve commercial objectives, and meet compliance requirements. As this is an international role, regular travel is required.  

You would also:
* Lead the development, launch, and continuous improvement of residential access products, software, and services across the full product lifecycle.
* Engage with customers, Market Regions, Sales, Marketing, and cross-functional stakeholders to identify market opportunities, define requirements, and prioritize product initiatives.
* Build business cases, define value propositions, and manage product portfolios to support growth, profitability, and strategic objectives.
* Drive cross-functional product development activities, ensuring products meet quality, certification, compliance, and governance requirements.
* Contribute to successful product launches through close partnership with Product Marketing, including packaging, customer documentation, training, and go-to-market activities.

  

**The skills and experience you need**
We are looking for someone with:
* A degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Proven product management experience, ideally within connected products, IoT, smart home solutions, or residential access technologies.
* Experience managing products throughout their lifecycle, including defining requirements, developing business cases, driving product development, successful launches, and continuous improvements.
* Strong commercial, analytical, and customer-focused skills, with the ability to identify growth opportunities, optimize product portfolios, and translate market needs into product strategies. You have experience working within a matrix organization.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in international cross-functional teams. You are structured, analytical, and customer-focused, and thrive in a fast-paced, international environment and are fluent in English.
* Experience with hardware, electronics, firmware, software, mobile applications, cloud-connected ecosystems, compliance, certification requirements, and regulated product launches is an advantage**.**

  

**What we offer**
We’re passionate about providing amazing opportunities and benefits, so you can continue and progress a lifelong career with us – here’s what we have to offer:
* Learning and career development opportunities, whether it’s online learning, management training or enhancing your skills.
* A competitive salary and benefits package.
* A dynamic and inclusive work environment.
* The chance to make a meaningful impact in attracting and retaining top talent.

  

**We review applications regularly, so don't wait**
We are building diverse, inclusive teams, and encourage applications from everyone who can see themselves working with us. Just set up your profile and apply here.  

To make sure your personal data is safe, we don’t look at any applications sent by email or post. If you have any questions about the role or the process, email Alexandra Kymäläinen, Talent Acquisition Business Partner, at
alexandra.kymalainen@assaabloy.com
Depending on the risk profile for the role, a background screening will need to be performed. Final candidates may therefore be subjected to background screening. The performance of a background check is subject to consent and based on our Applicant Privacy Notice.  

**Let’s create a safer and more open world - together!**
To find out more about us, visit www.assaabloy.com  



**When you join Yale, we open doors for you**
  

We’re trusted by millions of people every day to keep what’s important to them safe. Their home, family and belongings. Looking after our people is just as important to us.


When you join our Yale team, you’ll also be part of the ASSA ABLOY Group, the global leader in access solutions. You’ll have 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.


As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.
