title: Account Manager - Pharma & Life Sciences
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.


We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!


Job Description


We are looking for an experienced account manager who is passionate about industrial automation, manufacturing technologies and helping customers solve complex challenges within pharma and life science industry.  



  

You will work with some of Sweden''s leading manufacturers, supporting their journey towards smarter, more connected operations through automation, industrial software, digital transformation and connected enterprise solutions.  



  

You will manage and develop strategic customer relationships. You will identify new business opportunities. You will collaborate with teams of technical specialists, software experts, customer success professionals, and industry consultants to deliver value across the entire manufacturing lifecycle.  



  

The ideal candidate combines strong commercial skills with a technical understanding of manufacturing operations and is comfortable engaging both shop-floor stakeholders and executive decisionmakers.  



  

You will be part of our Nordic End user sales team and report directly to the Nordic sales manager End users, Joakim Holmyr.  



  

While you will not have direct people management responsibilities, you will lead customer engagements and coordinate cross-functional teams to deliver successful results.  



  

You would preferably be based out of our Stockholm office, although we also have offices in Gothenburg and Lund.  



  

**Your responsibilities:**

* Achieve growth across a portfolio of strategic and enterprise manufacturing accounts in Sweden.
* Develop trusted relationships with stakeholders ranging from engineers and operations teams to plant leadership and c-level executives
* Identify customer challenges and align Rockwell Automation solutions to deliver measurable business outcomes
* Lead sales opportunities from early engagement and value discovery through proposal development, negotiation, and implementation
* Expand adoption of connected enterprise solutions, including automation, industrial software, MES, analytics, cybersecurity, and edge-to-cloud technologies
* Identify and develop new business opportunities within target industries
* Collaborate with internal technical experts, industry specialists, partners, and customer success teams to deliver successful customer outcomes

Stay informed on market trends, emerging technologies, and industry developments within manufacturing  

* 

  

**The essentials - you will have:**

* Proven experience selling industrial automation solutions, industrial software or other technically advanced manufacturing technologies.
* 8+ years of experience within industrial automation, manufacturing technology, or related industries.
* Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken
* Excellent knowledge of production processes within the life sciences or pharmaceutical industries, including regulated manufacturing environments, GMP requirements, validation processes, quality systems, or similar relevant experience.
* Experience engaging with multiple stakeholders across technical, operational and executive levels.
* Experience managing complex sales cycles and strategic customer relationships.

Have experience in sales of high-level industrial software solutions (IoT, MES, Analytics to edge and cloud)  

* 

  

**The preferred – you might also have:**

* Experience within life sciences, pharmaceutical, or process manufacturing industries
* Experience selling enterprise-level software, digital transformation or smart manufacturing solutions
* Business and financial acumen, with the ability to build value-based business cases

Technical education or background in engineering, automation, manufacturing, or related disciplines  

* 

  

**What we offer:**

At Rockwell Automation, you will join a global technology leader in industrial automation and digital transformation. Working with experienced colleagues across sales, software, engineering, services and customer success, you will help some of the region’s most advanced manufacturers solve complex challenges with world-class technologies and strong global support.


Also, we offer:


· *Pension scheme with employer contribution*


· *Comprehensive health insurance for employees and eligible dependents*


· *Life and accident insurance*


· *Company car*


· *5 days of floating holidays*


... and other local benefits!  



  

Application information: Please submit your application and CV in English. Please note that the initial stage of the recruitment process will include a conversation with an English-speaking Talent Acquisition colleague.  



  

\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*  



  

På Rockwell Automation hjälper vi världens ledande tillverkande företag att bli mer produktiva, hållbara och digitalt uppkopplade.

  

  

Vi söker nu en erfaren Account Manager med ett starkt intresse för industriell automation, tillverkningsteknik och att hjälpa kunder lösa komplexa utmaningar inom läkemedels- och life science-industrin.

  

  

I rollen kommer du att arbeta med några av Världens ledande tillverkningsföretag och stödja dem på deras resa mot smartare och mer uppkopplade verksamheter genom automation, industriell mjukvara, digital transformation och Connected Enterprise-lösningar.


Du ansvarar för att utveckla och stärka strategiska kundrelationer, identifiera nya affärsmöjligheter och skapa långsiktigt värde för våra kunder. Tillsammans med tekniska specialister, mjukvaruexperter, Customer Success-team och branschkonsulter hjälper du kunder genom hela tillverkningslivscykeln.

  

  

Vi söker dig som kombinerar stark affärsförståelse med teknisk insikt i tillverkningsprocesser och som känner dig trygg i dialogen med såväl operativa verksamheter som beslutsfattare på ledningsnivå.

  

  

Du blir en del av vårt nordiska End User Sales Team och rapporterar direkt till Nordic Sales Manager End Users. Rollen har inget formellt personalansvar, men du kommer att leda kundengagemang och koordinera tvärfunktionella team för att säkerställa framgångsrika resultat.

  

  

Du utgår helst från vårt kontor i Stockholm, vi har även kontor i Göteborg och Lund.

  

  

**Dina ansvarsområden**


* Driva tillväxt inom en portfölj av strategiska och större tillverkningskunder i Sverige.
* Bygga och utveckla förtroendefulla relationer med intressenter på alla nivåer, från ingenjörer och driftteam till fabriksledning och ledningsgrupper.
* Identifiera kunders utmaningar och koppla Rockwell Automations lösningar till konkreta och mätbara affärsresultat.
* Driva försäljningsmöjligheter genom hela processen, från tidig kunddialog och behovsanalys till offert, förhandling och implementering.
* Öka användningen av Connected Enterprise-lösningar inom bland annat automation, industriell mjukvara, MES, analys, cybersäkerhet samt edge- och molnteknik.
* Identifiera och utveckla nya affärsmöjligheter inom prioriterade branscher.
* Samarbeta nära interna tekniska experter, branschspecialister, partners och Customer Success-team för att säkerställa framgångsrika kundresultat.
* Hålla dig uppdaterad om marknadstrender, ny teknik och utvecklingen inom tillverkningsindustrin.

title: Consultant / Senior Consultant, Financial Services Transformation
description:
**Make an impact in financial services transformation**

Are you ready to take the next step in your career and join our successful teams in Sweden? Deloitte is a market leader in Sweden, working with decision-makers across global and local organisations. As a Consultant or Senior Consultant in the Operations Transformation or Engineering team, you will help leading financial institutions translate complex business and technology challenges into practical transformation initiatives.


You will help financial services clients innovate and transform their organisations, core systems and operating models. This includes driving business transformation, consolidating and implementing systems and processes, embedding regulatory change and operational efficiency, designing new operating models, and leading large-scale transformations.


**Requirements to succeed in this role**

We will assess your level based on the depth of your experience and the scope of responsibility you have held. You are expected to have 1-4 years of professional experience in management consulting, financial services, or a business or technology transformation role.


* As a Consultant, you will typically contribute to analysis and project delivery, while coordinating stakeholders within a workstream.
* As a Senior Consultant, you will typically lead workstreams, shape solutions, manage senior stakeholders, review deliverables, and guide junior colleagues.

**What you will do**

* Analyse complex business, operating model, regulatory, data, and technology challenges.
* Design practical solutions in collaboration with client stakeholders and Deloitte specialists.
* Support or lead workstreams from strategy and requirements through implementation and adoption.
* Translate business needs into clear requirements for technology and delivery teams.
* Develop evidence-based recommendations and present them clearly to senior stakeholders.
* Contribute to proposals, client relationships, and the continued development of our Financial Services capabilities.

**About the team**

You will join the Operations Transformation or Engineering team within Technology & Transformation. We combine deep industry knowledge with expertise in strategy, operations, technology, data, and change to help financial institutions deliver sustainable transformation.


Our team brings together colleagues with expertise across:


* Banking: payments, lending, savings, cards, financial crime, risk, compliance, and regulatory reporting.
* Capital markets: front-to-back trading, post-trade, treasury, finance transformation, and regulatory change.
* Asset and wealth management: operating model, product, platform, data, and regulatory transformation.
* Insurance: underwriting, claims, policy administration, personal and commercial products, and core-system implementation.
**Qualifications**
------------------

What we are looking for:


* A bachelor’s or master’s degree in a relevant field, such as business, engineering, economics, or information systems.
* Experience contributing to projects or workstreams that have delivered measurable business or operational change.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex information into practical recommendations.
* Confidence working with stakeholders across both business and technology functions.
* Professional fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.
* Willingness to travel as required for client assignments.

**Experience that would be an advantage:**

* Experience in one or more of the Financial Services areas described above.
* Demonstrated interest or experience in business and IT transformations - project, programme, product, or requirements management.
* Business development.
* Regulatory, operating model, or process transformation.
* Change management and implementation of new ways of working.
* Business and technology transformation, including system implementation, cloud or system migration, vendor selection, data migration, testing, or agile delivery.

**How you work and as a person:**

* You build strong working relationships across diverse teams and client organisations.
* You take ownership of your work, manage priorities effectively, and deliver on commitments.
* You communicate complex ideas clearly, in a structured way and tailored to your audience.
* You are curious, actively seek feedback, and use it to continuously improve.
* You enjoy collaborating with others and are equally comfortable working independently when required.
* You are outgoing, collaborative and enjoy working as part of a team.
**Additional Information**
--------------------------

**What we offer**

* Varied assignments spanning design, implementation, and adoption.
* Structured development supported by a dedicated coach, formal learning, and regular on-the-job feedback.
* Access to Financial Services specialists and international teams across Deloitte’s global network.
* A collaborative and inclusive environment that values knowledge sharing and diverse perspectives.
* Opportunities to deepen your expertise, contribute to client development, and take on greater responsibility.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.

At Deloitte, we are committed to helping our employees grow and develop throughout their career. We offer a range of on-the-job learning experiences, formal development programs at Deloitte University, and access to a personal coach to support you in identifying and utilizing your strengths. We also provide the necessary training and resources for you to obtain various certifications to further advance in your career.


Our culture is built on collaboration and innovation. We value diverse perspectives and encourage our employees to think creatively to find the best solutions for our clients. We work hand-in-hand with our clients to understand their unique needs and to develop tailored solutions that drive growth and innovation. At Deloitte, you´ll have the chance to grow and succeed alongside like-minded professionals who share your passion.


**How to apply**

Please apply online. As part of your application, please submit:


* CV
* A short statement explaining your interest in the role and relevant industry experience (if any)
* University grades

*As a qualitative part of Deloitte's recruitment process, our final candidates undergo a background check, to increase awareness of our future employees, secure the working environment for our employees and meet regulatory requirements. The background check process is carried out in collaboration with To Find Out.* *https://tofindout.se/en/background-check/*

**Please submit your application as soon as possible, as we work with ongoing selection.**

At Deloitte, we value different skills, perspectives, and experiences, as it enables us to effectively solve complex challenges for our clients. We encourage you to apply for the position if you believe your skills can contribute to our team’s success.


**Questions?**

If you have any questions regarding the role or the application process, please contact Anna Taube, Manager Talent Acquisition, at ataube@deloitte.se .


**We are looking forward to your application!**

**What impact will you make?**

Every day, your work will make an impact that matters, while you thrive in a dynamic culture of inclusion, collaboration and high performance. We do not just aspire to make solutions. We wish to create an impact that makes a positive and crucial difference for the people around us, our clients and our society. We are hiring **Integration Specialist (WSO2)**for **Sweden.**


**Job Summary:**


We are looking for an experienced **Integration Specialist (WSO2)** to manage, configure and further develop API management and integration capabilities in a modern cloud environment. The assignment combines WSO2 API platform management with infrastructure responsibilities across Linux-based virtual machines and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). A key part of the role is securing and governing access to LLM-based APIs and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations through the API gateway. The role involves close collaboration with DevOps and platform teams.


**Educational Qualification:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* **Platform Administration & DevOps Collaboration:** Manage, govern, and maintain the WSO2 API platform across all environments (Linux VMs and AKS), overseeing deployments, security standards, performance monitoring, CI/CD automation, and technical documentation.
* **AI & Advanced Integration Governance:** Securely configure and govern LLM-based APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, ensuring proper access controls (rate limiting, authentication), tool discovery, and observability through the API gateway.
**Technical Skills & Expertise:**


* 4+ years of hands-on experience administering **WSO2 API Manager**, preferably versions 3.x or 4.x.
* Strong knowledge of **WSO2 core components**, including Gateway, Publisher, Developer Portal, Key Manager, Traffic Manager and Carbon-based architecture.
* Proven experience integrating **third-party key managers and identity providers** with WSO2.
* Experience installing, configuring and maintaining WSO2 API Manager on **virtual machines**, including database setup, load balancing and high-availability deployments.
* Working knowledge of **Azure AKS**, including kubectl, Helm, node pools, networking, ingress controllers and monitoring.
* Familiar with **LLM APIs**, including request/response structures, token-based billing, streaming, rate limits and API gateway governance.
* Strong understanding of the **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**, including client-server architecture, transport layers, session lifecycle, server development and deployment, client behavior and capability negotiation.
* Experience securing **MCP endpoints** through authentication, authorization, input validation and sandboxing.
* Able to troubleshoot **MCP integrations**, including tool call failures, transport issues, schema mismatches and timeout handling.
* Solid knowledge of **OAuth2, JWT, API security** and **certificate management**.
* Experience with **Linux system administration**.
* Strong **troubleshooting and root-cause analysis** skills in distributed API gateway environments.
* Understanding of how **AI agents** interact with external systems through tool-use protocols such as MCP.
* Holding **WSO2 certifications** (Meriting).
* Experience with **WSO2 Identity Server** or **WSO2 Micro Integrator** (Plus).
* Hands-on experience with **Terraform or Bicep** for Azure infrastructure provisioning (Meriting).
* Experience with **API monetization** and subscription-tier management (Advantage).
* Experience building **custom mediators** or **Synapse configurations** (Plus).
* Experience building or integrating **MCP servers** using TypeScript, Python or Java SDKs (Meriting).
* Exposure to **prompt engineering** or **AI/ML API orchestration** patterns (Advantage).
* Experience governing **MCP traffic at scale**, including routing, load balancing and monitoring multiple MCP server instances behind an API gateway (Highly meriting).

**Soft Skills:**


* **Communicate effectively** across development, security, AI and infrastructure teams.
* Ability to **document** complex technical configurations clearly.
* **Self-directed**, with a strong focus on **reliability and uptime**.

title: Associate Solutions Architect Internship 2027
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Join Amazon Web Services (AWS) as an Associate Solutions Architect Intern and launch your career in cloud computing. Available to work full-time for either 3 or 6 months during 2027, you'll gain hands-on experience designing cloud and generative AI solutions, learning from experienced architects, and working on real AWS projects that impact millions of customers worldwide.  

  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's leading cloud computing platform, helping millions of customers — from startups to global enterprises — build and run applications without managing physical servers. We're seeking motivated individuals for our Associate Solutions Architect Intern program, a structured learning experience designed to develop the next generation of Cloud Solutions Architects.  

  

This internship serves as a pathway to our Solutions Architect Graduate Program, offering you the opportunity to build foundational knowledge in cloud computing, AWS services, and solutions architecture principles in a supportive, education-first environment. You'll learn to understand customer requirements, build working cloud and AI solutions, and communicate technical recommendations effectively while being mentored by experienced Solutions Architects.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Complete a structured training curriculum to build cloud architecture foundations and develop expertise in AWS services  

Analyze customer requirements and learn to translate them into technical solution recommendations  

Participate in solution design sessions and observe customer engagements with experienced Solutions Architects  

Work on a real AWS project, applying architecture principles and building hands-on experience with AWS services
  

Develop communication skills by learning to present technical concepts effectively to diverse audiences  

  

A day in the life  

As an Associate Solutions Architect Intern, you'll engage in a mix of structured learning and practical application. Your day might include attending training sessions on AWS services and the Well-Architected Framework, then applying those concepts to a real project you're building on AWS. You'll participate in solution design discussions, observing how experienced architects translate customer needs into technical recommendations. You might shadow customer engagements to see how solutions are presented to diverse audiences, then return to work on your own project, experimenting with AWS services and architecture principles. Throughout your internship, you'll develop presentation skills by communicating technical concepts to colleagues and mentors, receiving feedback that helps you grow as a solutions architect.  

  

About the team  

We are the EMEA Student Programs Team within AWS, dedicated to nurturing emerging talent in cloud computing. Our team collaborates across the organization to create meaningful internship experiences that bridge the gap between academic learning and real-world cloud architecture. We work with experienced Solutions Architects who are committed to mentoring the next generation of cloud professionals. Together, we're building a community of architects who understand how to solve complex business problems through innovative cloud solutions. When you join us, you'll be part of a team that values your growth, supports your learning journey, and helps you develop the skills needed to succeed in cloud consulting and solutions architecture.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Currently enrolled in penultimate or final year of a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field, graduating in 2027 or 2028
* Speak, write, and read fluently in English at C1 level or above
* Speak, write, and read fluently in Swedish at C1 level or above
* Experience with at least one modern programming language (such as Python, Java, C++, or JavaScript)
* Right to work in Spain for the duration of the internship
* Understanding of basic IT systems, software development, or system architecture concepts

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of networking fundamentals, including security, storage, or databases (relational and/or NoSQL)
* Understanding of operating systems (Unix, Linux, and/or Windows)
* Interest in or experience with generative AI, for example building with LLM APIs, agents or AI coding assistants
* Experience with systems administration (Linux/Windows), network administration (DNS, IPsec, BGP, VPN, load balancing), or programming (Node.JS, Java, Ruby, C#, Python, or PHP)

title: Senior Data Center Technician
description:
**Overview**  

As a Microsoft Senior Data Center Technician (SDCT), you will demonstrate expertise in standard processes and procedures for preparing, installing, performing diagnostics, troubleshooting, replacing, and/or decommissioning equipment, as well as a holistic understanding of the functions of, and interactions between, network and server equipment. You will provide input for suggested modifications to these processes and procedures as needed to improve service quality and efficiency while providing guidance to other technicians.

  

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

  

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

  

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

  

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Apply advanced diagnostic and troubleshooting expertise to quickly identify the cause(s) of issues to quickly identify the cause of issues.
* Decommission hardware for complex changes and/or systems with complex interactions (e.g., upgrading entire racks) following standard procedures.
* Delegate hardware installation, deployment, and/or replacement work to technicians while providing expert guidance for preparing, staging, setting up, and performing startups and shutdowns (e.g., racks, hard drives, switches).
* Ensure quality execution as defined by organizational standards, coordinating downtime, and keeping relevant stakeholders informed of work status to minimize downstream rework.
* Assist and provide guidance to technicians to complete challenging or complex tasks and escalate issues as needed.
* Ensure that technicians are performing post-execution quality checks and verifying that grounding, staging, labeling, and cabling are set up in compliance with safety protocols, deployment standards, and planned Network Design Tasks (NDTs).
* Verify security compliance for decommissions and processes data-bearing devices for destruction.
* Maintain an awareness of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) through dashboards and/or monthly performance discussions.
* Train and mentor technicians through on-the-job training and by providing direct guidance on specific tasks.
* Attend, conduct, or assist in conducting daily safety briefings, completes required safety training, provides guidance to technicians to facilitate compliance with safety procedures (e.g., Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) usage, equipment use, lifting, electrical hazards, ladder/rolling stair use).
* Has pride and a sense of accountability for the service quality, completeness, and resulting user experience.
* Embody our culture and values.

  

**Qualifications** **Required Qualifications:**

* High school diploma, GED, or equivalent and basic knowledge of computer hardware and components AND experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.

 **Background Check Requirements:**


Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.


While not required, we also look for the following

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Associate degree in computer science or other field and/or equivalent work experience.
* Experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.
* Experience working in a production, mission-critical 24x7x365 data center environment.
* Applicable certifications: ASICS/Inventory Control, CompTIA (A+, Server+, Network+), Basic Structure Cabling (BSC), Data Center Foundation Certification (DCFC), Microsoft Certified Professional (MCP), Vendor-Specific Network Certifications.

  

  

  

Data Center Technicians ATR-D - The typical base pay range for this role across Sweden is kr 520,000.00 - kr 749,000.00 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation.

https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/corporate-pay/sweden-corporate-pay.html

  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

At Tele2, data, AI and agentic tools are already a core part of how we work. As Marketing Data Science Lead, you will extend their impact across Comviq, Tele2 B2C and Tele2 B2B. You will combine marketing science with AI to deepen our customer understanding, measure what drives growth and guide where we invest.


You will be the marketing department’s go-to expert for advanced analytics and AI. You will build models, run experiments and turn customer insights and data into solutions that show what really drives sales and make our marketing smarter. This is a hands-on role where you will support the whole marketing team in our decisions. You will work closely with the Marketing Director, our AI/Data function and colleagues across marketing.


You will strengthen marketing’s in-house analytical expertise, building on Tele2’s shared data and AI capabilities.


**Key responsibilities**

* Build and own our measurement framework, including marketing mix modeling, experimentation and incrementality testing, and systematically test our media spend to understand how we should invest.
* Own our customer insights from external research, including brand tracking, ad tracking and NPS, and combine them with our own data to get a complete picture of our customers and brands.
* Drive personalization and AI-driven decisioning across channels, together with the marketing team and other commercial teams across the organization.
* Turn complex analyses into clear recommendations that guide budget allocation and business decisions.
* Make data a natural part of the team’s everyday work by improving data quality, building dashboards that give everyone access to insights, setting up smarter ways of working and sharing your knowledge.
* Explore and develop how AI and agentic tools can make our analysis and experimentation faster and smarter, while maintaining analytical rigor and human oversight.

You combine technical depth with a commercial mindset. You understand what makes customers buy, and you see models and code as tools to find the next business opportunity, not as an end in themselves. You are a doer who likes to get things done. You are eager to explore new AI capabilities and confident in questioning their outputs. You enjoy explaining complex analyses in a simple and engaging way, and you make others curious about what data and AI can do.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**We are Stravito and this is the problem we solve.**
 Stravito transforms how Consumer Insights professionals and Brand Managers work by building AI that automates their core workflows. We help world-leading organizations across industries accelerate strategic decision-making by turning millions of market research documents into intelligent systems that generate reports, discover insights proactively, and synthesize knowledge across vast content libraries.
   

  

 The data platform underneath makes all of this possible: ingesting millions of documents, enforcing tenant-level security, and feeding the AI systems our customers rely on daily.
   

  

****What Makes This Role Unique****
* Build the foundation: Own the data platform that powers AI products used daily by thousands of professionals at Fortune 500 companies
* Work with data that matters: Transform event streams, usage telemetry, and millions of proprietary market research documents into reliable, queryable intelligence
* Solve hard infrastructure problems: Design multi-tenant, secure-by-default pipelines and APIs that meet the compliance bar of the world's most demanding enterprise customers
* Own it end-to-end: This isn't a role where someone else defines the work. You'll scope work independently, dig into data quality issues, field requests from stakeholders, and drive things to completion.


****What You’ll Do****
 As part of the platform team, you'll own a broad area: from building infrastructure to supporting the teams that depend on it. In any given week you might:
   

  

* Build and operate data pipelines that move event streams, document metadata, and usage data into our cloud data warehouse (ClickHouse Cloud, Snowflake, Azure)
* Design and maintain APIs for analytics and event extraction, with multi-tenant security baked in (RBAC, OAuth, SSO/SAML)
* Make data usable: whether that's modeling schemas for BI consumers, investigating a data quality issue, or helping a stakeholder understand what's possible with the data we have
* Keep things reliable and secure through automated tests, monitoring, and handling of sensitive data within SOC 2 and ISO 27001 environments
* Power our AI experiences by working with vector stores, indexing, and retrieval systems
* Drive engineering best practices across the platform: CI/CD, peer reviews, infrastructure as code, API versioning, and clear documentation


****What We Need****
**Must-haves**
* A track record of building data platforms in SaaS or cloud-native analytics environments
* Strong programming skills, with depth in at least one of Python or Kotlin and willingness to work across both. Experience with Rust or TypeScript is a plus
* Hands-on experience with MPP/cloud data warehouses (e.g., ClickHouse, Redshift, BigQuery, Snowflake, Azure Synapse) and cloud infrastructure on AWS or Azure
* Practical experience designing, consuming, and maintaining APIs
* Familiarity with multi-tenant security patterns: RBAC, row-level security, and identity standards such as OAuth and SAML/SSO
* Solid engineering fundamentals: CI/CD, automated testing, observability, and infrastructure as code (Terraform a plus)
* Working knowledge of data privacy requirements (PII handling, GDPR) and experience operating within compliance frameworks like SOC 2 or ISO 27001


**Nice-to-haves**
* Experience integrating with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker)
* Familiarity with semantic search, embeddings, or vector stores (e.g., Pinecone, pgvector)
* Exposure to event-driven or streaming architectures (Kafka, Kinesis, SQS/SNS)
* Experience with containerisation (Docker, ECS/Fargate)
* Interest in leveraging LLMs and AI tooling to accelerate data engineering work
* dbt, SQLMesh, or similar transformation framework experience


**This role is fully remote, but you will need to be a current resident for tax purposes in one of the chosen locations.**
*The salary range for this role depends on location and will proactively be shared with you in the first interview.*
**What’s in it for you?**
 Join a remote-first, globally distributed team of 100+ professionals from 30+ nationalities, united by our core values: simplicity first, an 'own it, do it' mentality, embracing different perspectives, and enjoying the journey together. We bring everyone together for company events throughout the year to strengthen our global connections.
   

  

 You'll grow alongside experienced colleagues with deep expertise across AI, market research, and enterprise systems. We offer exceptional career development opportunities in our fast-evolving market, competitive compensation, and a collaborative culture where everyone actively supports each other's success.
   

  

 Most importantly, you'll have the satisfaction of simplifying the professional lives of thousands of Brand Managers and Consumer Insights professionals worldwide, making their strategic decisions more data-driven and impactful.
   

  

 Ready to build the data platform behind Fortune 500 strategy? Join us.
   

  

 Stravito is the insights platform for the world's leading enterprises, right in the middle of an exciting transformation from a SaaS company into a world-class AI company. We bring all of a company's customer and market knowledge into one place, making it findable, usable, and ready to act on, so insights teams can make sharper, fact-based decisions. Founded in Stockholm, Sweden in 2017, Stravito today works with some of the world's most recognised brands and is home to 100 employees across 10 countries in Europe and North America.

 Experience in software quality, testing, automation, DevOps, or another relevant technical domain.
   

  

**Skills You Bring**
* Ownership and expansion of strategic enterprise accounts — identifying opportunities, building exec relationships, and closing complex multi-stakeholder deals.
* Strategic account ownership: Evidence of identifying whitespace, developing focused account plans, building executive sponsorship, and converting opportunities into sustainable growth.
* Forecasting and pipeline discipline: Experience using data, qualification criteria, and clear next steps to improve revenue predictability and execution.
* Executive influence and value selling: Ability to engage senior IT leaders, uncover business drivers, and connect technical solutions to strategic and financial outcomes.
* Business and technical translation: Ability to turn complex customer challenges into quantified business impact and position Tricentis solutions against measurable outcomes.
* Complex deal execution: Demonstrated use of structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC and value-based selling to navigate multi-stakeholder decisions.
* Cross-functional execution: Experience working with Pre-Sales, Customer Growth, Marketing, and peers to strengthen account strategy and customer outcomes.
* Sales technology fluency: Practical experience with CRM, forecasting, sales enablement, and AI tools, such as Salesforce, Clari, Outreach, or comparable platforms.


**Who You Are**
* Coachable: You actively seek feedback, apply new learning, and refine your approach based on evidence and customer insight.
* Resilient: You maintain focus through long, complex sales cycles, adapt when conditions change, and turn setbacks into informed next steps.
* Driven for Results: You set ambitious goals, take ownership of outcomes, and combine strategic thinking with disciplined execution.
* Resourceful: You find practical ways through ambiguity and constraints while keeping account strategy, customer value, and scale in view.
* Collaborative: You share information, invite expertise, and work across teams to solve customer problems and deliver shared success.


**Tricentis Core Values:**
 At Tricentis, we strive for success while inspiring those around us by knowing what we need to achieve and how we’ll achieve it. Our core values serve as our guiding light to drive our every action and define our ways of working so that we can create and enjoy a successful journey and reach higher heights together.
   

  

* Demonstrate Self-Awareness: Own your strengths and limitations.
* Finish What We Start: Do what we say we are going to do.
* Move Fast: Create momentum and efficiency.
* Run Towards Change: Challenge the status quo.
* Serve Our Customers & Communities: Create a positive experience with each interaction.
* Solve Problems Together: We win or lose as one team.
* Think Big & Believe: Set extraordinary goals and believe you can achieve them.


 Tricentis is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, ethnicity, gender, religious affiliation, age, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or physical and mental disability and other statuses protected by law.
   

  

**Global Sanctions Compliance**
 We comply with all applicable global sanctions and export control laws. Candidates must not be listed on any government restricted party lists (including OFAC SDN List and U.S. Commerce Department restricted lists) and must certify that their employment would not violate any sanctions or export control regulations. Candidates must notify us of any changes to their status during the application process or subsequent employment.

title: Power BI-utvecklare
description:
**Sista ansökningsdatum 16 november** 




 I takt med att vår IT-division på Svenska kraftnät växer ökar även enhetens uppdrag och Data- och rapportplattformen är och kommer att bli en allt viktigare del i Svenska kraftnäts satsning inom dataområdet. Vi söker en BI-utvecklare som vill vara med och göra Svenska kraftnät ännu mer datadrivet, genom att omvandla data till värdefulla insikter och skapa beslutsstöd som verkligen gör skillnad för hela verksamheten.
 



 Vill du ta dig an energiutmaningen och vara med och jobba för ett lysande Sverige?
 



  





**Om tjänsten** 




 Här blir du en del av enheten Dataanalys och dataplattform, som ansvarar för att tillhandahålla plattformar för lagring, analys och delning av data. Enheten möjliggör en säker och effektiv användning av data och information på hela myndigheten, och svarar på frågor och beställningar om strukturerad data, exempelvis datauttag och publicerade rapporter.
 



 På enheten arbetar ett engagerat team bestående av 20 medarbetare i olika roller som bland annat arkitekter, utvecklare och IT-specialister som hanterar applikationsdrift och support för våra plattformar. Vi arbetar tvärfunktionellt enligt agila principer tillsammans med förvaltningsledare och produktägare med både förvaltning och vidareutveckling.
 



 I din roll som BI-utvecklare ansvarar du, tillsammans med teamet, för att säkerställa att våra befintliga plattformar och verktyg för lagring, insamling, analys och delning av data fungerar samt att vidareutveckla dem både proaktivt och utifrån verksamhetens behov.
 



 Som BI-utvecklare arbetar du med att driva och utveckla myndighetens self-service-satsning, med fokus på att öka användningen av Power BI och stärka medvetenheten om möjligheterna med dataanalys inom verksamheten. Du blir en viktig del i att utveckla både den tekniska miljön och användarnas förmåga att arbeta datadrivet.
 



  





 Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:
 


* Ta fram och vidareutveckla Power BI-rapporter
* Förvalta och vidareutveckla den befintliga Power BI-miljön
* Utveckla dataflöden och arbetssätt för datahantering
* Driva utvecklingen av self-service genom att utbilda olika användargrupper och öka medvetenheten om hur verksamheten kan använda data för analys och uppföljning
* Stötta användare genom kunskapsdelning, utveckling av användargrupper och utbildningar inom Power BI
* Bidra till att hålla ihop och vidareutveckla den tekniska plattformen



  





 I rollen finns möjlighet att ta ett större ansvar för den tekniska miljön och samtidigt forma och påverka din roll utifrån verksamhetens behov.
 



  





**Om dig** 




**Skallkrav:** 




 Vi söker dig som är strukturerad och har förmåga att se helheten med ett pragmatiskt och lösningsorienterat förhållningssätt. Du är flexibel och tålmodig när förutsättningarna förändras och hitta möjligheter även i utmanande situationer. Med eget driv och initiativförmåga flyttar du fram positionerna, samtidigt som du entusiasmerar och får med dig andra längs vägen. Samarbete och relationsbyggande är en naturlig del av ditt arbetssätt. I rollen möter du hela verksamheten och skapar intresse inom området, stöttar nya och befintliga användare samt förmedlar värdet och möjligheterna med ett datadrivet arbetssätt. Du är trygg inom ditt område, delar gärna med dig av din kunskap och arbetar metodiskt med både genomförande och dokumentation.
 



 Du ska också leva upp till
 **den statliga värdegrunden.** 
 Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.
 



 Vidare har du en relevant högskole- eller universitetsutbildning inom Teknik, Systemvetenskap eller Datateknik, alternativt motsvarande utbildning eller arbetslivserfarenhet som Svenska kraftnät bedömer likvärdigt.
 



  





**Du har även:** 



* Minst 4 års aktuell och relevant erfarenhet av Power BI-utveckling
* Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift samt goda kunskaper i engelska



  





**Vi ser det som meriterande om du har:** 



* Erfarenhet av att leda och driva användargrupper eller andra nätverk
* Erfarenhet av att hålla utbildningar, exempelvis inom Power BI
* Erfarenhet av att jobba med Power BI Server
* Erfarenhet av agila arbetsmetoder och verktyg
* Erfarenhet av att jobba med/mot datalagerlösningar
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med Linux, Java och/eller Python
* Erfarenhet av att samarbeta med kompetenser inom infrastruktur
* God kännedom om IT-säkerhet



  





**Bra att veta** 



* Tjänsten är placerad i Stockholm (Sundbyberg)
* Möjlighet till distansarbete upp till 50 %, om arbetet tillåter. #LI-hybrid
* Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning, men 6 månaders provanställning kan komma att tillämpas
* I tjänsten kan schemalagd beredskap komma att ingå
* Sista ansökningsdag är den 16 november 2026. Vi använder urvalsfrågor i stället för personligt brev.
* Individuell lönesättning tillämpas och sker i enlighet med de centrala löneavtalen RALS/RALS-T
* **Förmåner | Svenska kraftnät**



  





**Vid frågor:** 




 I denna rekrytering samarbetar vi med Computer Sweden Recruitment. För frågor kring tjänsten och rekryteringsprocessen, välkommen att kontakta huvudansvarig rekryteringskonsult Johanna Nordberg, 070 3343159 eller
 **johanna.nordberg@csrecruitment.se** 
 . Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!
 



  





 Kontakter på Svenska kraftnät:
 


* Maria Sahlén, rekryteringsspecialist, 010 489 20 27
* Annika Ingeborn, SACO, 010 475 87 72
* Erica Midfjäll, ST, 010 475 87 31



  





 Du når oss också via e-post:
 **Förnamn.Efternamn@svk.se** 
 .
 



**Jobba här – bli en viktig del av vår energiframtid | Svenska kraftnät** 




 Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare i samband med rekrytering, vi har upphandlade avtal som gäller för Svenska kraftnät som statlig myndighet.
 



  





**Övrig information** 




 Vi ställer höga krav på våra medarbetares säkerhets- och sekretess-medvetenhet. Inför anställning genomförs säkerhetsprövning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) vilket innefattar grundutredning och om anställningen avser befattning i säkerhetsklass kommer säkerhetsprövningen även att innefatta en registerkontroll. För anställning på Svenska kraftnät kan det vara ett krav på svenskt medborgarskap i vissa befattningar. Med anställningen följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras. För mer information om personalsäkerhet på svenska kraftnät.
 **https://www.svk.se/sakerhet-och-beredskap/sakerhetsskydd/personalsakerhet**

title: Tactical Portfolio Manager
description:
**Help Shape the Future of Hybrid & Cloud Services at Telia Cygate**
 At Telia Cygate, we believe the best solutions are created when people with different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives come together. We are now looking for a
 **Tactical Portfolio Manager** 
 to join our growing Hybrid & Cloud team and help shape the future offerings we bring to our customers.
   

  

 My name is
 **Staffan Sundqvist** 
 , and I lead the Hybrid & Cloud business area within Managed Services at Telia Cygate. Together with an experienced team of specialists, we develop services that help organizations navigate an increasingly complex IT landscape. If you are passionate about hybrid cloud, service innovation, and creating tangible business value, this could be your next career move.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 As a Tactical Portfolio Manager, you will play a central role in developing and managing our Hybrid & Cloud portfolio. Working closely with Service Owners and other Portfolio Managers, you will ensure that our existing services continue to deliver value while identifying opportunities for further development and innovation.
   

  

 This role combines strategic thinking, commercial insight, and cross-functional collaboration. You will have the opportunity to influence business direction and create real impact within one of today’s most important technology areas.
   

  

 Your responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Driving the continuous development and optimization of the Hybrid & Cloud portfolio.
* Maximizing the return on portfolio investments and, together with Service Owners, ensuring long-term profitability.
* Supporting sales teams and solution specialists by communicating portfolio strategy, customer value, and service differentiation.
* Participating in selected customer engagements and supporting strategic business opportunities.
* Building strong partnerships across sales, delivery, marketing, and product organizations.
* Monitoring and reporting on portfolio performance, trends, and outcomes.
* Collaborating with vendors and technology partners on market analysis, customer events, and go-to-market initiatives.
* Leading and qualifying new service development initiatives, including building business cases and securing stakeholder alignment.
* Partnering with procurement teams to evaluate and select new technologies.
* Contributing to the overall success and growth of the Hybrid & Cloud portfolio.


**What Will Help You Thrive In This Role**
 We are looking for someone with experience in portfolio management, service portfolio governance, service development, or product and service strategy, ideally within technology-driven organizations.
   

  

 You do not need to meet every requirement to apply. We know that many strong candidates, particularly women and individuals from underrepresented groups, may hesitate if they do not match every qualification. If this role excites you and you believe you can make a meaningful contribution, we would love to hear from you.
   

  

 We believe that you are a match for this role if you:
   

  

* Have a strong interest in Hybrid & Cloud technologies and digital services.
* Enjoy turning insights, data, and market trends into concrete decisions.
* Are comfortable engaging with customers, partners, vendors, and senior stakeholders.
* Have a commercial mindset and a strong customer focus.
* Are structured, proactive, and able to drive initiatives independently.
* Build trust through collaboration and clear communication.
* Thrive in environments where learning and continuous improvement are encouraged.
* Are fluent in both Swedish and English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.


****Why Telia Cygate?****
 At Telia Cygate, we’re not only experts in networks, security, and various types of cloud solutions – we’re also a team that believes work should be fun!
   

  

 As part of Telia Company, we have the strength to create real impact on a large scale, contribute to societal value, and help our customers navigate the world of digitalization. And we always do it with warmth, care, and a smile. Here, it’s our ideas and diverse perspectives that make us strong, and together we ensure that the world of technology becomes a place where everyone feels good – and where you belong.
   

  

 Your development matters to us. We encourage continuous learning and make sure that you and your interests are in focus. We know that people are the heart of our company, which is why we value joy, creativity, and different perspectives in everything we do.
   

  

 Welcome to grow together with us – where we make technology human and create real impact!
   

  

**Telia Cygate is proud to be certificated as Great Place to Work**
 With us, people are at the center – here you get the chance to grow, be challenged, and thrive together with dedicated colleagues. We are building a culture where security, togetherness, and opportunities go hand in hand. Do you want to be part of the journey? Welcome to a workplace that truly lives up to its name.
   

  

**What we offer** 
  

  

 When you join us, you'll receive a comprehensive benefits package tailored to your local market, opportunities for remote work, and more. You'll also have the chance to earn a bonus based on your performance and Telia's results.
   

  

**Interested? Apply!**
 We look forward to receiving your application by
 **2026-11-06.**
 Please note that we might close the position earlier if we find the right candidate, so don’t wait too long to apply!
   

  

**Location:** 
 Solna or Gothenburg
   

  

 If you’re selected for the next stage, you’ll be contacted by our
 **Talent Acquisition Partner.**
*Telia is part of critical infrastructure and parts of our operations are subject to security protection. Depending on the role, vetting activities may be required prior to employment. In some cases, additional eligibility requirements, including specific citizenship requirements, may apply. Background and reference checks will be part of the process.*
 Want to know more about this role? Please reach out to
 
 Staffan Sundqvist at staffan.sundqvist@cygate.se
   

  

 We kindly ask recruitment agencies and external vendors not to contact us regarding this position.
   

  

**Equal opportunities**
 At Telia, we recognize talent by professional skills and growth potential. We champion diversity, ensuring every individual’s needs are met, regardless of disability, gender, age, nationality, sexual orientation, or social status. Together, we’re dedicated to fostering an inclusive work environment where your uniqueness is our strength.
   

  

**Welcome to Telia Cygate – Home of  Experts**
**Attachments**

title: Service Delivery Manager End-to-End (SDM E2E)
description:
Beskrivning av tjänsten
   

  

 Vill du vara med och leda en verksamhetskritisk infrastruktur där stabilitet, säkerhet och utveckling behöver fungera som en sammanhängande helhet? Här får du kombinera kundrelation, affär, service management och helhetsansvar för en IT miljö i en roll med tydligt mandat att påverka både leveransen och dess fortsatta utveckling.
   

  

 Vi söker en Service Delivery Manager End to End (SDM E2E) med erfarenhet och brinnande intresse att leverera kvalificerade tjänster i kombination av ägarskapskap av end to end inom ett förvaltningsområde. Du tar ett samlat ansvar från kundens och verksamhetens behov till robust drift, säkerhet, ekonomi, livscykel och kontinuerlig utveckling.
   

  

 Det här är en roll för dig som trivs med att se hela bilden. Du behöver inte vara den djupaste tekniska specialisten i rummet, men du behöver förstå verksamhet, teknik, ekonomi, säkerhet och leverans tillräckligt väl för att samla rätt människor, sätta riktning och driva beslut.
   

  

 Dina framtida arbetsuppgifter
   

  

 Som SDM är du en central länk mellan kunden, verksamheten och vår leveransorganisation. Du leder den taktiska och strategiska dialogen och har ett end to end perspektiv på tjänsternas kvalitet, ekonomi, risk, säkerhet, utveckling och kundvärde.
   

  

 Du arbetar nära Operations Manager, arkitekter, tekniska specialister och andra service management funktioner. Tillsammans säkerställer ni ett stabilt och säkert betalningssystem, samtidigt som leveransen utvecklas i takt med verksamhetens behov och regulatoriska och säkerhetsrelaterade krav.
   

  

 I rollen kommer du bland annat att:
   

  

* Äga den taktiska och strategiska kundrelationen och skapa en långsiktig, förtroendefull dialog
* Ha helhetsansvar för tjänstekvalitet, livscykel, beroenden och end to end leverans
* Ansvara för ekonomi, budget, prognos, kostnadsutveckling och ekonomiskt resultat
* Leda governance, service reviews och andra strategiska kund och styrforum
* Följa upp SLA, KPI:er, risker, säkerhet och leveransens utveckling – med fokus på beslut och åtgärder
* Äga och driva roadmap, plattformsutveckling, teknisk förnyelse och prioritering av förbättringsinitiativ
* Koordinera större förändringar, incidenter och åtgärder över flera team och leverantörer
* Säkerställa att krav på tillgänglighet, kontinuitet, spårbarhet och informationssäkerhet omsätts i leveransen
* Identifiera utvecklings och affärsmöjligheter tillsammans med kunden och våra specialistteam.


 Kvalifikationer för att bli framgångsrik denna roll
   

  

 Vi tror att du redan har erfarenhet av att leda komplexa IT tjänster, plattformar eller större outsourcing och managed services leveranser. Du är van att arbeta med många beroenden och intressenter och kan växla mellan strategiska diskussioner med kunden och konkreta frågor tillsammans med leveransorganisationen.
   

  

 Du är bekväm med ekonomi och kommersiella frågor, förstår hur SLA:er, KPI:er, risk, governance och roadmap används för att styra en tjänst och kan omsätta stora mängder information till tydliga prioriteringar och beslut. Du har också tillräcklig teknisk förståelse för att kunna vara en trovärdig motpart i frågor om plattform, integrationer, drift, säkerhet och livscykel.
   

  

 Framför allt söker vi dig som har ett helhetsperspektiv. När ett problem uppstår börjar du med vad det betyder för kunden, verksamheten och betalningsflödet som helhet. Du skapar förtroende genom transparens och tydlighet, vågar prioritera och får människor från olika delar av organisationen att arbeta mot samma mål.
   

  

* Flera års erfarenhet av Service Delivery Management, IT tjänsteledning eller motsvarande
* Erfarenhet av verksamhetskritisk infrastruktur, meriterande med erfarenhet av finansiella tjänster eller andra miljöer med höga krav på tillgänglighet och säkerhet
* Erfarenhet av att leda leveranser med flera team, leverantörer och tekniska beroenden
* God förståelse för ITIL baserad service management, incident , problem , förändrings och kontinuitetshantering
* God förståelse för informationssäkerhet, riskhantering och krav på spårbarhet och regelefterlevnad
* Mycket god svenska och engelska i tal och skrift
* Relevant akademisk utbildning inom IT, systemvetenskap, teknik, ekonomi eller motsvarande kompetens genom arbetslivserfarenhet.


 Säkerhetskrav
   

  

 Eftersom uppdraget omfattas av registerkontroll och säkerhetskrav behöver du kunna genomgå och godkännas i den säkerhetsprövning och registerkontroll som uppdraget kräver. Svenskt medborgarskap är ett krav.
   

  

 Du kommer inte in för att förvalta en statisk leverans. Ambitionen är att leda och utveckla infrastruktur som en sammanhängande produkt där stabil drift, säkerhet och kontinuerlig utveckling går hand i hand. Kundens verksamhetsmål ska kunna följas hela vägen från strategisk dialog till prioriteringar och konkreta aktiviteter i leveransorganisationen.
   

  

 Du får arbeta tillsammans med Operations Manager, arkitekter, tekniska specialister, service management funktioner och andra delar av organisationen för att skapa en robust leverans, en gemensam riktning och ett tydligt ansvar gentemot kunden. Framgång mäts inte bara i gröna SLA:er, utan också i kundvärde, kvalitet, säkerhet, ekonomi och förbättringstakt.
   

  

 Placeringsort: Stockholm
   

  

**Låt oss som ägare omvandla verklig insikt till handling – tillsammans.**
 Livet på CGI bygger på ägande, lagarbete, respekt och tillhörighet. Tillsammans med oss kommer du att kunna nå din fulla potential.
   

  

 Du är inbjuden att ta ägandeskap redan från första dagen i vårt arbete med att förverkliga vår dröm om att skapa en arbetsmiljö där vi trivs med att arbeta tillsammans och bidrar till framgången för vårt företag. Det är därför vi kallar oss CGI Partners snarare än anställda. Vi drar nytta av vår kollektiva framgång och tillsammans får vi möjlighet att aktivt forma vår företagsstrategi och inriktning.
   

  

 Ditt arbete skapar värde. Du kommer att vara med att utveckla innovativa lösningar och bygga relationer med medarbetare och kunder samtidigt som du får tillgång till globala möjligheter att skala upp dina idéer, omfamna nya möjligheter och dra nytta av gedigen bransch- och teknikexpertis.
   

  

 Du kommer att forma din karriär tillsammans med ett företag som är byggt för att växa och bestå. Du får stöd av ledare som bryr sig om din hälsa och ditt välbefinnande och ger dig möjligheter att fördjupa dina kunskaper och vidga dina vyer.
   

  

 Bli en del en av världens största leverantörer av IT- och affärskonsulttjänster.

title: We're not looking for a traditional CTO
description:
*We're looking for someone who leads and sets technical direction in equal measure. Someone who can make hard calls, navigate business trade-offs, and still walk into a room and have a genuinely useful conversation about architecture, credit decisioning, or how AI is changing the way great engineering teams work.*
*That combination is rare. That's why we're writing this.* 
 Few companies at this stage have this much cool stuff ahead of them.
   

  

**The foundation is built. The real expansion starts now.**
 We've already helped a lot of people in debt take back control of their finances. But we're moving to a much larger scale, extending the journey toward lasting financial stability and wellbeing for more people across Europe. We're profitable. We're regulated as a kreditmarknadsbolag, a licence that lets us operate across the entire EU. Germany is growing fast and Sweden and Finland is strong markets. Our 2030 ambition is to be a pan-European company. That future is genuinely exciting and not fully written yet.
   

  

 The team is small and intentionally so. We're not trying to build a massive organisation. We'd rather have fewer people who want to do the exceptional and sometimes the unthinkable. People who trust each other, move fast and care about doing things properly. That's the culture we've built and it's something we're protective of.
   

  

 AI is a big part of how we work. Not just as a strategy, but something that's lived and breathed across engineering, analytics, operations and product development. We're building internal tooling on frontier models and we believe the way strong product and engineering organisations operate is changing quickly. This role requires someone who genuinely believes that too.
   

  

**What The Role Actually Is**
**You'll own the full technology function.** 
 That means setting direction, building the team, making trade-offs between speed and quality, and being a real contributor in leadership discussions about the business, not just the technical ones.
   

  

**This role is inherently cross-functional.** 
 The CTO's scope isn't tech alone, it's how technology creates value across every part of the business. How engineering decisions shape customer behaviour and the product experience. How technical choices affect our ability to expand, comply, and compete.
   

  

 We don't really think of "the business" and "tech" as separate conversations.
   

  

**You'll be close to the work.** 
 Not because we expect you to write production code every day, but because we think good technical leadership requires genuine proximity. Something that's just lived and breathed, not performed. You must be the kind of person who finds that energising rather than beneath them.
   

  

**The problems ahead of us are not just engineering problems.** 
 They're business problems, AI problems, regulatory problems and organisational problems at the same time. Credit decisioning across markets. Payments infrastructure. Scaling internationally. Multilingual AI systems. Understanding how customers actually behave and interact with financial products. Building a team that stays strong as we grow.
   

  

 You'll need to hold all of that.
   

  

**What We Think Matters**
**You've been here before. Y** 
 ou've sat in a leadership team, made decisions that affected the whole business and have managed other leaders. You've scaled an organisation from scrappy to structured, without losing what made it good. If your experience is primarily hands-on engineering management, this probably isn't the right next step.
   

  

**You've scaled a modern B2C product company in fintech** 
 , lending, payments or another regulated financial environment where product, risk and engineering constantly influence each other. You understand the business well enough to have a real opinion in any room, not just the technical ones.
   

  

**You lead well.** 
 Not in a "strong leader" the LinkedIn way. People actually want to work for you and with you. You make decisions, give direction, and create clarity without creating politics.
   

  

**You understand systems** 
 , trade-offs and leverage. You're comfortable making difficult calls with incomplete information and you don't need the picture to be fully clear before you act.
   

  

**You care about impact.** 
 Not just shipping things but actually moving the needle for customers and the business. You know what good looks like and it bothers you when things aren't and you don't really know how to turn that off. That's just how you're wired.
   

  

**And you're genuinely excited by AI** 
 . Not just following the discourse, but actually building with it, thinking about it, and probably annoying people at dinner parties with it. You're the person who can't stop thinking about what it changes. For products, for engineering teams, for financial services, and probably for a lot of other things too.
   

  

**Technically** 
 , we work with TypeScript, Python, Go, GraphQL, React Native, Kubernetes, BigQuery and GCP. The stack matters less than the judgment you bring to it.
   

  

**This role is based in Stockholm** 
 . We're at a stage where leadership needs to be embedded, close to the teams and part of how the culture develops. That's not negotiable, but we think if this role is right for you, it won't feel like a compromise.
   

  

**We offer a competitive salary and meaningful equity.** 
 This is real skin in the game, we're profitable and growing, and we want you to feel that.
   

  

 If this sounds like the kind of problem you want to work on, we'd like to hear from you.
   

  

 Anyfin is a fintech on a mission to simplify loan repayments and improve the financial well-being of millions. We help consumers reduce the costs of high-interest loans, and take control of their repayment plan.

title: Workspace Security Sales Specialist
description:
At Check Point, what you do matters. Every day, we protect over 100,000 organizations worldwide from increasingly sophisticated cyber and AI-driven threats, securing their AI transformation.
   

  

 Our prevention-first approach safeguards hybrid networks, cloud environments, digital workspaces, and AI systems, stopping attacks before they happen.
   

  

 This is where innovation meets real-world impact. You’ll help customers across industries operate with confidence in a rapidly changing digital world, working alongside smart, curious people who take ownership, challenge assumptions, and solve complex problems.
   

  

 We’re proud to be recognized by TIME, Newsweek, and Forbes for excellence and workplace culture.
   

  

 What really sets Check Point apart is the opportunity to grow, contribute, and help companies navigate their AI transformation securely.
   

  

 If you’re excited to work at the forefront of AI-driven security on a global scale, this is the place to do it.
   

  

**Job Description**
* Build new-logo Workspace business across Sweden and Norway, focused on enterprise organisations of 2,500+ seats.
* Create your own pipeline through focused account selection, direct outreach, trigger-based prospecting and effective use of SDR, Marketing and local account introductions.
* Lead Workspace opportunities from first meaningful customer engagement through discovery, assessment, commercial process and close.
* Use evidence-led motions such as the Email Security Annual Checkup to turn assumptions into measurable customer outcomes.
* Identify incumbent email-security platforms, renewal timing and buying triggers to create competitive displacement opportunities.
* Build relationships with CISOs, CIOs, Heads of Security and senior IT stakeholders and translate technical capability into a clear business case.
* Run a disciplined territory with strong pipeline hygiene, accurate forecasting and clear next steps.


**Qualifications**
* 5+ years of B2B technology sales experience, including meaningful enterprise SaaS and cyber security exposure.
* Comfort creating pipeline yourself rather than relying mainly on inbound, channel or inherited accounts.
* Experience selling subscription / ARR-based enterprise software, ideally with opportunities in the $100K-$500K+ range.
* Strong discovery, multi-threading, value creation, negotiation and closing skills.
* Credibility with senior security and IT stakeholders without needing to be the deepest technical expert in the room.
* A practical, self-directed working style: you move with pace, but you also run a structured and forecastable sales process.
* Fluent English. Swedish is strongly preferred; Norwegian is a useful advantage. Based in the Stockholm area and comfortable travelling regularly across Sweden and Norway.

title: IT Compliance Manager
description:
Vill du vara med och skapa en säker, hållbar och smart digital framtid – på riktigt?
   

  

**Är du personen som inte bara kan regelverken, utan faktiskt gillar att få dem att fungera i vardagen? Perfekt** 
 –
 **för hos oss får du chansen att göra just det.**
**Som IT Compliance Manager kliver du rakt in i hjärtat av vår IT-organisation och ser till att våra kontroller, rutiner och rapportering håller toppklass. Det här är en IT-nära roll där du både driver arbetet framåt och själv är med och genomför det i praktiken. Du jobbar tätt ihop med drift, säkerhet, utveckling och vår centrala risk- och compliancefunktion och blir en viktig del av vårt arbete med att bygga en robust digital miljö.**
 Försäkringar och hälsa är en vinnande kombination! Genom tidiga insatser, samarbete med kompetenta partners och smarta digitala tjänster har vi på Euro Accident fått saker att hända. Med vårt erbjudande har försäkring gått från att bara vara ekonomisk ersättning till att bidra till livskvalitet och Hållbara medarbetare. Idag har nästan en halv miljon människor trygghet genom oss. Vi är stolta över våra nöjda kunder, vårt goda rykte och den insats vi gör för samhället. Nu avancerar vi för att kunna hjälpa ännu fler och söker dig som vill vara med på vår fortsatta framgångsresa.
   

  

 Om rollen
   

  

 Det här är en roll där du får både ansvar och möjlighet att påverka. Du omsätter regelverk som DORA och GDPR till lösningar som fungerar i praktiken och gör skillnad i vardagen, från struktur och uppföljning till det operativa genomförandet.
   

  

 Du blir en central aktör i allt från revisioner och kontroller till införande av AI‑rutiner, och har stora möjligheter att påverka hur IT arbetar med compliance framåt.Du blir en central aktör i allt från revisioner och kontroller till införande av AI‑rutiner, och har stora möjligheter att påverka hur IT arbetar med compliance framåt.
   

  

**Det Här Kommer Du Att Göra**
* Bygga, utveckla och förbättra IT-kontroller (t.ex. accesshantering, backup, change management) – gärna med smart automatisering.
* Själv genomföra kontroller och tester, samla bevis, följa upp avvikelser och driva åtgärder hela vägen i mål.
* Göra regelverk som DORA och GDPR begripliga och användbara i vardagen.
* Planera och driva interna och externa IT-revisioner – från start till genomförd förbättring.
* Vara med och forma hur vi arbetar med AI utifrån DORA och AI Act.
* Bidra i uppföljningen av IT-leverantörer och säkerställa att krav, kontroller och dokumentation finns på plats.
* Höja kunskapsnivån i organisationen genom workshops, mallar och konkreta verktyg.


 Vem är du?
   

  

 Vi tror att du har några års erfarenhet av IT-compliance, IT-revision eller internkontroll – och en vilja att jobba nära verksamheten med händerna i det operativa. Du trivs i en roll där du både skapar struktur, driver frågor framåt och själv bidrar när kontroller, dokumentation och uppföljning behöver komma på plats
   

  

**Vi Ser Att Du Har**
* Erfarenhet av DORA, GDPR, NIS2 eller liknande ramverk.
* Grundläggande förståelse för cybersäkerhet, incidenthantering och ramverk som CIS Controls.
* Mycket god svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.


**Ett Extra Plus Om Du Har**
* Bakgrund inom IT-revision men vill arbeta närmare implementering, uppföljning och praktiskt förbättringsarbete.
* Erfarenhet från någon av Big4, PwC, EY, Deloitte, KPMG eller annan liknande konsultverksamhet.
* Erfarenhet från finans eller annan reglerad bransch.
* Jobbat med automatiserade kontroller eller rapporteringsverktyg.


 Som person är du strukturerad, kommunikativ och gillar att göra komplex information begriplig. Du drivs av samarbete, nyfikenhet och att skapa verklig nytta. Du delar självklart våra värderingar: omtanke, handlingskraft och nytänkande – vår kompass i vardagen.
   

  

 På Euro Accident är det vi medarbetare som bygger framgång. Personliga egenskaper och förmågor är alltid en viktig komponent när vi söker nya medarbetare.
   

  

 Vi erbjuder dig
   

  

 När vi bidrar till en trygg och frisk värld börjar vi på våra egna kontor. Vi vill att du ska få och välja en sund balans mellan arbete och privatliv och vi värnar om arbetsglädjen och vår unika kultur där omtanke, handlingskraft och nytänkande är våra ledord i vardagen. Vi erbjuder förmånlig tjänstepension, sjuk- och sjukvårdsförsäkring samt ett generöst friskvårdsbidrag och möjlighet till hybridarbete. Med vår EA-spirit håller vi kulturen och gemenskapen levande genom olika sociala aktiviteter, som gemensamma frukostar, afterworks och föreläsningar med tema hälsa och välmående.
   

  

 Du välkomnas till vårt trivsamma kontor vid Mörby C. Start enligt överenskommelse. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid.
   

  

 Välkommen med din ansökan
   

  

 Om du har frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta Emil Berntling eller Lovisa Larsson enligt kontaktuppgifterna nedan. Urval sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, så vänta inte med din ansökan.
   

  

 För en mer rättvis och objektiv urvalsprocess använder vi arbetspsykologiska tester tidigt i processen och ber dig att svara på våra urvalsfrågor i stället för att bifoga ett personligt brev.
   

  

 Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomför vi bakgrundskontroller av våra slutkandidater före anställningsbeslut.
   

  

*Vi tror att mångfald skapar starkare team. Vi välkomnar alla sökande och arbetar aktivt för en jämn könsfördelning och en inkluderande arbetsplats.*
 Vi är stolta över att ha fått denna utmärkelse av Karriärföretagen, som varje år lyfter fram de arbetsgivare i Sverige som utmärker sig inom HR, talent management och employer branding. För oss är det en fantastiskt fin bekräftelse på det målmedvetna arbete vi gör som arbetsgivare.
   

  

  

  

 Hållbara medarbetare är fokus i allt vi gör – från våra förstklassiga försäkringar till vår egen kultur. Vi tar bort alla onödiga o:n, så att fler kan må bra och känna sig trygga i sin vardag. Vill du vara en del av det arbetet? Utforska våra lediga tjänster eller läs mer om hur det är att arbeta hos oss. Ditt nästa steg i karriären kan börja hos oss!
   

  

  

  

 Vill du vara en del av vårt nätverk? Skapa kontakt med oss och berätta vilket område du är intresserad av. På så sätt håller du dig uppdaterad om framtida jobbmöjligheter som matchar din profil – enkelt och smidigt!

title: Verksamhetsområdeschef till Arbetsförmedlingens VO IT
description:
Arbetsförmedlingen fortsätter att utveckla verksamhet, arbetssätt och service för att möta förändrade behov. Digitalisering, data, automatisering och ny teknik skapar stora möjligheter – men värdet uppstår först när de används för att lösa verkliga behov, förbättra verksamheten och skapa resultat för människor, arbetsgivare och samhället.
   

  





 Vi söker nu en verksamhetsområdeschef som vill leda Arbetsförmedlingens IT-verksamhet i den riktningen.
   

  





****Om verksamhetsområde IT****




 Verksamhetsområde IT ansvarar för Arbetsförmedlingens samlade IT-verksamhet och för att skapa de tekniska förutsättningarna för myndighetens digitala utveckling. Det omfattar bland annat att utveckla och förvalta digital service, automatisering och IT-stöd utifrån verksamhetens behov. IT ska bidra till effektiv, rättssäker och korrekt handläggning.
   

  





 Verksamhetsområdet ansvarar också för IT-styrning, produktstyrning samt för att utveckla och förvalta IT-arkitektur och den tekniska målbilden i linje med myndighetens övergripande inriktning. I uppdraget ingår även digital samverkan och informationsutbyte med andra myndigheter, offentliga aktörer och samarbetspartners samt arbete med öppna data.
   

  





 En viktig del av uppdraget är att säkerställa en ändamålsenlig nivå av säkerhet och motståndskraft i myndighetens IT-miljö samt att data och ny teknik används på ett ansvarsfullt, rättssäkert och värdeskapande sätt, i linje med den statliga värdegrunden och de krav som gäller för offentlig verksamhet.
   

  





 IT-verksamheten omfattar drygt 800 medarbetare, fördelade på fyra avdelningar och 18 enheter med tillhörande sektioner.
   

  





****Ditt uppdrag****




 Som verksamhetsområdeschef leder du en stor och komplex organisation i förändring. Du utvecklar organisationens förmåga och kultur samt skapar förutsättningar för medarbetare och chefer att ta ansvar, samarbeta och åstadkomma resultat.
   

  





 Du är en tydlig och trygg förändringsledare som kan utmana etablerade arbetssätt, fatta beslut och hålla riktningen även när förutsättningarna förändras. Du bygger tillit genom dialog, transparens och tydliga mandat och leder genom andra genom att skapa engagemang, riktning och ansvar.
   

  





 Du ser hela Arbetsförmedlingen som ditt uppdrag och arbetar aktivt över organisatoriska gränser. Du skapar starka partnerskap och får andra att vilja bidra till gemensamma mål.
   

  





 Som medlem i generaldirektörens ledningsgrupp tar du ansvar för myndighetens samlade resultat och utveckling. Du behöver därför kunna se bortom den egna organisationen och omsätta teknikens möjligheter till verksamhetsnytta, med tydlig koppling till Arbetsförmedlingens uppdrag, mål och prioriteringar.
   

  





 Som statlig myndighet har Arbetsförmedlingen ett särskilt ansvar för att använda information, data och offentliga resurser på ett ansvarsfullt sätt.
